verses.text: Bismi ail laahi air-rahmaani air-raheem
Ail hamdu lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Aar-rahmaani air-raheem
Mal iki yawmi aid-deen
'iyyaaka na'budu waiyyaaka nasta'een
Auhdinaa aas-siraata aal mustaqeem
Siraata aal zeena 'an'amta 'al ayhim
Ghayri ail maghdoobi 'al ayhim wal aa aad-daal leen
'al aammiaa zaal ika aal kitaabu laa rayba feehi huda llil muttaqeen
Aal zeena yu'minoona bial ghaybi wayuqeemoona aas-sal awaata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Waal zeena yu'minoona bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka wamaa 'unzil a min qablika wabial aakhirati hum yooqinoon
'ul aa'ika 'al aa huda mmir rrabbihim waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
'inna aal zeena kafaru sawaa'un 'al ayhim 'aanzartahum 'am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon
Khatama aal laahu 'al aa qul oobihim wa'al aa sam'ihim wa'al aa 'absaarihim ghishaawat wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Wamina aan-naasi many yyaqoolu 'aamannaa bial laahi wabial yawmi ail aakhiri wamaa hum bimu'mineen
Yukhaadi'oona aal laaha waal zeena 'aamanu wamaa yukhaadi'oona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
Fi qul oobihim mmarad fazaadahumu aul laahu marada wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eemu bimaa kaanu yukazziboon
Waizaa qeela lahum laa tufsidu fi ail ardi qaal u 'innamaa nahnu muslihoon
'al aa 'innahum humu aul mufsidoona wal aakil llaa yash'uroon
Waizaa qeela lahum 'aaminu kamaa 'aamana aan-naasu qaal u 'anu'minu kamaa 'aamana aas-sufahaa'u aal aa 'innahum humu aus-sufahaa'u wal aakil llaa ya'lamoon
Waizaa laqu aul zeena 'aamanu qaal u 'aamannaa waizaa khal awa 'il aa shayaateenihim qaal u 'innaa ma'akum 'innamaa nahnu mustahzi'oon
Aal laahu yastahziu bihim wayamudduhum fi tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
'ul aa'ika aal zeena aashtarawua aud-dal aal ata bial hudaa famaa rabihat ttijaaratuhum wamaa kaanu muhtadeen
Mathal uhum kamathal i ail zi aistawqada naara fal ammaa 'adaa'at maa hawlahu zahaba aal laahu binoorihim watarakahum fi zul umaat llaa yubsiroon
Summu bukmun 'umy fahum laa yarji'oon
'aw kasayyib mmina aas-samaa'i feehi zul umaat wara'd wabarq yaj'al oona 'asaabi'ahum fi 'aazaanihim mmina aas-sawaa'iqi hazara aal mawti waal laahu muheetu bial kaafireen

Yakaadu aul barqu yakhtafu 'absaarahum kul lamaa 'adaa'a lahum mmashawa feehi waizaa 'azlama 'al ayhim qaamu wal aw shaa'a aal laahu lazahaba bisam'ihim waabsaarihim 'inna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu au'budu rabbakumu aul zi khal aqakum waal zeena min qablikum la'al lakum tattaqoon
Aal zi ja'al a lakumu aul arda firaasha waas-samaa'a binaa' waanzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faakhraja bihi mina aath-thamaraati rizqa llakum fal aa taj'al u lil hi 'andaada waantum ta'lamoon
Wain kuntum fi rayb mmimmaa nazzal naa 'al aa 'abdinaa fatu bisoorat mmim mmithlihi waad'u shuhadaa'akum mmin dooni ail laahi 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fail llam taf'al u wal an taf'al u faattaqu aun-naara aal ti waqooduhaa aan-naasu waal hijaaratu 'u'iddat lil kaafireen

Wabashshiri ail zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati 'anna lahum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru kul lamaa ruziqu minhaa min thamarat rrizqa qaal u haazaa aal zi ruziqnaa min qablu wautu bihi mutashaabiha wal ahum feehaa 'azwaaj mmutahharat wahum feehaa khaal idoon

'inna aal laaha laa yastahyi 'any yyadriba mathal a mmaa ba'oodat famaa fawqahaa faammaa aal zeena 'aamanu faya'lamoona 'annahu aul haqqu mir rrabbihim waammaa aal zeena kafaru fayaqooloona maazaa 'araada aal laahu bihaazaa mathal a yudil lu bihi katheera wayahdi bihi katheera wamaa yudil lu bihi 'il laa aal faasiqeen
Aal zeena yanqudoona 'ahda aal laahi mim ba'di meethaaqihi wayaqta'oona maa 'amara aal laahu bihi 'any yyoosal a wayufsidoona fi ail ardi 'ul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
Kayfa takfuroona bial laahi wakuntum 'amwaata faahyaakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum thumma 'il ayhi turja'oon
Hooa aal zi khal aqa lakum mmaa fi ail ardi jamee'a thumma aastawaa 'il aa aas-samaa'i fasawwayaahunna sab'a samaawaat wahwa bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Waiz qaal a rabbuka lil mal aa'ikati 'inni jaa'il fi ail ardi khal eefat qaal u 'ataj'al u feehaa many yyufsidu feehaa wayasfiku aud-dimaa'a wanahnu nusabbihu bihamdika wanuqaddisu laka qaal a 'inneea 'a'lamu maa laa ta'lamoon
Wa'al lama 'aadama aal asmaa'a kul laahaa thumma 'aradahum 'al aa aal mal aa'ikati faqaal a 'anbiooni biasmaa'i haa'ul aa 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qaal u subhaanaka laa 'il ma lanaa 'il laa maa 'al lamtanaa 'innaka 'anta aal'al eemu aul hakeem
Qaal a yaadamu 'anbeehum biasmaa'ihim fal ammaa 'anbaahum biasmaa'ihim qaal a 'al am 'aqul-lakum 'inneea 'a'lamu ghayba aas-samaawaati waal ardi waa'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa kuntum taktumoon
Waiz qul naa lil mal aa'ikati aisjudu liaadama fasajadu 'il laa 'ibleesa 'abaa waastakbara wakaana mina aal kaafireen
Waqul naa yaadamu auskun 'anta wazawjuka aal jannata wakul aa minhaa raghadaan haythu sheetumaa wal aa taqrabaa haazihi aish-shajarata fatakoonaa mina aaz-zaal imeen
Faazal laahumaa aash-shaytaanu 'anhaa faakhrajahumaa mimmaa kaanaa feehi waqul naa aahbitu ba'dukum liba'din 'adoow wal akum fi ail ardi mustaqarr wamataa'un 'il aa heen
Fatal aqqaa 'aadamu mir rrabbihi kal imaat fataaba 'al ayhi 'innahu hooa aat-tawwaabu aur-raheem
Qul naa aahbitu minhaa jamee'a faimmaa yateeannakum mminni huda faman tabi'a hudaya fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Waal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Yaabani 'israa'eela aazkuru ni'mateea aal ti 'an'amtu 'al aykum waawfu bi'ahdi 'oofi bi'ahdikum waiyyaya faarhaboon
Wa'aaminu bimaa 'anzal tu musaddiqa llimaa ma'akum wal aa takoonu 'awwal a kaafiri bihi wal aa tashtaru biayaati thamana qal eela waiyyaya faattaqoon
Wal aa tal bisu aul haqqa bial baatil i wataktumu aul haqqa waantum ta'lamoon
Waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata waarka'u ma'a aar-raaki'een
'atamuroona aan-naasa bial birri watansawna 'anfusakum waantum tatloona aal kitaaba 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Waasta'eenu bias-sabri waas-sal aati wainnahaa lakabeeratun 'il laa 'al aa aal khaashi'een
Aal zeena yazunnoona 'annahum mmul aaqu rabbihim waannahum 'il ayhi raaji'oon
Yaabani 'israa'eela aazkuru ni'mateea aal ti 'an'amtu 'al aykum waanni faddal tukum 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Waattaqu yawma llaa tajzi nafsun 'an nnafs shaya wal aa yuqbal u minhaa shafaa'at wal aa yu'khazu minhaa 'adl wal aa hum yunsaroon
Waiz najjaynaakum mmin 'aal i fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooaa'a aal'azaabi yuzabbihoona 'abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum wafi zaal ikum bal aa' mmir rrabbikum 'azeem
Waiz faraqnaa bikumu aul bahra faanjaynaakum waaghraqnaa 'aal a fir'awna waantum tanzuroon
Waiz waa'adnaa moosaa 'arba'eena laylat thumma aattakhazttumu aul'ijla mim ba'dihi waantum zaal imoon
Thumma 'afawnaa 'ankum mmim ba'di zaal ika la'al lakum tashkuroon
Waiz 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba waal furqaana la'al lakum tahtadoon

Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi yaaqawmi 'innakum zal amtum 'anfusakum biattikhaazikumu aul'ijla fatoobu 'il aa baari'ikum faaqtul u 'anfusakum zaal ikum khayr llakum 'inda baari'ikum fataaba 'al aykum 'innahu hooa aat-tawwaabu aur-raheem
Waiz qul tum yaamoosaa lan nnu'mina laka hattaa naraa aal laaha jahrat faakhazatkumu aus-saa'iqatu waantum tanzuroon
Thumma ba'athnaakum mmim ba'di mawtikum la'al lakum tashkuroon
Wazal lal naa 'al aykumu aul ghamaama waanzal naa 'al aykumu aul manna waas-sal waa kul u min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum wamaa zal amoonaa wal aakin kaanu 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Waiz qul naa aadkhul u haazihi ail qaryata fakul u minhaa haythu sheetum raghada waadkhul u aul baaba sujjada waqoolu hittat yughfar lakum khatayaakum wasanazeedu aul muhsineen
Fabaddal a aal zeena zal amu qawlaan ghayra aal zi qeela lahum faanzal naa 'al aa aal zeena zal amu rijza mmina aas-samaa'i bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon

Waizi aistasqaa moosaa liqawmihi faqul naa aadrib bbi'asaaka aal hajara faanfajarat minhu authnataa 'ashrata 'ayna qad 'al ima kul lu 'unaas mmashrabahum kul u waashrabu mir rrizqi ail laahi wal aa ta'thawa fi ail ardi mufsideen

Waiz qul tum yaamoosaa lan nnasbira 'al aa ta'aam waahid faad'u lanaa rabbaka yukhrij lanaa mimmaa tunbitu aul ardu mim baqlihaa waqiththaa'ihaa wafoomihaa wa'adasihaa wabasal ihaa qaal a 'atastabdil oona aal zi hooa 'adnaa bial zi hooa khayrun aihbitu misra fainna lakum mmaa saal tum waduribat 'al ayhimu auz-zil latu waal maskanatu wabaa'oo bighadab mmina aal laahi zaal ika biannahum kaanu yakfuroona biayaati ail laahi wayaqtul oona aan-nabeeaaina bighayri ail haqqi zaal ika bimaa 'asa wwakaanu ya'tadoon

'inna aal zeena 'aamanu waal zeena haadu waan-nasaaraa waas-saabeena man 'aamana bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wa'amil a saal iha fal ahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Waiz 'akhaznaa meethaaqakum warafa'naa fawqakumu aut-toora khuzu maa 'aataynaakum biqoowat waazkuru maa feehi la'al lakum tattaqoon
Thumma tawal laytum mmim ba'di zaal ika fal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu lakuntum mmina aal khaasireen
Wal aqad 'al imtumu aul zeena aa'tadawa minkum fi ais-sabti faqul naa lahum koonu qiradatan khaasieen
Faja'al naahaa nakaal a llimaa bayna yadayhaa wamaa khal fahaa wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen
Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi 'inna aal laaha yamurukum 'an tazbahu baqarat qaal u 'atattakhizunaa huzu'a qaal a 'a'oozu bial laahi 'an 'akoona mina aal jaahil een
Qaal u aud'u lanaa rabbaka yubayyil llanaa maa heea qaal a 'innahu yaqoolu 'innahaa baqarat llaa faarid wal aa bikrun 'awaanu bayna zaal ika faaf'al u maa tu'maroon
Qaal u aud'u lanaa rabbaka yubayyil llanaa maa lawnuhaa qaal a 'innahu yaqoolu 'innahaa baqarat safraa'u faaqi' llawnuhaa tasurru aun-naazireen
Qaal u aud'u lanaa rabbaka yubayyil llanaa maa heea 'inna aal baqara tashaabaha 'al aynaa wainnaa 'in shaa'a aal laahu lamuhtadoon
Qaal a 'innahu yaqoolu 'innahaa baqarat llaa zal ool tutheeru aul arda wal aa tasqi ail hartha musal lamat llaa sheeata feehaa qaal u au'al aana jeeta bial haqqi fazabahoohaa wamaa kaadu yaf'al oon
Waiz qatal tum nafsa faaddaaraa'tum feehaa waal laahu mukhrij mmaa kuntum taktumoon
Faqul naa aadriboohu biba'dihaa kazaal ika yuhyi ail laahu aul mawtaa wayureekum 'ayaatihi la'al lakum ta'qil oon

Thumma qasat qul oobukum mmim ba'di zaal ika fahya kaal hijaarati 'aw 'ashaddu qaswat wainna mina aal hijaarati lamaa yatafajjaru minhu aul anhaaru wainna minhaa lamaa yashshaqqaqu fayakhruju minhu aul maa'u wainna minhaa lamaa yahbitu min khashyati ail laahi wamaa aal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
'afatatma'oona 'any yyu'minu lakum waqad kaana fareeq mminhum yasma'oona kal aama aal laahi thumma yuharrifoonahu mim ba'di maa 'aqal oohu wahum ya'lamoon
Waizaa laqu aul zeena 'aamanu qaal u 'aamannaa waizaa khal aa ba'duhum 'il aa ba'd qaal u 'atuhaddithoonahum bimaa fataha aal laahu 'al aykum leeuhaajjookum bihi 'inda rabbikum 'afal aa ta'qil oon
'awal aa ya'lamoona 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoon
Waminhum 'ummeeyoona laa ya'lamoona aal kitaaba 'il laa 'amaaniyya wain hum 'il laa yazunnoon

Fawayl llil zeena yaktuboona aal kitaaba biaydeehim thumma yaqooloona haazaa min 'indi ail laahi leeashtaru bihi thamana qal eela fawayl llaahum mmimmaa katabat 'aydeehim wawayl llaahum mmimmaa yaksiboon
Waqaal u lan tamassanaa aan-naaru 'il laa 'ayyaama mma'doodat qul 'attakhazttum 'inda aal laahi 'ahda fal any yyukhlifa aal laahu 'ahdahu 'am taqooloona 'al aa aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Bal aa man kasaba sayyeeat waahaatat bihi khateeaatuhu faul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon

Waiz 'akhaznaa meethaaqa bani 'israa'eela laa ta'budoona 'il laa aal laaha wabial waal idayni 'ihsaana wazi ail qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeeni waqoolu lin-naasi husna waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata thumma tawal laytum 'il laa qal eela mminkum waantum mmu'ridoon
Waiz 'akhaznaa meethaaqakum laa tasfikoona dimaa'akum wal aa tukhrijoona 'anfusakum mmin deeaarikum thumma 'aqrartum waantum tashhadoon

Thumma 'antum haa'ul aa'i taqtul oona 'anfusakum watukhrijoona fareeqa mminkum mmin deeaarihim tazzaaharoona 'al ayhim bial ithmi waal'udwaani wainy yyatookum 'usaaraa tufaadoohum wahwa muharramun 'al aykum 'ikhraajuhum 'afatu'minoona biba'di ail kitaabi watakfuroona biba'd famaa jazaa'u many yyaf'al u zaal ika minkum 'il laa khizy fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wayawma aal qeeaamati yuraddoona 'il aa 'ashaddi ail'azaabi wamaa aal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ya'mal oon
'ul aa'ika aal zeena aashtarawua aul hayawaata aad-dunyaa bial aakhirati fal aa yukhaffafu 'anhumu aul'azaabu wal aa hum yunsaroon

Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba waqaffaynaa mim ba'dihi biar-rusul i wa'aataynaa 'eesaa aabna maryama aal bayyinaati wayyadnaahu biroohi ail qudusi 'afakul lamaa jaa'akum rasoolu bimaa laa tahwaa 'anfusukumu austakbartum fafareeqa kazzabtum wafareeqa taqtul oon
Waqaal u qul oobunaa ghul fu bal-la'anahumu aul laahu bikufrihim faqal eela mmaa yu'minoon

Wal ammaa jaa'ahum kitaab mmin 'indi ail laahi musaddiq llimaa ma'ahum wakaanu min qablu yastaftihoona 'al aa aal zeena kafaru fal ammaa jaa'ahum mmaa 'arafu kafaru bihi fal a'natu aul laahi 'al aa aal kaafireen

Beesamaa aashtarawa bihi 'anfusahum 'any yyakfuru bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu baghyaan 'any yyunazzil a aal laahu min fadlihi 'al aa many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi fabaa'oo bighadabin 'al aa ghadab wal il kaafireena 'azaab mmuheen

Waizaa qeela lahum 'aaminu bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu qaal u nu'minu bimaa 'unzil a 'al aynaa wayakfuroona bimaa waraa'ahu wahwa aal haqqu musaddiqa llimaa ma'ahum qul fal ima taqtul oona 'anbeeaa'a aal laahi min qablu 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wal aqad jaa'akum mmoosaa bial bayyinaati thumma aattakhazttumu aul'ijla mim ba'dihi waantum zaal imoon

Waiz 'akhaznaa meethaaqakum warafa'naa fawqakumu aut-toora khuzu maa 'aataynaakum biqoowat waasma'u qaal u sami'naa wa'asaynaa waushribu fi qul oobihimu aul'ijla bikufrihim qul beesamaa yamurukum bihi 'eemaanukum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Qul 'in kaanat lakumu aud-daaru aul aakhiratu 'inda aal laahi khaal isat mmin dooni ain-naasi fatamannawua aul mawta 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Wal any yyatamannawhu 'abadaa bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim waal laahu 'al eemu biaz-zaal imeen

Wal atajidannahum 'ahrasa aan-naasi 'al aa hayawaat wamina aal zeena 'ashraku yawaddu 'ahaduhum law yu'ammaru 'al fa sanat wamaa hooa bimuzahzihihi mina aal'azaabi 'any yyu'ammara waal laahu baseeru bimaa ya'mal oon
Qul man kaana 'adoowa llijibreela fainnahu nazzal ahu 'al aa qal bika biizni ail laahi musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi wahuda wabushraa lil mu'mineen
Man kaana 'adoowa llil hi wamal aa'ikatihi warusul ihi wajibreela wameekaa'il a fainna aal laaha 'adoow llil kaafireen
Wal aqad 'anzal naa 'il ayka 'ayaati bayyinaat wamaa yakfuru bihaa 'il laa aal faasiqoon
'awakul lamaa 'aahadu 'ahda nnabazahu fareeq mminhum bal 'aktharuhum laa yu'minoon
Wal ammaa jaa'ahum rasool mmin 'indi ail laahi musaddiq llimaa ma'ahum nabaza fareeq mmina aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba kitaaba aal laahi waraa'a zuhoorihim kaannahum laa ya'lamoon

Waattaba'u maa tatlu aush-shayaateenu 'al aa mul ki sul aymaana wamaa kafara sul aymaanu wal aakinna aash-shayaateena kafaru yu'al limoona aan-naasa aas-sihra wamaa 'unzil a 'al aa aal mal akayni bibaabil a haaroota wamaaroota wamaa yu'al limaani min 'ahadin hattaa yaqoolaa 'innamaa nahnu fitnat fal aa takfur fayata'al lamoona minhumaa maa yufarriqoona bihi bayna aal mar'i wazawjihi wamaa hum bidaarreena bihi min 'ahadin 'il laa biizni ail laahi wayata'al lamoona maa yadurruhum wal aa yanfa'uhum wal aqad 'al imu lamani aishtarayaahu maa lahu fi ail aakhirati min khal aaq wal abeesa maa sharawa bihi 'anfusahum law kaanu ya'lamoon
Wal aw 'annahum 'aamanu waattaqawa lamathoobat mmin 'indi ail laahi khayr llaw kaanu ya'lamoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa taqoolu raa'inaa waqoolu aunzurnaa waasma'u wal il kaafireena 'azaabun 'al eem

Mmaa yawaddu aul zeena kafaru min 'ahli ail kitaabi wal aa aal mushrikeena 'any yyunazzal a 'al aykum mmin khayr mmir rrabbikum waal laahu yakhtassu birahmatihi many yyashaa'u waal laahu zoo aul fadli ail'azeem
Maa nansakh min 'ayatin 'aw nunsihaa nati bikhayr mminhaa 'aw mithlihaa 'al am ta'lam 'anna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
'al am ta'lam 'anna aal laaha lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa lakum mmin dooni ail laahi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer
'am tureedoona 'an tasal u rasoolakum kamaa su'il a moosaa min qablu wamany yyatabaddal i ail kufra bial eemaani faqad dal la sawaa'a aas-sabeel

Wadda katheer mmin 'ahli ail kitaabi law yaruddoonakum mmim ba'di 'eemaanikum kuffaaraan hasada mmin 'indi 'anfusihim mmim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumu aul haqqu faa'fu waasfahu hattaa yateea aal laahu biamrihi 'inna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata wamaa tuqaddimu lianfusikum mmin khayr tajidoohu 'inda aal laahi 'inna aal laaha bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Waqaal u lany yyadkhul a aal jannata 'il laa man kaana hoodaan 'aw nasaaraa til ka 'amaaneeyuhum qul haatu burhaanakum 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal aa man 'aslama wajhahu lil hi wahwa muhsin fal ahu 'ajruhu 'inda rabbihi wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon

Waqaal ati ail yahoodu laysati ain-nasaaraa 'al aa sha' waqaal ati ain-nasaaraa laysati ail yahoodu 'al aa sha' wahum yatloona aal kitaaba kazaal ika qaal a aal zeena laa ya'lamoona mithla qawlihim faal laahu yahkumu baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon

Waman 'azlamu mimmam mmana'a masaajida aal laahi 'any yyuzkara feehaa aasmuhu wasa'aa fi kharaabihaa 'ul aa'ika maa kaana lahum 'any yyadkhul oohaa 'il laa khaa'ifeena lahum fi aid-dunyaa khizy wal ahum fi ail aakhirati 'azaabun 'azeem
Wal il hi ail mashriqu waal maghribu faynamaa tooal lu fathamma wajhu aul laahi 'inna aal laaha waasi'un 'al eem
Waqaal u auttakhaza aal laahu wal ada subhaanahu bal-laahu maa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi kul l llaahu qaanitoon
Badee'u aus-samaawaati waal ardi waizaa qadaa 'amra fainnamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon

Waqaal a aal zeena laa ya'lamoona lawlaa yukal limunaa aal laahu 'aw tateenaa 'ayat kazaal ika qaal a aal zeena min qablihim mmithla qawlihim tashaabahat qul oobuhum qad bayyannaa aal ayaati liqawm yooqinoon
'innaa 'arsal naaka bial haqqi basheera wanazeera wal aa tasal 'an 'ashaabi ail jaheem

Wal an tardaa 'anka aal yahoodu wal aa aan-nasaaraa hattaa tattabi'a mil latahum qul 'inna hudaa aal laahi hooa aal hudaa wal a'ini aittaba'ta 'ahwaa'ahum ba'da aal zi jaa'aka mina aal'il mi maa laka mina aal laahi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer
Ail zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba yatloonahu haqqa til aawatihi 'ul aa'ika yu'minoona bihi wamany yyakfur bihi faul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
Yaabani 'israa'eela aazkuru ni'mateea aal ti 'an'amtu 'al aykum waanni faddal tukum 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Waattaqu yawma llaa tajzi nafsun 'an nnafs shaya wal aa yuqbal u minhaa 'adl wal aa tanfa'uhaa shafaa'at wal aa hum yunsaroon
Waizi aibtal aa 'ibraaheema rabbuhu bikal imaat faatammahunna qaal a 'inni jaa'il uka lin-naasi 'imaama qaal a wamin zurriyyati qaal a laa yanaal u 'ahdeea aaz-zaal imeen

Waiz ja'al naa aal bayta mathaabat llin-naasi waamna waattakhazu mim mmaqaami 'ibraaheema musal la wa'ahidnaa 'il aa 'ibraaheema waismaa'eela 'an tahhiraa bayteea lit-taa'ifeena waal'aakifeena waar-rukka'i ais-sujood

Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu rabbi aij'al haazaa bal adaan 'aamina waarzuq 'ahlahu mina aath-thamaraati man 'aamana minhum bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri qaal a waman kafara faumatti'uhu qal eela thumma 'adtarruhu 'il aa 'azaabi ain-naari wabeesa aal maseer
Waiz yarfa'u 'ibraaheemu aul qawaa'ida mina aal bayti waismaa'eelu rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa 'innaka 'anta aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Rabbanaa waaj'al naa muslimayni laka wamin zurriyyatinaa 'ummat mmuslimat llaka waarinaa manaasikanaa watub 'al aynaa 'innaka 'anta aat-tawwaabu aur-raheem
Rabbanaa waab'ath feehim rasoola mminhum yatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatika wayu'al limuhumu aul kitaaba waal hikmata wayuzakkeehim 'innaka 'anta aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Wamany yyarghabu 'am mmil lati 'ibraaheema 'il laa man safiha nafsahu wal aqadi aistafaynaahu fi aid-dunyaa wainnahu fi ail aakhirati lamina aas-saal iheen
'iz qaal a lahu rabbuhu 'aslim qaal a 'aslamtu lirabbi ail'aal ameen
Waawsaa bihaa 'ibraaheemu baneehi waya'qoobu yaabaniyya 'inna aal laaha aastafaa lakumu aud-deena fal aa tamootunna 'il laa waantum mmuslimoon

'am kuntum shuhadaa'a az hadara ya'qooba aal mawtu 'iz qaal a libaneehi maa ta'budoona mim ba'di qaal u na'budu 'il aahaka wail aaha 'aabaa'ika 'ibraaheema waismaa'eela waishaaqa 'il aaha waahida wanahnu lahu muslimoon
Til ka 'ummat qad khal at lahaa maa kasabat wal akum mmaa kasabtum wal aa tusal oona 'ammaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waqaal u koonu hoodaan 'aw nasaaraa tahtadu qul bal mil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wamaa kaana mina aal mushrikeen

Qoolu 'aamannaa bial laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'il aynaa wamaa 'unzil a 'il aa 'ibraaheema waismaa'eela waishaaqa waya'qooba waal asbaati wamaa 'ooteea moosaa wa'eesaa wamaa 'ooteea aan-nabeeaaoona mir rrabbihim laa nufarriqu bayna 'ahad mminhum wanahnu lahu muslimoon
Fain 'aamanu bimithli maa 'aamantum bihi faqadi aihtada wwain tawal lawa fainnamaa hum fi shiqaaq fasayakfeekahumu aul laahu wahwa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Sibghata aal laahi waman 'ahsanu mina aal laahi sibghat wanahnu lahu 'aabidoon
Qul 'atuhaajjoonanaa fi ail laahi wahwa rabbunaa warabbukum wal anaa 'a'maal unaa wal akum 'a'maal ukum wanahnu lahu mukhlisoon

'am yaqooloona 'inna 'ibraaheema waismaa'eela waishaaqa waya'qooba waal asbaata kaanu hoodaan 'aw nasaaraa qul 'aantum 'a'lamu 'ami ail laahu waman 'azlamu mimman katama shahaadatan 'indahu mina aal laahi wamaa aal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Til ka 'ummat qad khal at lahaa maa kasabat wal akum mmaa kasabtum wal aa tusal oona 'ammaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Sayaqoolu aus-sufahaa'u mina aan-naasi maa wal layaahum 'an qiblatihimu aul ti kaanu 'al ayhaa qul-lil hi ail mashriqu waal maghribu yahdi many yyashaa'u ail aa siraat mmustaqeem

Wakazaal ika ja'al naakum 'ummat wasata llitakoonu shuhadaa'a 'al aa aan-naasi wayakoona aar-rasoolu 'al aykum shaheeda wamaa ja'al naa aal qiblata aal ti kunta 'al ayhaa 'il laa lina'lama many yyattabi'u aur-rasoola mimmany yyanqal ibu 'al aa 'aqibayhi wain kaanat lakabeeratan 'il laa 'al aa aal zeena hadaa aal laahu wamaa kaana aal laahu leeudee'a 'eemaanakum 'inna aal laaha bian-naasi lara'oof rraheem

Qad naraa taqal luba wajhika fi ais-samaa'i fal anooal leeannaka qiblat tardayaahaa fawal li wajhaka shatra aal masjidi ail haraami wahaythu maa kuntum fawal lu wujoohakum shatrahu wainna aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba laya'lamoona 'annahu aul haqqu mir rrabbihim wamaa aal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ya'mal oon

Wal a'in 'atayta aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba bikul li 'ayat mmaa tabi'u qiblataka wamaa 'anta bitaabi' qiblatahum wamaa ba'duhum bitaabi' qiblata ba'd wal a'ini aittaba'ta 'ahwaa'ahum mmim ba'di maa jaa'aka mina aal'il mi 'innaka 'iza llamina aaz-zaal imeen
Aal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba ya'rifoonahu kamaa ya'rifoona 'abnaa'ahum wainna fareeqa mminhum layaktumoona aal haqqa wahum ya'lamoon
Aal haqqu mir rrabbika fal aa takoonanna mina aal mumtareen
Wal ikul l wijhatun hooa mooal leehaa faastabiqu aul khayraati 'ayna maa takoonu yati bikumu aul laahu jamee'aan 'inna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wamin haythu kharajta fawal li wajhaka shatra aal masjidi ail haraami wainnahu lal haqqu mir rrabbika wamaa aal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon

Wamin haythu kharajta fawal li wajhaka shatra aal masjidi ail haraami wahaythu maa kuntum fawal lu wujoohakum shatrahu leeal laa yakoona lin-naasi 'al aykum hujjatun 'il laa aal zeena zal amu minhum fal aa takhshawhum waakhshawni wal iutimma ni'mati 'al aykum wal a'al lakum tahtadoon
Kamaa 'arsal naa feekum rasoola mminkum yatlu 'al aykum 'ayaatinaa wayuzakkeekum wayu'al limukumu aul kitaaba waal hikmata wayu'al limukum mmaa lam takoonu ta'lamoon
Faazkurooni 'azkurkum waashkuru li wal aa takfuroon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu austa'eenu bias-sabri waas-sal aati 'inna aal laaha ma'a aas-saabireen
Wal aa taqoolu limany yyuqtal u fi sabeeli ail laahi 'amwaatu bal 'ahyaa' wal aakil llaa tash'uroon
Wal anablooannakum bisha' mmina aal khawfi waal joo'i wanaqs mmina aal amwaal i waal anfusi waath-thamaraati wabashshiri ais-saabireen
Aal zeena 'izaa 'asaabathum mmuseebat qaal u 'innaa lil hi wainnaa 'il ayhi raaji'oon
'ul aa'ika 'al ayhim sal awaat mmir rrabbihim warahmat waul aa'ika humu aul muhtadoon
'inna aas-safaa waal marwata min sha'aa'iri ail laahi faman hajja aal bayta 'awi ai'tamara fal aa junaaha 'al ayhi 'any yyattawwafa bihimaa waman tatawwa'a khayra fainna aal laaha shaakirun 'al eem
'inna aal zeena yaktumoona maa 'anzal naa mina aal bayyinaati waal hudaa mim ba'di maa bayyannaahu lin-naasi fi ail kitaabi 'ul aa'ika yal'anuhumu aul laahu wayal'anuhumu aul laa'inoon
'il laa aal zeena taabu waaslahu wabayyanu faul aa'ika 'atoobu 'al ayhim waanaa aat-tawwaabu aur-raheem
'inna aal zeena kafaru wamaatu wahum kuffaarun 'ul aa'ika 'al ayhim la'natu aul laahi waal mal aa'ikati waan-naasi 'ajma'een
Khaal ideena feehaa laa yukhaffafu 'anhumu aul'azaabu wal aa hum yunzaroon
Wail aahukum 'il aah waahid llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa aar-rahmaanu aur-raheem

'inna fi khal qi ais-samaawaati waal ardi waakhtil aafi ail yli waan-nahaari waal ful ki ail ti tajri fi ail bahri bimaa yanfa'u aun-naasa wamaa 'anzal a aal laahu mina aas-samaa'i mim mmaa' faahyaa bihi ail arda ba'da mawtihaa wabaththa feehaa min kul li daabbat watasreefi air-reeaahi waas-sahaabi ail musakhkhari bayna aas-samaa'i waal ardi layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon

Wamina aan-naasi many yyattakhizu min dooni ail laahi 'andaada yuhibboonahum kahubbi ail laahi waal zeena 'aamanu 'ashaddu hubba llil hi wal aw taraa aal zeena zal amu 'iz yarawna aal'azaaba 'anna aal qoowata lil hi jamee'a waanna aal laaha shadeedu aul'azaab
'iz tabarraa aal zeena aattubi'u mina aal zeena aattaba'u waraawua aul'azaaba wataqatta'at bihimu aul asbaab
Waqaal a aal zeena aattaba'u law 'anna lanaa karrat fanatabarraa minhum kamaa tabarra'u minnaa kazaal ika yureehimu aul laahu 'a'maal ahum hasaraatin 'al ayhim wamaa hum bikhaarijeena mina aan-naar
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu kul u mimmaa fi ail ardi hal aal a tayyiba wal aa tattabi'u khutwaati aish-shaytaani 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen
'innamaa yamurukum bias-sooaa'i waal fahshaa'i waan taqoolu 'al aa aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Waizaa qeela lahumu auttabi'u maa 'anzal a aal laahu qaal u bal nattabi'u maa 'al faynaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa 'awal aw kaana 'aabaa'uhum laa ya'qil oona shaya wal aa yahtadoon
Wamathal u aul zeena kafaru kamathal i ail zi yan'iqu bimaa laa yasma'u 'il laa du'aa' wanidaa' summu bukmun 'umy fahum laa ya'qil oon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu kul u min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum waashkuru lil hi 'in kuntum 'iyyaahu ta'budoon

'innamaa harrama 'al aykumu aul maytata waad-dama wal ahma aal khinzeeri wamaa 'uhil la bihi lighayri ail laahi famanu audturra ghayra baagh wal aa 'aad fal aa 'ithma 'al ayhi 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem

'inna aal zeena yaktumoona maa 'anzal a aal laahu mina aal kitaabi wayashtaroona bihi thamana qal eelaan 'ul aa'ika maa yakul oona fi butoonihim 'il laa aan-naara wal aa yukal limuhumu aul laahu yawma aal qeeaamati wal aa yuzakkeehim wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
'ul aa'ika aal zeena aashtarawua aud-dal aal ata bial hudaa waal'azaaba bial maghfirati famaa 'asbarahum 'al aa aan-naar
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha nazzal a aal kitaaba bial haqqi wainna aal zeena aakhtal afu fi ail kitaabi lafi shiqaaqi ba'eed

Llaysa aal birru 'an tooal lu wujoohakum qibal a aal mashriqi waal maghribi wal aakini ail birru man 'aamana bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri waal mal aa'ikati waal kitaabi waan-nabeeaaina wa'aataa aal maal a 'al aa hubbihi zawi ail qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeena waabna aas-sabeeli waas-saa'il eena wafi air-riqaabi waaqaama aas-sal awaata wa'aataa aaz-zakawaata waal moofoona bi'ahdihim 'izaa 'aahadu waas-saabireena fi ail basaa'i waad-darraa'i waheena aal basi 'ul aa'ika aal zeena sadaqu waul aa'ika humu aul muttaqoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu kutiba 'al aykumu aul qisaasu fi ail qatlaa aal hurru bial hurri waal'abdu bial'abdi waal unthaa bial unthaa faman 'ufeea lahu min 'akheehi sha' faattibaa'u bial ma'roofi waadaa'un 'il ayhi biihsaan zaal ika takhfeef mmir rrabbikum warahmat famani ai'tadaa ba'da zaal ika fal ahu 'azaabun 'al eem
Wal akum fi ail qisaasi hayawaat yaaooli ail al baabi la'al lakum tattaqoon
Kutiba 'al aykum 'izaa hadara 'ahadakumu aul mawtu 'in taraka khayraan ail wasiyyatu lil waal idayni waal aqrabeena bial ma'roofi haqqaan 'al aa aal muttaqeen
Famam baddal ahu ba'da maa sami'ahu fainnamaa 'ithmuhu 'al aa aal zeena yubaddil oonahu 'inna aal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Faman khaafa mim mmoos janafaan 'aw 'ithma faaslaha baynahum fal aa 'ithma 'al ayhi 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu kutiba 'al aykumu aus-seeaamu kamaa kutiba 'al aa aal zeena min qablikum la'al lakum tattaqoon

'ayyaama mma'doodaat faman kaana minkum mmareedaan 'aw 'al aa safar fa'iddat mmin 'ayyaamin 'ukhara wa'al aa aal zeena yuteeqoonahu fidyatu ta'aami masaakeena faman tatawwa'a khayra fahwa khayr llaahu waan tasoomu khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon

Shahru ramadaana aal zi 'unzil a feehi ail qur'aanu huda llin-naasi wabayyinaat mmina aal hudaa waal furqaani faman shahida minkumu aush-shahra fal yasumhu waman kaana mareedaan 'aw 'al aa safar fa'iddat mmin 'ayyaamin 'ukhara yureedu aul laahu bikumu aul yusra wal aa yureedu bikumu aul'usra wal itukmil u aul'iddata wal itukabbiru aul laaha 'al aa maa hadayaakum wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Waizaa saal aka 'ibaadi 'anni fainni qareebun 'ujeebu da'wata aad-daa'i 'izaa da'aani fal yastajeebu li wal yu'minu bi la'al laahum yarshudoon

'uhil la lakum laylata aas-seeaami air-rafathu 'il aa nisaa'ikum hunna libaas llakum waantum libaas llaahunna 'al ima aal laahu 'annakum kuntum takhtaanoona 'anfusakum fataaba 'al aykum wa'afaa 'ankum faa'al aana baashiroohunna waabtaghu maa kataba aal laahu lakum wakul u waashrabu hattaa yatabayyana lakumu aul khaytu aul abyadu mina aal khayti ail aswadi mina aal fajri thumma 'atimmu aus-seeaama 'il aa aal yli wal aa tubaashiroohunna waantum 'aakifoona fi ail masaajidi til ka hudoodu aul laahi fal aa taqraboohaa kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu 'ayaatihi lin-naasi la'al laahum yattaqoon
Wal aa takul u 'amwaal akum baynakum bial baatil i watudlu bihaa 'il aa aal hukkaami litakul u fareeqa mmin 'amwaal i ain-naasi bial ithmi waantum ta'lamoon

Yasal oonaka 'ani ail ahil lati qul heea mawaaqeetu lin-naasi waal hajji wal aysa aal birru bian tatu aul beeoota min zuhoorihaa wal aakini ail birru mani aittaqaa watu aul beeoota min 'abwaabihaa waattaqu aul laaha la'al lakum tuflihoon
Waqaatil u fi sabeeli ail laahi ail zeena yuqaatil oonakum wal aa ta'tadu 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul mu'tadeen

Waaqtul oohum haythu thaqiftumoohum waakhrijoohum mmin haythu 'akhrajookum waal fitnatu 'ashaddu mina aal qatli wal aa tuqaatil oohum 'inda aal masjidi ail haraami hattaa yuqaatil ookum feehi fain qaatal ookum faaqtul oohum kazaal ika jazaa'u aul kaafireen
Faini aintahawa fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Waqaatil oohum hattaa laa takoona fitnat wayakoona aad-deenu lil hi faini aintahawa fal aa 'udwaana 'il laa 'al aa aaz-zaal imeen

Aash-shahru aul haraamu biash-shahri ail haraami waal hurumaatu qisaas famani ai'tadaa 'al aykum faa'tadu 'al ayhi bimithli maa aa'tadaa 'al aykum waattaqu aul laaha waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha ma'a aal muttaqeen
Waanfiqu fi sabeeli ail laahi wal aa tul qu biaydeekum 'il aa aat-tahlukati waahsinu 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muhsineen

Waatimmu aul hajja waal'umrata lil hi fain 'uhsirtum famaa aastaysara mina aal hadyi wal aa tahliqu ru'oosakum hattaa yablugha aal hadyu mahil laahu faman kaana minkum mmareedaan 'aw bihi 'aza mmir rrasihi fafidyat mmin seeaamin 'aw sadaqatin 'aw nusuk faizaa 'amintum faman tamatta'a bial'umrati 'il aa aal hajji famaa aastaysara mina aal hadyi famal llam yajid faseeaamu thal aathati 'ayyaam fi ail hajji wasab'atin 'izaa raja'tum til ka 'asharat kaamil at zaal ika limal llam yakun 'ahluhu haadiri ail masjidi ail haraami waattaqu aul laaha waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab

Ail hajju 'ashhur mma'loomaat faman farada feehinna aal hajja fal aa rafatha wal aa fusooqa wal aa jidaal a fi ail hajji wamaa taf'al u min khayr ya'lamhu aul laahu watazawwadu fainna khayra aaz-zaadi ait-taqwaa waattaqooni yaaooli ail al baab

Laysa 'al aykum junaahun 'an tabtaghu fadla mmir rrabbikum faizaa 'afadtum mmin 'arafaat faazkuru aul laaha 'inda aal mash'ari ail haraami waazkuroohu kamaa hadayaakum wain kuntum mmin qablihi lamina aad-daal leen
Thumma 'afeedu min haythu 'afaada aan-naasu waastaghfiru aul laaha 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Faizaa qadaytum mmanaasikakum faazkuru aul laaha kazikrikum 'aabaa'akum 'aw 'ashadda zikra famina aan-naasi many yyaqoolu rabbanaa 'aatinaa fi aid-dunyaa wamaa lahu fi ail aakhirati min khal aaq waminhum mmany yyaqoolu rabbanaa 'aatinaa fi aid-dunyaa hasanat wafi ail aakhirati hasanat waqinaa 'azaaba aan-naar
'ul aa'ika lahum naseeb mmimmaa kasabu waal laahu saree'u aul hisaab

Waazkuru aul laaha fi 'ayyaam mma'doodaat faman ta'ajjal a fi yawmayni fal aa 'ithma 'al ayhi waman taakhkhara fal aa 'ithma 'al ayhi limani aittaqaa waattaqu aul laaha waa'lamu 'annakum 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
Wamina aan-naasi many yyu'jibuka qawluhu fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wayushhidu aul laaha 'al aa maa fi qal bihi wahwa 'al addu aul khisaam
Waizaa tawal laa sa'aa fi ail ardi leeufsida feehaa wayuhlika aal hartha waan-nasla waal laahu laa yuhibbu aul fasaad
Waizaa qeela lahu auttaqi ail laaha 'akhazathu aul'izzatu bial ithmi fahasbuhu jahannamu wal abeesa aal mihaad
Wamina aan-naasi many yyashri nafsahu aubtighaa'a mardaati ail laahi waal laahu ra'oofu bial'ibaad
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu audkhul u fi ais-sal mi kaaffat wal aa tattabi'u khutwaati aish-shaytaani 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen
Fain zal al tum mmim ba'di maa jaa'atkumu aul bayyinaatu faa'lamu 'anna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem
Hal yanzuroona 'il laa 'any yyateeahumu aul laahu fi zul al mmina aal ghamaami waal mal aa'ikatu waqudeea aal amru wail aa aal laahi turja'u aul umoor
Sal bani 'israa'eela kam 'aataynaahum mmin 'ayati bayyinat wamany yyubaddil ni'mata aal laahi mim ba'di maa jaa'athu fainna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab
Zuyyina lil zeena kafaru aul hayawaatu aud-dunyaa wayaskharoona mina aal zeena 'aamanu waal zeena aattaqawa fawqahum yawma aal qeeaamati waal laahu yarzuqu many yyashaa'u bighayri hisaab

Kaana aan-naasu 'ummat waahidat faba'atha aal laahu aun-nabeeaaina mubashshireena wamunzireena waanzal a ma'ahumu aul kitaaba bial haqqi leeahkuma bayna aan-naasi feemaa aakhtal afu feehi wamaa aakhtal afa feehi 'il laa aal zeena 'ootoohu mim ba'di maa jaa'athumu aul bayyinaatu baghyaa baynahum fahadaa aal laahu aul zeena 'aamanu limaa aakhtal afu feehi mina aal haqqi biiznihi waal laahu yahdi many yyashaa'u ail aa siraat mmustaqeem

'am hasibtum 'an tadkhul u aul jannata wal ammaa yatikum mmathal u aul zeena khal awa min qablikum mmassathumu aul basaa'u waad-darraa'u wazul zil u hattaa yaqoolu aur-rasoolu waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu mataa nasru aul laahi 'al aa 'inna nasra aal laahi qareeb
Yasal oonaka maazaa yunfiqoona qul maa 'anfaqtum mmin khayr fal il waal idayni waal aqrabeena waal yataamaa waal masaakeeni waabni ais-sabeeli wamaa taf'al u min khayr fainna aal laaha bihi 'al eem
Kutiba 'al aykumu aul qitaal u wahwa kurh llakum wa'asaa 'an takrahu shaya wahwa khayr llakum wa'asaa 'an tuhibbu shaya wahwa sharr llakum waal laahu ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon

Yasal oonaka 'ani aish-shahri ail haraami qitaal feehi qul qitaal feehi kabeer wasaddun 'an sabeeli ail laahi wakufru bihi waal masjidi ail haraami waikhraaju 'ahlihi minhu 'akbaru 'inda aal laahi waal fitnatu 'akbaru mina aal qatli wal aa yazaal oona yuqaatil oonakum hattaa yaruddookum 'an deenikum 'ini aistataa'u wamany yyartadid minkum 'an deenihi fayamut wahwa kaafir faul aa'ika habitat 'a'maal uhum fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati waul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu waal zeena haajaru wajaahadu fi sabeeli ail laahi 'ul aa'ika yarjoona rahmata aal laahi waal laahu ghafoor rraheem

Yasal oonaka 'ani ail khamri waal maysiri qul feehimaa 'ithm kabeer wamanaafi'u lin-naasi waithmuhumaa 'akbaru min nnaf'ihimaa wayasal oonaka maazaa yunfiqoona qul i ail'afwa kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakumu aul ayaati la'al lakum tatafakkaroon

Fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati wayasal oonaka 'ani ail yataamaa qul 'islaah llaahum khayr wain tukhaal itoohum faikhwaanukum waal laahu ya'lamu aul mufsida mina aal muslihi wal aw shaa'a aal laahu laa'natakum 'inna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem

Wal aa tankihu aul mushrikaati hattaa yu'minna wal aamat mmu'minatun khayr mmim mmushrikat wal aw 'a'jabatkum wal aa tunkihu aul mushrikeena hattaa yu'minu wal a'abd mmu'minun khayr mmim mmushrik wal aw 'a'jabakum 'ul aa'ika yad'oona 'il aa aan-naari waal laahu yad'u 'il aa aal jannati waal maghfirati biiznihi wayubayyinu 'ayaatihi lin-naasi la'al laahum yatazakkaroon

Wayasal oonaka 'ani ail maheedi qul hooa 'aza faa'tazil u aun-nisaa'a fi ail maheedi wal aa taqraboohunna hattaa yathurna faizaa tatahharna fatoohunna min haythu 'amarakumu aul laahu 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aut-tawwaabeena wayuhibbu aul mutatahhireen
Nisaa'ukum harth llakum fatu harthakum 'annaa sheetum waqaddimu lianfusikum waattaqu aul laaha waa'lamu 'annakum mmul aaqoohu wabashshiri ail mu'mineen
Wal aa taj'al u aul laaha 'urdat lliaymaanikum 'an tabarru watattaqu watuslihu bayna aan-naasi waal laahu samee'un 'al eem
Llaa yu'aakhizukumu aul laahu bial laghwi fi 'aymaanikum wal aakiny yyu'aakhizukum bimaa kasabat qul oobukum waal laahu ghafoorun hal eem
Llil zeena yu'loona min nnisaa'ihim tarabbusu 'arba'ati 'ashhur fain faa'oo fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Wain 'azamu aut-tal aaqa fainna aal laaha samee'un 'al eem

Waal mutal laqaatu yatarabbasna bianfusihinna thal aathata qurooaa' wal aa yahil lu lahunna 'any yyaktumna maa khal aqa aal laahu fi 'arhaamihinna 'in kunna yu'minna bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wabu'oolatuhunna 'ahaqqu biraddihinna fi zaal ika 'in 'araadu 'islaaha wal ahunna mithlu aul zi 'al ayhinna bial ma'roofi wal ir-rijaal i 'al ayhinna darajat waal laahu 'azeezun hakeem

Ait-tal aaqu marrataani faimsaaku bima'roofin 'aw tasreehu biihsaanw wal aa yahil lu lakum 'an takhuzu mimmaa 'aataytumoohunna shayaan 'il laa 'any yyakhaafaa 'al laa yuqeemaa hudooda aal laahi fain khiftum 'al laa yuqeemaa hudooda aal laahi fal aa junaaha 'al ayhimaa feemaa aaftadat bihi til ka hudoodu aul laahi fal aa ta'tadoohaa wamany yyata'adda hudooda aal laahi faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon

Fain tal laqahaa fal aa tahil lu lahu mim ba'du hattaa tankiha zawjaan ghayrahu fain tal laqahaa fal aa junaaha 'al ayhimaa 'any yyataraaja'aa 'in zannaa 'any yyuqeemaa hudooda aal laahi watil ka hudoodu aul laahi yubayyinuhaa liqawm ya'lamoon

Waizaa tal laqtumu aun-nisaa'a fabal aghna 'ajal ahunna faamsikoohunna bima'roofin 'aw sarrihoohunna bima'roof wal aa tumsikoohunna diraara llita'tadu wamany yyaf'al zaal ika faqad zal ama nafsahu wal aa tattakhizu 'ayaati ail laahi huzu'a waazkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykum wamaa 'anzal a 'al aykum mmina aal kitaabi waal hikmati ya'izukum bihi waattaqu aul laaha waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Waizaa tal laqtumu aun-nisaa'a fabal aghna 'ajal ahunna fal aa ta'dul oohunna 'any yyankihna 'azwaajahunna 'izaa taraadawa baynahum bial ma'roofi zaal ika yoo'azu bihi man kaana minkum yu'minu bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri zaal ikum 'azkaa lakum waatharu waal laahu ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon

Waal waal idaatu yurdi'na 'awlaadahunna hawlayni kaamil ayni liman 'araada 'any yyutimma aar-radaa'ata wa'al aa aal mawloodi lahu rizquhunna wakiswatuhunna bial ma'roofi laa tukal lafu nafsun 'il laa wus'ahaa laa tudaarra waal idatu biwal adihaa wal aa mawlood llaahu biwal adihi wa'al aa aal waarithi mithlu zaal ika fain 'araadaa fisaal aan 'an taraad mminhumaa watashaawur fal aa junaaha 'al ayhimaa wain 'aradttum 'an tastardi'u 'awlaadakum fal aa junaaha 'al aykum 'izaa sal lamtum mmaa 'aataytum bial ma'roofi waattaqu aul laaha waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha bimaa ta'mal oona baseer

Waal zeena yutawaffawna minkum wayazaroona 'azwaaja yatarabbasna bianfusihinna 'arba'ata 'ashhur wa'ashra faizaa bal aghna 'ajal ahunna fal aa junaaha 'al aykum feemaa fa'al na fi 'anfusihinna bial ma'roofi waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Wal aa junaaha 'al aykum feemaa 'arradtum bihi min khitbati ain-nisaa'i aaw 'aknantum fi 'anfusikum 'al ima aal laahu 'annakum satazkuroonahunna wal aakil llaa tooaa'idoohunna sirraan 'il laa 'an taqoolu qawla mma'roofa wal aa ta'zimu 'uqdata aan-nikaahi hattaa yablugha aal kitaabu 'ajal ahu waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu maa fi 'anfusikum faahzaroohu waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha ghafoorun hal eem

Llaa junaaha 'al aykum 'in tal laqtumu aun-nisaa'a maa lam tamassoohunna 'aw tafridu lahunna fareedat wamatti'oohunna 'al aa aal moosi'i qadruhu wa'al aa aal muqtiri qadruhu mataa'aa bial ma'roofi haqqaan 'al aa aal muhsineen

Wain tal laqtumoohunna min qabli 'an tamassoohunna waqad faradtum lahunna fareedat fanisfu maa faradtum 'il laa 'any yya'foona 'aw ya'fooaa aal zi beeadihi 'uqdatu aun-nikaahi waan ta'fu 'aqrabu lit-taqwaa wal aa tansawua aul fadla baynakum 'inna aal laaha bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Haafizu 'al aa aas-sal awaati waas-sal aati ail wustaa waqoomu lil hi qaaniteen
Fain khiftum farijaal aan 'aw rukbaana faizaa 'amintum faazkuru aul laaha kamaa 'al lamakum mmaa lam takoonu ta'lamoon

Waal zeena yutawaffawna minkum wayazaroona 'azwaaja wasiyyat lliazwaajihim mmataa'aan 'il aa aal hawli ghayra 'ikhraaj fain kharajna fal aa junaaha 'al aykum fi maa fa'al na fi 'anfusihinna mim mma'roof waal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Wal il mutal laqaati mataa'u bial ma'roofi haqqaan 'al aa aal muttaqeen
Kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakum 'ayaatihi la'al lakum ta'qil oon

'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena kharaju min deeaarihim wahum 'ul oofun hazara aal mawti faqaal a lahumu aul laahu mootu thumma 'ahyaahum 'inna aal laaha lazoo fadlin 'al aa aan-naasi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Waqaatil u fi sabeeli ail laahi waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Mman zaa aal zi yuqridu aul laaha qardaan hasana fayudaa'ifuhu lahu 'ad'aafa katheerat waal laahu yaqbidu wayabsutu wail ayhi turja'oon

'al am tara 'il aa aal mal ai mim bani 'israa'eela mim ba'di moosaa 'iz qaal u linabiaa' llaahumu aub'ath lanaa mal ika nnuqaatil fi sabeeli ail laahi qaal a hal 'aseetum 'in kutiba 'al aykumu aul qitaal u 'al laa tuqaatil u qaal u wamaa lanaa 'al laa nuqaatil a fi sabeeli ail laahi waqad 'ukhrijnaa min deeaarinaa waabnaa'inaa fal ammaa kutiba 'al ayhimu aul qitaal u tawal lawa 'il laa qal eela mminhum waal laahu 'al eemu biaz-zaal imeen

Waqaal a lahum nabeeaauhum 'inna aal laaha qad ba'atha lakum taal oota mal ika qaal u 'annaa yakoonu lahu aul mul ku 'al aynaa wanahnu 'ahaqqu bial mul ki minhu wal am yu'ta sa'at mmina aal maal i qaal a 'inna aal laaha aastafayaahu 'al aykum wazaadahu bastat fi ail'il mi waal jismi waal laahu yu'ti mul kahu many yyashaa'u waal laahu waasi'un 'al eem

Waqaal a lahum nabeeaauhum 'inna 'ayata mul kihi 'any yyateeakumu aut-taabootu feehi sakeenat mmir rrabbikum wabaqiyyat mmimmaa taraka 'aal u moosaa wa'aal u haaroona tahmil uhu aul mal aa'ikatu 'inna fi zaal ika layat llakum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen

Fal ammaa fasal a taal ootu bial junoodi qaal a 'inna aal laaha mubtal eekum binahar faman shariba minhu fal aysa minni wamal llam yat'amhu fainnahu minneea 'il laa mani aightarafa gharfata beeadihi fasharibu minhu 'il laa qal eela mminhum fal ammaa jaawazahu hooa waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu qaal u laa taaqata lanaa aal yawma bijaal oota wajunoodihi qaal a aal zeena yazunnoona 'annahum mmul aaqu aul laahi kam mmin feeat qal eelatin ghal abat feeat katheerata biizni ail laahi waal laahu ma'a aas-saabireen
Wal ammaa barazu lijaal oota wajunoodihi qaal u rabbanaa 'afrigh 'al aynaa sabra wathabbit 'aqdaamanaa waansurnaa 'al aa aal qawmi ail kaafireen

Fahazamoohum biizni ail laahi waqatal a daawudu jaal oota wa'aatayaahu aul laahu aul mul ka waal hikmata wa'al lamahu mimmaa yashaa'u wal awlaa difaa'u aul laahi ain-naasa ba'dahum biba'd llafasadati ail ardu wal aakinna aal laaha zoo fadlin 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Til ka 'ayaatu aul laahi natloohaa 'al ayka bial haqqi wainnaka lamina aal mursal een

Til ka aar-rusul u faddal naa ba'dahum 'al aa ba'd mminhum mman kal lama aal laahu warafa'a ba'dahum darajaat wa'aataynaa 'eesaa aabna maryama aal bayyinaati wayyadnaahu biroohi ail qudusi wal aw shaa'a aal laahu maa aaqtatal a aal zeena mim ba'dihim mmim ba'di maa jaa'athumu aul bayyinaatu wal aakini aikhtal afu faminhum mman 'aamana waminhum mman kafara wal aw shaa'a aal laahu maa aaqtatal u wal aakinna aal laaha yaf'al u maa yureed
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'anfiqu mimmaa razaqnaakum mmin qabli 'any yyateea yawm llaa bay' feehi wal aa khul lat wal aa shafaa'at waal kaafiroona humu auz-zaal imoon
Aal laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa aal hayyu aul qayyoom

Laa takhuzuhu sinat wal aa nawm llaahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi man zaa aal zi yashfa'u 'indahu 'il laa biiznihi ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wal aa yuheetoona bisha' mmin 'il mihi 'il laa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kurseeyuhu aus-samaawaati waal arda wal aa yaooduhu hifzuhumaa wahwa aal'al eeyu aul'azeem

Laa 'ikraaha fi aid-deeni qad ttabayyana aar-rushdu mina aal ghayyi famany yyakfur biat-taaghooti wayu'mim bial laahi faqadi aistamsaka bial'urwati ail wuthqaa laa aanfisaama lahaa waal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Ail laahu wal eeyu aul zeena 'aamanu yukhrijuhum mmina aaz-zul umaati 'il aa aan-noori waal zeena kafaru 'awleeaa'uhumu aut-taaghootu yukhrijoonahum mmina aan-noori 'il aa aaz-zul umaati 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon

'al am tara 'il aa aal zi haajja 'ibraaheema fi rabbihi 'an 'aatayaahu aul laahu aul mul ka 'iz qaal a 'ibraaheemu rabbeea aal zi yuhyi wayumeetu qaal a 'anaa 'uhyi waumeetu qaal a 'ibraaheemu fainna aal laaha yati biash-shamsi mina aal mashriqi fati bihaa mina aal maghribi fabuhita aal zi kafara waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen

'aw kaal zi marra 'al aa qaryat wahya khaaweeatun 'al aa 'urooshihaa qaal a 'annaa yuhyi haazihi ail laahu ba'da mawtihaa faamaatahu aul laahu miayata 'aam thumma ba'athahu qaal a kam labithta qaal a labithtu yawmaan 'aw ba'da yawm qaal a bal-labithta miayata 'aam faanzur 'il aa ta'aamika washaraabika lam yatasannah waanzur 'il aa himaarika wal inaj'al aka 'ayat llin-naasi waanzur 'il aa aal'izaami kayfa nunshiruhaa thumma naksoohaa lahma fal ammaa tabayyana lahu qaal a 'a'lamu 'anna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu rabbi 'arini kayfa tuhyi ail mawtaa qaal a 'awal am tu'min qaal a bal aa wal aakil lleeatma'inna qal bi qaal a fakhuz 'arba'at mmina aat-tayri fasurhunna 'il ayka thumma aaj'al 'al aa kul li jabal mminhunna juz'a thumma aad'uhunna yateenaka sa'ya waa'lam 'anna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem

Mmathal u aul zeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum fi sabeeli ail laahi kamathal i habbatin 'anbatat sab'a sanaabil a fi kul li sunbul at mmiayatu habbat waal laahu yudaa'ifu limany yyashaa'u waal laahu waasi'un 'al eem
Ail zeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum fi sabeeli ail laahi thumma laa yutbi'oona maa 'anfaqu manna wal aa 'aza llaahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Qawl mma'roof wamaghfiratun khayr mmin sadaqat yatba'uhaa 'aza waal laahu ghaneeyun hal eem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tubtil u sadaqaatikum bial manni waal azaa kaal zi yunfiqu maal ahu reeaa'a aan-naasi wal aa yu'minu bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri famathal uhu kamathal i safwaanin 'al ayhi turaab faasaabahu waabil fatarakahu sal da llaa yaqdiroona 'al aa sha' mmimmaa kasabu waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal kaafireen

Wamathal u aul zeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahumu aubtighaa'a mardaati ail laahi watathbeeta mmin 'anfusihim kamathal i jannati birubwatin 'asaabahaa waabil faatat 'uklahaa di'fayni fail llam yusibhaa waabil fatal l waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer

'ayawaddu 'ahadukum 'an takoona lahu jannat mmin nnakheel waa'naab tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru lahu feehaa min kul li aith-thamaraati waasaabahu aul kibaru wal ahu zurriyyat du'afaa'u faasaabahaa 'i'saar feehi naar faahtaraqat kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakumu aul ayaati la'al lakum tatafakkaroon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'anfiqu min tayyibaati maa kasabtum wamimmaa 'akhrajnaa lakum mmina aal ardi wal aa tayammamu aul khabeetha minhu tunfiqoona wal astum biaakhizeehi 'il laa 'an tughmidu feehi waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha ghaneeyun hameed
Aish-shaytaanu ya'idukumu aul faqra wayamurukum bial fahshaa'i waal laahu ya'idukum mmaghfirat mminhu wafadla waal laahu waasi'un 'al eem
Yu'ti ail hikmata many yyashaa'u wamany yyu'ta aal hikmata faqad 'ooteea khayra katheera wamaa yazzakkaru 'il laa 'oolu aul al baab
Wamaa 'anfaqtum mmin nnafaqatin 'aw nazartum mmin nnazr fainna aal laaha ya'lamuhu wamaa liz-zaal imeena min 'ansaar
'in tubdu aus-sadaqaati fani'mmaa heea wain tukhfoohaa watu'toohaa aal fuqaraa'a fahwa khayr llakum wanukaffir 'ankum mmin sayyiaatikum waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Llaysa 'al ayka hudayaahum wal aakinna aal laaha yahdi many yyashaa'u wamaa tunfiqu min khayr fal ianfusikum wamaa tunfiqoona 'il laa aabtighaa'a wajhi ail laahi wamaa tunfiqu min khayr yooaffa 'il aykum waantum laa tuzlamoon

Lil fuqaraa'i ail zeena 'uhsiru fi sabeeli ail laahi laa yastatee'oona darba fi ail ardi yahsibuhumu aul jaahil u 'aghneeaa'a mina aat-ta'affufi ta'rifuhum biseemaahum laa yasal oona aan-naasa 'il haafa wamaa tunfiqu min khayr fainna aal laaha bihi 'al eem
Ail zeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum bial yli waan-nahaari sirra wa'al aaneeat fal ahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon

Aal zeena yakul oona aar-ribawaa laa yaqoomoona 'il laa kamaa yaqoomu aul zi yatakhabbatuhu aush-shaytaanu mina aal massi zaal ika biannahum qaal u 'innamaa aal bay'u mithlu aur-ribawaa waahal la aal laahu aul bay'a waharrama aar-ribawaa faman jaa'ahu maw'izat mmir rrabbihi faantahaa fal ahu maa sal afa waamruhu 'il aa aal laahi waman 'aada faul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Yamhaqu aul laahu aur-ribawaa wayurbi ais-sadaqaati waal laahu laa yuhibbu kul la kaffaarin 'atheem
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati waaqaamu aus-sal awaata wa'aatawua auz-zakawaata lahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auttaqu aul laaha wazaru maa baqeea mina aar-ribawaa 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Fail llam taf'al u fazanu biharb mmina aal laahi warasoolihi wain tubtum fal akum ru'oosu 'amwaal ikum laa tazlimoona wal aa tuzlamoon
Wain kaana zoo 'usrat fanaziratun 'il aa maysurat waan tassaddaqu khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Waattaqu yawma turja'oona feehi 'il aa aal laahi thumma tooaffaa kul lu nafs mmaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa tadayantum bidaynin 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma faaktuboohu wal yaktub bbaynakum kaatibu bial'adli wal aa yaba kaatibun 'any yyaktuba kamaa 'al lamahu aul laahu fal yaktub wal yumlil i ail zi 'al ayhi ail haqqu wal yattaqi ail laaha rabbahu wal aa yabkhas minhu shaya fain kaana aal zi 'al ayhi ail haqqu safeehaan 'aw da'eefaan 'aw laa yastatee'u 'any yyumil la hooa fal yumlil wal eeyuhu bial'adli waastashhidu shaheedayni mir rrijaal ikum fail llam yakoonaa rajul ayni farajul waamraataani mimman tardawna mina aash-shuhadaa'i aan tadil la 'ihdayaahumaa fatuzakkira 'ihdayaahumaa aal ukhraa wal aa yaba aash-shuhadaa'u aizaa maa du'u wal aa tasamu 'an taktuboohu sagheeraan 'aw kabeeraan 'il aa 'ajal ihi zaal ikum 'aqsatu 'inda aal laahi waaqwamu lish-shahaadati waadnaa 'al laa tartaabu 'il laa 'an takoona tijaaratun haadirat tudeeroonahaa baynakum fal aysa 'al aykum junaahun 'al laa taktuboohaa waashhidu 'izaa tabaya'tum wal aa yudaarra kaatib wal aa shaheed wain taf'al u fainnahu fusooqu bikum waattaqu aul laaha wayu'al limukumu aul laahu waal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Wain kuntum 'al aa safar wal am tajidu kaatiba farihaam mmaqboodat fain 'amina ba'dukum ba'da fal yu'addi ail zi ai'tumina 'amaanatahu wal yattaqi ail laaha rabbahu wal aa taktumu aush-shahaadata wamany yyaktumhaa fainnahu 'aathim qal buhu waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona 'al eem

Llil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wain tubdu maa fi 'anfusikum 'aw tukhfoohu yuhaasibkum bihi ail laahu fayaghfir limany yyashaa'u wayu'azzib mmany yyashaa'u waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

'aamana aar-rasoolu bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayhi mir rrabbihi waal mu'minoona kul lun 'aamana bial laahi wamal aa'ikatihi wakutubihi warusul ihi laa nufarriqu bayna 'ahad mmir rrusul ihi waqaal u sami'naa waata'naa ghufraanaka rabbanaa wail ayka aal maseer

Laa yukal lifu aul laahu nafsaan 'il laa wus'ahaa lahaa maa kasabat wa'al ayhaa maa aaktasabat rabbanaa laa tu'aakhiznaa 'in nnaseenaa 'aw 'akhtanaa rabbanaa wal aa tahmil 'al aynaa 'isra kamaa hamal tahu 'al aa aal zeena min qablinaa rabbanaa wal aa tuhammil naa maa laa taaqata lanaa bihi waa'fu 'annaa waaghfir lanaa waarhamnaa 'anta mawlayaanaa faansurnaa 'al aa aal qawmi ail kaafireen
'al aammiaa aal laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa aal hayyu aul qayyoom
Nazzal a 'al ayka aal kitaaba bial haqqi musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi waanzal a aat-tawrayaata waal injeel
Min qablu huda llin-naasi waanzal a aal furqaan
'inna aal zeena kafaru biayaati ail laahi lahum 'azaab shadeed waal laahu 'azeez zoo auntiqaam
'inna aal laaha laa yakhfaa 'al ayhi sha' fi ail ardi wal aa fi ais-samaa'
Hooa aal zi yusawwirukum fi ail arhaami kayfa yashaa'u laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Hooa aal zi 'anzal a 'al ayka aal kitaaba minhu 'ayaat mmuhkamaatun hunna 'ummu aul kitaabi waukharu mutashaabihaat faammaa aal zeena fi qul oobihim zaygh fayattabi'oona maa tashaabaha minhu aubtighaa'a aal fitnati waabtighaa'a taweelihi wamaa ya'lamu taweelahu 'il laa aal laahu waar-raasikhoona fi ail'il mi yaqooloona 'aamannaa bihi kul l mmin 'indi rabbinaa wamaa yazzakkaru 'il laa 'oolu aul al baab
Rabbanaa laa tuzigh qul oobanaa ba'da 'iz hadaytanaa wahab lanaa mil lladunka rahmatan 'innaka 'anta aal wahhaab
Rabbanaa 'innaka jaami'u aun-naasi leeawm llaa rayba feehi 'inna aal laaha laa yukhlifu aul mee'aad
'inna aal zeena kafaru lan tughneea 'anhum 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhum mmina aal laahi shaya waul aa'ika hum waqoodu aun-naar
Kadabi 'aal i fir'awna waal zeena min qablihim kazzabu biayaatinaa faakhazahumu aul laahu bizunoobihim waal laahu shadeedu aul'iqaab
Qul-lil zeena kafaru satughlaboona watuhsharoona 'il aa jahannama wabeesa aal mihaad

Qad kaana lakum 'ayat fi feeatayni ail taqataa feeat tuqaatil u fi sabeeli ail laahi waukhraa kaafirat tarawnahum mmithlayhim raya aal'ayni waal laahu yu'ayyidu binasrihi many yyashaa'u ainna fi zaal ika la'ibrat lliooli ail absaar

Zuyyina lin-naasi hubbu aush-shahawaati mina aan-nisaa'i waal baneena waal qanaateeri ail muqantarati mina aaz-zahabi waal fiddati waal khayli ail musawwamati waal an'aami waal harthi zaal ika mataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunyaa waal laahu 'indahu husnu aul maab

Qul 'aawnabbeeukum bikhayr mmin zaal ikum lil zeena aattaqawa 'inda rabbihim jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa waazwaaj mmutahharat waridwaam mmina aal laahi waal laahu baseeru bial'ibaad
Ail zeena yaqooloona rabbanaa 'innanaa 'aamannaa faaghfir lanaa zunoobanaa waqinaa 'azaaba aan-naar
Ais-saabireena waas-saadiqeena waal qaaniteena waal munfiqeena waal mustaghfireena bial ashaar
Shahida aal laahu 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa waal mal aa'ikatu waoolu aul'il mi qaa'imaa bial qisti laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

'inna aad-deena 'inda aal laahi ail islaamu wamaa aakhtal afa aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba 'il laa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumu aul'il mu baghyaa baynahum wamany yyakfur biayaati ail laahi fainna aal laaha saree'u aul hisaab

Fain haajjooka faqul 'aslamtu wajheea lil hi wamani aittaba'ani waqul-lil zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba waal ummeeyina 'aaslamtum fain 'aslamu faqadi aihtada wwain tawal lawa fainnamaa 'al ayka aal bal aaghu waal laahu baseeru bial'ibaad
'inna aal zeena yakfuroona biayaati ail laahi wayaqtul oona aan-nabeeaaina bighayri haqq wayaqtul oona aal zeena yamuroona bial qisti mina aan-naasi fabashshirhum bi'azaabin 'al eem
'ul aa'ika aal zeena habitat 'a'maal uhum fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena 'ootu naseeba mmina aal kitaabi yud'awna 'il aa kitaabi ail laahi leeahkuma baynahum thumma yatawal laa fareeq mminhum wahum mmu'ridoon
Zaal ika biannahum qaal u lan tamassanaa aan-naaru 'il laa 'ayyaama mma'doodaat wagharrahum fi deenihim mmaa kaanu yaftaroon
Fakayfa 'izaa jama'naahum leeawm llaa rayba feehi wawuffeeat kul lu nafs mmaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon

Qul i ail laahumma maal ika aal mul ki tu'ti ail mul ka man tashaa'u watanzi'u aul mul ka mimman tashaa'u watu'izzu man tashaa'u watuzil lu man tashaa'u beeadika aal khayru 'innaka 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Tooliju aul yla fi ain-nahaari watooliju aun-nahaara fi ail yli watukhriju aul hayya mina aal mayyiti watukhriju aul mayyita mina aal hayyi watarzuqu man tashaa'u bighayri hisaab

Llaa yattakhizi ail mu'minoona aal kaafireena 'awleeaa'a min dooni ail mu'mineena wamany yyaf'al zaal ika fal aysa mina aal laahi fi sha'in 'il laa 'an tattaqu minhum tuqayaat wayuhazzirukumu aul laahu nafsahu wail aa aal laahi ail maseer
Qul 'in tukhfu maa fi sudoorikum 'aw tubdoohu ya'lamhu aul laahu waya'lamu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

Yawma tajidu kul lu nafs mmaa 'amil at min khayr mmuhdara wamaa 'amil at min sooaa' tawaddu law 'anna baynahaa wabaynahu 'amadaa ba'eeda wayuhazzirukumu aul laahu nafsahu waal laahu ra'oofu bial'ibaad
Qul 'in kuntum tuhibboona aal laaha faattabi'ooni yuhbibkumu aul laahu wayaghfir lakum zunoobakum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Qul 'atee'u aul laaha waar-rasoola fain tawal lawa fainna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul kaafireen
'inna aal laaha aastafaa 'aadama wanooha wa'aal a 'ibraaheema wa'aal a 'imraana 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Zurriyyata ba'duhaa mim ba'd waal laahu samee'un 'al eem
'iz qaal ati aimraatu 'imraana rabbi 'inni nazartu laka maa fi batni muharrara fataqabbal minneea 'innaka 'anta aas-samee'u aul'al eem

Fal ammaa wada'athaa qaal at rabbi 'inni wada'tuhaa 'unthaa waal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa wada'at wal aysa aaz-zakaru kaal unthaa wainni sammaytuhaa maryama wainneea 'u'eezuhaa bika wazurriyyatahaa mina aash-shaytaani air-rajeem

Fataqabbal ahaa rabbuhaa biqaboolin hasanw waanbatahaa nabaataan hasana wakafal ahaa zakariyyaa'u kul lamaa dakhal a 'al ayhaa zakariyyaa'u aul mihraaba wajada 'indahaa rizqa qaal a yaamaryamu 'annaa laki haazaa qaal at hooa min 'indi ail laahi 'inna aal laaha yarzuqu many yyashaa'u bighayri hisaab
Hunaal ika da'aa zakariyyaa'u rabbahu qaal a rabbi hab li mil lladunka zurriyyat tayyibatan 'innaka samee'u aud-du'aa'
Fanaadathu aul mal aa'ikatu wahwa qaa'im yusal li fi ail mihraabi 'anna aal laaha yubashshiruka beeahyaa musaddiqaa bikal imat mmina aal laahi wasayyida wahasoora wanabeeaa mmina aas-saal iheen
Qaal a rabbi 'annaa yakoonu li ghul aam waqad bal aghaneea aal kibaru waamraati 'aaqir qaal a kazaal ika aal laahu yaf'al u maa yashaa'
Qaal a rabbi aij'al-leea 'ayat qaal a 'ayatuka 'al laa tukal lima aan-naasa thal aathata 'ayyaamin 'il laa ramza waazkur rrabbaka katheera wasabbih bial'asheeyi waal ibkaar
Waiz qaal ati ail mal aa'ikatu yaamaryamu 'inna aal laaha aastafayaaki watahharaki waastafayaaki 'al aa nisaa'i ail'aal ameen
Yaamaryamu auqnuti lirabbiki waasjudi waarka'i ma'a aar-raaki'een
Zaal ika min 'anbaa'i ail ghaybi nooheehi 'il ayka wamaa kunta ladayhim 'iz yul qoona 'aqlaamahum 'ayyuhum yakful u maryama wamaa kunta ladayhim 'iz yakhtasimoon
'iz qaal ati ail mal aa'ikatu yaamaryamu 'inna aal laaha yubashshiruki bikal imat mminhu ausmuhu aul maseehu 'eesaa aabnu maryama wajeeha fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati wamina aal muqarrabeen
Wayukal limu aun-naasa fi ail mahdi wakahla wamina aas-saal iheen
Qaal at rabbi 'annaa yakoonu li wal ad wal am yamsasni bashar qaal a kazaal iki ail laahu yakhluqu maa yashaa'u aizaa qadaa 'amra fainnamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon

Wayu'al limuhu aul kitaaba waal hikmata waat-tawrayaata waal injeela warasoolaan 'il aa bani 'israa'eela 'anni qad jeetukum biayat mmir rrabbikum 'inneea 'akhluqu lakum mmina aat-teeni kahayati ait-tayri faanfukhu feehi fayakoonu taa'iraa biizni ail laahi waubriu aul akmaha waal abrasa wauhyi ail mawtaa biizni ail laahi waunabbeeukum bimaa takul oona wamaa taddakhiroona fi beeootikum 'inna fi zaal ika layat llakum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wamusaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayya mina aat-tawrayaati wal iuhil la lakum ba'da aal zi hurrima 'al aykum wajeetukum biayat mmir rrabbikum faattaqu aul laaha waatee'oon
'inna aal laaha rabbi warabbukum faa'budoohu haazaa siraat mmustaqeem
Fal ammaa 'ahassa 'eesaa minhumu aul kufra qaal a man 'ansaareea 'il aa aal laahi qaal a aal hawaareeyoona nahnu 'ansaaru aul laahi 'aamannaa bial laahi waashhad biannaa muslimoon
Rabbanaa 'aamannaa bimaa 'anzal ta waattaba'naa aar-rasoola faaktubnaa ma'a aash-shaahideen
Wamakaru wamakara aal laahu waal laahu khayru aul maakireen

'iz qaal a aal laahu yaa'eesaa 'inni mutawaffeeka waraafi'uka 'il ayya wamutahhiruka mina aal zeena kafaru wajaa'il u aul zeena aattaba'ooka fawqa aal zeena kafaru 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati thumma 'il ayya marji'ukum faahkumu baynakum feemaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
Faammaa aal zeena kafaru fau'azzibuhum 'azaaba shadeeda fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Waammaa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fanooaffeehim 'ujoorahum waal laahu laa yuhibbu auz-zaal imeen
Zaal ika natloohu 'al ayka mina aal ayaati waaz-zikri ail hakeem
'inna mathal a 'eesaa 'inda aal laahi kamathal i 'aadama khal aqahu min turaab thumma qaal a lahu kun fayakoon
Aul haqqu mir rrabbika fal aa takum mmina aal mumtareen

Faman haajjaka feehi mim ba'di maa jaa'aka mina aal'il mi faqul ta'aal awa nad'u 'abnaa'anaa waabnaa'akum wanisaa'anaa wanisaa'akum waanfusanaa waanfusakum thumma nabtahil fanaj'al-la'nata aal laahi 'al aa aal kaazibeen
'inna haazaa lahwa aal qasasu aul haqqu wamaa min 'il aahin 'il laa aal laahu wainna aal laaha lahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Fain tawal lawa fainna aal laaha 'al eemu bial mufsideen

Qul yaahla aal kitaabi ta'aal awa 'il aa kal imat sawaa'i baynanaa wabaynakum 'al laa na'buda 'il laa aal laaha wal aa nushrika bihi shaya wal aa yattakhiza ba'dunaa ba'daan 'arbaaba mmin dooni ail laahi fain tawal lawa faqoolu aushhadu biannaa muslimoon
Yaahla aal kitaabi lima tuhaajjoona fi 'ibraaheema wamaa 'unzil ati ait-tawrayaatu waal injeelu 'il laa mim ba'dihi 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Haantum haa'ul aa'i haajajtum feemaa lakum bihi 'il m fal ima tuhaajjoona feemaa laysa lakum bihi 'il m waal laahu ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon
Maa kaana 'ibraaheemu yahoodiyya wal aa nasraaniyya wal aakin kaana haneefa mmuslima wamaa kaana mina aal mushrikeen
'inna 'awlaa aan-naasi biibraaheema lal zeena aattaba'oohu wahaazaa aan-nabiaa'u waal zeena 'aamanu waal laahu wal eeyu aul mu'mineen
Waddat ttaa'ifat mmin 'ahli ail kitaabi law yudil loonakum wamaa yudil loona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
Yaahla aal kitaabi lima takfuroona biayaati ail laahi waantum tashhadoon
Yaahla aal kitaabi lima tal bisoona aal haqqa bial baatil i wataktumoona aal haqqa waantum ta'lamoon
Waqaal at ttaa'ifat mmin 'ahli ail kitaabi 'aaminu bial zi 'unzil a 'al aa aal zeena 'aamanu wajha aan-nahaari waakfuru 'aakhirahu la'al laahum yarji'oon

Wal aa tu'minu 'il laa liman tabi'a deenakum qul 'inna aal hudaa hudaa aal laahi 'any yyu'taa 'ahad mmithla maa 'ooteetum 'aw yuhaajjookum 'inda rabbikum qul 'inna aal fadla beeadi ail laahi yu'teehi many yyashaa'u waal laahu waasi'un 'al eem
Yakhtassu birahmatihi many yyashaa'u waal laahu zoo aul fadli ail'azeem

Wamin 'ahli ail kitaabi man 'in tamanhu biqintaar yu'addihi 'il ayka waminhum mman 'in tamanhu bideenaar llaa yu'addihi 'il ayka 'il laa maa dumta 'al ayhi qaa'ima zaal ika biannahum qaal u laysa 'al aynaa fi ail ummeeyina sabeel wayaqooloona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba wahum ya'lamoon
Bal aa man 'awfaa bi'ahdihi waattaqaa fainna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muttaqeen

'inna aal zeena yashtaroona bi'ahdi ail laahi waymaanihim thamana qal eelaan 'ul aa'ika laa khal aaqa lahum fi ail aakhirati wal aa yukal limuhumu aul laahu wal aa yanzuru 'il ayhim yawma aal qeeaamati wal aa yuzakkeehim wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem

Wainna minhum lafareeqa yal wuna 'al sinatahum bial kitaabi litahsiboohu mina aal kitaabi wamaa hooa mina aal kitaabi wayaqooloona hooa min 'indi ail laahi wamaa hooa min 'indi ail laahi wayaqooloona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba wahum ya'lamoon

Maa kaana libasharin 'any yyu'teeahu aul laahu aul kitaaba waal hukma waan-nubooaa'ata thumma yaqoola lin-naasi koonu 'ibaada lli min dooni ail laahi wal aakin koonu rabbaaneeyina bimaa kuntum ta'lamoona aal kitaaba wabimaa kuntum tadrusoon
Wal aa yamurukum 'an tattakhizu aul mal aa'ikata waan-nabeeaaina 'arbaabaan 'ayamurukum bial kufri ba'da 'iz 'antum mmuslimoon

Waiz 'akhaza aal laahu meethaaqa aan-nabeeaaina lamaa 'aataynaakum mmin kitaab wahikmat thumma jaa'akum rasool mmusaddiq llimaa ma'akum latu'minunna bihi wal atansurunnahu qaal a 'aaqrartum waakhazttum 'al aa zaal ikum 'isri qaal u 'aqrarnaa qaal a faashhadu waanaa ma'akum mmina aash-shaahideen
Faman tawal laa ba'da zaal ika faul aa'ika humu aul faasiqoon
'afaghayra deeni ail laahi tabghoona wal ahu 'aslama man fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi taw'a wakarha wail ayhi turja'oon

Qul 'aamannaa bial laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'al aynaa wamaa 'unzil a 'al aa 'ibraaheema waismaa'eela waishaaqa waya'qooba waal asbaati wamaa 'ooteea moosaa wa'eesaa waan-nabeeaaoona mir rrabbihim laa nufarriqu bayna 'ahad mminhum wanahnu lahu muslimoon
Wamany yyabtaghi ghayra aal islaami deena fal any yyuqbal a minhu wahwa fi ail aakhirati mina aal khaasireen
Kayfa yahdi ail laahu qawma kafaru ba'da 'eemaanihim washahidu 'anna aar-rasoola haqq wajaa'ahumu aul bayyinaatu waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
'ul aa'ika jazaa'uhum 'anna 'al ayhim la'nata aal laahi waal mal aa'ikati waan-naasi 'ajma'een
Khaal ideena feehaa laa yukhaffafu 'anhumu aul'azaabu wal aa hum yunzaroon
'il laa aal zeena taabu mim ba'di zaal ika waaslahu fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
'inna aal zeena kafaru ba'da 'eemaanihim thumma aazdaadu kufra llan tuqbal a tawbatuhum waul aa'ika humu aud-daal loon
'inna aal zeena kafaru wamaatu wahum kuffaar fal any yyuqbal a min 'ahadihim mmil'u aul ardi zahaba wal awi aiftadaa bihi 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'al eem wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Lan tanaal u aul birra hattaa tunfiqu mimmaa tuhibboon
Wamaa tunfiqu min sha' fainna aal laaha bihi 'al eem
Kul lu aut-ta'aami kaana hil la llibani 'israa'eela 'il laa maa harrama 'israa'eelu 'al aa nafsihi min qabli 'an tunazzal a aat-tawrayaatu qul fatu biat-tawrayaati faatloohaa 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Famani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba mim ba'di zaal ika faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon
Qul sadaqa aal laahu faattabi'u mil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wamaa kaana mina aal mushrikeen
'inna 'awwal a bayt wudi'a lin-naasi lal zi bibakkata mubaaraka wahuda llil'aal ameen

Feehi 'ayaatu bayyinaat mmaqaamu 'ibraaheema waman dakhal ahu kaana 'aamina wal il hi 'al aa aan-naasi hajju aul bayti mani aistataa'a 'il ayhi sabeela waman kafara fainna aal laaha ghaneeyun 'ani ail'aal ameen
Qul yaahla aal kitaabi lima takfuroona biayaati ail laahi waal laahu shaheedun 'al aa maa ta'mal oon
Qul yaahla aal kitaabi lima tasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi man 'aamana tabghoonahaa 'iwaja waantum shuhadaa'u wamaa aal laahu bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'in tutee'u fareeqa mmina aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba yaruddookum ba'da 'eemaanikum kaafireen
Wakayfa takfuroona waantum tutlaa 'al aykum 'ayaatu aul laahi wafeekum rasooluhu wamany yya'tasim bial laahi faqad hudeea 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auttaqu aul laaha haqqa tuqaatihi wal aa tamootunna 'il laa waantum mmuslimoon

Waa'tasimu bihabli ail laahi jamee'a wal aa tafarraqu waazkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykum 'iz kuntum 'a'daa' faal lafa bayna qul oobikum faasbahtum bini'matihi 'ikhwaana wakuntum 'al aa shafaa hufrat mmina aan-naari faanqazakum mminhaa kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakum 'ayaatihi la'al lakum tahtadoon
Wal takum mminkum 'ummat yad'oona 'il aa aal khayri wayamuroona bial ma'roofi wayanhawna 'ani ail munkari waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Wal aa takoonu kaal zeena tafarraqu waakhtal afu mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumu aul bayyinaatu waul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Yawma tabyaddu wujooh wataswaddu wujooh faammaa aal zeena aaswaddat wujoohuhum 'akafartum ba'da 'eemaanikum fazooqu aul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Waammaa aal zeena aabyaddat wujoohuhum fafi rahmati ail laahi hum feehaa khaal idoon
Til ka 'ayaatu aul laahi natloohaa 'al ayka bial haqqi wamaa aal laahu yureedu zul ma llil'aal ameen
Wal il hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wail aa aal laahi turja'u aul umoor

Kuntum khayra 'ummatin 'ukhrijat lin-naasi tamuroona bial ma'roofi watanhawna 'ani ail munkari watu'minoona bial laahi wal aw 'aamana 'ahlu aul kitaabi lakaana khayra llaahum mminhumu aul mu'minoona waaktharuhumu aul faasiqoon
Lany yyadurrookum 'il laa 'aza wainy yyuqaatil ookum yooal lookumu aul adbaara thumma laa yunsaroon

Duribat 'al ayhimu auz-zil latu 'ayna maa thuqifu 'il laa bihabl mmina aal laahi wahabl mmina aan-naasi wabaa'oo bighadab mmina aal laahi waduribat 'al ayhimu aul maskanatu zaal ika biannahum kaanu yakfuroona biayaati ail laahi wayaqtul oona aal anbeeaa'a bighayri haqq zaal ika bimaa 'asa wwakaanu ya'tadoon
Laysu sawaa' mmin 'ahli ail kitaabi 'ummat qaa'imat yatloona 'ayaati ail laahi 'aanaa'a aal yli wahum yasjudoon
Yu'minoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wayamuroona bial ma'roofi wayanhawna 'ani ail munkari wayusaari'oona fi ail khayraati waul aa'ika mina aas-saal iheen
Wamaa taf'al u min khayr fal an tukfaroohu waal laahu 'al eemu bial muttaqeen
'inna aal zeena kafaru lan tughneea 'anhum 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhum mmina aal laahi shaya waul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon

Mathal u maa yunfiqoona fi haazihi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa kamathal i reeh feehaa sirrun 'asaabat hartha qawm zal amu 'anfusahum faahlakathu wamaa zal amahumu aul laahu wal aakin 'anfusahum yazlimoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu bitaanat mmin doonikum laa yal oonakum khabaal a waddu maa 'anittum qad badati ail baghdaa'u min 'afwaahihim wamaa tukhfi sudooruhum 'akbaru qad bayyannaa lakumu aul ayaati 'in kuntum ta'qil oon

Haantum 'oolaa'i tuhibboonahum wal aa yuhibboonakum watu'minoona bial kitaabi kul lihi waizaa laqookum qaal u 'aamannaa waizaa khal awa 'addu 'al aykumu aul anaamil a mina aal ghayzi qul mootu bighayzikum 'inna aal laaha 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
'in tamsaskum hasanat tasu'hum wain tusibkum sayyeeat yafrahu bihaa wain tasbiru watattaqu laa yadirkum kayduhum shayaan 'inna aal laaha bimaa ya'mal oona muheeh
Waiz ghadawta min 'ahlika tubawwiu aul mu'mineena maqaa'ida lil qitaal i waal laahu samee'un 'al eem
'iz hammat ttaa'ifataani minkum 'an tafshal aa waal laahu wal eeyuhumaa wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail mu'minoon
Wal aqad nasarakumu aul laahu bibadr waantum 'azil lat faattaqu aul laaha la'al lakum tashkuroon
'iz taqoolu lil mu'mineena 'al any yyakfeeakum 'any yyumiddakum rabbukum bithal aathati 'aal aaf mmina aal mal aa'ikati munzal een
Bal aa 'in tasbiru watattaqu wayatookum mmin fawrihim haazaa yumdidkum rabbukum bikhamsati 'aal aaf mmina aal mal aa'ikati musawwameen
Wamaa ja'al ahu aul laahu 'il laa bushraa lakum wal itatma'inna qul oobukum bihi wamaa aan-nasru 'il laa min 'indi ail laahi ail'azeezi ail hakeem
Leeaqta'a tarafa mmina aal zeena kafaru 'aw yakbitahum fayanqal ibu khaa'ibeen
Laysa laka mina aal amri sha'un 'aw yatooba 'al ayhim 'aw yu'azzibahum fainnahum zaal imoon
Wal il hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi yaghfiru limany yyashaa'u wayu'azzibu many yyashaa'u waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa takul u aur-ribawaa 'ad'aafa mmudaa'afat waattaqu aul laaha la'al lakum tuflihoon
Waattaqu aun-naara aal ti 'u'iddat lil kaafireen
Waatee'u aul laaha waar-rasoola la'al lakum turhamoon
Saari'u 'il aa maghfirat mmir rrabbikum wajannatin 'arduhaa aas-samaawaatu waal ardu 'u'iddat lil muttaqeen
Aal zeena yunfiqoona fi ais-sarraa'i waad-darraa'i waal kaazimeena aal ghayza waal'aafeena 'ani ain-naasi waal laahu yuhibbu aul muhsineen
Waal zeena 'izaa fa'al u faahishatan 'aw zal amu 'anfusahum zakaru aul laaha faastaghfaru lizunoobihim wamany yyaghfiru auz-zunooba 'il laa aal laahu wal am yusirru 'al aa maa fa'al u wahum ya'lamoon
'ul aa'ika jazaa'uhum mmaghfirat mmir rrabbihim wajannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wani'ma 'ajru aul'aamil een
Qad khal at min qablikum sunan faseeru fi ail ardi faanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mukazzibeen
Haazaa bayaal llin-naasi wahuda wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen
Wal aa tahinu wal aa tahzanu waantumu aul a'lawna 'in kuntum mmu'mineen

'iny yyamsaskum qarh faqad massa aal qawma qarh mmithluhu watil ka aal ayyaamu nudaawil uhaa bayna aan-naasi wal eea'lama aal laahu aul zeena 'aamanu wayattakhiza minkum shuhadaa'a waal laahu laa yuhibbu auz-zaal imeen
Wal eeumahhisa aal laahu aul zeena 'aamanu wayamhaqa aal kaafireen
'am hasibtum 'an tadkhul u aul jannata wal ammaa ya'lami ail laahu aul zeena jaahadu minkum waya'lama aas-saabireen
Wal aqad kuntum tamannawna aal mawta min qabli 'an tal qawhu faqad raytumoohu waantum tanzuroon

Wamaa muhammadun 'il laa rasool qad khal at min qablihi air-rusul u 'afaeen mmaata 'aw qutil a aanqal abtum 'al aa 'a'qaabikum wamany yyanqal ib 'al aa 'aqibayhi fal any yyadurra aal laaha shaya wasayajzi ail laahu aush-shaakireen

Wamaa kaana linafsin 'an tamoota 'il laa biizni ail laahi kitaaba mmu'ajjal a wamany yyurid thawaaba aad-dunyaa nu'tihi minhaa wamany yyurid thawaaba aal aakhirati nu'tihi minhaa wasanajzi aish-shaakireen
Wakayyim mmin nnabiaa' qutil a ma'ahu ribbeeyoona katheer famaa wahanu limaa 'asaabahum fi sabeeli ail laahi wamaa da'ufu wamaa aastakaanu waal laahu yuhibbu aus-saabireen
Wamaa kaana qawlahum 'il laa 'an qaal u rabbanaa aaghfir lanaa zunoobanaa waisraafanaa fi 'amrinaa wathabbit 'aqdaamanaa waansurnaa 'al aa aal qawmi ail kaafireen
Faatayaahumu aul laahu thawaaba aad-dunyaa wahusna thawaabi ail aakhirati waal laahu yuhibbu aul muhsineen
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'in tutee'u aul zeena kafaru yaruddookum 'al aa 'a'qaabikum fatanqal ibu khaasireen
Bal i ail laahu mawlayaakum wahwa khayru aun-naasireen
Sanul qi fi qul oobi ail zeena kafaru aur-ru'ba bimaa 'ashraku bial laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sul taana wamawayaahumu aun-naaru wabeesa mathwaa aaz-zaal imeen

Wal aqad sadaqakumu aul laahu wa'dahu 'iz tahussoonahum biiznihi hattaa 'izaa fashil tum watanaaza'tum fi ail amri wa'asaytum mmim ba'di maa 'arayaakum mmaa tuhibboona minkum mmany yyureedu aud-dunyaa waminkum mmany yyureedu aul aakhirata thumma sarafakum 'anhum leeabtal eeakum wal aqad 'afaa 'ankum waal laahu zoo fadlin 'al aa aal mu'mineen

'iz tus'idoona wal aa tal wuna 'al aa 'ahad waar-rasoolu yad'ookum fi 'ukhrayaakum faathaabakum ghammaa bighamm llikaylaa tahzanu 'al aa maa faatakum wal aa maa 'asaabakum waal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon

Thumma 'anzal a 'al aykum mmim ba'di ail ghammi 'amanat nnu'aasa yaghshaa taa'ifat mminkum wataa'ifat qad 'ahammathum 'anfusuhum yazunnoona bial laahi ghayra aal haqqi zanna aal jaahil iyyati yaqooloona hal-lanaa mina aal amri min sha' qul 'inna aal amra kul laahu lil hi yukhfoona fi 'anfusihim mmaa laa yubdoona laka yaqooloona law kaana lanaa mina aal amri sha' mmaa qutil naa haahunaa qul-law kuntum fi beeootikum labaraza aal zeena kutiba 'al ayhimu aul qatlu 'il aa madaaji'ihim wal eeabtal eea aal laahu maa fi sudoorikum wal eeumahhisa maa fi qul oobikum waal laahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
'inna aal zeena tawal lawa minkum yawma aal taqaa aal jam'aani 'innamaa aastazal laahumu aush-shaytaanu biba'di maa kasabu wal aqad 'afaa aal laahu 'anhum 'inna aal laaha ghafoorun hal eem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa takoonu kaal zeena kafaru waqaal u liikhwaanihim 'izaa darabu fi ail ardi 'aw kaanu ghuzza llaw kaanu 'indanaa maa maatu wamaa qutil u leeaj'al a aal laahu zaal ika hasrat fi qul oobihim waal laahu yuhyi wayumeetu waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Wal a'in qutil tum fi sabeeli ail laahi 'aw mittum lamaghfirat mmina aal laahi warahmatun khayr mmimmaa tajma'oon
Wal a'im mmittum 'aw qutil tum lail aa aal laahi tuhsharoon

Fabimaa rahmat mmina aal laahi linta lahum wal aw kunta fazzaan ghal eeza aal qal bi laanfaddu min hawlika faa'fu 'anhum waastaghfir lahum washaawirhum fi ail amri faizaa 'azamta fatawakkal 'al aa aal laahi 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul mutawakkil een
'iny yyansurkumu aul laahu fal aa ghaal iba lakum wainy yyakhzul kum faman zaa aal zi yansurukum mmim ba'dihi wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail mu'minoon
Wamaa kaana linabiaa'in 'any yyughal la wamany yyaghlul yati bimaa ghal la yawma aal qeeaamati thumma tooaffaa kul lu nafs mmaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
'afamani aittaba'a ridwaana aal laahi kamam baa'a bisakhat mmina aal laahi wamawayaahu jahannamu wabeesa aal maseer
Hum darajaatun 'inda aal laahi waal laahu baseeru bimaa ya'mal oon

Laqad manna aal laahu 'al aa aal mu'mineena 'iz ba'atha feehim rasoola mmin 'anfusihim yatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatihi wayuzakkeehim wayu'al limuhumu aul kitaaba waal hikmata wain kaanu min qablu lafi dal aal mmubeen
'awal ammaa 'asaabatkum mmuseebat qad 'asabtum mmithlayhaa qul tum 'annaa haazaa qul hooa min 'indi 'anfusikum 'inna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wamaa 'asaabakum yawma aal taqaa aal jam'aani fabiizni ail laahi wal eea'lama aal mu'mineen

Wal eea'lama aal zeena naafaqu waqeela lahum ta'aal awa qaatil u fi sabeeli ail laahi 'awi aidfa'u qaal u law na'lamu qitaal a llaattaba'naakum hum lil kufri yawma'izin 'aqrabu minhum lil eemaani yaqooloona biafwaahihim mmaa laysa fi qul oobihim waal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa yaktumoon
Aal zeena qaal u liikhwaanihim waqa'adu law 'ataa'oonaa maa qutil u qul faadra'u 'an 'anfusikumu aul mawta 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Wal aa tahsibanna aal zeena qutil u fi sabeeli ail laahi 'amwaataa bal 'ahyaa'un 'inda rabbihim yurzaqoon
Fariheena bimaa 'aatayaahumu aul laahu min fadlihi wayastabshiroona bial zeena lam yal haqu bihim mmin khal fihim 'al laa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Yastabshiroona bini'mat mmina aal laahi wafadl waanna aal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajra aal mu'mineen
Aal zeena aastajaabu lil hi waar-rasooli mim ba'di maa 'asaabahumu aul qarhu lil zeena 'ahsanu minhum waattaqawa 'ajrun 'azeem
Ail zeena qaal a lahumu aun-naasu 'inna aan-naasa qad jama'u lakum faakhshawhum fazaadahum 'eemaana waqaal u hasbunaa aal laahu wani'ma aal wakeel
Faanqal abu bini'mat mmina aal laahi wafadl llam yamsashum sooaa' waattaba'u ridwaana aal laahi waal laahu zoo fadlin 'azeem
'innamaa zaal ikumu aush-shaytaanu yukhawwifu 'awleeaa'ahu fal aa takhaafoohum wakhaafooni 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wal aa yuhzinka aal zeena yusaari'oona fi ail kufri 'innahum lany yyadurru aul laaha shaya yureedu aul laahu 'al laa yaj'al a lahum hazza fi ail aakhirati wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
'inna aal zeena aashtarawua aul kufra bial eemaani lany yyadurru aul laaha shaya wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wal aa yahsibanna aal zeena kafaru 'annamaa numli lahum khayr llianfusihim 'innamaa numli lahum leeazdaadu 'ithma wal ahum 'azaab mmuheen
