Mmaa kaana aal laahu leeazara aal mu'mineena 'al aa maa 'antum 'al ayhi hattaa yameeza aal khabeetha mina aat-tayyibi wamaa kaana aal laahu leeutli'akum 'al aa aal ghaybi wal aakinna aal laaha yajtabi mir rrusul ihi many yyashaa'u faaminu bial laahi warusul ihi wain tu'minu watattaqu fal akum 'ajrun 'azeem

Wal aa yahsibanna aal zeena yabkhal oona bimaa 'aatayaahumu aul laahu min fadlihi hooa khayra llaahum bal hooa sharr llaahum sayutawwaqoona maa bakhil u bihi yawma aal qeeaamati wal il hi meeraathu aus-samaawaati waal ardi waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Llaqad sami'a aal laahu qawla aal zeena qaal u 'inna aal laaha faqeer wanahnu 'aghneeaa'u sanaktubu maa qaal u waqatlahumu aul anbeeaa'a bighayri haqq wanaqoolu zooqu 'azaaba aal hareeq
Zaal ika bimaa qaddamat 'aydeekum waanna aal laaha laysa bizal laam llil'abeed

Ail zeena qaal u 'inna aal laaha 'ahida 'il aynaa 'al laa nu'mina lirasoolin hattaa yateeanaa biqurbaan takul uhu aun-naaru qul qad jaa'akum rusul mmin qabli bial bayyinaati wabial zi qul tum fal ima qatal tumoohum 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fain kazzabooka faqad kuzziba rusul mmin qablika jaa'oo bial bayyinaati waaz-zuburi waal kitaabi ail muneer

Kul lu nafs zaa'iqatu aul mawti wainnamaa tooaffawna 'ujoorakum yawma aal qeeaamati faman zuhziha 'ani ain-naari waudkhil a aal jannata faqad faaza wamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunyaa 'il laa mataa'u aul ghuroor

Latublawunna fi 'amwaal ikum waanfusikum wal atasma'unna mina aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba min qablikum wamina aal zeena 'ashraku 'aza katheera wain tasbiru watattaqu fainna zaal ika min 'azmi ail umoor
Waiz 'akhaza aal laahu meethaaqa aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba latubayyinunnahu lin-naasi wal aa taktumoonahu fanabazoohu waraa'a zuhoorihim waashtarawa bihi thamana qal eela fabeesa maa yashtaroon
Laa yahsibanna aal zeena yafrahoona bimaa 'ata wwayuhibboona 'any yyuhmadu bimaa lam yaf'al u fal aa tahsibannahum bimafaazat mmina aal'azaabi wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wal il hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
'inna fi khal qi ais-samaawaati waal ardi waakhtil aafi ail yli waan-nahaari layaat lliooli ail al baab
Ail zeena yazkuroona aal laaha qeeaama waqu'ooda wa'al aa junoobihim wayatafakkaroona fi khal qi ais-samaawaati waal ardi rabbanaa maa khal aqta haazaa baatil a subhaanaka faqinaa 'azaaba aan-naar
Rabbanaa 'innaka man tudkhil i ain-naara faqad 'akhzaytahu wamaa liz-zaal imeena min 'ansaar
Rrabbanaa 'innanaa sami'naa munaadeea yunaadi lil eemaani 'an 'aaminu birabbikum faamannaa rabbanaa faaghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wakaffir 'annaa sayyiaatinaa watawaffanaa ma'a aal abraar
Rabbanaa wa'aatinaa maa wa'adttanaa 'al aa rusul ika wal aa tukhzinaa yawma aal qeeaamati 'innaka laa tukhlifu aul mee'aad

Faastajaaba lahum rabbuhum 'anni laa 'udee'u 'amal a 'aamil mminkum mmin zakarin 'aw 'unthaa ba'dukum mmim ba'd faal zeena haajaru waukhriju min deeaarihim waoozu fi sabeeli waqaatal u waqutil u laukaffiranna 'anhum sayyiaatihim wal audkhil annahum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru thawaaba mmin 'indi ail laahi waal laahu 'indahu husnu auth-thawaab
Laa yaghurrannaka taqal lubu aul zeena kafaru fi ail bil aad
Mataa' qal eel thumma mawayaahum jahannamu wabeesa aal mihaad
Laakini ail zeena aattaqawa rabbahum lahum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa nuzul a mmin 'indi ail laahi wamaa 'inda aal laahi khayr llil abraar

Wainna min 'ahli ail kitaabi lamany yyu'minu bial laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'il aykum wamaa 'unzil a 'il ayhim khaashi'eena lil hi laa yashtaroona biayaati ail laahi thamana qal eelaan 'ul aa'ika lahum 'ajruhum 'inda rabbihim 'inna aal laaha saree'u aul hisaab
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu ausbiru wasaabiru waraabitu waattaqu aul laaha la'al lakum tuflihoon

Yayyuhaa aan-naasu auttaqu rabbakumu aul zi khal aqakum mmin nnafs waahidat wakhal aqa minhaa zawjahaa wabaththa minhumaa rijaal a katheera wanisaa' waattaqu aul laaha aal zi tassaa'al oona bihi waal arhaama 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al aykum raqeeb
Wa'aatu aul yataamaa 'amwaal ahum wal aa tatabaddal u aul khabeetha biat-tayyibi wal aa takul u 'amwaal ahum 'il aa 'amwaal ikum 'innahu kaana hooba kabeer

Wain khiftum 'al laa tuqsitu fi ail yataamaa faankihu maa taaba lakum mmina aan-nisaa'i mathnaa wathul aatha warubaa'a fain khiftum 'al laa ta'dil u fawaahidatan 'aw maa mal akat 'aymaanukum zaal ika 'adnaa 'al laa ta'ool
Wa'aatu aun-nisaa'a saduqaatihinna nihlat fain tibna lakum 'an sha' mminhu nafsa fakul oohu haneeaa mmareea
Wal aa tu'tu aus-sufahaa 'amwaal akumu aul ti ja'al a aal laahu lakum qeeama waarzuqoohum feehaa waaksoohum waqoolu lahum qawla mma'roof

Waabtal u aul yataamaa hattaa 'izaa bal aghu aun-nikaaha fain 'aanastum mminhum rushda faadfa'u 'il ayhim 'amwaal ahum wal aa takul oohaa 'israafa wabidaaraan 'any yyakbaru waman kaana ghaniyya fal yasta'fif waman kaana faqeera fal yakul bial ma'roofi faizaa dafa'tum 'il ayhim 'amwaal ahum faashhidu 'al ayhim wakafaa bial laahi haseeb
Llir-rijaal i naseeb mmimmaa taraka aal waal idaani waal aqraboona wal in-nisaa'i naseeb mmimmaa taraka aal waal idaani waal aqraboona mimmaa qal la minhu 'aw kathura naseeba mmafrood
Waizaa hadara aal qismata 'oolu aul qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeenu faarzuqoohum mminhu waqoolu lahum qawla mma'roof
Wal yakhsha aal zeena law taraku min khal fihim zurriyyat di'aafaan khaafu 'al ayhim fal yattaqu aul laaha wal yaqoolu qawla sadeeda
'inna aal zeena yakul oona 'amwaal a aal yataamaa zul maan 'innamaa yakul oona fi butoonihim naara wasayaslawna sa'eer

Yooseekumu aul laahu fi 'awlaadikum liz-zakari mithlu hazzi ail unthayayni fain kunna nisaa' fawqa aathnatayni fal ahunna thul uthaa maa taraka wain kaanat waahidat fal ahaa aan-nisfu wal iabawayhi likul li waahid mminhumaa aas-sudusu mimmaa taraka 'in kaana lahu wal ad fail llam yakul llaahu wal ad wawarithahu 'abawaahu fal iummihi aith-thul uthu fain kaana lahu 'ikhwat fal iummihi ais-sudusu mim ba'di wasiyyat yoosi bihaa 'aw daynin 'aabaa'ukum waabnaa'ukum laa tadroona 'ayyuhum 'aqrabu lakum naf'a fareedat mmina aal laahi 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al eemaan hakeem

Wal akum nisfu maa taraka 'azwaajukum 'il llam yakul llaahunna wal ad fain kaana lahunna wal ad fal akumu aur-rubu'u mimmaa tarakna mim ba'di wasiyyat yooseena bihaa 'aw dayn wal ahunna aar-rubu'u mimmaa taraktum 'il llam yakul llakum wal ad fain kaana lakum wal ad fal ahunna aath-thumunu mimmaa taraktum mmim ba'di wasiyyat toosoona bihaa 'aw dayn wain kaana rajul yoorathu kal aal atan 'awi aimraat wal ahu 'akhun 'aw 'ukht fal ikul li waahid mminhumaa aas-sudusu fain kaanu 'akthara min zaal ika fahum shurakaa'u fi aith-thul uthi mim ba'di wasiyyat yoosi bihaa 'aw daynin ghayra mudaarr wasiyyat mmina aal laahi waal laahu 'al eemun hal eem
Til ka hudoodu aul laahi wamany yyuti'i ail laaha warasoolahu nudkhil hu jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wazaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem
Wamany yya'si ail laaha warasoolahu wayata'adda hudoodahu nudkhil hu naaraan khaal ida feehaa wal ahu 'azaab mmuheen

Waal laati yateena aal faahishata min nnisaa'ikum faastashhidu 'al ayhinna 'arba'at mminkum fain shahidu faamsikoohunna fi ail beeooti hattaa yatawaffayaahunna aal mawtu 'aw yaj'al a aal laahu lahunna sabeel
Waal zaani yateeaanihaa minkum faazoohumaa fain taabaa waaslahaa faa'ridu 'anhumaa 'inna aal laaha kaana tawwaaba rraheema
'innamaa aat-tawbatu 'al aa aal laahi lil zeena ya'mal oona aas-sooaa'a bijahaal at thumma yatooboona min qareeb faul aa'ika yatoobu aul laahu 'al ayhim wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeem

Wal aysati ait-tawbatu lil zeena ya'mal oona aas-sayyiaati hattaa 'izaa hadara 'ahadahumu aul mawtu qaal a 'inni tubtu au'al aana wal aa aal zeena yamootoona wahum kuffaarun 'ul aa'ika 'a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabaan 'al eem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa yahil lu lakum 'an tarithu aun-nisaa'a karha wal aa ta'dul oohunna litazhabu biba'di maa 'aataytumoohunna 'il laa 'any yyateena bifaahishat mmubayyinat wa'aashiroohunna bial ma'roofi fain karihtumoohunna fa'asaa 'an takrahu shaya wayaj'al a aal laahu feehi khayra katheer
Wain 'aradttumu austibdaal a zawj mmakaana zawj wa'aataytum 'ihdayaahunna qintaara fal aa takhuzu minhu shayaan 'atakhuzoonahu buhtaana waithma mmubeen
Wakayfa takhuzoonahu waqad 'afdaa ba'dukum 'il aa ba'd waakhazna minkum mmeethaaqaan ghal eez
Wal aa tankihu maa nakaha 'aabaa'ukum mmina aan-nisaa 'il laa maa qad sal afa 'innahu kaana faahishat wamaqta wasaa'a sabeela

Hurrimat 'al aykum 'ummahaatukum wabanaatukum waakhawaatukum wa'ammaatukum wakhaal aatukum wabanaatu aul akhi wabanaatu aul ukhti waummahaatukumu aul laati 'arda'nakum waakhawaatukum mmina aar-radaa'ati waummahaatu nisaa'ikum warabaa'ibukumu aul laati fi hujoorikum mmin nnisaa'ikumu aul laati dakhal tum bihinna fail llam takoonu dakhal tum bihinna fal aa junaaha 'al aykum wahal aa'il u 'abnaa'ikumu aul zeena min 'aslaabikum waan tajma'u bayna aal ukhtayni 'il laa maa qad sal afa 'inna aal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem

Waal muhsanaatu mina aan-nisaa 'il laa maa mal akat 'aymaanukum kitaaba aal laahi 'al aykum waahal la lakum mmaa waraa'a zaal ikum 'an tabtaghu biamwaal ikum mmuhsineena ghayra musaafiheena famaa aastamta'tum bihi minhunna faatoohunna 'ujoorahunna fareedat wal aa junaaha 'al aykum feemaa taraadaytum bihi mim ba'di ail fareedati 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al eemaan hakeem

Wamal llam yastati' minkum tawlaan 'any yyankiha aal muhsanaati ail mu'minaati famim mmaa mal akat 'aymaanukum mmin fatayaatikumu aul mu'minaati waal laahu 'a'lamu bieemaanikum ba'dukum mmim ba'd faankihoohunna biizni 'ahlihinna wa'aatoohunna 'ujoorahunna bial ma'roofi muhsanaatin ghayra musaafihaat wal aa muttakhizaati 'akhdaan faizaa 'uhsinna fain 'atayna bifaahishat fa'al ayhinna nisfu maa 'al aa aal muhsanaati mina aal'azaabi zaal ika liman khasheea aal'anata minkum waan tasbiru khayr llakum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Yureedu aul laahu leeubayyina lakum wayahdeeakum sunana aal zeena min qablikum wayatooba 'al aykum waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Waal laahu yureedu 'any yyatooba 'al aykum wayureedu aul zeena yattabi'oona aash-shahawaati 'an tameelu maylaan 'azeem
Yureedu aul laahu 'any yyukhaffifa 'ankum wakhul iqa aal insaanu da'eef
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa takul u 'amwaal akum baynakum bial baatil i 'il laa 'an takoona tijaaratun 'an taraad mminkum wal aa taqtul u 'anfusakum 'inna aal laaha kaana bikum raheem
Wamany yyaf'al zaal ika 'udwaana wazul ma fasawfa nusleehi naara wakaana zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseera
'in tajtanibu kabaa'ira maa tunhawna 'anhu nukaffir 'ankum sayyiaatikum wanudkhil kum mmadkhal a kareem

Wal aa tatamannawa maa faddal a aal laahu bihi ba'dakum 'al aa ba'd llir-rijaal i naseeb mmimmaa aaktasabu wal in-nisaa'i naseeb mmimmaa aaktasabna wasal u aul laaha min fadlihi 'inna aal laaha kaana bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Wal ikul l ja'al naa mawaal eea mimmaa taraka aal waal idaani waal aqraboona waal zeena 'aaqadat 'aymaanukum faatoohum naseebahum 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al aa kul li sha' shaheeda

Air-rijaal u qawwaamoona 'al aa aan-nisaa'i bimaa faddal a aal laahu ba'dahum 'al aa ba'd wabimaa 'anfaqu min 'amwaal ihim faas-saal ihaatu qaanitaatun haafizaat llil ghaybi bimaa hafiza aal laahu waal laati takhaafoona nushoozahunna fa'izoohunna waahjuroohunna fi ail madaaji'i waadriboohunna fain 'ata'nakum fal aa tabghu 'al ayhinna sabeelaan 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al iyya kabeer
Wain khiftum shiqaaqa baynihimaa faab'athu hakama mmin 'ahlihi wahakama mmin 'ahlihaa 'iny yyureedaa 'islaaha yooaffiqi ail laahu baynahumaa 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al eemaan khabeer

Waa'budu aul laaha wal aa tushriku bihi shaya wabial waal idayni 'ihsaana wabizi ail qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeeni waal jaari zi ail qurbaa waal jaari ail junubi waas-saahibi bial janbi waabni ais-sabeeli wamaa mal akat 'aymaanukum 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu man kaana mukhtaal a fakhoora
Ail zeena yabkhal oona wayamuroona aan-naasa bial bukhli wayaktumoona maa 'aatayaahumu aul laahu min fadlihi waa'tadnaa lil kaafireena 'azaaba mmuheen
Waal zeena yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum reeaa'a aan-naasi wal aa yu'minoona bial laahi wal aa bial yawmi ail aakhiri wamany yyakuni aish-shaytaanu lahu qareena fasaa'a qareen
Wamaazaa 'al ayhim law 'aamanu bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri waanfaqu mimmaa razaqahumu aul laahu wakaana aal laahu bihim 'al eema
'inna aal laaha laa yazlimu mithqaal a zarrat wain taku hasanat yudaa'ifhaa wayu'ti mil lladunhu 'ajraan 'azeem
Fakayfa 'izaa jeenaa min kul li 'ummati bishaheed wajeenaa bika 'al aa haa'ul aa'i shaheed
Yawma'iz yawaddu aul zeena kafaru wa'asawua aur-rasoola law tassawwaa bihimu aul ardu wal aa yaktumoona aal laaha hadeeth

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa taqrabu aus-sal awaata waantum sukaaraa hattaa ta'lamu maa taqooloona wal aa junubaan 'il laa 'aabiri sabeelin hattaa taghtasil u wain kuntum mmardaa 'aw 'al aa safarin 'aw jaa 'ahad mminkum mmina aal ghaa'iti 'aw laamastumu aun-nisaa'a fal am tajidu maa' fatayammamu sa'eeda tayyiba faamsahu biwujoohikum waydeekum 'inna aal laaha kaana 'afoowaan ghafoora

'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena 'ootu naseeba mmina aal kitaabi yashtaroona aad-dal aal ata wayureedoona 'an tadil lu aus-sabeela  waal laahu 'a'lamu bia'daa'ikum wakafaa bial laahi wal iyya wakafaa bial laahi naseer

Mmina aal zeena haadu yuharrifoona aal kal ima 'am mmawaadi'ihi wayaqooloona sami'naa wa'asaynaa waasma' ghayra musma' waraa'inaa layyaa bial sinatihim wata'na fi aid-deeni wal aw 'annahum qaal u sami'naa waata'naa waasma' waanzurnaa lakaana khayra llaahum waaqwama wal aakil lla'anahumu aul laahu bikufrihim fal aa yu'minoona 'il laa qal eel

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba 'aaminu bimaa nazzal naa musaddiqa llimaa ma'akum mmin qabli 'an nnatmisa wujooha fanaruddahaa 'al aa 'adbaarihaa 'aw nal'anahum kamaa la'annaa 'ashaaba aas-sabti wakaana 'amru aul laahi maf'oola
'inna aal laaha laa yaghfiru 'any yyushraka bihi wayaghfiru maa doona zaal ika limany yyashaa'u wamany yyushrik bial laahi faqadi aiftaraa 'ithmaan 'azeema
'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena yuzakkoona 'anfusahum bal i ail laahu yuzakki many yyashaa'u wal aa yuzlamoona fateela
Aunzur kayfa yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba wakafaa bihi 'ithma mmubeena
'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena 'ootu naseeba mmina aal kitaabi yu'minoona bial jibti waat-taaghooti wayaqooloona lil zeena kafaru haa'ul aa'i aahdaa mina aal zeena 'aamanu sabeela
'ul aa'ika aal zeena la'anahumu aul laahu wamany yyal'ani ail laahu fal an tajida lahu naseera
'am lahum naseeb mmina aal mul ki faiza llaa yu'toona aan-naasa naqeera
'am yahsudoona aan-naasa 'al aa maa 'aatayaahumu aul laahu min fadlihi faqad 'aataynaa 'aal a 'ibraaheema aal kitaaba waal hikmata wa'aataynaahum mmul kaan 'azeem
Faminhum mman 'aamana bihi waminhum mman sadda 'anhu wakafaa bijahannama sa'eera
'inna aal zeena kafaru biayaatinaa sawfa nusleehim naara kul lamaa nadijat jul ooduhum baddal naahum jul oodaan ghayrahaa leeazooqu aul'azaaba 'inna aal laaha kaana 'azeezaan hakeem
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati sanudkhil uhum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada llaahum feehaa 'azwaaj mmutahharat wanudkhil uhum zil la zal eela
'inna aal laaha yamurukum 'an tu'addu aul amaanaati 'il aa 'ahlihaa waizaa hakamtum bayna aan-naasi 'an tahkumu bial'adli 'inna aal laaha ni'mmaa ya'izukum bihi 'inna aal laaha kaana samee'aa baseer

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'atee'u aul laaha waatee'u aur-rasoola waooli ail amri minkum fain tanaaza'tum fi sha' faruddoohu 'il aa aal laahi waar-rasooli 'in kuntum tu'minoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri zaal ika khayr waahsanu taweela

'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena yaz'umoona 'annahum 'aamanu bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka wamaa 'unzil a min qablika yureedoona 'any yyatahaakamu 'il aa aat-taaghooti waqad 'umiru 'any yyakfuru bihi wayureedu aush-shaytaanu 'any yyudil laahum dal aal aa ba'eed
Waizaa qeela lahum ta'aal awa 'il aa maa 'anzal a aal laahu wail aa aar-rasooli rayta aal munaafiqeena yasuddoona 'anka sudood
Fakayfa 'izaa 'asaabathum mmuseebatu bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim thumma jaa'ooka yahlifoona bial laahi 'in 'aradnaa 'il laa 'ihsaana watawfeeqa
'ul aa'ika aal zeena ya'lamu aul laahu maa fi qul oobihim faa'rid 'anhum wa'izhum waqul-laahum fi 'anfusihim qawlaa bal eegh

Wamaa 'arsal naa mir rrasoolin 'il laa leeutaa'a biizni ail laahi wal aw 'annahum 'iz zzal amu 'anfusahum jaa'ooka faastaghfaru aul laaha waastaghfara lahumu aur-rasoolu lawajadu aul laaha tawwaaba rraheem
Fal aa warabbika laa yu'minoona hattaa yuhakkimooka feemaa shajara baynahum thumma laa yajidu fi 'anfusihim haraja mmimmaa qadayta wayusal limu tasleem

Wal aw 'annaa katabnaa 'al ayhim 'anu auqtul u 'anfusakum 'awu aukhruju min deeaarikum mmaa fa'al oohu 'il laa qal eel mminhum wal aw 'annahum fa'al u maa yoo'azoona bihi lakaana khayra llaahum waashadda tathbeeh
Waiza llaataynaahum mmil lladunnaa 'ajraan 'azeem
Wal ahadaynaahum siraata mmustaqeem
Wamany yyuti'i ail laaha waar-rasoola faul aa'ika ma'a aal zeena 'an'ama aal laahu 'al ayhim mmina aan-nabeeaaina waas-siddeeqeena waash-shuhadaa'i waas-saal iheena wahasuna 'ul aa'ika rafeeq
Zaal ika aal fadlu mina aal laahi wakafaa bial laahi 'al eem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu khuzu hizrakum faanfiru thubaatin 'awi ainfiru jamee'
Wainna minkum lamal llayubatteeanna fain 'asaabatkum mmuseebat qaal a qad 'an'ama aal laahu 'al ayya 'iz lam 'akum mma'ahum shaheed
Wal a'in 'asaabakum fadl mmina aal laahi layaqoolanna kaal llam yakum baynakum wabaynahu mawaddat yaal aytani kuntu ma'ahum faafooza fawzaan 'azeem
Fal yuqaatil fi sabeeli ail laahi ail zeena yashroona aal hayawaata aad-dunyaa bial aakhirati wamany yyuqaatil fi sabeeli ail laahi fayuqtal 'aw yaghlib fasawfa nu'teehi 'ajraan 'azeem

Wamaa lakum laa tuqaatil oona fi sabeeli ail laahi waal mustad'afeena mina aar-rijaal i waan-nisaa'i waal wil daani ail zeena yaqooloona rabbanaa 'akhrijnaa min haazihi ail qaryati aiz-zaal imi 'ahluhaa waaj'al-lanaa mil lladunka wal iyya waaj'al-lanaa mil lladunka naseera
Ail zeena 'aamanu yuqaatil oona fi sabeeli ail laahi waal zeena kafaru yuqaatil oona fi sabeeli ait-taaghooti faqaatil u 'awleeaa'a aash-shaytaani 'inna kayda aash-shaytaani kaana da'eefa

'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena qeela lahum kuffu 'aydeeakum waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata fal ammaa kutiba 'al ayhimu aul qitaal u 'izaa fareeq mminhum yakhshawna aan-naasa kakhashyati ail laahi 'aw 'ashadda khashyat waqaal u rabbanaa lima katabta 'al aynaa aal qitaal a lawlaa 'akhkhartanaa 'il aa 'ajal qareeb qul mataa'u aud-dunyaa qal eel waal aakhiratu khayr llimani aittaqaa wal aa tuzlamoona fateela

'aynamaa takoonu yudrikkkumu aul mawtu wal aw kuntum fi burooj mmushayyadat wain tusibhum hasanat yaqoolu haazihi min 'indi ail laahi wain tusibhum sayyeeat yaqoolu haazihi min 'indika qul kul l mmin 'indi ail laahi famaal i haa'ul aa'i ail qawmi laa yakaadoona yafqahoona hadeeth
Mmaa 'asaabaka min hasanat famina aal laahi wamaa 'asaabaka min sayyeeat famin nnafsika waarsal naaka lin-naasi rasoola wakafaa bial laahi shaheed
Mmany yyuti'i air-rasoola faqad 'ataa'a aal laaha waman tawal laa famaa 'arsal naaka 'al ayhim hafeez
Wayaqooloona taa'at faizaa barazu min 'indika bayyata taa'ifat mminhum ghayra aal zi taqoolu waal laahu yaktubu maa yubayyitoona faa'rid 'anhum watawakkal 'al aa aal laahi wakafaa bial laahi wakeela
'afal aa yatadabbaroona aal qur'aana wal aw kaana min 'indi ghayri ail laahi lawajadu feehi aikhtil aafa katheer

Waizaa jaa'ahum 'amr mmina aal amni 'awi ail khawfi 'azaa'u bihi wal aw raddoohu 'il aa aar-rasooli wail aa 'ooli ail amri minhum la'al imahu aul zeena yastanbitoonahu minhum wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu laattaba'tumu aush-shaytaana 'il laa qal eel
Faqaatil fi sabeeli ail laahi laa tukal lafu 'il laa nafsaka waharridi ail mu'mineena 'asaa aal laahu 'any yyakuffa basa aal zeena kafaru waal laahu 'ashaddu basa waashaddu tankeel
Mmany yyashfa' shafaa'atan hasanat yakul llaahu naseeb mminhaa wamany yyashfa' shafaa'at sayyeeat yakul llaahu kifl mminhaa wakaana aal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' mmuqeeh
Waizaa huyyeetum bitahiyyat fahayyu biahsana minhaa 'aw ruddoohaa 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al aa kul li sha'in haseeba
Ail laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa layajma'annakum 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati laa rayba feehi waman 'asdaqu mina aal laahi hadeeth
Famaa lakum fi ail munaafiqeena feeatayni waal laahu 'arkasahum bimaa kasabu 'atureedoona 'an tahdu man 'adal la aal laahu wamany yyudlil i ail laahu fal an tajida lahu sabeel

Waddu law takfuroona kamaa kafaru fatakoonoona sawaa' fal aa tattakhizu minhum 'awleeaa'a hattaa yuhaajiru fi sabeeli ail laahi fain tawal lawa fakhuzoohum waaqtul oohum haythu wajadttumoohum wal aa tattakhizu minhum wal iyya wal aa naseera

'il laa aal zeena yasil oona 'il aa qawmi baynakum wabaynahum mmeethaaqun 'aw jaa'ookum hasirat sudooruhum 'any yyuqaatil ookum 'aw yuqaatil u qawmahum wal aw shaa'a aal laahu lasal latahum 'al aykum fal aqaatal ookum faini ai'tazal ookum fal am yuqaatil ookum waal qawa 'il aykumu aus-sal ama famaa ja'al a aal laahu lakum 'al ayhim sabeel

Satajidoona 'aakhareena yureedoona 'any yyamanookum wayamanu qawmahum kul la maa ruddu 'il aa aal fitnati 'urkisu feehaa fail llam ya'tazil ookum wayul qu 'il aykumu aus-sal ama wayakuffu 'aydeeahum fakhuzoohum waaqtul oohum haythu thaqiftumoohum waoolaa'ikum ja'al naa lakum 'al ayhim sul taana mmubeen

Wamaa kaana limu'minin 'any yyaqtul a mu'minaan 'il laa khataa waman qatal a mu'minaan khataa fatahreeru raqabat mmu'minat wadeeat mmusal lamatun 'il aa 'ahlihi 'il laa 'any yyassaddaqu fain kaana min qawmin 'adoow llakum wahwa mu'min fatahreeru raqabat mmu'minat wain kaana min qawmi baynakum wabaynahum mmeethaaq fadeeat mmusal lamatun 'il aa 'ahlihi watahreeru raqabat mmu'minat famal llam yajid faseeaamu shahrayni mutataabi'ayni tawbat mmina aal laahi wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeem
Wamany yyaqtul mu'mina mmuta'ammida fajazaa'uhu jahannamu khaal ida feehaa waghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhi wal a'anahu waa'adda lahu 'azaabaan 'azeem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa darabtum fi sabeeli ail laahi fatabayyanu wal aa taqoolu liman 'al qaa 'il aykumu aus-sal ama lasta mu'mina tabtaghoona 'arada aal hayawaati aid-dunyaa fa'inda aal laahi maghaanimu katheerat kazaal ika kuntum mmin qablu famanna aal laahu 'al aykum fatabayyanu 'inna aal laaha kaana bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Llaa yastawi ail qaa'idoona mina aal mu'mineena ghayra 'ooli aid-darari waal mujaahidoona fi sabeeli ail laahi biamwaal ihim waanfusihim faddal a aal laahu aul mujaahideena biamwaal ihim waanfusihim 'al aa aal qaa'ideena darajat wakul la wa'ada aal laahu aul husnaa wafaddal a aal laahu aul mujaahideena 'al aa aal qaa'ideena 'ajraan 'azeem
Darajaat mminhu wamaghfirat warahmat wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheema

'inna aal zeena tawaffayaahumu aul mal aa'ikatu zaal imi 'anfusihim qaal u feema kuntum qaal u kunnaa mustad'afeena fi ail ardi qaal u 'al am takun 'ardu aul laahi waasi'at fatuhaajiru feehaa faul aa'ika mawayaahum jahannamu wasaa'at maseera
'il laa aal mustad'afeena mina aar-rijaal i waan-nisaa'i waal wil daani laa yastatee'oona heelat wal aa yahtadoona sabeel
Faul aa'ika 'asaa aal laahu 'any yya'fooa 'anhum wakaana aal laahu 'afoowaan ghafoor

Wamany yyuhaajir fi sabeeli ail laahi yajid fi ail ardi muraaghama katheera wasa'at wamany yyakhruj mim baytihi muhaajiraan 'il aa aal laahi warasoolihi thumma yudrikhu aul mawtu faqad waqa'a 'ajruhu 'al aa aal laahi wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheem
Waizaa darabtum fi ail ardi fal aysa 'al aykum junaahun 'an taqsuru mina aas-sal awaati 'in khiftum 'any yyaftinakumu aul zeena kafaru 'inna aal kaafireena kaanu lakum 'adoowa mmubeen

Waizaa kunta feehim faaqamta lahumu aus-sal awaata fal taqum taa'ifat mminhum mma'aka wal yakhuzu 'aslihatahum faizaa sajadu fal yakoonu minw wwaraa'ikum wal tati taa'ifatun 'ukhraa lam yusal lu fal yusal lu ma'aka wal yakhuzu hizrahum waaslihatahum wadda aal zeena kafaru law taghful oona 'an 'aslihatikum waamti'atikum fayameeloona 'al aykum mmaylat waahidat wal aa junaaha 'al aykum 'in kaana bikum 'aza mmim mmatarin 'aw kuntum mmardaa 'an tada'u 'aslihatakum wakhuzu hizrakum 'inna aal laaha 'a'adda lil kaafireena 'azaaba mmuheen
Faizaa qadaytumu aus-sal awaata faazkuru aul laaha qeeaama waqu'ooda wa'al aa junoobikum faizaa aatmanantum faaqeemu aus-sal awaata 'inna aas-sal awaata kaanat 'al aa aal mu'mineena kitaaba mmawqooh
Wal aa tahinu fi aibtighaa'i ail qawmi 'in takoonu tal amoona fainnahum yal amoona kamaa tal amoona watarjoona mina aal laahi maa laa yarjoona wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeema
'innaa 'anzal naa 'il ayka aal kitaaba bial haqqi litahkuma bayna aan-naasi bimaa 'arayaaka aal laahu wal aa takul llil khaa'ineena khaseem
Waastaghfiri ail laaha 'inna aal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem
Wal aa tujaadil 'ani ail zeena yakhtaanoona 'anfusahum 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu man kaana khawwaanaan 'atheem
Yastakhfoona mina aan-naasi wal aa yastakhfoona mina aal laahi wahwa ma'ahum 'iz yubayyitoona maa laa yardaa mina aal qawli wakaana aal laahu bimaa ya'mal oona muheeta
Haantum haa'ul aa'i jaadal tum 'anhum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa famany yyujaadil u aul laaha 'anhum yawma aal qeeaamati 'am mmany yyakoonu 'al ayhim wakeel
Wamany yya'mal sooaa'aan 'aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiri ail laaha yajidi ail laaha ghafoora rraheem
Wamany yyaksib 'ithma fainnamaa yaksibuhu 'al aa nafsihi wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeem
Wamany yyaksib khateeaatan 'aw 'ithma thumma yarmi bihi bareeaa faqadi aihtamal a buhtaana waithma mmubeen

Wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al ayka warahmatuhu lahammat ttaa'ifat mminhum 'any yyudil looka wamaa yudil loona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yadurroonaka min sha' waanzal a aal laahu 'al ayka aal kitaaba waal hikmata wa'al lamaka maa lam takun ta'lamu wakaana fadlu aul laahi 'al ayka 'azeem

Llaa khayra fi katheer mmin nnajwayaahum 'il laa man 'amara bisadaqatin 'aw ma'roofin 'aw 'islaahi bayna aan-naasi wamany yyaf'al zaal ika aabtighaa'a mardaati ail laahi fasawfa nu'teehi 'ajraan 'azeem
Wamany yyushaaqiqi air-rasoola mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahu aul hudaa wayattabi' ghayra sabeeli ail mu'mineena nooal lihi maa tawal laa wanuslihi jahannama wasaa'at maseera
'inna aal laaha laa yaghfiru 'any yyushraka bihi wayaghfiru maa doona zaal ika limany yyashaa'u wamany yyushrik bial laahi faqad dal la dal aal aa ba'eeda
'iny yyad'oona min doonihi 'il laa 'inaatha wainy yyad'oona 'il laa shaytaana mmareed
Lla'anahu aul laahu waqaal a laattakhizanna min 'ibaadika naseeba mmafrood

Wal audil lannahum wal aumanneeannahum wal aamurannahum fal ayubattikunna 'aazaana aal an'aami wal aamurannahum fal ayughayyirunna khal qa aal laahi wamany yyattakhizi aish-shaytaana wal iyya mmin dooni ail laahi faqad khasira khusraana mmubeen
Ya'iduhum wayumanneehim wamaa ya'iduhumu aush-shaytaanu 'il laa ghuroora
'ul aa'ika mawayaahum jahannamu wal aa yajidoona 'anhaa mahees
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati sanudkhil uhum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada wa'da aal laahi haqqa waman 'asdaqu mina aal laahi qeel
Llaysa biamaaneeyikum wal aa 'amaaneeyi 'ahli ail kitaabi many yya'mal sooaa'a yujza bihi wal aa yajid lahu min dooni ail laahi wal iyya wal aa naseer
Wamany yya'mal mina aas-saal ihaati min zakarin 'aw 'unthaa wahwa mu'min faul aa'ika yadkhul oona aal jannata wal aa yuzlamoona naqeer
Waman 'ahsanu deena mmimman 'aslama wajhahu lil hi wahwa muhsinw waattaba'a mil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa waattakhaza aal laahu 'ibraaheema khal eel
Wal il hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wakaana aal laahu bikul li sha' mmuheeh

Wayastaftoonaka fi ain-nisaa'i qul i ail laahu yufteekum feehinna wamaa yutlaa 'al aykum fi ail kitaabi fi yataamaa aan-nisaa'i ail laati laa tu'toonahunna maa kutiba lahunna watarghaboona 'an tankihoohunna waal mustad'afeena mina aal wil daani waan taqoomu lil yataamaa bial qisti wamaa taf'al u min khayr fainna aal laaha kaana bihi 'al eem

Waini aimraatun khaafat mim ba'lihaa nushoozaan 'aw 'i'raada fal aa junaaha 'al ayhimaa 'any yyassaal ahaa baynahumaa sul ha waas-sul hu khayr wauhdirati ail anfusu aush-shuhha wain tuhsinu watattaqu fainna aal laaha kaana bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Wal an tastatee'u 'an ta'dil u bayna aan-nisaa'i wal aw harastum fal aa tameelu kul la aal mayli fatazaroohaa kaal mu'al laqati wain tuslihu watattaqu fainna aal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem
Wainy yyatafarraqaa yughni ail laahu kul la mmin sa'atihi wakaana aal laahu waasi'aan hakeem

Wal il hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wal aqad wassaynaa aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba min qablikum waiyyaakum 'ani aittaqu aul laaha wain takfuru fainna lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wakaana aal laahu ghaniyyaan hameed
Wal il hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wakafaa bial laahi wakeela
'iny yyasha yuzhibkum 'ayyuhaa aan-naasu wayati biaakhareena wakaana aal laahu 'al aa zaal ika qadeer

'inna aal munaafiqeena yukhaadi'oona aal laaha wahwa khaadi'uhum waizaa qaamu 'il aa aas-sal awaati qaamu kusaal aa yuraa'oona aan-naasa wal aa yazkuroona aal laaha 'il laa qal eel
Mmuzabzabeena bayna zaal ika laa 'il aa haa'ul aa'i wal aa 'il aa haa'ul aa'i wamany yyudlil i ail laahu fal an tajida lahu sabeel
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu aul kaafireena 'awleeaa'a min dooni ail mu'mineena 'atureedoona 'an taj'al u lil hi 'al aykum sul taana mmubeena
'inna aal munaafiqeena fi aid-daraki ail asfal i mina aan-naari wal an tajida lahum naseera
'il laa aal zeena taabu waaslahu waa'tasamu bial laahi waakhlasu deenahum lil hi faul aa'ika ma'a aal mu'mineena wasawfa yu'ti ail laahu aul mu'mineena 'ajraan 'azeem
Mmaa yaf'al u aul laahu bi'azaabikum 'in shakartum wa'aamantum wakaana aal laahu shaakiraan 'al eem
Llaa yuhibbu aul laahu aul jahra bias-sooaa'i mina aal qawli 'il laa man zul ima wakaana aal laahu samee'aan 'al eema
'in tubdu khayraan 'aw tukhfoohu 'aw ta'fu 'an sooaa' fainna aal laaha kaana 'afoowa qadeera

'inna aal zeena yakfuroona bial laahi warusul ihi wayureedoona 'any yyufarriqu bayna aal laahi warusul ihi wayaqooloona nu'minu biba'd wanakfuru biba'd wayureedoona 'any yyattakhizu bayna zaal ika sabeela
'ul aa'ika humu aul kaafiroona haqqa waa'tadnaa lil kaafireena 'azaaba mmuheen
Waal zeena 'aamanu bial laahi warusul ihi wal am yufarriqu bayna 'ahad mminhum 'ul aa'ika sawfa nu'teehim 'ujoorahum wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheem

Yasal uka 'ahlu aul kitaabi 'an tunazzil a 'al ayhim kitaaba mmina aas-samaa'i faqad saal u moosaa 'akbara min zaal ika faqaal u 'arinaa aal laaha jahrat faakhazathumu aus-saa'iqatu bizul mihim thumma aattakhazu aul'ijla mim ba'di maa jaa'athumu aul bayyinaatu fa'afawnaa 'an zaal ika wa'aataynaa moosaa sul taana mmubeen
Warafa'naa fawqahumu aut-toora bimeethaaqihim waqul naa lahumu audkhul u aul baaba sujjada waqul naa lahum laa ta'ddu fi ais-sabti waakhaznaa minhum mmeethaaqaan ghal eez

Fabimaa naqdihim mmeethaaqahum wakufrihim biayaati ail laahi waqatlihimu aul anbeeaa'a bighayri haqq waqawlihim qul oobunaa ghul fu bal taba'a aal laahu 'al ayhaa bikufrihim fal aa yu'minoona 'il laa qal eel
Wabikufrihim waqawlihim 'al aa maryama buhtaanaan 'azeem

Waqawlihim 'innaa qatal naa aal maseeha 'eesaa aabna maryama rasoola aal laahi wamaa qatal oohu wamaa sal aboohu wal aakin shubbiha lahum wainna aal zeena aakhtal afu feehi lafi shakk mminhu maa lahum bihi min 'il min 'il laa aattibaa'a aaz-zanni wamaa qatal oohu yaqeena
Bar-rafa'ahu aul laahu 'il ayhi wakaana aal laahu 'azeezaan hakeem
Waim mmin 'ahli ail kitaabi 'il laa layu'minanna bihi qabla mawtihi wayawma aal qeeaamati yakoonu 'al ayhim shaheed
Fabizul m mmina aal zeena haadu harramnaa 'al ayhim tayyibaatin 'uhil lat lahum wabisaddihim 'an sabeeli ail laahi katheer
Waakhzihimu aur-ribawaa waqad nuhu 'anhu waaklihim 'amwaal a aan-naasi bial baatil i waa'tadnaa lil kaafireena minhum 'azaabaan 'al eem

Llaakini air-raasikhoona fi ail'il mi minhum waal mu'minoona yu'minoona bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka wamaa 'unzil a min qablika waal muqeemeena aas-sal awaata waal mu'toona aaz-zakawaata waal mu'minoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri 'ul aa'ika sanu'teehim 'ajraan 'azeema

'innaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka kamaa 'awhaynaa 'il aa nooh waan-nabeeaaina mim ba'dihi waawhaynaa 'il aa 'ibraaheema waismaa'eela waishaaqa waya'qooba waal asbaati wa'eesaa wayyooba wayoonusa wahaaroona wasul aymaana wa'aataynaa daawuda zaboor
Warusul a qad qasasnaahum 'al ayka min qablu warusul a llam naqsushum 'al ayka wakal lama aal laahu moosaa takleem
Rrusul a mmubashshireena wamunzireena leeal laa yakoona lin-naasi 'al aa aal laahi hujjatu ba'da aar-rusul i wakaana aal laahu 'azeezaan hakeem
Llaakini ail laahu yashhadu bimaa 'anzal a 'il ayka 'anzal ahu bi'il mihi waal mal aa'ikatu yashhadoona wakafaa bial laahi shaheeda
'inna aal zeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi qad dal lu dal aal aa ba'eeda
'inna aal zeena kafaru wazal amu lam yakuni ail laahu leeaghfira lahum wal aa leeahdeeahum tareeqa
'il laa tareeqa jahannama khaal ideena feehaa 'abada wakaana zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu qad jaa'akumu aur-rasoolu bial haqqi mir rrabbikum faaminu khayra llakum wain takfuru fainna lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeem

Yaahla aal kitaabi laa taghlu fi deenikum wal aa taqoolu 'al aa aal laahi 'il laa aal haqqa 'innamaa aal maseehu 'eesaa aabnu maryama rasoolu aul laahi wakal imatuhu 'al qayaahaa 'il aa maryama warooh mminhu faaminu bial laahi warusul ihi wal aa taqoolu thal aathatun aintahu khayra llakum 'innamaa aal laahu 'il aah waahid subhaanahu 'any yyakoona lahu wal ad llaahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wakafaa bial laahi wakeel
Llany yyastankifa aal maseehu 'any yyakoona 'abda llil hi wal aa aal mal aa'ikatu aul muqarraboona wamany yyastankif 'an 'ibaadatihi wayastakbir fasayahshuruhum 'il ayhi jamee'

Faammaa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fayooaffeehim 'ujoorahum wayazeeduhum mmin fadlihi waammaa aal zeena aastankafu waastakbaru fayu'azzibuhum 'azaabaan 'al eema wal aa yajidoona lahum mmin dooni ail laahi wal iyya wal aa naseer
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu qad jaa'akum burhaam mmir rrabbikum waanzal naa 'il aykum noora mmubeen
Faammaa aal zeena 'aamanu bial laahi waa'tasamu bihi fasayudkhil uhum fi rahmat mminhu wafadl wayahdeehim 'il ayhi siraata mmustaqeem

Yastaftoonaka qul i ail laahu yufteekum fi ail kal aal ati 'ini aimru'una hal aka laysa lahu wal ad wal ahu 'ukht fal ahaa nisfu maa taraka wahwa yarithuhaa 'il llam yakul llaahaa wal ad fain kaanataa aathnatayni fal ahumaa aath-thul uthaani mimmaa taraka wain kaanu 'ikhwat rrijaal a wanisaa' fal iz-zakari mithlu hazzi ail unthayayni yubayyinu aul laahu lakum 'an tadil lu waal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'awfu bial'uqood
'uhil lat lakum baheematu aul an'aami 'il laa maa yutlaa 'al aykum ghayra muhil li ais-saydi waantum hurumun 'inna aal laaha yahkumu maa yureed

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tuhil lu sha'aa'ira aal laahi wal aa aash-shahra aal haraama wal aa aal hadya wal aa aal qal aa'ida wal aa 'aammeena aal bayta aal haraama yabtaghoona fadla mmir rrabbihim waridwaana waizaa hal al tum faastaadu wal aa yajrimannakum shanaanu qawmin 'an saddookum 'ani ail masjidi ail haraami 'an ta'tadu wata'aawanu 'al aa aal birri waat-taqwaa wal aa ta'aawanu 'al aa aal ithmi waal'udwaani waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab

Hurrimat 'al aykumu aul maytatu waad-damu wal ahmu aul khinzeeri wamaa 'uhil la lighayri ail laahi bihi waal munkhaniqatu waal mawqoozatu waal mutaraddeeatu waan-nateehatu wamaa 'akal a aas-sabu'u 'il laa maa zakkaytum wamaa zubiha 'al aa aan-nusubi waan tastaqsimu bial azlaami zaal ikum fisqun ail yawma ya'isa aal zeena kafaru min deenikum fal aa takhshawhum waakhshawni ail yawma 'akmal tu lakum deenakum waatmamtu 'al aykum ni'mati waradeetu lakumu aul islaama deena famanu audturra fi makhmasatin ghayra mutajaanif lliithm fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Yasal oonaka maazaa 'uhil la lahum qul 'uhil la lakumu aut-tayyibaatu wamaa 'al lamtum mmina aal jawaarihi mukal libeena tu'al limoonahunna mimmaa 'al lamakumu aul laahu fakul u mimmaa 'amsakna 'al aykum waazkuru ausma aal laahi 'al ayhi waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha saree'u aul hisaab

Ail yawma 'uhil la lakumu aut-tayyibaatu wata'aamu aul zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba hil l llakum wata'aamukum hil l llaahum waal muhsanaatu mina aal mu'minaati waal muhsanaatu mina aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba min qablikum 'izaa 'aataytumoohunna 'ujoorahunna muhsineena ghayra musaafiheena wal aa muttakhizi 'akhdaanw wamany yyakfur bial eemaani faqad habita 'amal uhu wahwa fi ail aakhirati mina aal khaasireen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa qumtum 'il aa aas-sal awaati faaghsil u wujoohakum waydeeakum 'il aa aal maraafiqi waamsahu biru'oosikum waarjul akum 'il aa aal ka'bayni wain kuntum junuba faattahharu wain kuntum mmardaa 'aw 'al aa safarin 'aw jaa 'ahad mminkum mmina aal ghaa'iti 'aw laamastumu aun-nisaa'a fal am tajidu maa' fatayammamu sa'eeda tayyiba faamsahu biwujoohikum waydeekum mminhu maa yureedu aul laahu leeaj'al a 'al aykum mmin haraj wal aakiny yyureedu leeutahhirakum wal eeutimma ni'matahu 'al aykum la'al lakum tashkuroon
Waazkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykum wameethaaqahu aul zi waathaqakum bihi 'iz qul tum sami'naa waata'naa waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu koonu qawwaameena lil hi shuhadaa'a bial qisti wal aa yajrimannakum shanaanu qawmin 'al aa 'al laa ta'dil u au'dil u hooa 'aqrabu lit-taqwaa waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Wa'ada aal laahu aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lahum mmaghfirat waajrun 'azeem
Waal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jaheem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auzkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykum 'iz hamma qawmun 'any yyabsutu 'il aykum 'aydeeahum fakaffa 'aydeeahum 'ankum waattaqu aul laaha wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail mu'minoon

Wal aqad 'akhaza aal laahu meethaaqa bani 'israa'eela waba'athnaa minhumu authna 'ashara naqeeba waqaal a aal laahu 'inni ma'akum la'in 'aqamtumu aus-sal awaata wa'aataytumu auz-zakawaata wa'aamantum birusul i wa'azzartumoohum waaqradtumu aul laaha qardaan hasana llaukaffiranna 'ankum sayyiaatikum wal audkhil annakum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru faman kafara ba'da zaal ika minkum faqad dal la sawaa'a aas-sabeel

Fabimaa naqdihim mmeethaaqahum la'annaahum waja'al naa qul oobahum qaaseeat yuharrifoona aal kal ima 'am mmawaadi'ihi wanasu hazza mmimmaa zukkiru bihi wal aa tazaal u tattal i'u 'al aa khaa'inat mminhum 'il laa qal eela mminhum faa'fu 'anhum waasfah 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muhsineen

Wamina aal zeena qaal u 'innaa nasaaraa 'akhaznaa meethaaqahum fanasu hazza mmimmaa zukkiru bihi faaghraynaa baynahumu aul'adaawata waal baghdaa'a al aa yawmi ail qeeaamati wasawfa yunabbeeuhumu aul laahu bimaa kaanu yasna'oon
Yaahla aal kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum katheera mmimmaa kuntum tukhfoona mina aal kitaabi waya'fu 'an katheer
Qad jaa'akum mmina aal laahi noor wakitaab mmubeen
Yahdi bihi ail laahu mani aittaba'a ridwaanahu subul a aas-sal aami wayukhrijuhum mmina aaz-zul umaati 'il aa aan-noori biiznihi wayahdeehim 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem

Llaqad kafara aal zeena qaal u 'inna aal laaha hooa aal maseehu aubnu maryama qul famany yyamliku mina aal laahi shayaan 'in 'araada 'any yyuhlika aal maseeha aabna maryama waummahu waman fi ail ardi jamee'a wal il hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa baynahumaa yakhluqu maa yashaa'u waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

Waqaal ati ail yahoodu waan-nasaaraa nahnu 'abnaa'ua aul laahi waahibbaa'uhu qul fal ima yu'azzibukum bizunoobikum bal 'antum bashar mmimman khal aqa yaghfiru limany yyashaa'u wayu'azzibu many yyashaa'u wal il hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa baynahumaa wail ayhi ail maseer

Yaahla aal kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum 'al aa fatrat mmina aar-rusul i 'an taqoolu maa jaa'anaa mim basheer wal aa nazeer faqad jaa'akum basheer wanazeer waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi yaaqawmi aizkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykum 'iz ja'al a feekum 'anbeeaa'a waja'al akum mmul ooka wa'aatayaakum mmaa lam yu'ti 'ahada mmina aal'aal ameen
Yaaqawmi aidkhul u aul arda aal muqaddasata aal ti kataba aal laahu lakum wal aa tartaddu 'al aa 'adbaarikum fatanqal ibu khaasireen
Qaal u yaamoosaa 'inna feehaa qawma jabbaareena wainnaa lan nnadkhul ahaa hattaa yakhruju minhaa fainy yyakhruju minhaa fainnaa daakhil oon

Qaal a rajul aani mina aal zeena yakhaafoona 'an'ama aal laahu 'al ayhimaa aadkhul u 'al ayhimu aul baaba faizaa dakhal tumoohu fainnakum ghaal iboona wa'al aa aal laahi fatawakkal u 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Qaal u yaamoosaa 'innaa lan nnadkhul ahaa 'abada mmaa daamu feehaa faazhab 'anta warabbuka faqaatil aa 'innaa haahunaa qaa'idoon
Qaal a rabbi 'inni laa 'amliku 'il laa nafsi waakhi faafruq baynanaa wabayna aal qawmi ail faasiqeen
Qaal a fainnahaa muharramatun 'al ayhim 'arba'eena sanat yateehoona fi ail ardi fal aa tasa 'al aa aal qawmi ail faasiqeen

Waatlu 'al ayhim nabaa aabna 'aadama bial haqqi 'iz qarrabaa qurbaana fatuqubbil a min 'ahadihimaa wal am yutaqabbal mina aal aakhari qaal a laaqtul annaka qaal a 'innamaa yataqabbal u aul laahu mina aal muttaqeen
La'im basattta 'il ayya yadaka litaqtul ani maa 'anaa bibaasit yadeea 'il ayka liaqtul aka 'inneea 'akhaafu aul laaha rabba aal'aal ameen
'inneea 'ureedu 'an tabooaa biithmi waithmika fatakoona min 'ashaabi ain-naari wazaal ika jazaa'ua auz-zaal imeen
Fatawwa'at lahu nafsuhu qatla 'akheehi faqatal ahu faasbaha mina aal khaasireen

Faba'atha aal laahu ghuraaba yabhathu fi ail ardi leeureeahu kayfa yooaari saw'ata 'akheehi qaal a yaawaylataa 'a'ajaztu 'an 'akoona mithla haazaa aal ghuraabi faooaareea saw'ata 'akhi faasbaha mina aan-naadimeen

Min 'ajli zaal ika katabnaa 'al aa bani 'israa'eela 'annahu man qatal a nafsaa bighayri nafsin 'aw fasaad fi ail ardi fakaannamaa qatal a aan-naasa jamee'a waman 'ahyaahaa fakaannamaa 'ahyaa aan-naasa jamee'a wal aqad jaa'athum rusul unaa bial bayyinaati thumma 'inna katheera mminhum ba'da zaal ika fi ail ardi lamusrifoon

'innamaa jazaa'ua aul zeena yuhaariboona aal laaha warasoolahu wayas'awna fi ail ardi fasaadaan 'any yyuqattal u 'aw yusal labu 'aw tuqatta'a 'aydeehim waarjul uhum mmin khil aafin 'aw yunfawa mina aal ardi zaal ika lahum khizy fi aid-dunyaa wal ahum fi ail aakhirati 'azaabun 'azeem
'il laa aal zeena taabu min qabli 'an taqdiru 'al ayhim faa'lamu 'anna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auttaqu aul laaha waabtaghu 'il ayhi ail waseelata wajaahidu fi sabeelihi la'al lakum tuflihoon
'inna aal zeena kafaru law 'anna lahum mmaa fi ail ardi jamee'a wamithlahu ma'ahu leeaftadu bihi min 'azaabi yawmi ail qeeaamati maa tuqubbil a minhum wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Yureedoona 'any yyakhruju mina aan-naari wamaa hum bikhaarijeena minhaa wal ahum 'azaab mmuqeem
Waas-saariqu waas-saariqatu faaqta'u 'aydeeahumaa jazaa'a bimaa kasabaa nakaal a mmina aal laahi waal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Faman taaba mim ba'di zul mihi waaslaha fainna aal laaha yatoobu 'al ayhi 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
'al am ta'lam 'anna aal laaha lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi yu'azzibu many yyashaa'u wayaghfiru limany yyashaa'u waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

Yayyuhaa aar-rasoolu laa yuhzinka aal zeena yusaari'oona fi ail kufri mina aal zeena qaal u 'aamannaa biafwaahihim wal am tu'min qul oobuhum wamina aal zeena haadu sammaa'oona lil kazibi sammaa'oona liqawmin 'aakhareena lam yatooka yuharrifoona aal kal ima mim ba'di mawaadi'ihi yaqooloona 'in 'ooteetum haazaa fakhuzoohu wail llam tu'tawhu faahzaru wamany yyuridi ail laahu fitnatahu fal an tamlika lahu mina aal laahi shayaan 'ul aa'ika aal zeena lam yuridi ail laahu 'any yyutahhira qul oobahum lahum fi aid-dunyaa khizy wal ahum fi ail aakhirati 'azaabun 'azeem

Sammaa'oona lil kazibi 'akkaal oona lis-suhti fain jaa'ooka faahkum baynahum 'aw 'a'rid 'anhum wain tu'rid 'anhum fal any yyadurrooka shaya wain hakamta faahkum baynahum bial qisti 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muqsiteen
Wakayfa yuhakkimoonaka wa'indahumu aut-tawrayaatu feehaa hukmu aul laahi thumma yatawal lawna mim ba'di zaal ika wamaa 'ul aa'ika bial mu'mineen

'innaa 'anzal naa aat-tawrayaata feehaa huda wanoor yahkumu bihaa aan-nabeeaaoona aal zeena 'aslamu lil zeena haadu waar-rabbaaneeyoona waal ahbaaru bimaa aastuhfizu min kitaabi ail laahi wakaanu 'al ayhi shuhadaa'a fal aa takhshawua aun-naasa waakhshawni wal aa tashtaru biayaati thamana qal eela wamal llam yahkum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu faul aa'ika humu aul kaafiroon

Wakatabnaa 'al ayhim feehaa 'anna aan-nafsa bian-nafsi waal'ayna bial'ayni waal anfa bial anfi waal uzna bial uzni waas-sinna bias-sinni waal jurooha qisaas faman tasaddaqa bihi fahwa kaffaarat llaahu wamal llam yahkum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon

Waqaffaynaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim bi'eesaa aabni maryama musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi mina aat-tawrayaati wa'aataynaahu aul injeela feehi huda wanoor wamusaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi mina aat-tawrayaati wahuda wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen
Wal yahkum 'ahlu aul injeeli bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu feehi wamal llam yahkum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu faul aa'ika humu aul faasiqoon

Waanzal naa 'il ayka aal kitaaba bial haqqi musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi mina aal kitaabi wamuhayminaan 'al ayhi faahkum baynahum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu wal aa tattabi' 'ahwaa'ahum 'ammaa jaa'aka mina aal haqqi likul l ja'al naa minkum shir'at waminhaaja wal aw shaa'a aal laahu laja'al akum 'ummat waahidat wal aakil lleeablooakum fi maa 'aatayaakum faastabiqu aul khayraati 'il aa aal laahi marji'ukum jamee'a fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon

Waanu auhkum baynahum bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu wal aa tattabi' 'ahwaa'ahum waahzarhum 'any yyaftinooka 'am ba'di maa 'anzal a aal laahu 'il ayka fain tawal lawa faa'lam 'annamaa yureedu aul laahu 'any yyuseebahum biba'di zunoobihim wainna katheera mmina aan-naasi lafaasiqoon
'afahukma aal jaahil iyyati yabghoona waman 'ahsanu mina aal laahi hukma lliqawm yooqinoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu aul yahooda waan-nasaaraa 'awleeaa'a ba'duhum 'awleeaa'u ba'd wamany yyatawal laahum mminkum fainnahu minhum 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen

Fataraa aal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad yusaari'oona feehim yaqooloona nakhshaa 'an tuseebanaa daa'irat fa'asaa aal laahu 'any yyateea bial fathi 'aw 'amr mmin 'indihi fayusbihu 'al aa maa 'asarru fi 'anfusihim naadimeen
Yaqoolu aul zeena 'aamanu 'ahaa'ul aa'i ail zeena 'aqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihim 'innahum lama'akum habitat 'a'maal uhum faasbahu khaasireen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu many yyartadid minkum 'an deenihi fasawfa yati ail laahu biqawm yuhibbuhum wayuhibboonahu 'azil latin 'al aa aal mu'mineena 'a'izzatin 'al aa aal kaafireena yujaahidoona fi sabeeli ail laahi wal aa yakhaafoona lawmata laa'im zaal ika fadlu aul laahi yu'teehi many yyashaa'u waal laahu waasi'un 'al eem
'innamaa wal eeyukumu aul laahu warasooluhu waal zeena 'aamanu aul zeena yuqeemoona aas-sal awaata wayu'toona aaz-zakawaata wahum raaki'oon
Wamany yyatawal la aal laaha warasoolahu waal zeena 'aamanu fainna hizba aal laahi humu aul ghaal iboon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu aul zeena aattakhazu deenakum huzu'a wal a'iba mmina aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba min qablikum waal kuffaara 'awleeaa'a waattaqu aul laaha 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Waizaa naadaytum 'il aa aas-sal awaati aittakhazoohaa huzu'a wal a'iba zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa ya'qil oon
Qul yaahla aal kitaabi hal tanqimoona minnaa 'il laa 'an 'aamannaa bial laahi wamaa 'unzil a 'il aynaa wamaa 'unzil a min qablu waanna 'aktharakum faasiqoon

Qul hal 'unabbeeukum bisharr mmin zaal ika mathoobatan 'inda aal laahi mal lla'anahu aul laahu waghadiba 'al ayhi waja'al a minhumu aul qiradata waal khanaazeera wa'abada aat-taaghoota 'ul aa'ika sharr mmakaana waadal lu 'an sawaa'i ais-sabeel
Waizaa jaa'ookum qaal u 'aamannaa waqad ddakhal u bial kufri wahum qad kharaju bihi waal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa kaanu yaktumoon
Wataraa katheera mminhum yusaari'oona fi ail ithmi waal'udwaani waaklihimu aus-suhta labeesa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Lawlaa yanhayaahumu aur-rabbaaneeyoona waal ahbaaru 'an qawlihimu aul ithma waaklihimu aus-suhta labeesa maa kaanu yasna'oon

Waqaal ati ail yahoodu yadu aul laahi maghloolatun ghul lat 'aydeehim wal u'inu bimaa qaal u bal yadaahu mabsootataani yunfiqu kayfa yashaa'u wal ayazeedanna katheera mminhum mmaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika tughyaana wakufra waal qaynaa baynahumu aul'adaawata waal baghdaa'a al aa yawmi ail qeeaamati kul lamaa 'awqadu naara llil harbi 'atfaahaa aal laahu wayas'awna fi ail ardi fasaada waal laahu laa yuhibbu aul mufsideen
Wal aw 'anna 'ahla aal kitaabi 'aamanu waattaqawa lakaffarnaa 'anhum sayyiaatihim wal aadkhal naahum jannaati ain-na'eem

Wal aw 'annahum 'aqaamu aut-tawrayaata waal injeela wamaa 'unzil a 'il ayhim mmir rrabbihim laakal u min fawqihim wamin tahti 'arjul ihim mminhum 'ummat mmuqtasidat wakatheer mminhum saa'a maa ya'mal oon
Yayyuhaa aar-rasoolu bal ligh maa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika wail llam taf'al famaa bal laghta risaal aatihi waal laahu ya'simuka mina aan-naasi 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aal kaafireen

Qul yaahla aal kitaabi lastum 'al aa sha'in hattaa tuqeemu aut-tawrayaata waal injeela wamaa 'unzil a 'il aykum mmir rrabbikum wal ayazeedanna katheera mminhum mmaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika tughyaana wakufra fal aa tasa 'al aa aal qawmi ail kaafireen
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu waal zeena haadu waas-saaboona waan-nasaaraa man 'aamana bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wa'amil a saal iha fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Laqad 'akhaznaa meethaaqa bani 'israa'eela waarsal naa 'il ayhim rusul a kul lamaa jaa'ahum rasoolu bimaa laa tahwaa 'anfusuhum fareeqa kazzabu wafareeqa yaqtul oon
Wahasibu 'al laa takoona fitnat fa'amu wasammu thumma taaba aal laahu 'al ayhim thumma 'amu wasammu katheer mminhum waal laahu baseeru bimaa ya'mal oon

Laqad kafara aal zeena qaal u 'inna aal laaha hooa aal maseehu aubnu maryama waqaal a aal maseehu yaabani 'israa'eela aa'budu aul laaha rabbi warabbakum 'innahu many yyushrik bial laahi faqad harrama aal laahu 'al ayhi ail jannata wamawayaahu aun-naaru wamaa liz-zaal imeena min 'ansaar

Llaqad kafara aal zeena qaal u 'inna aal laaha thaal ithu thal aathat wamaa min 'il aahin 'il laa 'il aah waahid wail llam yantahu 'ammaa yaqooloona layamassanna aal zeena kafaru minhum 'azaabun 'al eem
'afal aa yatooboona 'il aa aal laahi wayastaghfiroonahu waal laahu ghafoor rraheem

Mmaa aal maseehu aubnu maryama 'il laa rasool qad khal at min qablihi air-rusul u waummuhu siddeeqat kaanaa yakul aani ait-ta'aama aanzur kayfa nubayyinu lahumu aul ayaati thumma aanzur 'annaa yu'fakoon
Qul 'ata'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa laa yamliku lakum darra wal aa naf'a waal laahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Qul yaahla aal kitaabi laa taghlu fi deenikum ghayra aal haqqi wal aa tattabi'u 'ahwaa'a qawm qad dal lu min qablu waadal lu katheera wadal lu 'an sawaa'i ais-sabeel
Lu'ina aal zeena kafaru mim bani 'israa'eela 'al aa lisaani daawuda wa'eesaa aabni maryama zaal ika bimaa 'asa wwakaanu ya'tadoon
Kaanu laa yatanaahawna 'am mmunkar fa'al oohu labeesa maa kaanu yaf'al oon
Taraa katheera mminhum yatawal lawna aal zeena kafaru labeesa maa qaddamat lahum 'anfusuhum 'an sakhita aal laahu 'al ayhim wafi ail'azaabi hum khaal idoon
Wal aw kaanu yu'minoona bial laahi waan-nabiaa'i wamaa 'unzil a 'il ayhi maa aattakhazoohum 'awleeaa'a wal aakinna katheera mminhum faasiqoon

Latajidanna 'ashadda aan-naasi 'adaawat llil zeena 'aamanu aul yahooda waal zeena 'ashraku wal atajidanna 'aqrabahum mmawaddat llil zeena 'aamanu aul zeena qaal u 'innaa nasaaraa zaal ika bianna minhum qisseeseena waruhbaana waannahum laa yastakbiroon
Waizaa sami'u maa 'unzil a 'il aa aar-rasooli taraa 'a'yunahum tafeedu mina aad-dam'i mimmaa 'arafu mina aal haqqi yaqooloona rabbanaa 'aamannaa faaktubnaa ma'a aash-shaahideen
Wamaa lanaa laa nu'minu bial laahi wamaa jaa'anaa mina aal haqqi wanatma'u 'any yyudkhil anaa rabbunaa ma'a aal qawmi ais-saal iheen
Faathaabahumu aul laahu bimaa qaal u jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wazaal ika jazaa'u aul muhsineen
Waal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jaheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tuharrimu tayyibaati maa 'ahal la aal laahu lakum wal aa ta'tadu 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul mu'tadeen
Wakul u mimmaa razaqakumu aul laahu hal aal a tayyiba waattaqu aul laaha aal zi 'antum bihi mu'minoon

Laa yu'aakhizukumu aul laahu bial laghwi fi 'aymaanikum wal aakiny yyu'aakhizukum bimaa 'aqqadttumu aul aymaana fakaffaaratuhu 'it'aamu 'asharati masaakeena min 'awsati maa tut'imoona 'ahleekum 'aw kiswatuhum 'aw tahreeru raqabat famal llam yajid faseeaamu thal aathati 'ayyaam zaal ika kaffaaratu 'aymaanikum 'izaa hal aftum waahfazu 'aymaanakum kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakum 'ayaatihi la'al lakum tashkuroon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'innamaa aal khamru waal maysiru waal ansaabu waal azlaamu rijs mmin 'amal i aish-shaytaani faajtaniboohu la'al lakum tuflihoon
'innamaa yureedu aush-shaytaanu 'any yyooqi'a baynakumu aul'adaawata waal baghdaa'a fi ail khamri waal maysiri wayasuddakum 'an zikri ail laahi wa'ani ais-sal awaati fahal 'antum mmuntahoon
Waatee'u aul laaha waatee'u aur-rasoola waahzaru fain tawal laytum faa'lamu 'annamaa 'al aa rasoolinaa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen

Laysa 'al aa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati junaah feemaa ta'imu 'izaa maa aattaqa wwa'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati thumma aattaqa wwa'aamanu thumma aattaqa wwaahsanu waal laahu yuhibbu aul muhsineen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu layablooannakumu aul laahu bisha' mmina aas-saydi tanaal uhu 'aydeekum warimaahukum leea'lama aal laahu many yyakhaafuhu bial ghaybi famani ai'tadaa ba'da zaal ika fal ahu 'azaabun 'al eem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa taqtul u aus-sayda waantum hurum waman qatal ahu minkum mmuta'ammida fajazaa'u mithli maa qatal a mina aan-na'ami yahkumu bihi zawaa 'adl mminkum hadyaa baal igha aal ka'bati 'aw kaffaaratu ta'aami masaakeena 'aw 'adlu zaal ika seeaama lleeazooqa wabaal a 'amrihi 'afaa aal laahu 'ammaa sal afa waman 'aada fayantaqimu aul laahu minhu waal laahu 'azeez zoo auntiqaam
'uhil la lakum saydu aul bahri wata'aamuhu mataa'a llakum wal is-sayyaarati wahurrima 'al aykum saydu aul barri maa dumtum huruma waattaqu aul laaha aal zi 'il ayhi tuhsharoon

Ja'al a aal laahu aul ka'bata aal bayta aal haraama qeeaama llin-naasi waash-shahra aal haraama waal hadya waal qal aa'ida zaal ika lita'lamu 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi waanna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Ai'lamu 'anna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaabi waanna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Mmaa 'al aa aar-rasooli 'il laa aal bal aaghu waal laahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
Qul-laa yastawi ail khabeethu waat-tayyibu wal aw 'a'jabaka kathratu aul khabeethi faattaqu aul laaha yaaooli ail al baabi la'al lakum tuflihoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tasal u 'an 'ashyaa'a an tubda lakum tasu'kum wain tasal u 'anhaa heena yunazzal u aul qur'aanu tubda lakum 'afaa aal laahu 'anhaa waal laahu ghafoorun hal eem
Qad saal ahaa qawm mmin qablikum thumma 'asbahu bihaa kaafireen
Maa ja'al a aal laahu mim baheerat wal aa saa'ibat wal aa waseelat wal aa haam wal aakinna aal zeena kafaru yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba waaktharuhum laa ya'qil oon
Waizaa qeela lahum ta'aal awa 'il aa maa 'anzal a aal laahu wail aa aar-rasooli qaal u hasbunaa maa wajadnaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa 'awal aw kaana 'aabaa'uhum laa ya'lamoona shaya wal aa yahtadoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'al aykum 'anfusakum laa yadurrukum mman dal la 'izaa aahtadaytum 'il aa aal laahi marji'ukum jamee'a fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu shahaadatu baynikum 'izaa hadara 'ahadakumu aul mawtu heena aal wasiyyati aithnaani zawaa 'adl mminkum 'aw 'aakharaani min ghayrikum 'in 'antum darabtum fi ail ardi faasaabatkum mmuseebatu aul mawti tahbisoonahumaa mim ba'di ais-sal awaati fayuqsimaani bial laahi 'ini airtabtum laa nashtari bihi thamana wal aw kaana zaa qurbaa wal aa naktumu shahaadata aal laahi 'innaa 'iza llamina aal aathimeen

Fain 'uthira 'al aa 'annahumaa aastahaqqaa 'ithma faakharaani yaqoomaani maqaamahumaa mina aal zeena aastuhiqqa 'al ayhimu aul awlayaani fayuqsimaani bial laahi lashahaadatunaa 'ahaqqu min shahaadatihimaa wamaa aa'tadaynaa 'innaa 'iza llamina aaz-zaal imeen
Zaal ika 'adnaa 'any yyatu biash-shahaadati 'al aa wajhihaa 'aw yakhaafu 'an turadda 'aymaanu ba'da 'aymaanihim waattaqu aul laaha waasma'u waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal faasiqeen
Yawma yajma'u aul laahu aur-rusul a fayaqoolu maazaa 'ujibtum qaal u laa 'il ma lanaa 'innaka 'anta 'al laamu aul ghuyoob

'iz qaal a aal laahu yaa'eesaa aabna maryama aazkur ni'mati 'al ayka wa'al aa waal idatika 'iz 'ayyadttuka biroohi ail qudusi tukal limu aun-naasa fi ail mahdi wakahla waiz 'al lamtuka aal kitaaba waal hikmata waat-tawrayaata waal injeela waiz takhluqu mina aat-teeni kahayati ait-tayri biizni fatanfukhu feehaa fatakoonu taa'iraa biizni watubriu aul akmaha waal abrasa biizni waiz tukhriju aul mawtaa biizni waiz kafaftu bani 'israa'eela 'anka 'iz jeetahum bial bayyinaati faqaal a aal zeena kafaru minhum 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Waiz 'awhaytu 'il aa aal hawaareeyina 'an 'aaminu bi wabirasooli qaal u 'aamannaa waashhad biannanaa muslimoon
'iz qaal a aal hawaareeyoona yaa'eesaa aabna maryama hal yastatee'u rabbuka 'any yyunazzil a 'al aynaa maa'idat mmina aas-samaa'i qaal a aattaqu aul laaha 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Qaal u nureedu 'an nnakul a minhaa watatma'inna qul oobunaa wana'lama 'an qad sadaqtanaa wanakoona 'al ayhaa mina aash-shaahideen
Qaal a 'eesaa aabnu maryama aal laahumma rabbanaa 'anzil 'al aynaa maa'idat mmina aas-samaa'i takoonu lanaa 'eeda lliawwal inaa wa'aakhirinaa wa'ayat mminka waarzuqnaa waanta khayru aur-raaziqeen
Qaal a aal laahu 'inni munazzil uhaa 'al aykum famany yyakfur ba'du minkum fainneea 'u'azzibuhu 'azaaba llaa 'u'azzibuhu 'ahada mmina aal'aal ameen

Waiz qaal a aal laahu yaa'eesaa aabna maryama 'aanta qul ta lin-naasi aittakhizooni waummeea 'il aahayni min dooni ail laahi qaal a subhaanaka maa yakoonu leea 'an 'aqoola maa laysa li bihaqqin 'in kuntu qul tuhu faqad 'al imtahu ta'lamu maa fi nafsi wal aa 'a'lamu maa fi nafsika 'innaka 'anta 'al laamu aul ghuyoob

Maa qul tu lahum 'il laa maa 'amartani bihi 'anu au'budu aul laaha rabbi warabbakum wakuntu 'al ayhim shaheeda mmaa dumtu feehim fal ammaa tawaffaytani kunta 'anta aar-raqeeba 'al ayhim waanta 'al aa kul li sha' shaheed
'in tu'azzibhum fainnahum 'ibaaduka wain taghfir lahum fainnaka 'anta aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Qaal a aal laahu haazaa yawma yanfa'u aus-saadiqeena sidquhum lahum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada rradeea aal laahu 'anhum waradu 'anhu zaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem
Lil hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa feehinna wahwa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Ail hamdu lil hi ail zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda waja'al a aaz-zul umaati waan-noor
Thumma aal zeena kafaru birabbihim ya'dil oon
Hooa aal zi khal aqakum mmin teen thumma qadaa 'ajal a waajal mmusammaan 'indahu thumma 'antum tamtaroon
Wahwa aal laahu fi ais-samaawaati wafi ail ardi ya'lamu sirrakum wajahrakum waya'lamu maa taksiboon
Wamaa tateehim mmin 'ayat mmin 'ayaati rabbihim 'il laa kaanu 'anhaa mu'rideen
Faqad kazzabu bial haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fasawfa yateehim 'anbaa'ua maa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon

'al am yarawa kam 'ahlaknaa min qablihim mmin qarn mmakkannaahum fi ail ardi maa lam numakkil llakum waarsal naa aas-samaa'a 'al ayhim mmidraara waja'al naa aal anhaara tajri min tahtihim faahlaknaahum bizunoobihim waanshanaa mim ba'dihim qarnaan 'aakhareen
Wal aw nazzal naa 'al ayka kitaaba fi qirtaas fal amasoohu biaydeehim laqaal a aal zeena kafaru 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Waqaal u lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi mal ak wal aw 'anzal naa mal aka llaqudeea aal amru thumma laa yunzaroon
Wal aw ja'al naahu mal aka llaja'al naahu rajul a wal al abasnaa 'al ayhim mmaa yal bisoon
Wal aqadu austuhzia birusul mmin qablika fahaaqa bial zeena sakhiru minhum mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Qul seeru fi ail ardi thumma aanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mukazzibeen
Qul-limam mmaa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi qul-lil hi kataba 'al aa nafsihi air-rahmata layajma'annakum 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati laa rayba feehi ail zeena khasiru 'anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
Wal ahu maa sakana fi ail yli waan-nahaari wahwa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Qul 'aghayra aal laahi 'attakhizu wal iyya faatiri ais-samaawaati waal ardi wahwa yut'imu wal aa yut'amu qul 'inneea 'umirtu 'an 'akoona 'awwal a man 'aslama wal aa takoonanna mina aal mushrikeen
Qul 'inneea 'akhaafu 'in 'asaytu rabbi 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Mmany yyusraf 'anhu yawma'iz faqad rahimahu wazaal ika aal fawzu aul mubeen
Wainy yyamsaska aal laahu bidurr fal aa kaashifa lahu 'il laa hooa wainy yyamsaska bikhayr fahwa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wahwa aal qaahiru fawqa 'ibaadihi wahwa aal hakeemu aul khabeer

Qul 'ayyu sha'in 'akbaru shahaadat qul i ail laahu shaheedu bayni wabaynakum waooheea 'il ayya haazaa aal qur'aanu liunzirakum bihi wamam bal agha 'aa'innakum latashhadoona 'anna ma'a aal laahi 'aal ihatan 'ukhraa qul-laa 'ashhadu qul 'innamaa hooa 'il aah waahid wainnani bariaa' mmimmaa tushrikoon
Aal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba ya'rifoonahu kamaa ya'rifoona 'abnaa'ahumu aul zeena khasiru 'anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
Waman 'azlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan 'aw kazzaba biayaatihi 'innahu laa yuflihu auz-zaal imoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a thumma naqoolu lil zeena 'ashraku 'ayna shurakaa'ukumu aul zeena kuntum taz'umoon
Thumma lam takun fitnatahum 'il laa 'an qaal u waal laahi rabbinaa maa kunnaa mushrikeen
Aanzur kayfa kazabu 'al aa 'anfusihim wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

Waminhum mmany yyastami'u 'il ayka waja'al naa 'al aa qul oobihim 'akinnatan 'any yyafqahoohu wafi 'aazaanihim waqra wainy yyarawa kul la 'ayat llaa yu'minu bihaa hattaa 'izaa jaa'ooka yujaadil oonaka yaqoolu aul zeena kafaru 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateeru aul awwal een
Wahum yanhawna 'anhu wayanawna 'anhu wainy yyuhlikoona 'il laa 'anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
Wal aw taraa 'iz wuqifu 'al aa aan-naari faqaal u yaal aytanaa nuraddu wal aa nukazzibu biayaati rabbinaa wanakoonu mina aal mu'mineen
Bal badaa lahum mmaa kaanu yukhfoona min qablu wal aw ruddu la'aadu limaa nuhu 'anhu wainnahum lakaaziboon
Waqaal u 'in heea 'il laa hayaatunaa aad-dunyaa wamaa nahnu bimab'ootheen
Wal aw taraa 'iz wuqifu 'al aa rabbihim qaal a 'al aysa haazaa bial haqqi qaal u bal aa warabbinaa qaal a fazooqu aul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon

Qad khasira aal zeena kazzabu bil iqaa'i ail laahi hattaa 'izaa jaa'athumu aus-saa'atu baghtat qaal u yaahasratanaa 'al aa maa farratnaa feehaa wahum yahmil oona 'awzaarahum 'al aa zuhoorihim 'al aa saa'a maa yaziroon
Wamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunyaa 'il laa la'ib wal ahw wal ad-daaru aul aakhiratu khayr llil zeena yattaqoona 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Qad na'lamu 'innahu layuhzinuka aal zi yaqooloona fainnahum laa yukziboonaka wal aakinna aaz-zaal imeena biayaati ail laahi yajhadoon
Wal aqad kuzzibat rusul mmin qablika fasabaru 'al aa maa kuzzibu waoozu hattaa 'atayaahum nasrunaa wal aa mubaddil a likal imaati ail laahi wal aqad jaa'aka min nnabai ail mursal een

Wain kaana kabura 'al ayka 'i'raaduhum faini aistata'ta 'an tabtagheea nafaqa fi ail ardi 'aw sul lama fi ais-samaa'i fatateeahum biayat wal aw shaa'a aal laahu lajama'ahum 'al aa aal hudaa fal aa takoonanna mina aal jaahil een
'innamaa yastajeebu aul zeena yasma'oona waal mawtaa yab'athuhumu aul laahu thumma 'il ayhi yurja'oon
Waqaal u lawlaa nuzzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi qul 'inna aal laaha qaadirun 'al aa 'any yyunazzil a 'ayat wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa min daabbat fi ail ardi wal aa taa'ir yateeru bijanaahayhi 'il laa 'umamun 'amthaal ukum mmaa farratnaa fi ail kitaabi min sha' thumma 'il aa rabbihim yuhsharoon
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa summ wabukm fi aiz-zul umaati many yyashai ail laahu yudlil hu wamany yyasha yaj'al hu 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Qul 'araytakum 'in 'atayaakum 'azaabu aul laahi 'aw 'atatkumu aus-saa'atu 'aghayra aal laahi tad'oona 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal 'iyyaahu tad'oona fayakshifu maa tad'oona 'il ayhi 'in shaa'a watansawna maa tushrikoon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa 'il aa 'umam mmin qablika faakhaznaahum bial basaa'i waad-darraa'i la'al laahum yatadarra'oon
Fal awlaa 'iz jaa'ahum basunaa tadarra'u wal aakin qasat qul oobuhum wazayyana lahumu aush-shaytaanu maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Fal ammaa nasu maa zukkiru bihi fatahnaa 'al ayhim 'abwaaba kul li sha'in hattaa 'izaa farihu bimaa 'ootu 'akhaznaahum baghtat faizaa hum mmublisoon
Faquti'a daabiru aul qawmi ail zeena zal amu waal hamdu lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Qul 'araytum 'in 'akhaza aal laahu sam'akum waabsaarakum wakhatama 'al aa qul oobikum mman 'il aahun ghayru aul laahi yateekum bihi ainzur kayfa nusarrifu aul ayaati thumma hum yasdifoon
Qul 'araytakum 'in 'atayaakum 'azaabu aul laahi baghtatan 'aw jahratan hal yuhlaku 'il laa aal qawmu auz-zaal imoon
Wamaa nursil u aul mursal eena 'il laa mubashshireena wamunzireena faman 'aamana waaslaha fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa yamassuhumu aul'azaabu bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon

Qul-laa 'aqoolu lakum 'indi khazaa'inu aul laahi wal aa 'a'lamu aul ghayba wal aa 'aqoolu lakum 'inni mal akun 'in 'attabi'u 'il laa maa yoohaa 'il ayya qul hal yastawi ail a'maa waal baseeru 'afal aa tatafakkaroon
Waanzir bihi ail zeena yakhaafoona 'any yyuhsharu 'il aa rabbihim laysa lahum mmin doonihi wal eey wal aa shafee' lla'al laahum yattaqoon

Wal aa tatrudi ail zeena yad'oona rabbahum bial ghadawaati waal'asheeyi yureedoona wajhahu maa 'al ayka min hisaabihim mmin sha' wamaa min hisaabika 'al ayhim mmin sha' fatatrudahum fatakoona mina aaz-zaal imeen
Wakazaal ika fatannaa ba'dahum biba'd lleeaqoolu 'ahaa'ul aa'i manna aal laahu 'al ayhim mmim bayninaa 'al aysa aal laahu bia'lama biash-shaakireen

Waizaa jaa'aka aal zeena yu'minoona biayaatinaa faqul sal aamun 'al aykum kataba rabbukum 'al aa nafsihi air-rahmata 'annahu man 'amil a minkum sooaa'aa bijahaal at thumma taaba mim ba'dihi waaslaha fainnahu ghafoor rraheem
Wakazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati wal itastabeena sabeela aal mujrimeen
Qul 'inni nuheetu 'an 'a'buda aal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi qul-laa 'attabi'u 'ahwaa'akum qad dal al tu 'iza wamaa 'anaa mina aal muhtadeen
Qul 'inni 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbi wakazzabtum bihi maa 'indi maa tasta'jil oona bihi 'ini ail hukmu 'il laa lil hi yaqussu aul haqqa wahwa khayru aul faasil een
Qul-law 'anna 'indi maa tasta'jil oona bihi laqudeea aal amru bayni wabaynakum waal laahu 'a'lamu biaz-zaal imeen

Wa'indahu mafaatihu aul ghaybi laa ya'lamuhaa 'il laa hooa waya'lamu maa fi ail barri waal bahri wamaa tasqutu minw wwaraqatin 'il laa ya'lamuhaa wal aa habbat fi zul umaati ail ardi wal aa ratb wal aa yaabisin 'il laa fi kitaab mmubeen
Wahwa aal zi yatawaffayaakum bial yli waya'lamu maa jarahtum bian-nahaari thumma yab'athukum feehi leeuqdaa 'ajal mmusamma thumma 'il ayhi marji'ukum thumma yunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wahwa aal qaahiru fawqa 'ibaadihi wayursil u 'al aykum hafazatan hattaa 'izaa jaa 'ahadakumu aul mawtu tawaffathu rusul unaa wahum laa yufarritoon
Thumma ruddu 'il aa aal laahi mawlayaahumu aul haqqi 'al aa lahu aul hukmu wahwa 'asra'u aul haasibeen
Qul many yyunajjeekum mmin zul umaati ail barri waal bahri tad'oonahu tadarru'a wakhufyat lla'in 'anjaytanaa min haazihi lanakoonanna mina aash-shaakireen
Qul i ail laahu yunjeekum mminhaa wamin kul li karb thumma 'antum tushrikoon

Qul hooa aal qaadiru 'al aa 'any yyab'atha 'al aykum 'azaaba mmin fawqikum 'aw min tahti 'arjul ikum 'aw yal bisakum sheea'a wayuzeeqa ba'dakum basa ba'din aunzur kayfa nusarrifu aul ayaati la'al laahum yafqahoon
Wakazzaba bihi qawmuka wahwa aal haqqu qul-lastu 'al aykum biwakeel llikul li naba mmustaqarr wasawfa ta'lamoon
Waizaa rayta aal zeena yakhoodoona fi 'ayaatinaa faa'rid 'anhum hattaa yakhoodu fi hadeethin ghayrihi waimmaa yunseeannaka aash-shaytaanu fal aa taq'ud ba'da aaz-zikraa ma'a aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wamaa 'al aa aal zeena yattaqoona min hisaabihim mmin sha' wal aakin zikraa la'al laahum yattaqoon

Wazari ail zeena aattakhazu deenahum la'iba wal ahwa wagharrathumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunyaa wazakkir bihi 'an tubsal a nafsu bimaa kasabat laysa lahaa min dooni ail laahi wal eey wal aa shafee' wain ta'dil kul la 'adl llaa yu'khaz minhaa 'ul aa'ika aal zeena 'ubsil u bimaa kasabu lahum sharaab mmin hameem wa'azaabun 'al eemu bimaa kaanu yakfuroon

Qul 'anad'u min dooni ail laahi maa laa yanfa'unaa wal aa yadurrunaa wanuraddu 'al aa 'a'qaabinaa ba'da 'iz hadayaanaa aal laahu kaal zi aistahwathu aush-shayaateenu fi ail ardi hayraana lahu 'ashaab yad'oonahu 'il aa aal hudaa aytinaa qul 'inna hudaa aal laahi hooa aal hudaa waumirnaa linuslima lirabbi ail'aal ameen
Waan 'aqeemu aus-sal awaata waattaqoohu wahwa aal zi 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
Wahwa aal zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda bial haqqi wayawma yaqoolu kun fayakoon
Qawluhu aul haqqu wal ahu aul mul ku yawma yunfakhu fi ais-soori 'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati wahwa aal hakeemu aul khabeer
Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu liabeehi 'aazara 'atattakhizu 'asnaamaan 'aal ihatan 'inneea 'arayaaka waqawmaka fi dal aal mmubeen
Wakazaal ika nuri 'ibraaheema mal akoota aas-samaawaati waal ardi wal eeakoona mina aal mooqineen
Fal ammaa janna 'al ayhi ail ylu ra'aa kawkaba qaal a haazaa rabbi fal ammaa 'afal a qaal a laa 'uhibbu aul aafil een
Fal ammaa ra'aa aal qamara baazigha qaal a haazaa rabbi fal ammaa 'afal a qaal a la'il llam yahdini rabbi laakoonanna mina aal qawmi aid-daal leen
Fal ammaa ra'aa aash-shamsa baazighat qaal a haazaa rabbi haazaa 'akbaru fal ammaa 'afal at qaal a yaaqawmi 'inni bariaa' mmimmaa tushrikoon
'inni wajjahtu wajheea lil zi fatara aas-samaawaati waal arda haneefa wamaa 'anaa mina aal mushrikeen
Wahaajjahu qawmuhu qaal a 'atuhaajjooni fi ail laahi waqad hadayaani wal aa 'akhaafu maa tushrikoona bihi 'il laa 'any yyashaa'a rabbi shaya wasi'a rabbi kul la sha'in 'il maan 'afal aa tatazakkaroon
Wakayfa 'akhaafu maa 'ashraktum wal aa takhaafoona 'annakum 'ashraktum bial laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi 'al aykum sul taana fayyu aul fareeqayni 'ahaqqu bial amni 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Aal zeena 'aamanu wal am yal bisu 'eemaanahum bizul min 'ul aa'ika lahumu aul amnu wahum mmuhtadoon
Watil ka hujjatunaa 'aataynaahaa 'ibraaheema 'al aa qawmihi narfa'u darajaati man nnashaa'u ainna rabbaka hakeemun 'al eem
Wawahabnaa lahu 'ishaaqa waya'qooba kul laan hadaynaa wanoohaan hadaynaa min qablu wamin zurriyyatihi daawuda wasul aymaana wayyooba wayoosufa wamoosaa wahaaroona wakazaal ika najzi ail muhsineen
Wazakariyyaa'a wayahyaa wa'eesaa wail yaasa kul l mmina aas-saal iheen
Waismaa'eela waal yasa'a wayoonusa wal oota wakul la faddal naa 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Wamin 'aabaa'ihim wazurriyyaatihim waikhwaanihim waajtabaynaahum wahadaynaahum 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Zaal ika hudaa aal laahi yahdi bihi many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wal aw 'ashraku lahabita 'anhum mmaa kaanu ya'mal oon
'ul aa'ika aal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba waal hukma waan-nubooaa'ata fainy yyakfur bihaa haa'ul aa'i faqad wakkal naa bihaa qawma llaysu bihaa bikaafireen
'ul aa'ika aal zeena hadaa aal laahu fabihudayaahumu auqtadih qul-laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi 'ajraan 'in hooa 'il laa zikraa lil'aal ameen

Wamaa qadaru aul laaha haqqa qadrihi 'iz qaal u maa 'anzal a aal laahu 'al aa bashar mmin sha' qul man 'anzal a aal kitaaba aal zi jaa'a bihi moosaa noora wahuda llin-naasi taj'al oonahu qaraateesa tubdoonahaa watukhfoona katheera wa'ul limtum mmaa lam ta'lamu 'antum wal aa 'aabaa'ukum qul i ail laahu thumma zarhum fi khawdihim yal'aboon

Wahaazaa kitaabun 'anzal naahu mubaarak mmusaddiqu aul zi bayna yadayhi wal itunzira 'umma aal quraa waman hawlahaa waal zeena yu'minoona bial aakhirati yu'minoona bihi wahum 'al aa sal aatihim yuhaafizoon

Waman 'azlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan 'aw qaal a 'ooheea 'il ayya wal am yooha 'il ayhi sha' waman qaal a saunzil u mithla maa 'anzal a aal laahu wal aw taraa 'izi aiz-zaal imoona fi ghamaraati ail mawti waal mal aa'ikatu baasitu 'aydeehim 'akhriju 'anfusakumu aul yawma tujzawna 'azaaba aal hooni bimaa kuntum taqooloona 'al aa aal laahi ghayra aal haqqi wakuntum 'an 'ayaatihi tastakbiroon

Wal aqad jeetumoonaa furaadaa kamaa khal aqnaakum 'awwal a marrat wataraktum mmaa khawwal naakum waraa'a zuhoorikum wamaa naraa ma'akum shufa'aa'akumu aul zeena za'amtum 'annahum feekum shurakaa'ua laqad ttaqatta'a baynakum wadal la 'ankum mmaa kuntum taz'umoon
'inna aal laaha faal iqu aul habbi waan-nawaa yukhriju aul hayya mina aal mayyiti wamukhriju aul mayyiti mina aal hayyi zaal ikumu aul laahu faannaa tu'fakoon
Faal iqu aul isbaahi wajaa'il u aul yli sakana waash-shamsa waal qamara husbaana zaal ika taqdeeru aul'azeezi ail'al eem
Wahwa aal zi ja'al a lakumu aun-nujooma litahtadu bihaa fi zul umaati ail barri waal bahri qad fassal naa aal ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon
Wahwa aal zi 'anshaakum mmin nnafs waahidat famustaqarr wamustawda' qad fassal naa aal ayaati liqawm yafqahoon

Wahwa aal zi 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faakhrajnaa bihi nabaata kul li sha' faakhrajnaa minhu khadira nnukhriju minhu habba mmutaraakiba wamina aan-nakhli min tal'ihaa qinwaan daaneeat wajannaat mmin 'a'naab waaz-zaytoona waar-rummaana mushtabiha waghayra mutashaabihin aunzuru 'il aa thamarihi 'izaa 'athmara wayan'ihi 'inna fi zaal ikum layaat lliqawm yu'minoon
Waja'al u lil hi shurakaa'a aal jinna wakhal aqahum wakharraqu lahu baneena wabanaati bighayri 'il m subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yasifoon
Badee'u aus-samaawaati waal ardi 'annaa yakoonu lahu wal ad wal am takul llaahu saahibat wakhal aqa kul la sha' wahwa bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukum laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa khaal iqu kul li sha' faa'budoohu wahwa 'al aa kul li sha' wakeel
Llaa tudrikuhu aul absaaru wahwa yudriku aul absaara wahwa aal lateefu aul khabeer
Qad jaa'akum basaa'iru mir rrabbikum faman 'absara fal inafsihi waman 'ameea fa'al ayhaa wamaa 'anaa 'al aykum bihafeez
Wakazaal ika nusarrifu aul ayaati wal eeaqoolu darasta wal inubayyinahu liqawm ya'lamoon
Aattabi' maa 'ooheea 'il ayka mir rrabbika laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa waa'rid 'ani ail mushrikeen
Wal aw shaa'a aal laahu maa 'ashraku wamaa ja'al naaka 'al ayhim hafeeza wamaa 'anta 'al ayhim biwakeel

Wal aa tasubbu aul zeena yad'oona min dooni ail laahi fayasubbu aul laaha 'adwaa bighayri 'il m kazaal ika zayyannaa likul li 'ummatin 'amal ahum thumma 'il aa rabbihim mmarji'uhum fayunabbeeuhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waaqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihim la'in jaa'athum 'ayat llayu'minunna bihaa qul 'innamaa aal ayaatu 'inda aal laahi wamaa yush'irukum 'annahaa 'izaa jaa'at laa yu'minoon
Wanuqal libu 'afidatahum waabsaarahum kamaa lam yu'minu bihi 'awwal a marrat wanazaruhum fi tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Wal aw 'annanaa nazzal naa 'il ayhimu aul mal aa'ikata wakal lamahumu aul mawtaa wahasharnaa 'al ayhim kul la sha' qibal a mmaa kaanu leeu'minu 'il laa 'any yyashaa'a aal laahu wal aakinna 'aktharahum yajhal oon
Wakazaal ika ja'al naa likul li nabiaa'in 'adoowa shayaateena aal insi waal jinni yoohi ba'duhum 'il aa ba'd zukhrufa aal qawli ghuroora wal aw shaa'a rabbuka maa fa'al oohu fazarhum wamaa yaftaroon
Wal itasghaa 'il ayhi 'afidatu aul zeena laa yu'minoona bial aakhirati wal eeardawhu wal eeaqtarifu maa hum mmuqtarifoon

'afaghayra aal laahi 'abtaghi hakama wahwa aal zi 'anzal a 'il aykumu aul kitaaba mufassal a waal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba ya'lamoona 'annahu munzal mmir rrabbika bial haqqi fal aa takoonanna mina aal mumtareen
Watammat kal imaatu rabbika sidqa wa'adla llaa mubaddil a likal imaatihi wahwa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Wain tuti' 'akthara man fi ail ardi yudil looka 'an sabeeli ail laahi 'iny yyattabi'oona 'il laa aaz-zanna wain hum 'il laa yakhrusoon
'inna rabbaka hooa 'a'lamu many yyadil lu 'an sabeelihi wahwa 'a'lamu bial muhtadeen
Fakul u mimmaa zukira aasmu aul laahi 'al ayhi 'in kuntum biayaatihi mu'mineen

Wamaa lakum 'al laa takul u mimmaa zukira aasmu aul laahi 'al ayhi waqad fassal a lakum mmaa harrama 'al aykum 'il laa maa aadturirtum 'il ayhi wainna katheera llayadil loona biahwaa'ihim bighayri 'il min 'inna rabbaka hooa 'a'lamu bial mu'tadeen
Wazaru zaahira aal ithmi wabaatinahu 'inna aal zeena yaksiboona aal ithma sayujzawna bimaa kaanu yaqtarifoon
Wal aa takul u mimmaa lam yuzkari aismu aul laahi 'al ayhi wainnahu lafisq wainna aash-shayaateena layoohoona 'il aa 'awleeaa'ihim leeujaadil ookum wain 'ata'tumoohum 'innakum lamushrikoon
'awaman kaana mayyita faahyaynaahu waja'al naa lahu noora yamshi bihi fi ain-naasi kamam mmathal uhu fi aiz-zul umaati laysa bikhaarij mminhaa kazaal ika zuyyina lil kaafireena maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wakazaal ika ja'al naa fi kul li qaryatin 'akaabira mujrimeehaa leeamkuru feehaa wamaa yamkuroona 'il laa bianfusihim wamaa yash'uroon

Waizaa jaa'athum 'ayat qaal u lan nnu'mina hattaa nu'taa mithla maa 'ooteea rusul u aul laahi ail laahu 'a'lamu haythu yaj'al u risaal aatihi sayuseebu aul zeena 'ajramu saghaarun 'inda aal laahi wa'azaab shadeedu bimaa kaanu yamkuroon

Famany yyuridi ail laahu 'any yyahdeeahu yashrah sadrahu lil islaami wamany yyurid 'any yyudil laahu yaj'al sadrahu dayyiqaan harija kaannamaa yassa'adu fi ais-samaa'i kazaal ika yaj'al u aul laahu aur-rijsa 'al aa aal zeena laa yu'minoon
Wahaazaa siraatu rabbika mustaqeema qad fassal naa aal ayaati liqawm yazzakkaroon
Lahum daaru aus-sal aami 'inda rabbihim wahwa wal eeyuhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon

Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a yaama'shara aal jinni qadi aistakthartum mmina aal insi waqaal a 'awleeaa'uhum mmina aal insi rabbanaa aastamta'a ba'dunaa biba'd wabal aghnaa 'ajal anaa aal zi 'ajjal ta lanaa qaal a aan-naaru mathwayaakum khaal ideena feehaa 'il laa maa shaa'a aal laahu 'inna rabbaka hakeemun 'al eem
Wakazaal ika nooal li ba'da aaz-zaal imeena ba'daa bimaa kaanu yaksiboon

Yaama'shara aal jinni waal insi 'al am yatikum rusul mminkum yaqussoona 'al aykum 'ayaati wayunziroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa qaal u shahidnaa 'al aa 'anfusinaa wagharrathumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunyaa washahidu 'al aa 'anfusihim 'annahum kaanu kaafireen
Zaal ika 'al llam yakur rrabbuka muhlika aal quraa bizul m waahluhaa ghaafil oon
Wal ikul l darajaat mmimmaa 'amil u wamaa rabbuka bighaafil in 'ammaa ya'mal oon
Warabbuka aal ghaneeyu zoo aur-rahmati 'iny yyasha yuzhibkum wayastakhlif mim ba'dikum mmaa yashaa'u kamaa 'anshaakum mmin zurriyyati qawmin 'aakhareen
'inna maa too'adoona laat wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeen
Qul yaaqawmi ai'mal u 'al aa makaanatikum 'inni 'aamil fasawfa ta'lamoona man takoonu lahu 'aaqibatu aud-daari 'innahu laa yuflihu auz-zaal imoon

Waja'al u lil hi mimmaa zaraa mina aal harthi waal an'aami naseeba faqaal u haazaa lil hi biza'mihim wahaazaa lishurakaa'inaa famaa kaana lishurakaa'ihim fal aa yasil u 'il aa aal laahi wamaa kaana lil hi fahwa yasil u 'il aa shurakaa'ihim saa'a maa yahkumoon
Wakazaal ika zayyana likatheer mmina aal mushrikeena qatla 'awlaadihim shurakaa'uhum leeurdoohum wal eeal bisu 'al ayhim deenahum wal aw shaa'a aal laahu maa fa'al oohu fazarhum wamaa yaftaroon

Waqaal u haazihi 'an'aam waharthun hijr llaa yat'amuhaa 'il laa man nnashaa'u biza'mihim waan'aamun hurrimat zuhooruhaa waan'aam llaa yazkuroona aasma aal laahi 'al ayhaa aaftiraa'an 'al ayhi sayajzeehim bimaa kaanu yaftaroon
Waqaal u maa fi butooni haazihi ail an'aami khaal isat llizukoorinaa wamuharramun 'al aa 'azwaajinaa wainy yyakum mmaytat fahum feehi shurakaa'u sayajzeehim wasfahum 'innahu hakeemun 'al eem
Qad khasira aal zeena qatal u 'awlaadahum safahaa bighayri 'il m waharramu maa razaqahumu aul laahu auftiraa'an 'al aa aal laahi qad dal lu wamaa kaanu muhtadeen
