Wahwa aal zi 'anshaa jannaat mma'rooshaat waghayra ma'rooshaat waan-nakhla waaz-zar'a mukhtal ifaan 'ukluhu waaz-zaytoona waar-rummaana mutashaabiha waghayra mutashaabih kul u min thamarihi 'izaa 'athmara wa'aatu haqqahu yawma hisaadihi wal aa tusrifu 'innahu laa yuhibbu aul musrifeen
Wamina aal an'aami hamoolat wafarsha kul u mimmaa razaqakumu aul laahu wal aa tattabi'u khutwaati aish-shaytaani 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen

Thamaaneeata 'azwaaj mmina aad-dani aithnayni wamina aal ma'zi aithnayni qul 'aaz-zakarayni harrama 'ami ail unthayayni 'ammaa aashtamal at 'al ayhi 'arhaamu aul unthayayni nabbiooni bi'il min 'in kuntum saadiqeen

Wamina aal ibil i aithnayni wamina aal baqari aithnayni qul 'aaz-zakarayni harrama 'ami ail unthayayni 'ammaa aashtamal at 'al ayhi 'arhaamu aul unthayayni 'am kuntum shuhadaa'a az wassayaakumu aul laahu bihaazaa faman 'azlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kaziba lleeudil la aan-naasa bighayri 'il min 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen

Qul-laa 'ajidu fi maa 'ooheea 'il ayya muharramaan 'al aa taa'im yat'amuhu 'il laa 'any yyakoona maytatan 'aw dama mmasfoohaan 'aw lahma khinzeer fainnahu rijsun 'aw fisqaan 'uhil la lighayri ail laahi bihi famanu audturra ghayra baagh wal aa 'aad fainna rabbaka ghafoor rraheem

Wa'al aa aal zeena haadu harramnaa kul la zi zufur wamina aal baqari waal ghanami harramnaa 'al ayhim shuhoomahumaa 'il laa maa hamal at zuhooruhumaa 'awi ail hawayaa 'aw maa aakhtal ata bi'azm zaal ika jazaynaahum bibaghyihim wainnaa lasaadiqoon
Fain kazzabooka faqur-rabbukum zoo rahmat waasi'at wal aa yuraddu basuhu 'ani ail qawmi ail mujrimeen

Sayaqoolu aul zeena 'ashraku law shaa'a aal laahu maa 'ashraknaa wal aa 'aabaa'unaa wal aa harramnaa min sha' kazaal ika kazzaba aal zeena min qablihim hattaa zaaqu basanaa qul hal 'indakum mmin 'il m fatukhrijoohu lanaa 'in tattabi'oona 'il laa aaz-zanna wain 'antum 'il laa takhrusoon
Qul fal il hi ail hujjatu aul baal ighatu fal aw shaa'a lahadayaakum 'ajma'een

Qul hal umma shuhadaa'akumu aul zeena yashhadoona 'anna aal laaha harrama haazaa fain shahidu fal aa tashhad ma'ahum wal aa tattabi' 'ahwaa'a aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa waal zeena laa yu'minoona bial aakhirati wahum birabbihim ya'dil oon

Qul ta'aal awa 'atlu maa harrama rabbukum 'al aykum 'al laa tushriku bihi shaya wabial waal idayni 'ihsaana wal aa taqtul u 'awlaadakum mmin 'imlaaq nnahnu narzuqukum waiyyaahum wal aa taqrabu aul fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana wal aa taqtul u aun-nafsa aal ti harrama aal laahu 'il laa bial haqqi zaal ikum wassayaakum bihi la'al lakum ta'qil oon

Wal aa taqrabu maal a aal yateemi 'il laa bial ti heea 'ahsanu hattaa yablugha 'ashuddahu waawfu aul kayla waal meezaana bial qisti laa nukal lifu nafsaan 'il laa wus'ahaa waizaa qul tum faa'dil u wal aw kaana zaa qurbaa wabi'ahdi ail laahi 'awfu zaal ikum wassayaakum bihi la'al lakum tazzakkaroon
Waanna haazaa siraati mustaqeema faattabi'oohu wal aa tattabi'u aus-subul a fatafarraqa bikum 'an sabeelihi zaal ikum wassayaakum bihi la'al lakum tattaqoon
Thumma 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba tamaamaan 'al aa aal zi 'ahsana watafseela llikul li sha' wahuda warahmat lla'al laahum bil iqaa'i rabbihim yu'minoon
Wahaazaa kitaabun 'anzal naahu mubaarak faattabi'oohu waattaqu la'al lakum turhamoon
'an taqoolu 'innamaa 'unzil a aal kitaabu 'al aa taa'ifatayni min qablinaa wain kunnaa 'an diraasatihim laghaafil een

'aw taqoolu law 'annaa 'unzil a 'al aynaa aal kitaabu lakunnaa 'ahdaa minhum faqad jaa'akum bayyinat mmir rrabbikum wahuda warahmat faman 'azlamu mimman kazzaba biayaati ail laahi wasadafa 'anhaa sanajzi ail zeena yasdifoona 'an 'ayaatinaa sooaa'a aal'azaabi bimaa kaanu yasdifoon

Hal yanzuroona 'il laa 'an tateeahumu aul mal aa'ikatu 'aw yateea rabbuka 'aw yateea ba'du 'ayaati rabbika yawma yati ba'du 'ayaati rabbika laa yanfa'u nafsaan 'eemaanuhaa lam takun 'aamanat min qablu 'aw kasabat fi 'eemaanihaa khayra qul i aintaziru 'innaa muntaziroon
'inna aal zeena farraqu deenahum wakaanu sheea'a llasta minhum fi sha'in 'innamaa 'amruhum 'il aa aal laahi thumma yunabbeeuhum bimaa kaanu yaf'al oon
Man jaa'a bial hasanati fal ahu 'ashru 'amthaal ihaa waman jaa'a bias-sayyeeati fal aa yujzaa 'il laa mithlahaa wahum laa yuzlamoon
Qul 'innani hadayaani rabbeea 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Deena qayyima mmil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wamaa kaana mina aal mushrikeen
Qul 'inna sal aati wanusuki wamahyaa wamamaateea lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Laa shareeka lahu wabizaal ika 'umirtu waanaa 'awwal u aul muslimeen

Qul 'aghayra aal laahi 'abghi rabba wahwa rabbu kul li sha' wal aa taksibu kul lu nafsin 'il laa 'al ayhaa wal aa taziru waazirat wizra 'ukhraa thumma 'il aa rabbikum mmarji'ukum fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
Wahwa aal zi ja'al akum khal aa'ifa aal ardi warafa'a ba'dakum fawqa ba'd darajaat lleeablooakum fi maa 'aatayaakum 'inna rabbaka saree'u aul'iqaabi wainnahu laghafoor rraheem
'al aammiaasaa kitaabun 'unzil a 'il ayka fal aa yakun fi sadrika haraj mminhu litunzira bihi wazikraa lil mu'mineen
Aattabi'u maa 'unzil a 'il aykum mmir rrabbikum wal aa tattabi'u min doonihi 'awleeaa'a qal eela mmaa tazzakkaroon
Wakam mmin qaryatin 'ahlaknaahaa fajaa'ahaa basunaa bayaataan 'aw hum qaa'il oon
Famaa kaana da'wayaahum 'iz jaa'ahum basunaa 'il laa 'an qaal u 'innaa kunnaa zaal imeen
Fal anasal anna aal zeena 'ursil a 'il ayhim wal anasal anna aal mursal een
Fal anaqussanna 'al ayhim bi'il m wamaa kunnaa ghaa'ibeen
Waal waznu yawma'izin ail haqqu faman thaqul at mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Waman khaffat mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika aal zeena khasiru 'anfusahum bimaa kaanu biayaatinaa yazlimoon
Wal aqad makkannaakum fi ail ardi waja'al naa lakum feehaa ma'ayisha qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Wal aqad khal aqnaakum thumma sawwarnaakum thumma qul naa lil mal aa'ikati aisjudu liaadama fasajadu 'il laa 'ibleesa lam yakum mmina aas-saajideen
Qaal a maa mana'aka 'al laa tasjuda 'iz 'amartuka qaal a 'anaa khayr mminhu khal aqtani min nnaar wakhal aqtahu min teen
Qaal a faahbit minhaa famaa yakoonu laka 'an tatakabbara feehaa faakhruj 'innaka mina aas-saaghireen
Qaal a 'anzirni 'il aa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaal a 'innaka mina aal munzareen
Qaal a fabimaa 'aghwaytani laaq'udanna lahum siraataka aal mustaqeem
Thumma laateeannahum mmim bayni 'aydeehim wamin khal fihim wa'an 'aymaanihim wa'an shamaa'il ihim wal aa tajidu 'aktharahum shaakireen
Qaal a aakhruj minhaa maz'ooma mmadhoora llaman tabi'aka minhum laamlaanna jahannama minkum 'ajma'een
Wayaadamu auskun 'anta wazawjuka aal jannata fakul aa min haythu sheetumaa wal aa taqrabaa haazihi aish-shajarata fatakoonaa mina aaz-zaal imeen

Fawaswasa lahumaa aash-shaytaanu leeubdeea lahumaa maa wureea 'anhumaa min saw'aatihimaa waqaal a maa nahayaakumaa rabbukumaa 'an haazihi aish-shajarati 'il laa 'an takoonaa mal akayni 'aw takoonaa mina aal khaal ideen
Waqaasamahumaa 'inni lakumaa lamina aan-naasiheen

Fadal layaahumaa bighuroor fal ammaa zaaqaa aash-shajarata badat lahumaa saw'aatuhumaa watafiqaa yakhsifaani 'al ayhimaa minw wwaraqi ail jannati wanaadayaahumaa rabbuhumaa 'al am 'anhakumaa 'an til kumaa aash-shajarati waaqul-lakumaa 'inna aash-shaytaana lakumaa 'adoow mmubeen
Qaal aa rabbanaa zal amnaa 'anfusanaa wail llam taghfir lanaa watarhamnaa lanakoonanna mina aal khaasireen
Qaal a aahbitu ba'dukum liba'din 'adoow wal akum fi ail ardi mustaqarr wamataa'un 'il aa heen
Qaal a feehaa tahyawna wafeehaa tamootoona waminhaa tukhrajoon
Yaabani 'aadama qad 'anzal naa 'al aykum libaasa yooaari saw'aatikum wareesha wal ibaasa aat-taqwaa zaal ika khayr zaal ika min 'ayaati ail laahi la'al laahum yazzakkaroon

Yaabani 'aadama laa yaftinannakumu aush-shaytaanu kamaa 'akhraja 'abawaykum mmina aal jannati yanzi'u 'anhumaa libaasahumaa leeureeahumaa saw'aatihimaa 'innahu yarayaakum hooa waqabeeluhu min haythu laa tarawnahum 'innaa ja'al naa aash-shayaateena 'awleeaa'a lil zeena laa yu'minoon
Waizaa fa'al u faahishat qaal u wajadnaa 'al ayhaa 'aabaa'anaa waal laahu 'amaranaa bihaa qul 'inna aal laaha laa yamuru bial fahshaa'i aataqooloona 'al aa aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon

Qul 'amara rabbi bial qisti waaqeemu wujoohakum 'inda kul li masjid waad'oohu mukhliseena lahu aud-deena kamaa badaakum ta'oodoona fareeqaan hadaa wafareeqaan haqqa 'al ayhimu aud-dal aal atu 'innahumu auttakhazu aush-shayaateena 'awleeaa'a min dooni ail laahi wayahsiboona 'annahum mmuhtadoon
Yaabani 'aadama khuzu zeenatakum 'inda kul li masjid wakul u waashrabu wal aa tusrifu 'innahu laa yuhibbu aul musrifeen

Qul man harrama zeenata aal laahi ail ti 'akhraja li'ibaadihi waat-tayyibaati mina aar-rizqi qul heea lil zeena 'aamanu fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa khaal isat yawma aal qeeaamati kazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon

Qul 'innamaa harrama rabbeea aal fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana waal ithma waal baghya bighayri ail haqqi waan tushriku bial laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sul taana waan taqoolu 'al aa aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Wal ikul li 'ummatin 'ajal faizaa jaa 'ajal uhum laa yastaakhiroona saa'at wal aa yastaqdimoon
Yaabani 'aadama 'immaa yateeannakum rusul mminkum yaqussoona 'al aykum 'ayaati famani aittaqaa waaslaha fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa waastakbaru 'anhaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon

Faman 'azlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan 'aw kazzaba biayaatihi 'ul aa'ika yanaal uhum naseebuhum mmina aal kitaabi hattaa 'izaa jaa'athum rusul unaa yatawaffawnahum qaal u 'ayna maa kuntum tad'oona min dooni ail laahi qaal u dal lu 'annaa washahidu 'al aa 'anfusihim 'annahum kaanu kaafireen

Qaal a aadkhul u fi 'umam qad khal at min qablikum mmina aal jinni waal insi fi ain-naari kul lamaa dakhal at 'ummat lla'anat 'ukhtahaa hattaa 'izaa aaddaaraku feehaa jamee'a qaal at 'ukhrayaahum lioolayaahum rabbanaa haa'ul aa'i aadal loonaa faatihim 'azaaba di'fa mmina aan-naar
Qaal a likul l di'f wal aakil llaa ta'lamoon
Waqaal at 'oolayaahum liukhrayaahum famaa kaana lakum 'al aynaa min fadl fazooqu aul'azaaba bimaa kuntum taksiboon

'inna aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa waastakbaru 'anhaa laa tufattahu lahum 'abwaabu aus-samaa'i wal aa yadkhul oona aal jannata hattaa yal ija aal jamal u fi sammi ail kheeaati wakazaal ika najzi ail mujrimeen
Lahum mmin jahannama mihaad wamin fawqihim ghawaash wakazaal ika najzi aiz-zaal imeen
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati laa nukal lifu nafsaan 'il laa wus'ahaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon

Wanaza'naa maa fi sudoorihim mmin ghil l tajri min tahtihimu aul anhaaru waqaal u aul hamdu lil hi ail zi hadayaanaa lihaazaa wamaa kunnaa linahtadeea lawlaa 'an hadayaanaa aal laahu laqad jaa'at rusul u rabbinaa bial haqqi wanoodu 'an til kumu aul jannatu 'oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon

Wanaadaa 'ashaabu aul jannati 'ashaaba aan-naari 'an qad wajadnaa maa wa'adanaa rabbunaa haqqa fahal wajadttum mmaa wa'ada rabbukum haqqa qaal u na'am faazzana mu'azzinu baynahum 'al lla'natu aul laahi 'al aa aaz-zaal imeen
Aal zeena yasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwaja wahum bial aakhirati kaafiroon
Wabaynahumaa hijaab wa'al aa aal a'raafi rijaal ya'rifoona kul laa biseemayaahum wanaadawa 'ashaaba aal jannati 'an sal aamun 'al aykum lam yadkhul oohaa wahum yatma'oon
Waizaa surifat 'absaaruhum til qaa 'ashaabi ain-naari qaal u rabbanaa laa taj'al naa ma'a aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wanaadaa 'ashaabu aul a'raafi rijaal a ya'rifoonahum biseemayaahum qaal u maa 'aghnaa 'ankum jam'ukum wamaa kuntum tastakbiroon
'ahaa'ul aa'i ail zeena 'aqsamtum laa yanaal uhumu aul laahu birahmatin audkhul u aul jannata laa khawfun 'al aykum wal aa 'antum tahzanoon
Wanaadaa 'ashaabu aun-naari 'ashaaba aal jannati 'an 'afeedu 'al aynaa mina aal maa'i aaw mimmaa razaqakumu aul laahu qaal u 'inna aal laaha harramahumaa 'al aa aal kaafireen
Aal zeena aattakhazu deenahum lahwa wal a'iba wagharrathumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunyaa faal yawma nansayaahum kamaa nasu liqaa'a yawmihim haazaa wamaa kaanu biayaatinaa yajhadoon
Wal aqad jeenaahum bikitaab fassal naahu 'al aa 'il min huda warahmat lliqawm yu'minoon

Hal yanzuroona 'il laa taweelahu yawma yati taweeluhu yaqoolu aul zeena nasoohu min qablu qad jaa'at rusul u rabbinaa bial haqqi fahal-lanaa min shufa'aa'a fayashfa'u lanaa 'aw nuraddu fana'mal a ghayra aal zi kunnaa na'mal u qad khasiru 'anfusahum wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

'inna rabbakumu aul laahu aul zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda fi sittati 'ayyaam thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi yughshi ail yla aan-nahaara yatlubuhu hatheetha waash-shamsa waal qamara waan-nujooma musakhkharaati biamrihi 'al aa lahu aul khal qu waal amru tabaaraka aal laahu rabbu aul'aal ameen
Aad'u rabbakum tadarru'a wakhufyatan 'innahu laa yuhibbu aul mu'tadeen
Wal aa tufsidu fi ail ardi ba'da 'islaahihaa waad'oohu khawfa watama'aan 'inna rahmata aal laahi qareeb mmina aal muhsineen

Wahwa aal zi yursil u aur-reeaaha nushuraa bayna yada rahmatihi hattaa 'izaa 'aqal lat sahaaba thiqaal a suqnaahu libal ad mmayyit faanzal naa bihi ail maa'a faakhrajnaa bihi min kul li aith-thamaraati kazaal ika nukhriju aul mawtaa la'al lakum tazzakkaroon
Waal bal adu aut-tayyibu yakhruju nabaatuhu biizni rabbihi waal zi khabutha laa yakhruju 'il laa nakida kazaal ika nusarrifu aul ayaati liqawm yashkuroon
Laqad 'arsal naa noohaan 'il aa qawmihi faqaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qaal a aal mal au min qawmihi 'innaa lanarayaaka fi dal aal mmubeen
Qaal a yaaqawmi laysa bi dal aal at wal aakinni rasool mmir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
'ubal lighukum risaal aati rabbi waansahu lakum waa'lamu mina aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
'awa'ajibtum 'an jaa'akum zikr mmir rrabbikum 'al aa rajul mminkum leeunzirakum wal itattaqu wal a'al lakum turhamoon
Fakazzaboohu faanjaynaahu waal zeena ma'ahu fi ail ful ki waaghraqnaa aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa 'innahum kaanu qawmaan 'ameen
Wail aa 'aadin 'akhaahum hooda qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu 'afal aa tattaqoon
Qaal a aal mal au aul zeena kafaru min qawmihi 'innaa lanarayaaka fi safaahat wainnaa lanazunnuka mina aal kaazibeen
Qaal a yaaqawmi laysa bi safaahat wal aakinni rasool mmir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
'ubal lighukum risaal aati rabbi waanaa lakum naasihun 'ameen

'awa'ajibtum 'an jaa'akum zikr mmir rrabbikum 'al aa rajul mminkum leeunzirakum waazkuru 'iz ja'al akum khul afaa'a mim ba'di qawmi nooh wazaadakum fi ail khal qi bastat faazkuru 'aal aa'a aal laahi la'al lakum tuflihoon
Qaal u 'ajeetanaa lina'buda aal laaha wahdahu wanazara maa kaana ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa fatinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen

Qaal a qad waqa'a 'al aykum mmir rrabbikum rijs waghadabun 'atujaadil oonani fi 'asmaa' sammaytumoohaa 'antum wa'aabaa'ukum mmaa nazzal a aal laahu bihaa min sul taan faantaziru 'inni ma'akum mmina aal muntazireen
Faanjaynaahu waal zeena ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa waqata'naa daabira aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa wamaa kaanu mu'mineen

Wail aa thamooda 'akhaahum saal iha qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu qad jaa'atkum bayyinat mmir rrabbikum haazihi naaqatu aul laahi lakum 'ayat fazaroohaa takul fi 'ardi ail laahi wal aa tamassoohaa bisooaa' fayakhuzakum 'azaabun 'al eem

Waazkuru 'iz ja'al akum khul afaa'a mim ba'di 'aad wabawwaakum fi ail ardi tattakhizoona min suhoolihaa qusoora watanhitoona aal jibaal a beeoota faazkuru 'aal aa'a aal laahi wal aa ta'thawa fi ail ardi mufsideen
Qaal a aal mal au aul zeena aastakbaru min qawmihi lil zeena aastud'ifu liman 'aamana minhum 'ata'lamoona 'anna saal iha mmursal mmir rrabbihi qaal u 'innaa bimaa 'ursil a bihi mu'minoon
Qaal a aal zeena aastakbaru 'innaa bial zi 'aamantum bihi kaafiroon
Fa'aqaru aun-naaqata wa'atawa 'an 'amri rabbihim waqaal u yaasaal ihu auytinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta mina aal mursal een
Faakhazathumu aur-rajfatu faasbahu fi daarihim jaathimeen
Fatawal laa 'anhum waqaal a yaaqawmi laqad 'ablaghtukum risaal ata rabbi wanasahtu lakum wal aakil llaa tuhibboona aan-naasiheen
Wal ootaan 'iz qaal a liqawmihi 'atatoona aal faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa min 'ahad mmina aal'aal ameen
'innakum latatoona aar-rijaal a shahwat mmin dooni ain-nisaa'i bal 'antum qawm mmusrifoon
Wamaa kaana jawaaba qawmihi 'il laa 'an qaal u 'akhrijoohum mmin qaryatikum 'innahum 'unaas yatatahharoon
Faanjaynaahu waahlahu 'il laa aamraatahu kaanat mina aal ghaabireen
Waamtarnaa 'al ayhim mmatara faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mujrimeen

Wail aa madyana 'akhaahum shu'ayba qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu qad jaa'atkum bayyinat mmir rrabbikum faawfu aul kayla waal meezaana wal aa tabkhasu aun-naasa 'ashyaa'ahum wal aa tufsidu fi ail ardi ba'da 'islaahihaa zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen

Wal aa taq'udu bikul li siraat too'idoona watasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi man 'aamana bihi watabghoonahaa 'iwaja waazkuru 'iz kuntum qal eela fakaththarakum waanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mufsideen
Wain kaana taa'ifat mminkum 'aamanu bial zi 'ursil tu bihi wataa'ifat llam yu'minu faasbiru hattaa yahkuma aal laahu baynanaa wahwa khayru aul haakimeen
Qaal a aal mal au aul zeena aastakbaru min qawmihi lanukhrijannaka yaashu'aybu waal zeena 'aamanu ma'aka min qaryatinaa 'aw lata'oodunna fi mil latinaa qaal a 'awal aw kunnaa kaariheen

Qadi aiftaraynaa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan 'in 'udnaa fi mil latikum ba'da 'iz najjayaanaa aal laahu minhaa wamaa yakoonu lanaa 'an nna'ooda feehaa 'il laa 'any yyashaa'a aal laahu rabbunaa wasi'a rabbunaa kul la sha'in 'il maan 'al aa aal laahi tawakkal naa rabbanaa aaftah baynanaa wabayna qawminaa bial haqqi waanta khayru aul faatiheen
Waqaal a aal mal au aul zeena kafaru min qawmihi la'ini aittaba'tum shu'aybaan 'innakum 'iza llakhaasiroon
Faakhazathumu aur-rajfatu faasbahu fi daarihim jaathimeen
Aal zeena kazzabu shu'ayba kaal llam yaghnawa feehaa aal zeena kazzabu shu'ayba kaanu humu aul khaasireen
Fatawal laa 'anhum waqaal a yaaqawmi laqad 'ablaghtukum risaal aati rabbi wanasahtu lakum fakayfa 'aasaa 'al aa qawm kaafireen
Wamaa 'arsal naa fi qaryat mmin nnabiaa'in 'il laa 'akhaznaa 'ahlahaa bial basaa'i waad-darraa'i la'al laahum yaddarra'oon
Thumma baddal naa makaana aas-sayyeeati ail hasanata hattaa 'afa wwaqaal u qad massa 'aabaa'anaa aad-darraa'u waas-sarraa'u faakhaznaahum baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Wal aw 'anna 'ahla aal quraa 'aamanu waattaqawa lafatahnaa 'al ayhim barakaat mmina aas-samaa'i waal ardi wal aakin kazzabu faakhaznaahum bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
'afaamina 'ahlu aul quraa 'any yyateeahum basunaa bayaata wahum naa'imoon
'awamina 'ahlu aul quraa 'any yyateeahum basunaa duha wahum yal'aboon
'afaaminu makra aal laahi fal aa yamanu makra aal laahi 'il laa aal qawmu aul khaasiroon
'awal am yahdi lil zeena yarithoona aal arda mim ba'di 'ahlihaa 'al llaw nashaa'u aasabnaahum bizunoobihim wanatba'u 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa yasma'oon

Til ka aal quraa naqussu 'al ayka min 'anbaa'ihaa wal aqad jaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati famaa kaanu leeu'minu bimaa kazzabu min qablu kazaal ika yatba'u aul laahu 'al aa qul oobi ail kaafireen
Wamaa wajadnaa liaktharihim mmin 'ahd wainw wwajadnaa 'aktharahum lafaasiqeen
Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihim mmoosaa biayaatinaa 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi fazal amu bihaa faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mufsideen
Waqaal a moosaa yaafir'awnu 'inni rasool mmir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
Haqeequn 'al ayya 'al llaa 'aqoola 'al aa aal laahi 'il laa aal haqqa qad jeetukum bibayyinat mmir rrabbikum faarsil ma'i bani 'israa'eel
Qaal a 'in kunta jeeta biayat fati bihaa 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Faal qaa 'asaahu faizaa heea thu'baam mmubeen
Wanaza'a yadahu faizaa heea baydaa'u lin-naazireen
Qaal a aal mal au min qawmi fir'awna 'inna haazaa lasaahirun 'al eem
Yureedu 'any yyukhrijakum mmin 'ardikum famaazaa tamuroon
Qaal u 'arjihi waakhaahu waarsil fi ail madaa'ini haashireen
Yatooka bikul li saahirin 'al eem
Wajaa'a aas-saharatu fir'awna qaal u 'inna lanaa laajraan 'in kunnaa nahnu aul ghaal ibeen
Qaal a na'am wainnakum lamina aal muqarrabeen
Qaal u yaamoosaa 'immaa 'an tul qeea waimmaa 'an nnakoona nahnu aul mul qeen
Qaal a 'al qu fal ammaa 'al qawa saharu 'a'yuna aan-naasi waastarhaboohum wajaa'oo bisihrin 'azeem
Waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa 'an 'al qi 'asaaka faizaa heea tal aqqafu maa yafikoon
Fawaqa'a aal haqqu wabatal a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Faghul ibu hunaal ika waanqal abu saaghireen
Waul qeea aas-saharatu saajideen
Qaal u 'aamannaa birabbi ail'aal ameen
Rabbi moosaa wahaaroon
Qaal a fir'awnu 'aamantum bihi qabla 'an 'aazana lakum 'inna haazaa lamakr mmakartumoohu fi ail madeenati litukhriju minhaa 'ahlahaa fasawfa ta'lamoon
Lauqatti'anna 'aydeeakum waarjul akum mmin khil aaf thumma lausal libannakum 'ajma'een
Qaal u 'innaa 'il aa rabbinaa munqal iboon
Wamaa tanqimu minnaa 'il laa 'an 'aamannaa biayaati rabbinaa lammaa jaa'atnaa rabbanaa 'afrigh 'al aynaa sabra watawaffanaa muslimeen
Waqaal a aal mal au min qawmi fir'awna 'atazaru moosaa waqawmahu leeufsidu fi ail ardi wayazaraka wa'aal ihataka qaal a sanaqtul u 'abnaa'ahum wanastahyi nisaa'ahum wainnaa fawqahum qaahiroon
Qaal a moosaa liqawmihi aista'eenu bial laahi waasbiru 'inna aal arda lil hi yoorithuhaa many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi waal'aaqibatu lil muttaqeen
Qaal u 'oozeenaa min qabli 'an tateeanaa wamim ba'di maa jeetanaa qaal a 'asaa rabbukum 'any yyuhlika 'adoowakum wayastakhlifakum fi ail ardi fayanzura kayfa ta'mal oon
Wal aqad 'akhaznaa 'aal a fir'awna bias-sineena wanaqs mmina aath-thamaraati la'al laahum yazzakkaroon
Faizaa jaa'athumu aul hasanatu qaal u lanaa haazihi wain tusibhum sayyeeat yattayyaru bimoosaa wamam mma'ahu 'al aa 'innamaa taa'iruhum 'inda aal laahi wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Waqaal u mahmaa tatinaa bihi min 'ayat llitasharanaa bihaa famaa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
Faarsal naa 'al ayhimu aut-toofaana waal jaraada waal qummal a waad-dafaadi'a waad-dama 'ayaat mmufassal aat faastakbaru wakaanu qawma mmujrimeen
Wal ammaa waqa'a 'al ayhimu aur-rijzu qaal u yaamoosaa aad'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka la'in kashafta 'annaa aar-rijza lanu'minanna laka wal anursil anna ma'aka bani 'israa'eel
Fal ammaa kashafnaa 'anhumu aur-rijza 'il aa 'ajal in hum baal ighoohu 'izaa hum yankuthoon
Faantaqamnaa minhum faaghraqnaahum fi ail yammi biannahum kazzabu biayaatinaa wakaanu 'anhaa ghaafil een
Waawrathnaa aal qawma aal zeena kaanu yustad'afoona mashaariqa aal ardi wamaghaaribahaa aal ti baaraknaa feehaa watammat kal imatu rabbika aal husnaa 'al aa bani 'israa'eel
Bimaa sabaru wadammarnaa maa kaana yasna'u fir'awnu waqawmuhu wamaa kaanu ya'rishoon
Wajaawaznaa bibani 'israa'eela aal bahra faatawa 'al aa qawm ya'kufoona 'al aa 'asnaam llaahum qaal u yaamoosaa aaj'al-lanaa 'il aaha kamaa lahum 'aal ihat qaal a 'innakum qawm tajhal oon
'inna haa'ul aa'i mutabbar mmaa hum feehi wabaatil mmaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Qaal a 'aghayra aal laahi 'abgheekum 'il aaha wahwa faddal akum 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Waiz 'anjaynaakum mmin 'aal i fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooaa'a aal'azaabi yaqtul oona 'abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum wafi zaal ikum bal aa' mmir rrabbikum 'azeem

Wawaa'adnaa moosaa thal aatheena laylat waatmamnaahaa bi'ashr fatamma meeqaatu rabbihi 'arba'eena laylat waqaal a moosaa liakheehi haaroona aakhlufni fi qawmi waaslih wal aa tattabi' sabeela aal mufsideen

Wal ammaa jaa'a moosaa limeeqaatinaa wakal lamahu rabbuhu qaal a rabbi 'arini 'anzur 'il ayka qaal a lan tarayaani wal aakinu aunzur 'il aa aal jabal i faini aistaqarra makaanahu fasawfa tarayaani fal ammaa tajal laa rabbuhu lil jabal i ja'al ahu dakka wakharra moosaa sa'iqa fal ammaa 'afaaqa qaal a subhaanaka tubtu 'il ayka waanaa 'awwal u aul mu'mineen
Qaal a yaamoosaa 'inni aistafaytuka 'al aa aan-naasi birisaal ati wabikal aami fakhuz maa 'aataytuka wakum mmina aash-shaakireen
Wakatabnaa lahu fi ail al waahi min kul li sha' mmaw'izat watafseela llikul li sha' fakhuzhaa biqoowat wamur qawmaka yakhuzu biahsanihaa saooreekum daara aal faasiqeen

Saasrifu 'an 'ayaateea aal zeena yatakabbaroona fi ail ardi bighayri ail haqqi wainy yyarawa kul la 'ayat llaa yu'minu bihaa wainy yyarawa sabeela aar-rushdi laa yattakhizoohu sabeela wainy yyarawa sabeela aal ghayyi yattakhizoohu sabeela zaal ika biannahum kazzabu biayaatinaa wakaanu 'anhaa ghaafil een
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa wal iqaa'i ail aakhirati habitat 'a'maal uhum hal yujzawna 'il laa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waattakhaza qawmu moosaa mim ba'dihi min hul eeyihim 'ijla jasada llaahu khooaarun 'al am yarawa 'annahu laa yukal limuhum wal aa yahdeehim sabeelaan aittakhazoohu wakaanu zaal imeen
Wal ammaa suqita fi 'aydeehim waraawa 'annahum qad dal lu qaal u la'il llam yarhamnaa rabbunaa wayaghfir lanaa lanakoonanna mina aal khaasireen

Wal ammaa raja'a moosaa 'il aa qawmihi ghadbaana 'asifa qaal a beesamaa khal aftumooni mim ba'deea 'a'ajil tum 'amra rabbikum waal qaa aal al waaha waakhaza birasi 'akheehi yajurruhu 'il ayhi qaal a aabna 'umma 'inna aal qawma aastad'afooni wakaadu yaqtul oonani fal aa tushmit beea aal a'daa'a wal aa taj'al ni ma'a aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Qaal a rabbi aighfir li wal iakhi waadkhil naa fi rahmatika waanta 'arhamu aur-raahimeen
'inna aal zeena aattakhazu aul'ijla sayanaal uhum ghadab mmir rrabbihim wazil lat fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wakazaal ika najzi ail muftareen
Waal zeena 'amil u aus-sayyiaati thumma taabu mim ba'dihaa wa'aamanu 'inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoor rraheem
Wal ammaa sakata 'am mmoosaa aal ghadabu 'akhaza aal al waaha wafi nuskhatihaa huda warahmat llil zeena hum lirabbihim yarhaboon

Waakhtaara moosaa qawmahu sab'eena rajul a llimeeqaatinaa fal ammaa 'akhazathumu aur-rajfatu qaal a rabbi law sheeta 'ahlaktahum mmin qablu waiyyaya 'atuhlikunaa bimaa fa'al a aas-sufahaa'u minnaa 'in heea 'il laa fitnatuka tudil lu bihaa man tashaa'u watahdi man tashaa'u aanta wal eeyunaa faaghfir lanaa waarhamnaa waanta khayru aul ghaafireen

Waaktub lanaa fi haazihi aid-dunyaa hasanat wafi ail aakhirati 'innaa hudnaa 'il ayka qaal a 'azaabeea 'useebu bihi man 'ashaa'u warahmati wasi'at kul la sha' fasaaktubuhaa lil zeena yattaqoona wayu'toona aaz-zakawaata waal zeena hum biayaatinaa yu'minoon

Aal zeena yattabi'oona aar-rasoola aan-nabiaa'a aal ummiyya aal zi yajidoonahu maktoobaan 'indahum fi ait-tawrayaati waal injeeli yamuruhum bial ma'roofi wayanhayaahum 'ani ail munkari wayuhil lu lahumu aut-tayyibaati wayuharrimu 'al ayhimu aul khabaa'itha wayada'u 'anhum 'israhum waal aghlaal a aal ti kaanat 'al ayhim faal zeena 'aamanu bihi wa'azzaroohu wanasaroohu waattaba'u aun-noora aal zi 'unzil a ma'ahu 'ul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon

Qul yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'inni rasoolu aul laahi 'il aykum jamee'aan ail zi lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa yuhyi wayumeetu faaminu bial laahi warasoolihi ain-nabiaa'i ail ummeeyi ail zi yu'minu bial laahi wakal imaatihi waattabi'oohu la'al lakum tahtadoon
Wamin qawmi moosaa 'ummat yahdoona bial haqqi wabihi ya'dil oon

Waqatta'naahumu authnata 'ashrata 'asbaataan 'umama waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa 'izi aistasqayaahu qawmuhu 'ani aidrib bbi'asaaka aal hajara faanbajasat minhu authnataa 'ashrata 'ayna qad 'al ima kul lu 'unaas mmashrabahum wazal lal naa 'al ayhimu aul ghamaama waanzal naa 'al ayhimu aul manna waas-sal waa kul u min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum wamaa zal amoonaa wal aakin kaanu 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Waiz qeela lahumu auskunu haazihi ail qaryata wakul u minhaa haythu sheetum waqoolu hittat waadkhul u aul baaba sujjada tughfar lakum khateeaatukum sanazeedu aul muhsineen
Fabaddal a aal zeena zal amu minhum qawlaan ghayra aal zi qeela lahum faarsal naa 'al ayhim rijza mmina aas-samaa'i bimaa kaanu yazlimoon

Wasal hum 'ani ail qaryati ail ti kaanat haadirata aal bahri 'iz ya'doona fi ais-sabti 'iz tateehim heetaanuhum yawma sabtihim shurra'a wayawma laa yasbitoona laa tateehim kazaal ika nabloohum bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon
Waiz qaal at 'ummat mminhum lima ta'izoona qawmaan ail laahu muhlikuhum 'aw mu'azzibuhum 'azaaba shadeeda qaal u ma'ziratun 'il aa rabbikum wal a'al laahum yattaqoon
Fal ammaa nasu maa zukkiru bihi 'anjaynaa aal zeena yanhawna 'ani ais-sooaa'i waakhaznaa aal zeena zal amu bi'azaabi beesi bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon
Fal ammaa 'atawa 'am mmaa nuhu 'anhu qul naa lahum koonu qiradatan khaasieen
Waiz taazzana rabbuka layab'athanna 'al ayhim 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati many yyasoomuhum sooaa'a aal'azaabi 'inna rabbaka lasaree'u aul'iqaabi wainnahu laghafoor rraheem
Waqatta'naahum fi ail ardi 'umama mminhumu aus-saal ihoona waminhum doona zaal ika wabal awnaahum bial hasanaati waas-sayyiaati la'al laahum yarji'oon

Fakhal afa mim ba'dihim khal f warithu aul kitaaba yakhuzoona 'arada haazaa aal adnaa wayaqooloona sayughfaru lanaa wainy yyatihim 'arad mmithluhu yakhuzoohu 'al am yu'khaz 'al ayhim mmeethaaqu aul kitaabi 'al llaa yaqoolu 'al aa aal laahi 'il laa aal haqqa wadarasu maa feehi waad-daaru aul aakhiratu khayr llil zeena yattaqoona 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Waal zeena yumassikoona bial kitaabi waaqaamu aus-sal awaata 'innaa laa nudee'u 'ajra aal musliheen
Waiz nataqnaa aal jabal a fawqahum kaannahu zul lat wazannu 'annahu waaqi'u bihim khuzu maa 'aataynaakum biqoowat waazkuru maa feehi la'al lakum tattaqoon

Waiz 'akhaza rabbuka mim bani 'aadama min zuhoorihim zurriyyaatihim waashhadahum 'al aa 'anfusihim 'al astu birabbikum qaal u bal aa shahidnaa 'an taqoolu yawma aal qeeaamati 'innaa kunnaa 'an haazaa ghaafil een
'aw taqoolu 'innamaa 'ashraka 'aabaa'unaa min qablu wakunnaa zurriyyat mmim ba'dihim 'afatuhlikunaa bimaa fa'al a aal mubtil oon
Wakazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati wal a'al laahum yarji'oon
Waatlu 'al ayhim nabaa aal zi 'aataynaahu 'ayaatinaa faansal akha minhaa faatba'ahu aush-shaytaanu fakaana mina aal ghaaween

Wal aw sheenaa larafa'naahu bihaa wal aakinnahu 'akhlada 'il aa aal ardi waattaba'a hawayaahu famathal uhu kamathal i ail kal bi 'in tahmil 'al ayhi yal hath 'aw tatrukhu yal hath zzaal ika mathal u aul qawmi ail zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa faaqsusi ail qasasa la'al laahum yatafakkaroon
Saa'a mathal aan ail qawmu aul zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa waanfusahum kaanu yazlimoon
Many yyahdi ail laahu fahwa aal muhtadi wamany yyudlil faul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon

Wal aqad zaranaa lijahannama katheera mmina aal jinni waal insi lahum qul oob llaa yafqahoona bihaa wal ahum 'a'yul llaa yubsiroona bihaa wal ahum 'aazaal llaa yasma'oona bihaa 'ul aa'ika kaal an'aami bal hum 'adal lu 'ul aa'ika humu aul ghaafil oon
Wal il hi ail asmaa'u aul husnaa faad'oohu bihaa wazaru aul zeena yul hidoona fi 'asmaa'ihi sayujzawna maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wamimman khal aqnaa 'ummat yahdoona bial haqqi wabihi ya'dil oon
Waal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa sanastadrijuhum mmin haythu laa ya'lamoon
Waumli lahum 'inna kaydi mateen
'awal am yatafakkaru maa bisaahibihim mmin jinnatin 'in hooa 'il laa nazeer mmubeen
'awal am yanzuru fi mal akooti ais-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa khal aqa aal laahu min sha' waan 'asaa 'any yyakoona qadi aiqtaraba 'ajal uhum fabiayyi hadeethi ba'dahu yu'minoon
Many yyudlil i ail laahu fal aa haadeea lahu wanazaruhum fi tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Yasal oonaka 'ani ais-saa'ati 'ayyaana mursayaahaa qul 'innamaa 'il muhaa 'inda rabbi laa yujal leehaa liwaqtihaa 'il laa hooa thaqul at fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi laa tateekum 'il laa baghtat yasal oonaka kaannaka hafeeyun 'anhaa qul 'innamaa 'il muhaa 'inda aal laahi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon

Qul-laa 'amliku linafsi naf'a wal aa darraan 'il laa maa shaa'a aal laahu wal aw kuntu 'a'lamu aul ghayba laastakthartu mina aal khayri wamaa massaneea aas-sooaa'u ain 'anaa 'il laa nazeer wabasheer lliqawm yu'minoon

Hooa aal zi khal aqakum mmin nnafs waahidat waja'al a minhaa zawjahaa leeaskuna 'il ayhaa fal ammaa taghashshayaahaa hamal at hamlaan khafeefa famarrat bihi fal ammaa 'athqal at dda'awaa aal laaha rabbahumaa la'in 'aataytanaa saal iha llanakoonanna mina aash-shaakireen
Fal ammaa 'aatayaahumaa saal iha ja'al aa lahu shirka feemaa 'aatayaahumaa fata'aal aa aal laahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
'ayushrikoona maa laa yakhluqu shaya wahum yukhlaqoon
Wal aa yastatee'oona lahum nasra wal aa 'anfusahum yansuroon
Wain tad'oohum 'il aa aal hudaa laa yatba'ookum sawaa'un 'al aykum 'ada'awtumoohum 'am 'antum saamitoon
'inna aal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi 'ibaadun 'amthaal ukum faad'oohum fal yastajeebu lakum 'in kuntum saadiqeen
'al ahum 'arjul yamshoona bihaa 'am lahum 'ayd yabtishoona bihaa 'am lahum 'a'yuny yubsiroona bihaa 'am lahum 'aazaany yasma'oona bihaa qul u aud'u shurakaa'akum thumma keedooni fal aa tunziroon
'inna wal iieea aal laahu aul zi nazzal a aal kitaaba wahwa yatawal laa aas-saal iheen
Waal zeena tad'oona min doonihi laa yastatee'oona nasrakum wal aa 'anfusahum yansuroon
Wain tad'oohum 'il aa aal hudaa laa yasma'u watarayaahum yanzuroona 'il ayka wahum laa yubsiroon
Khuzi ail'afwa wamur bial'urfi waa'rid 'ani ail jaahil een
Waimmaa yanzaghannaka mina aash-shaytaani nazgh faasta'iz bial laahi 'innahu samee'un 'al eem
'inna aal zeena aattaqawa 'izaa massahum taa'if mmina aash-shaytaani tazakkaru faizaa hum mmubsiroon
Waikhwaanuhum yumiddoonahum fi ail ghayyi thumma laa yuqsiroon
Waizaa lam tatihim biayat qaal u lawlaa aajtabaytahaa qul 'innamaa 'attabi'u maa yoohaa 'il ayya mir rrabbi haazaa basaa'iru mir rrabbikum wahuda warahmat lliqawm yu'minoon
Waizaa quria aal qur'aanu faastami'u lahu waansitu la'al lakum turhamoon
Waazkur rrabbaka fi nafsika tadarru'a wakheefat wadoona aal jahri mina aal qawli bial ghudoowi waal aasaal i wal aa takum mmina aal ghaafil een
'inna aal zeena 'inda rabbika laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihi wayusabbihoonahu wal ahu yasjudoon
Yasal oonaka 'ani ail anfaal i qul i ail anfaal u lil hi waar-rasooli faattaqu aul laaha waaslihu zaata baynikum waatee'u aul laaha warasoolahu 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
'innamaa aal mu'minoona aal zeena 'izaa zukira aal laahu wajil at qul oobuhum waizaa tul eeat 'al ayhim 'ayaatuhu zaadathum 'eemaana wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Aal zeena yuqeemoona aas-sal awaata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
'ul aa'ika humu aul mu'minoona haqqa llaahum darajaatun 'inda rabbihim wamaghfirat warizq kareem
Kamaa 'akhrajaka rabbuka mim baytika bial haqqi wainna fareeqa mmina aal mu'mineena lakaarihoon
Yujaadil oonaka fi ail haqqi ba'da maa tabayyana kaannamaa yusaaqoona 'il aa aal mawti wahum yanzuroon

Waiz ya'idukumu aul laahu 'ihdaa aat-taa'ifatayni 'annahaa lakum watawaddoona 'anna ghayra zaati aish-shawkati takoonu lakum wayureedu aul laahu 'any yyuhiqqa aal haqqa bikal imaatihi wayaqta'a daabira aal kaafireen
Leeuhiqqa aal haqqa wayubtil a aal baatil a wal aw kariha aal mujrimoon
'iz tastagheethoona rabbakum faastajaaba lakum 'anni mumiddukum bial f mmina aal mal aa'ikati murdafeen
Wamaa ja'al ahu aul laahu 'il laa bushraa wal itatma'inna bihi qul oobukum wamaa aan-nasru 'il laa min 'indi ail laahi 'inna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem

'iz yughsheekumu aun-nu'aasa 'amanat mminhu wayunazzil u 'al aykum mmina aas-samaa'i maa' lleeutahhirakum bihi wayuzhiba 'ankum rijza aash-shaytaani wal eearbita 'al aa qul oobikum wayuthabbita bihi ail aqdaam
'iz yoohi rabbuka 'il aa aal mal aa'ikati 'anni ma'akum fathabbitu aul zeena 'aamanu saul qi fi qul oobi ail zeena kafaru aur-ru'ba faadribu fawqa aal a'naaqi waadribu minhum kul la bana
Zaal ika biannahum shaaqqu aul laaha warasoolahu wamany yyushaaqiqi ail laaha warasoolahu fainna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab
Zaal ikum fazooqoohu waanna lil kaafireena 'azaaba aan-naar
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa laqeetumu aul zeena kafaru zahfa fal aa tooal loohumu aul adbaar
Wamany yyooal lihim yawma'iz duburahu 'il laa mutaharrifa lliqitaal in 'aw mutahayyizaan 'il aa feeat faqad baa'a bighadab mmina aal laahi wamawayaahu jahannamu wabeesa aal maseer
Fal am taqtul oohum wal aakinna aal laaha qatal ahum wamaa ramayta 'iz ramayta wal aakinna aal laaha ramaa wal eeubleea aal mu'mineena minhu bal aa'an hasanaan 'inna aal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Zaal ikum waanna aal laaha mooahhin kayda aal kaafireen
'in tastaftihu faqad jaa'akumu aul fathu wain tantahu fahwa khayr llakum wain ta'oodu na'ud wal an tughneea 'ankum feeatukum shaya wal aw kathurat waanna aal laaha ma'a aal mu'mineen
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'atee'u aul laaha warasoolahu wal aa tawal lawa 'anhu waantum tasma'oon
Wal aa takoonu kaal zeena qaal u sami'naa wahum laa yasma'oon
'inna sharra aad-dawaabbi 'inda aal laahi ais-summu aul bukmu aul zeena laa ya'qil oon
Wal aw 'al ima aal laahu feehim khayra llaasma'ahum wal aw 'asma'ahum latawal la wwahum mmu'ridoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu austajeebu lil hi wal ir-rasooli 'izaa da'aakum limaa yuhyeekum waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha yahoolu bayna aal mar'i waqal bihi waannahu 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
Waattaqu fitnat llaa tuseebanna aal zeena zal amu minkum khaassat waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab
Waazkuru 'iz 'antum qal eel mmustad'afoona fi ail ardi takhaafoona 'any yyatakhattafakumu aun-naasu faawayaakum wayyadakum binasrihi warazaqakum mmina aat-tayyibaati la'al lakum tashkuroon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa takhoonu aul laaha waar-rasoola watakhoonu 'amaanaatikum waantum ta'lamoon
Waa'lamu 'annamaa 'amwaal ukum waawlaadukum fitnat waanna aal laaha 'indahu 'ajrun 'azeem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'in tattaqu aul laaha yaj'al-lakum furqaana wayukaffir 'ankum sayyiaatikum wayaghfir lakum waal laahu zoo aul fadli ail'azeem
Waiz yamkuru bika aal zeena kafaru leeuthbitooka 'aw yaqtul ooka 'aw yukhrijooka wayamkuroona wayamkuru aul laahu waal laahu khayru aul maakireen
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa qaal u qad sami'naa law nashaa'u laqul naa mithla haazaa 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateeru aul awwal een
Waiz qaal u aul laahumma 'in kaana haazaa hooa aal haqqa min 'indika faamtir 'al aynaa hijaarat mmina aas-samaa'i aawi aeetinaa bi'azaabin 'al eem
Wamaa kaana aal laahu leeu'azzibahum waanta feehim wamaa kaana aal laahu mu'azzibahum wahum yastaghfiroon
Wamaa lahum 'al laa yu'azzibahumu aul laahu wahum yasuddoona 'ani ail masjidi ail haraami wamaa kaanu 'awleeaa'ahu 'in 'awleeaa'uhu 'il laa aal muttaqoona wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa kaana sal aatuhum 'inda aal bayti 'il laa mukaa' watasdeeat fazooqu aul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
'inna aal zeena kafaru yunfiqoona 'amwaal ahum leeasuddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi fasayunfiqoonahaa thumma takoonu 'al ayhim hasrat thumma yughlaboona waal zeena kafaru 'il aa jahannama yuhsharoon
Leeameeza aal laahu aul khabeetha mina aat-tayyibi wayaj'al a aal khabeetha ba'dahu 'al aa ba'd fayarkumahu jamee'a fayaj'al ahu fi jahannama 'ul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
Qul-lil zeena kafaru 'iny yyantahu yughfar lahum mmaa qad sal afa wainy yya'oodu faqad madat sunnatu aul awwal een
Waqaatil oohum hattaa laa takoona fitnat wayakoona aad-deenu kul luhu lil hi faini aintahawa fainna aal laaha bimaa ya'mal oona baseer
Wain tawal lawa faa'lamu 'anna aal laaha mawlayaakum ni'ma aal mawlaa wani'ma aan-naseer

Waa'lamu 'annamaa ghanimtum mmin sha' faanna lil hi khumusahu wal ir-rasooli wal izi ail qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeeni waabni ais-sabeeli 'in kuntum 'aamantum bial laahi wamaa 'anzal naa 'al aa 'abdinaa yawma aal furqaani yawma aal taqaa aal jam'aani waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
'iz 'antum bial'udwati aid-dunyaa wahum bial'udwati ail quswaa waar-rakbu 'asfal a minkum wal aw tawaa'adttum laakhtal aftum fi ail mee'aadi wal aakil lleeaqdeea aal laahu 'amra kaana maf'ool
Lleeahlika man hal aka 'am bayyinat wayahyaa man haeea 'am bayyinat wainna aal laaha lasamee'un 'al eem
'iz yureekahumu aul laahu fi manaamika qal eela wal aw 'arayaakahum katheera llafashil tum wal atanaaza'tum fi ail amri wal aakinna aal laaha sal lama 'innahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
Waiz yureekumoohum 'izi ail taqaytum fi 'a'yunikum qal eela wayuqal lil ukum fi 'a'yunihim leeaqdeea aal laahu 'amra kaana maf'oola wail aa aal laahi turja'u aul umoor
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa laqeetum feeat faathbutu waazkuru aul laaha katheera lla'al lakum tuflihoon
Waatee'u aul laaha warasoolahu wal aa tanaaza'u fatafshal u watazhaba reehukum waasbiru 'inna aal laaha ma'a aas-saabireen
Wal aa takoonu kaal zeena kharaju min deeaarihim batara wareeaa'a aan-naasi wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi waal laahu bimaa ya'mal oona muheeh

Waiz zayyana lahumu aush-shaytaanu 'a'maal ahum waqaal a laa ghaal iba lakumu aul yawma mina aan-naasi wainni jaar llakum fal ammaa taraa'ati ail feeataani nakasa 'al aa 'aqibayhi waqaal a 'inni bariaa' mminkum 'inneea 'araa maa laa tarawna 'inneea 'akhaafu aul laaha waal laahu shadeedu aul'iqaab
'iz yaqoolu aul munaafiqoona waal zeena fi qul oobihim mmaradun gharra haa'ul aa'i deenuhum wamany yyatawakkal 'al aa aal laahi fainna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem
Wal aw taraa 'iz yatawaffaa aal zeena kafaru aul mal aa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbaarahum wazooqu 'azaaba aal hareeq
Zaal ika bimaa qaddamat 'aydeekum waanna aal laaha laysa bizal laam llil'abeed
Kadabi 'aal i fir'awna waal zeena min qablihim kafaru biayaati ail laahi faakhazahumu aul laahu bizunoobihim 'inna aal laaha qaweey shadeedu aul'iqaab
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha lam yaku mughayyira nni'matan 'an'amahaa 'al aa qawmin hattaa yughayyiru maa bianfusihim waanna aal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Kadabi 'aal i fir'awna waal zeena min qablihim kazzabu biayaati rabbihim faahlaknaahum bizunoobihim waaghraqnaa 'aal a fir'awna wakul l kaanu zaal imeen
'inna sharra aad-dawaabbi 'inda aal laahi ail zeena kafaru fahum laa yu'minoon
Aal zeena 'aahadtta minhum thumma yanqudoona 'ahdahum fi kul li marrat wahum laa yattaqoon
Faimmaa tathqafannahum fi ail harbi fasharrid bihim mman khal fahum la'al laahum yazzakkaroon
Waimmaa takhaafanna min qawmin kheeaanat faanbiz 'il ayhim 'al aa sawaa'in 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul khaa'ineen
Wal aa tahsibanna aal zeena kafaru sabaqu 'innahum laa yu'jizoon

Waa'iddu lahum mmaa aastata'tum mmin qoowat wamir rribaati ail khayli turhiboona bihi 'adoowa aal laahi wa'adoowakum wa'aakhareena min doonihim laa ta'lamoonahumu aul laahu ya'lamuhum wamaa tunfiqu min sha' fi sabeeli ail laahi yooaffa 'il aykum waantum laa tuzlamoon
Wain janahu lis-sal mi faajnah lahaa watawakkal 'al aa aal laahi 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Wainy yyureedu 'any yyakhda'ooka fainna hasbaka aal laahu hooa aal zi 'ayyadaka binasrihi wabial mu'mineen
Waal lafa bayna qul oobihim law 'anfaqta maa fi ail ardi jamee'a mmaa 'al lafta bayna qul oobihim wal aakinna aal laaha 'al lafa baynahum 'innahu 'azeezun hakeem
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u hasbuka aal laahu wamani aittaba'aka mina aal mu'mineen

Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u harridi ail mu'mineena 'al aa aal qitaal i 'iny yyakum mminkum 'ishroona saabiroona yaghlibu miayatayni wain takum mminkum mmiayat yaghlibu 'al fa mmina aal zeena kafaru biannahum qawm llaa yafqahoon

Aa'al aana khaffafa aal laahu 'ankum wa'al ima 'anna feekum du'fa fain takum mminkum mmiayat saabirat yaghlibu miayatayni wainy yyakum mminkum 'al f yaghlibu 'al fayni biizni ail laahi waal laahu ma'a aas-saabireen
Maa kaana linabiaa'in 'any yyakoona lahu 'asraa hattaa yuthkhina fi ail ardi tureedoona 'arada aad-dunyaa waal laahu yureedu aul aakhirata waal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Llawlaa kitaab mmina aal laahi sabaqa lamassakum feemaa 'akhazttum 'azaabun 'azeem
Fakul u mimmaa ghanimtum hal aal a tayyiba waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u qul-liman fi 'aydeekum mmina aal asraa 'iny yya'lami ail laahu fi qul oobikum khayra yu'tikum khayra mmimmaa 'ukhiza minkum wayaghfir lakum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Wainy yyureedu kheeaanataka faqad khaanu aul laaha min qablu faamkana minhum waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wahaajaru wajaahadu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim fi sabeeli ail laahi waal zeena 'aawa wwanasaru 'ul aa'ika ba'duhum 'awleeaa'u ba'd waal zeena 'aamanu wal am yuhaajiru maa lakum mminw wwal ayatihim mmin sha'in hattaa yuhaajiru waini aistansarookum fi aid-deeni fa'al aykumu aun-nasru 'il laa 'al aa qawmi baynakum wabaynahum mmeethaaq waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Waal zeena kafaru ba'duhum 'awleeaa'u ba'din 'il laa taf'al oohu takun fitnat fi ail ardi wafasaad kabeer
Waal zeena 'aamanu wahaajaru wajaahadu fi sabeeli ail laahi waal zeena 'aawa wwanasaru 'ul aa'ika humu aul mu'minoona haqqa llaahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Waal zeena 'aamanu mim ba'du wahaajaru wajaahadu ma'akum faul aa'ika minkum waoolu aul arhaami ba'duhum 'awlaa biba'd fi kitaabi ail laahi 'inna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Baraa'at mmina aal laahi warasoolihi 'il aa aal zeena 'aahadttum mmina aal mushrikeen
Faseehu fi ail ardi 'arba'ata 'ashhur waa'lamu 'annakum ghayru mu'jizi ail laahi waanna aal laaha mukhzi ail kaafireen

Waazaam mmina aal laahi warasoolihi 'il aa aan-naasi yawma aal hajji ail akbari 'anna aal laaha bariaa' mmina aal mushrikeena warasooluhu fain tubtum fahwa khayr llakum wain tawal laytum faa'lamu 'annakum ghayru mu'jizi ail laahi wabashshiri ail zeena kafaru bi'azaabin 'al eem
'il laa aal zeena 'aahadttum mmina aal mushrikeena thumma lam yanqusookum shaya wal am yuzaahiru 'al aykum 'ahada faatimmu 'il ayhim 'ahdahum 'il aa muddatihim 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muttaqeen

Faizaa aansal akha aal ashhuru aul hurumu faaqtul u aul mushrikeena haythu wajadttumoohum wakhuzoohum waahsuroohum waaq'udu lahum kul la marsad fain taabu waaqaamu aus-sal awaata wa'aatawua auz-zakawaata fakhal lu sabeelahum 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Wain 'ahad mmina aal mushrikeena aastajaaraka faajirhu hattaa yasma'a kal aama aal laahi thumma 'ablighhu mamanahu zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa ya'lamoon

Kayfa yakoonu lil mushrikeena 'ahdun 'inda aal laahi wa'inda rasoolihi 'il laa aal zeena 'aahadttum 'inda aal masjidi ail haraami famaa aastaqaamu lakum faastaqeemu lahum 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muttaqeen
Kayfa wainy yyazharu 'al aykum laa yarqubu feekum 'il la wal aa zimmat yurdoonakum biafwaahihim watabaa qul oobuhum waaktharuhum faasiqoon
Aashtarawa biayaati ail laahi thamana qal eela fasaddu 'an sabeelihi 'innahum saa'a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Laa yarquboona fi mu'minin 'il la wal aa zimmat waul aa'ika humu aul mu'tadoon
Fain taabu waaqaamu aus-sal awaata wa'aatawua auz-zakawaata faikhwaanukum fi aid-deeni wanufassil u aul ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon
Wain nnakathu 'aymaanahum mmim ba'di 'ahdihim wata'anu fi deenikum faqaatil u 'aymmata aal kufri 'innahum laa 'aymaana lahum la'al laahum yantahoon
'al aa tuqaatil oona qawma nnakathu 'aymaanahum wahammu biikhraaji air-rasooli wahum bada'ookum 'awwal a marratin 'atakhshawnahum faal laahu 'ahaqqu 'an takhshawhu 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Qaatil oohum yu'azzibhumu aul laahu biaydeekum wayukhzihim wayansurkum 'al ayhim wayashfi sudoora qawm mmu'mineen
Wayuzhib ghayza qul oobihim wayatoobu aul laahu 'al aa many yyashaa'u waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

'am hasibtum 'an tutraku wal ammaa ya'lami ail laahu aul zeena jaahadu minkum wal am yattakhizu min dooni ail laahi wal aa rasoolihi wal aa aal mu'mineena wal eejat waal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Maa kaana lil mushrikeena 'any yya'muru masaajida aal laahi shaahideena 'al aa 'anfusihim bial kufri 'ul aa'ika habitat 'a'maal uhum wafi ain-naari hum khaal idoon

'innamaa ya'muru masaajida aal laahi man 'aamana bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri waaqaama aas-sal awaata wa'aataa aaz-zakawaata wal am yakhsha 'il laa aal laaha fa'asaa 'ul aa'ika 'any yyakoonu mina aal muhtadeen

'aja'al tum siqayata aal haajji wa'imaarata aal masjidi ail haraami kaman 'aamana bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wajaahada fi sabeeli ail laahi laa yastawuna 'inda aal laahi waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Aal zeena 'aamanu wahaajaru wajaahadu fi sabeeli ail laahi biamwaal ihim waanfusihim 'a'zamu darajatan 'inda aal laahi waul aa'ika humu aul faa'izoon
Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmat mminhu waridwaanw wajannaat llaahum feehaa na'eem mmuqeem
Khaal ideena feehaa 'abadaan 'inna aal laaha 'indahu 'ajrun 'azeem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu 'aabaa'akum waikhwaanakum 'awleeaa'a ani aistahabbu aul kufra 'al aa aal eemaani wamany yyatawal laahum mminkum faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon

Qul 'in kaana 'aabaa'ukum waabnaa'ukum waikhwaanukum waazwaajukum wa'asheeratukum waamwaal un aiqtaraftumoohaa watijaarat takhshawna kasaadahaa wamasaakinu tardawnahaa 'ahabba 'il aykum mmina aal laahi warasoolihi wajihaad fi sabeelihi fatarabbasu hattaa yateea aal laahu biamrihi waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal faasiqeen
Laqad nasarakumu aul laahu fi mawaatina katheerat wayawma hunaynin 'iz 'a'jabatkum kathratukum fal am tughni 'ankum shaya wadaaqat 'al aykumu aul ardu bimaa rahubat thumma wal laytum mmudbireen
Thumma 'anzal a aal laahu sakeenatahu 'al aa rasoolihi wa'al aa aal mu'mineena waanzal a junooda llam tarawhaa wa'azzaba aal zeena kafaru wazaal ika jazaa'u aul kaafireen
Thumma yatoobu aul laahu mim ba'di zaal ika 'al aa many yyashaa'u waal laahu ghafoor rraheem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'innamaa aal mushrikoona najas fal aa yaqrabu aul masjida aal haraama ba'da 'aamihim haazaa wain khiftum 'aylat fasawfa yughneekumu aul laahu min fadlihi 'in shaa'a anna aal laaha 'al eemun hakeem

Qaatil u aul zeena laa yu'minoona bial laahi wal aa bial yawmi ail aakhiri wal aa yuharrimoona maa harrama aal laahu warasooluhu wal aa yadeenoona deena aal haqqi mina aal zeena 'ootu aul kitaaba hattaa yu'tu aul jizyata 'any yyad wahum saaghiroon

Waqaal ati ail yahoodu 'uzayru aubnu aul laahi waqaal ati ain-nasaaraa aal maseehu aubnu aul laahi zaal ika qawluhum biafwaahihim yudaahoona qawla aal zeena kafaru min qablu qaatal ahumu aul laahu 'annaa yu'fakoon
Aattakhazu 'ahbaarahum waruhbaanahum 'arbaaba mmin dooni ail laahi waal maseeha aabna maryama wamaa 'umiru 'il laa leea'budu 'il aaha waahida llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa subhaanahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
Yureedoona 'any yyutfiu noora aal laahi biafwaahihim wayabaa aal laahu 'il laa 'any yyutimma noorahu wal aw kariha aal kaafiroon
Hooa aal zi 'arsal a rasoolahu bial hudaa wadeeni ail haqqi leeuzhirahu 'al aa aad-deeni kul lihi wal aw kariha aal mushrikoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'inna katheera mmina aal ahbaari waar-ruhbaani layakul oona 'amwaal a aan-naasi bial baatil i wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi waal zeena yaknizoona aaz-zahaba waal fiddata wal aa yunfiqoonahaa fi sabeeli ail laahi fabashshirhum bi'azaabin 'al eem
Yawma yuhmaa 'al ayhaa fi naari jahannama fatukwaa bihaa jibaahuhum wajunoobuhum wazuhooruhum haazaa maa kanaztum lianfusikum fazooqu maa kuntum taknizoon

'inna 'iddata aash-shuhoori 'inda aal laahi aithnaa 'ashara shahra fi kitaabi ail laahi yawma khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda minhaa 'arba'atun hurum zaal ika aad-deenu aul qayyimu fal aa tazlimu feehinna 'anfusakum waqaatil u aul mushrikeena kaaffat kamaa yuqaatil oonakum kaaffat waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha ma'a aal muttaqeen

'innamaa aan-nasiaa'u zeeaadat fi ail kufri yadil lu bihi ail zeena kafaru yuhil loonahu 'aama wayuharrimoonahu 'aama lleeooaatiu 'iddata maa harrama aal laahu fayuhil lu maa harrama aal laahu zuyyina lahum sooaa'u aa'maal ihim waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal kaafireen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu maa lakum 'izaa qeela lakumu aunfiru fi sabeeli ail laahi aiththaaqal tum 'il aa aal ardi 'aradeetum bial hayawaati aid-dunyaa mina aal aakhirati famaa mataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunyaa fi ail aakhirati 'il laa qal eel
'il laa tanfiru yu'azzibkum 'azaabaan 'al eema wayastabdil qawmaan ghayrakum wal aa tadurroohu shaya waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

'il laa tansuroohu faqad nasarahu aul laahu 'iz 'akhrajahu aul zeena kafaru thaaneea aathnayni 'iz humaa fi ail ghaari 'iz yaqoolu lisaahibihi laa tahzan 'inna aal laaha ma'anaa faanzal a aal laahu sakeenatahu 'al ayhi wayyadahu bijunood llam tarawhaa waja'al a kal imata aal zeena kafaru aus-suflaa wakal imatu aul laahi heea aal'ul yaa waal laahu 'azeezun hakeem
Ainfiru khifaafa wathiqaal a wajaahidu biamwaal ikum waanfusikum fi sabeeli ail laahi zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon

Law kaana 'arada qareeba wasafara qaasida llaattaba'ooka wal aakim ba'udat 'al ayhimu aush-shuqqatu wasayahlifoona bial laahi lawi aistata'naa lakharajnaa ma'akum yuhlikoona 'anfusahum waal laahu ya'lamu 'innahum lakaaziboon
'afaa aal laahu 'anka lima 'azinta lahum hattaa yatabayyana laka aal zeena sadaqu wata'lama aal kaazibeen
Laa yastaazinuka aal zeena yu'minoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri 'any yyujaahidu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim waal laahu 'al eemu bial muttaqeen
'innamaa yastaazinuka aal zeena laa yu'minoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri waartaabat qul oobuhum fahum fi raybihim yataraddadoon
Wal aw 'araadu aul khurooja laa'addu lahu 'uddat wal aakin kariha aal laahu aunbi'aathahum fathabbatahum waqeela aaq'udu ma'a aal qaa'ideen
Law kharaju feekum mmaa zaadookum 'il laa khabaal a wal aawda'u khil aal akum yabghoonakumu aul fitnata wafeekum sammaa'oona lahum waal laahu 'al eemu biaz-zaal imeen
Laqadi aibtaghawua aul fitnata min qablu waqal labu laka aal umoora hattaa jaa'a aal haqqu wazahara 'amru aul laahi wahum kaarihoon
Waminhum mmany yyaqoolu auyzal lli wal aa taftinni 'al aa fi ail fitnati saqatu wainna jahannama lamuheetatu bial kaafireen
'in tusibka hasanat tasu'hum wain tusibka museebat yaqoolu qad 'akhaznaa 'amranaa min qablu wayatawal la wwahum farihoon
Qul-lany yyuseebanaa 'il laa maa kataba aal laahu lanaa hooa mawlayaanaa wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail mu'minoon
Qul hal tarabbasoona binaa 'il laa 'ihdaa aal husnayayni wanahnu natarabbasu bikum 'any yyuseebakumu aul laahu bi'azaab mmin 'indihi 'aw biaydeenaa fatarabbasu 'innaa ma'akum mmutarabbisoon
Qul 'anfiqu taw'aan 'aw karha llany yyutaqabbal a minkum 'innakum kuntum qawma faasiqeen
Wamaa mana'ahum 'an tuqbal a minhum nafaqaatuhum 'il laa 'annahum kafaru bial laahi wabirasoolihi wal aa yatoona aas-sal awaata 'il laa wahum kusaal aa wal aa yunfiqoona 'il laa wahum kaarihoon
Fal aa tu'jibka 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhum 'innamaa yureedu aul laahu leeu'azzibahum bihaa fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa watazhaqa 'anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
Wayahlifoona bial laahi 'innahum laminkum wamaa hum mminkum wal aakinnahum qawm yafraqoon
Law yajidoona mal jaan 'aw maghaaraatin 'aw muddakhal a llawal lawa 'il ayhi wahum yajmahoon
Waminhum mmany yyal mizuka fi ais-sadaqaati fain 'u'tu minhaa radu wail llam yu'tawa minhaa 'izaa hum yaskhatoon
Wal aw 'annahum radu maa 'aatayaahumu aul laahu warasooluhu waqaal u hasbunaa aal laahu sayu'teenaa aal laahu min fadlihi warasooluhu 'innaa 'il aa aal laahi raaghiboon

'innamaa aas-sadaqaatu lil fuqaraa'i waal masaakeeni waal'aamil eena 'al ayhaa waal mu'al lafati qul oobuhum wafi air-riqaabi waal ghaarimeena wafi sabeeli ail laahi waabni ais-sabeeli fareedat mmina aal laahi waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Waminhumu aul zeena yu'zoona aan-nabiaa'a wayaqooloona hooa 'uzn qul 'uznu khayr llakum yu'minu bial laahi wayu'minu lil mu'mineena warahmat llil zeena 'aamanu minkum waal zeena yu'zoona rasoola aal laahi lahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Yahlifoona bial laahi lakum leeurdookum waal laahu warasooluhu 'ahaqqu 'any yyurdoohu 'in kaanu mu'mineen
'al am ya'lamu 'annahu many yyuhaadidi ail laaha warasoolahu faanna lahu naara jahannama khaal ida feehaa zaal ika aal khizyu aul'azeem
Yahzaru aul munaafiqoona 'an tunazzal a 'al ayhim soorat tunabbeeuhum bimaa fi qul oobihim qul i aistahzi'u 'inna aal laaha mukhrij mmaa tahzaroon
Wal a'in saal tahum layaqoolunna 'innamaa kunnaa nakhoodu wanal'abu qul 'abial laahi wa'ayaatihi warasoolihi kuntum tastahzi'oon
Laa ta'taziru qad kafartum ba'da 'eemaanikum 'iny yyu'fa 'an taa'ifat mminkum tu'azzab taa'ifatu biannahum kaanu mujrimeen
Aal munaafiqoona waal munaafiqaatu ba'duhum mmim ba'd yamuroona bial munkari wayanhawna 'ani ail ma'roofi wayaqbidoona 'aydeeahum nasu aul laaha fanaseeahum 'inna aal munaafiqeena humu aul faasiqoon
Wa'ada aal laahu aul munaafiqeena waal munaafiqaati waal kuffaara naara jahannama khaal ideena feehaa heea hasbuhum wal a'anahumu aul laahu wal ahum 'azaab mmuqeem

Kaal zeena min qablikum kaanu 'ashadda minkum qoowat waakthara 'amwaal a waawlaada faastamta'u bikhal aaqihim faastamta'tum bikhal aaqikum kamaa aastamta'a aal zeena min qablikum bikhal aaqihim wakhudtum kaal zi khaadu 'ul aa'ika habitat 'a'maal uhum fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati waul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
'al am yatihim nabau aul zeena min qablihim qawmi nooh wa'aad wathamood
Waqawmi 'ibraaheema waashaabi madyana waal mu'tafikaati 'atathum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati famaa kaana aal laahu leeazlimahum wal aakin kaanu 'anfusahum yazlimoon

Waal mu'minoona waal mu'minaatu ba'duhum 'awleeaa'u ba'd yamuroona bial ma'roofi wayanhawna 'ani ail munkari wayuqeemoona aas-sal awaata wayu'toona aaz-zakawaata wayutee'oona aal laaha warasoolahu 'ul aa'ika sayarhamuhumu aul laahu 'inna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem

Wa'ada aal laahu aul mu'mineena waal mu'minaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wamasaakina tayyibat fi jannaati 'adn waridwaam mmina aal laahi 'akbaru zaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u jaahidi ail kuffaara waal munaafiqeena waaghluz 'al ayhim wamawayaahum jahannamu wabeesa aal maseer

Yahlifoona bial laahi maa qaal u wal aqad qaal u kal imata aal kufri wakafaru ba'da 'islaamihim wahammu bimaa lam yanaal u wamaa naqamu 'il laa 'an 'aghnayaahumu aul laahu warasooluhu min fadlihi fainy yyatoobu yaku khayra llaahum wainy yyatawal lawa yu'azzibhumu aul laahu 'azaabaan 'al eema fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati wamaa lahum fi ail ardi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer
Waminhum mman 'aahada aal laaha la'in 'aatayaanaa min fadlihi lanassaddaqanna wal anakoonanna mina aas-saal iheen
Fal ammaa 'aatayaahum mmin fadlihi bakhil u bihi watawal la wwahum mmu'ridoon
Faa'qabahum nifaaqa fi qul oobihim 'il aa yawmi yal qawnahu bimaa 'akhlafu aul laaha maa wa'adoohu wabimaa kaanu yakziboon
'al am ya'lamu 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu sirrahum wanajwayaahum waanna aal laaha 'al laamu aul ghuyoob
Ail zeena yal mizoona aal muttawwi'eena mina aal mu'mineena fi ais-sadaqaati waal zeena laa yajidoona 'il laa juhdahum fayaskharoona minhum sakhira aal laahu minhum wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem

Aistaghfir lahum 'aw laa tastaghfir lahum 'in tastaghfir lahum sab'eena marrat fal any yyaghfira aal laahu lahum zaal ika biannahum kafaru bial laahi warasoolihi waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal faasiqeen

Fariha aal mukhal lafoona bimaq'adihim khil aafa rasooli ail laahi wakarihu 'any yyujaahidu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim fi sabeeli ail laahi waqaal u laa tanfiru fi ail harri qul naaru jahannama 'ashaddu harra llaw kaanu yafqahoon
Fal yadhaku qal eela wal yabku katheera jazaa'a bimaa kaanu yaksiboon

Fair rraja'aka aal laahu 'il aa taa'ifat mminhum faastaazanooka lil khurooji faqul-lan takhruju ma'eea 'abada wal an tuqaatil u ma'i 'adoowaan 'innakum radeetum bial qu'oodi 'awwal a marrat faaq'udu ma'a aal khaal ifeen
Wal aa tusal li 'al aa 'ahad mminhum mmaata 'abada wal aa taqum 'al aa qabrihi 'innahum kafaru bial laahi warasoolihi wamaatu wahum faasiqoon
Wal aa tu'jibka 'amwaal uhum waawlaaduhum 'innamaa yureedu aul laahu 'any yyu'azzibahum bihaa fi aid-dunyaa watazhaqa 'anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
Waizaa 'unzil at sooratun 'an 'aaminu bial laahi wajaahidu ma'a rasoolihi aistaazanaka 'oolu aut-tawli minhum waqaal u zarnaa nakum mma'a aal qaa'ideen
Radu biany yyakoonu ma'a aal khawaal ifi watubi'a 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
Laakini air-rasoolu waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu jaahadu biamwaal ihim waanfusihim waul aa'ika lahumu aul khayraatu waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
'a'adda aal laahu lahum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa zaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem
Wajaa'a aal mu'azziroona mina aal a'raabi leeu'zana lahum waqa'ada aal zeena kazabu aul laaha warasoolahu sayuseebu aul zeena kafaru minhum 'azaabun 'al eem

Llaysa 'al aa aad-du'afaa'i wal aa 'al aa aal mardaa wal aa 'al aa aal zeena laa yajidoona maa yunfiqoona harajun 'izaa nasahu lil hi warasoolihi maa 'al aa aal muhsineena min sabeel waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Wal aa 'al aa aal zeena 'izaa maa 'atawka litahmil ahum qul ta laa 'ajidu maa 'ahmil ukum 'al ayhi tawal la wwaa'yunuhum tafeedu mina aad-dam'i hazanaan 'al laa yajidu maa yunfiqoon
'innamaa aas-sabeelu 'al aa aal zeena yastaazinoonaka wahum 'aghneeaa'u radu biany yyakoonu ma'a aal khawaal ifi wataba'a aal laahu 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa ya'lamoon

Ya'taziroona 'il aykum 'izaa raja'tum 'il ayhim qul-laa ta'taziru lan nnu'mina lakum qad nabbaanaa aal laahu min 'akhbaarikum wasayaraa aal laahu 'amal akum warasooluhu thumma turaddoona 'il aa 'aal imi ail ghaybi waash-shahaadati fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Sayahlifoona bial laahi lakum 'izaa aanqal abtum 'il ayhim litu'ridu 'anhum faa'ridu 'anhum 'innahum rijs wamawayaahum jahannamu jazaa'a bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
Yahlifoona lakum litardawa 'anhum fain tardawa 'anhum fainna aal laaha laa yardaa 'ani ail qawmi ail faasiqeen
Aal a'raabu 'ashaddu kufra wanifaaqa waajdaru 'al laa ya'lamu hudooda maa 'anzal a aal laahu 'al aa rasoolihi waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Wamina aal a'raabi many yyattakhizu maa yunfiqu maghrama wayatarabbasu bikumu aud-dawaa'ira 'al ayhim daa'iratu aus-saw'i waal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Wamina aal a'raabi many yyu'minu bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wayattakhizu maa yunfiqu qurubaatin 'inda aal laahi wasal awaati air-rasooli 'al aa 'innahaa qurbat llaahum sayudkhil uhumu aul laahu fi rahmatihi 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Waas-saabiqoona aal awwal oona mina aal muhaajireena waal ansaari waal zeena aattaba'oohum biihsaar rradeea aal laahu 'anhum waradu 'anhu waa'adda lahum jannaat tajri tahtahaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada zaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem

Wamimman hawlakum mmina aal a'raabi munaafiqoona wamin 'ahli ail madeenati maradu 'al aa aan-nifaaqi laa ta'lamuhum nahnu na'lamuhum sanu'azzibuhum mmarratayni thumma yuraddoona 'il aa 'azaabin 'azeem
Wa'aakharoona aa'tarafu bizunoobihim khal atu 'amal a saal iha wa'aakhara sayyeeaan 'asaa aal laahu 'any yyatooba 'al ayhim 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Khuz min 'amwaal ihim sadaqat tutahhiruhum watuzakkeehim bihaa wasal li 'al ayhim 'inna sal awaatika sakal llaahum waal laahu samee'un 'al eem
'al am ya'lamu 'anna aal laaha hooa yaqbal u aut-tawbata 'an 'ibaadihi wayakhuzu aus-sadaqaati waanna aal laaha hooa aat-tawwaabu aur-raheem
Waqul i ai'mal u fasayaraa aal laahu 'amal akum warasooluhu waal mu'minoona wasaturaddoona 'il aa 'aal imi ail ghaybi waash-shahaadati fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wa'aakharoona murjawna liamri ail laahi 'immaa yu'azzibuhum waimmaa yatoobu 'al ayhim waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Ail zeena aattakhazu masjida diraara wakufra watafreeqaa bayna aal mu'mineena wairsaada lliman haaraba aal laaha warasoolahu min qablu wal ayahlifunna 'in 'aradnaa 'il laa aal husnaa waal laahu yashhadu 'innahum lakaaziboon
Laa taqum feehi 'abada llamasjidun 'ussisa 'al aa aat-taqwaa min 'awwal i yawmin 'ahaqqu 'an taqooma feehi feehi rijaal yuhibboona 'any yyatatahharu waal laahu yuhibbu aul muttahhireen

'afaman 'ussisa bunyaanuhu 'al aa taqwaa mina aal laahi waridwaanin khayrun 'am mman 'ussisa bunyaanuhu 'al aa shafaa jurufin har faanhaara bihi fi naari jahannama waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Laa yazaal u bunyaanuhumu aul zi banawa reebat fi qul oobihim 'il laa 'an tuqatta'a qul oobuhum waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

'inna aal laaha aashtaraa mina aal mu'mineena 'anfusahum waamwaal ahum bianna lahumu aul jannata yuqaatil oona fi sabeeli ail laahi fayaqtul oona wayuqtal oona wa'daan 'al ayhi haqqa fi ait-tawrayaati waal injeeli waal qur'aani waman 'awfaa bi'ahdihi mina aal laahi faastabshiru bibay'ikumu aul zi baya'tum bihi wazaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem

Aut-taa'iboona aal'aabidoona aal haamidoona aas-saa'ihoona aar-raaki'oona aas-saajidoona aal aamiroona bial ma'roofi waan-naahoona 'ani ail munkari waal haafizoona lihudoodi ail laahi wabashshiri ail mu'mineen
Maa kaana lin-nabiaa'i waal zeena 'aamanu 'any yyastaghfiru lil mushrikeena wal aw kaanu 'ooli qurbaa mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahum 'annahum 'ashaabu aul jaheem
Wamaa kaana aastighfaaru 'ibraaheema liabeehi 'il laa 'am mmaw'idat wa'adahaa 'iyyaahu fal ammaa tabayyana lahu 'annahu 'adoow llil hi tabarraa minhu 'inna 'ibraaheema laawwaahun hal eem
Wamaa kaana aal laahu leeudil la qawmaa ba'da 'iz hadayaahum hattaa yubayyina lahum mmaa yattaqoona 'inna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem
'inna aal laaha lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi yuhyi wayumeetu wamaa lakum mmin dooni ail laahi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer

Llaqad ttaaba aal laahu 'al aa aan-nabiaa'i waal muhaajireena waal ansaari ail zeena aattaba'oohu fi saa'ati ail'usrati mim ba'di maa kaada tazeeghu qul oobu fareeq mminhum thumma taaba 'al ayhim 'innahu bihim ra'oof rraheem

Wa'al aa aath-thal aathati ail zeena khul lifu hattaa 'izaa daaqat 'al ayhimu aul ardu bimaa rahubat wadaaqat 'al ayhim 'anfusuhum wazannu 'al llaa mal jaa mina aal laahi 'il laa 'il ayhi thumma taaba 'al ayhim leeatoobu 'inna aal laaha hooa aat-tawwaabu aur-raheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auttaqu aul laaha wakoonu ma'a aas-saadiqeen

Maa kaana liahli ail madeenati waman hawlahum mmina aal a'raabi 'any yyatakhal lafu 'ar rrasooli ail laahi wal aa yarghabu bianfusihim 'an nnafsihi zaal ika biannahum laa yuseebuhum zama wal aa nasab wal aa makhmasat fi sabeeli ail laahi wal aa yataoona mawteea yagheezu aul kuffaara wal aa yanaal oona min 'adoow nnaylaan 'il laa kutiba lahum bihi 'amal saal ihun 'inna aal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajra aal muhsineen
Wal aa yunfiqoona nafaqat sagheerat wal aa kabeerat wal aa yaqta'oona waadeeaan 'il laa kutiba lahum leeajzeeahumu aul laahu 'ahsana maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wamaa kaana aal mu'minoona leeanfiru kaaffat fal awlaa nafara min kul li firqat mminhum taa'ifat lleeatafaqqahu fi aid-deeni wal eeunziru qawmahum 'izaa raja'u 'il ayhim la'al laahum yahzaroon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu qaatil u aul zeena yal oonakum mmina aal kuffaari wal yajidu feekum ghil zat waa'lamu 'anna aal laaha ma'a aal muttaqeen
Waizaa maa 'unzil at soorat faminhum mmany yyaqoolu 'ayyukum zaadathu haazihi 'eemaana faammaa aal zeena 'aamanu fazaadathum 'eemaana wahum yastabshiroon
Waammaa aal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad fazaadathum rijsaan 'il aa rijsihim wamaatu wahum kaafiroon
'awal aa yarawna 'annahum yuftanoona fi kul li 'aam mmarratan 'aw marratayni thumma laa yatooboona wal aa hum yazzakkaroon
Waizaa maa 'unzil at soorat nnazara ba'duhum 'il aa ba'din hal yarayaakum mmin 'ahad thumma aansarafu sarafa aal laahu qul oobahum biannahum qawm llaa yafqahoon
Laqad jaa'akum rasool mmin 'anfusikum 'azeezun 'al ayhi maa 'anittum hareesun 'al aykum bial mu'mineena ra'oof rraheem
Fain tawal lawa faqul hasbeea aal laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wahwa rabbu aul'arshi ail'azeem
'al aara til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi ail hakeem

'akaana lin-naasi 'ajabaan 'an 'awhaynaa 'il aa rajul mminhum 'an 'anziri ain-naasa wabashshiri ail zeena 'aamanu 'anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim qaal a aal kaafiroona 'inna haazaa lasihr mmubeen

'inna rabbakumu aul laahu aul zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda fi sittati 'ayyaam thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi yudabbiru aul amra maa min shafee'in 'il laa mim ba'di 'iznihi zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukum faa'budoohu 'afal aa tazzakkaroon

'il ayhi marji'ukum jamee'a wa'da aal laahi haqqaan 'innahu yabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu leeajzeea aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati bial qisti waal zeena kafaru lahum sharaab mmin hameem wa'azaabun 'al eemu bimaa kaanu yakfuroon

Hooa aal zi ja'al a aash-shamsa deeaa' waal qamara noora waqaddarahu manaazil a lita'lamu 'adada aas-sineena waal hisaaba maa khal aqa aal laahu zaal ika 'il laa bial haqqi nufassil u aul ayaati liqawm ya'lamoon
'inna fi aikhtil aafi ail yli waan-nahaari wamaa khal aqa aal laahu fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi layaat lliqawm yattaqoon
'inna aal zeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa waradu bial hayawaati aid-dunyaa waatmaannu bihaa waal zeena hum 'an 'ayaatinaa ghaafil oon
'ul aa'ika mawayaahumu aun-naaru bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati yahdeehim rabbuhum bieemaanihim tajri min tahtihimu aul anhaaru fi jannaati ain-na'eem
Da'wayaahum feehaa subhaanaka aal laahumma watahiyyatuhum feehaa sal aam wa'aakhiru da'wayaahum 'ani ail hamdu lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Wal aw yu'ajjil u aul laahu lin-naasi aish-sharra aasti'jaal ahum bial khayri laqudeea 'il ayhim 'ajal uhum fanazaru aul zeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa fi tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

Waizaa massa aal insaana aad-durru da'aanaa lijanbihi 'aw qaa'idaan 'aw qaa'ima fal ammaa kashafnaa 'anhu durrahu marra kaal llam yad'unaa 'il aa durr mmassahu kazaal ika zuyyina lil musrifeena maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wal aqad 'ahlaknaa aal quroona min qablikum lammaa zal amu wajaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati wamaa kaanu leeu'minu kazaal ika najzi ail qawma aal mujrimeen
Thumma ja'al naakum khal aa'ifa fi ail ardi mim ba'dihim linanzura kayfa ta'mal oon

Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat qaal a aal zeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa ayti biqur'aanin ghayri haazaa 'aw baddil hu qul maa yakoonu leea 'an 'ubaddil ahu min til qaa'i nafseea 'in 'attabi'u 'il laa maa yoohaa 'il ayya 'inneea 'akhaafu 'in 'asaytu rabbi 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qul-law shaa'a aal laahu maa tal awtuhu 'al aykum wal aa 'adrayaakum bihi faqad labithtu feekum 'umura mmin qablihi 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Faman 'azlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan 'aw kazzaba biayaatihi 'innahu laa yuflihu aul mujrimoon

Waya'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa laa yadurruhum wal aa yanfa'uhum wayaqooloona haa'ul aa'i shufa'aa'unaa 'inda aal laahi qul 'atunabbioona aal laaha bimaa laa ya'lamu fi ais-samaawaati wal aa fi ail ardi subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Wamaa kaana aan-naasu 'il laa 'ummat waahidat faakhtal afu wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika laqudeea baynahum feemaa feehi yakhtal ifoon
Wayaqooloona lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi faqul 'innamaa aal ghaybu lil hi faantaziru 'inni ma'akum mmina aal muntazireen
Waizaa 'azaqnaa aan-naasa rahmat mmim ba'di darraa'a massathum 'izaa lahum mmakr fi 'ayaatinaa qul i ail laahu 'asra'u makraan 'inna rusul anaa yaktuboona maa tamkuroon

Hooa aal zi yusayyirukum fi ail barri waal bahri hattaa 'izaa kuntum fi ail ful ki wajarayna bihim bireeh tayyibat wafarihu bihaa jaa'athaa reehun 'aasif wajaa'ahumu aul mawju min kul li makaanw wazannu 'annahum 'uheeta bihim da'awua aul laaha mukhliseena lahu aud-deena la'in 'anjaytanaa min haazihi lanakoonanna mina aash-shaakireen

Fal ammaa 'anjayaahum 'izaa hum yabghoona fi ail ardi bighayri ail haqqi yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'innamaa baghyukum 'al aa 'anfusikum mmataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunyaa thumma 'il aynaa marji'ukum fanunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon

'innamaa mathal u aul hayawaati aid-dunyaa kamaa'in 'anzal naahu mina aas-samaa'i faakhtal ata bihi nabaatu aul ardi mimmaa yakul u aun-naasu waal an'aamu hattaa 'izaa 'akhazati ail ardu zukhrufahaa waazzayyanat wazanna 'ahluhaa 'annahum qaadiroona 'al ayhaa 'atayaahaa 'amrunaa laylaan 'aw nahaara faja'al naahaa haseeda kaal llam taghna bial amsi kazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati liqawm yatafakkaroon
Waal laahu yad'u 'il aa daari ais-sal aami wayahdi many yyashaa'u ail aa siraat mmustaqeem
Llil zeena 'ahsanu aul husnaa wazeeaadat wal aa yarhaqu wujoohahum qatar wal aa zil latun 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon

Waal zeena kasabu aus-sayyiaati jazaa'u sayyeeati bimithlihaa watarhaquhum zil lat mmaa lahum mmina aal laahi min 'aasim kaannamaa 'ughsheeat wujoohuhum qita'a mmina aal yli muzlimaan 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a thumma naqoolu lil zeena 'ashraku makaanakum 'antum washurakaa'ukum fazayyal naa baynahum waqaal a shurakaa'uhum mmaa kuntum 'iyyaanaa ta'budoon
Fakafaa bial laahi shaheedaa baynanaa wabaynakum 'in kunnaa 'an 'ibaadatikum laghaafil een
Hunaal ika tablu kul lu nafs mmaa 'aslafat waruddu 'il aa aal laahi mawlayaahumu aul haqqi wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

Qul many yyarzuqukum mmina aas-samaa'i waal ardi 'ammany yyamliku aus-sam'a waal absaara wamany yyukhriju aul hayya mina aal mayyiti wayukhriju aul mayyita mina aal hayyi wamany yyudabbiru aul amra fasayaqooloona aal laahu faqul 'afal aa tattaqoon
Fazaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukumu aul haqqu famaazaa ba'da aal haqqi 'il laa aad-dal aal u faannaa tusrafoon
Kazaal ika haqqat kal imaatu rabbika 'al aa aal zeena fasaqu 'annahum laa yu'minoon
Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum mmany yyabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu qul i ail laahu yabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu faannaa tu'fakoon

Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum mmany yyahdi 'il aa aal haqqi qul i ail laahu yahdi lil haqqi 'afamany yyahdi 'il aa aal haqqi 'ahaqqu 'any yyuttaba'a 'ammal llaa yahddi 'il laa 'any yyuhdaa famaa lakum kayfa tahkumoon
Wamaa yattabi'u 'aktharuhum 'il laa zannaan 'inna aaz-zanna laa yughni mina aal haqqi shayaan 'inna aal laaha 'al eemu bimaa yaf'al oon
Wamaa kaana haazaa aal qur'aanu 'any yyuftaraa min dooni ail laahi wal aakin tasdeeqa aal zi bayna yadayhi watafseela aal kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
'am yaqooloona aaftarayaahu qul fatu bisoorat mmithlihi waad'u mani aistata'tum mmin dooni ail laahi 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal kazzabu bimaa lam yuheetu bi'il mihi wal ammaa yatihim taweeluhu kazaal ika kazzaba aal zeena min qablihim faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu auz-zaal imeen
Waminhum mmany yyu'minu bihi waminhum mmal llaa yu'minu bihi warabbuka 'a'lamu bial mufsideen
Wain kazzabooka faqul-li 'amal i wal akum 'amal ukum 'antum bareeaaoona mimmaa 'a'mal u waanaa bariaa' mmimmaa ta'mal oon
Waminhum mmany yyastami'oona 'il ayka 'afaanta tusmi'u aus-summa wal aw kaanu laa ya'qil oon
Waminhum mmany yyanzuru 'il ayka 'afaanta tahdi ail'umya wal aw kaanu laa yubsiroon
'inna aal laaha laa yazlimu aun-naasa shaya wal aakinna aan-naasa 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Wayawma nahshuruhum kaal llam yal bathu 'il laa saa'at mmina aan-nahaari yata'aarafoona baynahum qad khasira aal zeena kazzabu bil iqaa'i ail laahi wamaa kaanu muhtadeen
Waimmaa nureeannaka ba'da aal zi na'iduhum 'aw natawaffayannaka fail aynaa marji'uhum thumma aal laahu shaheedun 'al aa maa yaf'al oon
Wal ikul li 'ummat rrasool faizaa jaa'a rasooluhum qudeea baynahum bial qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaa aal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul-laa 'amliku linafsi darra wal aa naf'aan 'il laa maa shaa'a aal laahu likul li 'ummatin 'ajal un 'izaa jaa 'ajal uhum fal aa yastaakhiroona saa'at wal aa yastaqdimoon
Qul 'araytum 'in 'atayaakum 'azaabuhu bayaataan 'aw nahaara mmaazaa yasta'jil u minhu aul mujrimoon
'athumma 'izaa maa waqa'a 'aamantum bihi 'aal aana waqad kuntum bihi tasta'jil oon
Thumma qeela lil zeena zal amu zooqu 'azaaba aal khul di hal tujzawna 'il laa bimaa kuntum taksiboon
Wayastanbioonaka 'ahaqqun hooa qul 'i warabbeea 'innahu lahaqq wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeen
Wal aw 'anna likul li nafs zal amat maa fi ail ardi laaftadat bihi waasarru aun-nadaamata lammaa raawua aul'azaaba waqudeea baynahum bial qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
'al aa 'inna lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi 'al aa 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Hooa yuhyi wayumeetu wail ayhi turja'oon
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu qad jaa'atkum mmaw'izat mmir rrabbikum washifaa' llimaa fi ais-sudoori wahuda warahmat llil mu'mineen
Qul bifadli ail laahi wabirahmatihi fabizaal ika fal yafrahu hooa khayr mmimmaa yajma'oon
Qul 'araytum mmaa 'anzal a aal laahu lakum mmir rrizq faja'al tum mminhu haraama wahal aal a qul 'aal laahu 'azina lakum 'am 'al aa aal laahi taftaroon
Wamaa zannu aul zeena yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba yawma aal qeeaamati 'inna aal laaha lazoo fadlin 'al aa aan-naasi wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa yashkuroon

Wamaa takoonu fi shanw wamaa tatlu minhu min qur'aanw wal aa ta'mal oona min 'amal in 'il laa kunnaa 'al aykum shuhoodaan 'iz tufeedoona feehi wamaa ya'zubu 'ar rrabbika mim mmithqaal i zarrat fi ail ardi wal aa fi ais-samaa'i wal aa 'asghara min zaal ika wal aa 'akbara 'il laa fi kitaab mmubeen
'al aa 'inna 'awleeaa'a aal laahi laa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
Aal zeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Lahumu aul bushraa fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wafi ail aakhirati laa tabdeela likal imaati ail laahi zaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem
Wal aa yuhzinka qawluhum 'inna aal'izzata lil hi jamee'aan hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
'al aa 'inna lil hi man fi ais-samaawaati waman fi ail ardi wamaa yattabi'u aul zeena yad'oona min dooni ail laahi shurakaa'a any yyattabi'oona 'il laa aaz-zanna wain hum 'il laa yakhrusoon
Hooa aal zi ja'al a lakumu aul yla litaskunu feehi waan-nahaara mubsiraan 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yasma'oon
Qaal u auttakhaza aal laahu wal ada subhaanahu hooa aal ghaneeyu lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi 'in 'indakum mmin sul taani bihaazaa 'ataqooloona 'al aa aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qul 'inna aal zeena yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba laa yuflihoon
Mataa' fi aid-dunyaa thumma 'il aynaa marji'uhum thumma nuzeequhumu aul'azaaba aash-shadeeda bimaa kaanu yakfuroon

Waatlu 'al ayhim nabaa noohin 'iz qaal a liqawmihi yaaqawmi 'in kaana kabura 'al aykum mmaqaami watazkeeri biayaati ail laahi fa'al aa aal laahi tawakkal tu faajmi'u 'amrakum washurakaa'akum thumma laa yakun 'amrukum 'al aykum ghummat thumma aaqdu 'il ayya wal aa tunziroon
Fain tawal laytum famaa saal tukum mmin 'ajrin 'in 'ajreea 'il laa 'al aa aal laahi waumirtu 'an 'akoona mina aal muslimeen
Fakazzaboohu fanajjaynaahu wamam mma'ahu fi ail ful ki waja'al naahum khal aa'ifa waaghraqnaa aal zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul munzareen
Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihi rusul aan 'il aa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bial bayyinaati famaa kaanu leeu'minu bimaa kazzabu bihi min qablu kazaal ika natba'u 'al aa qul oobi ail mu'tadeen
Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihim mmoosaa wahaaroona 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi biayaatinaa faastakbaru wakaanu qawma mmujrimeen
Fal ammaa jaa'ahumu aul haqqu min 'indinaa qaal u 'inna haazaa lasihr mmubeen
Qaal a moosaa 'ataqooloona lil haqqi lammaa jaa'akum 'asihrun haazaa wal aa yuflihu aus-saahiroon
Qaal u 'ajeetanaa lital fitanaa 'ammaa wajadnaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa watakoona lakumaa aal kibreeaa'u fi ail ardi wamaa nahnu lakumaa bimu'mineen
Waqaal a fir'awnu auytooni bikul li saahirin 'al eem
Fal ammaa jaa'a aas-saharatu qaal a lahum mmoosaa 'al qu maa 'antum mmul qoon
Fal ammaa 'al qawa qaal a moosaa maa jeetum bihi ais-sihru 'inna aal laaha sayubtil uhu 'inna aal laaha laa yuslihu 'amal a aal mufsideen
Wayuhiqqu aul laahu aul haqqa bikal imaatihi wal aw kariha aal mujrimoon
Famaa 'aamana limoosaa 'il laa zurriyyat mmin qawmihi 'al aa khawf mmin fir'awna wamal aeehim 'any yyaftinahum wainna fir'awna la'aal fi ail ardi wainnahu lamina aal musrifeen
Waqaal a moosaa yaaqawmi 'in kuntum 'aamantum bial laahi fa'al ayhi tawakkal u 'in kuntum mmuslimeen
Faqaal u 'al aa aal laahi tawakkal naa rabbanaa laa taj'al naa fitnat llil qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wanajjinaa birahmatika mina aal qawmi ail kaafireen
Waawhaynaa 'il aa moosaa waakheehi 'an tabawwa'aa liqawmikumaa bimisra beeoota waaj'al u beeootakum qiblat waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wabashshiri ail mu'mineen

Waqaal a moosaa rabbanaa 'innaka 'aatayta fir'awna wamal aahu zeenat waamwaal a fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa rabbanaa leeadil lu 'an sabeelika rabbanaa aatmis 'al aa 'amwaal ihim waashdud 'al aa qul oobihim fal aa yu'minu hattaa yarawua aul'azaaba aal al eem
Qaal a qad 'ujeebat dda'watukumaa faastaqeemaa wal aa tattabi'aanni sabeela aal zeena laa ya'lamoon

Wajaawaznaa bibani 'israa'eela aal bahra faatba'ahum fir'awnu wajunooduhu baghya wa'adwaan hattaa 'izaa 'adrakahu aul gharaqu qaal a 'aamantu 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa aal zi 'aamanat bihi banu 'israa'eela waanaa mina aal muslimeen
'aal aana waqad 'asayta qablu wakunta mina aal mufsideen
Faal yawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khal faka 'ayat wainna katheera mmina aan-naasi 'an 'ayaatinaa laghaafil oon
