Wal aqad bawwanaa bani 'israa'eela mubawwaa sidq warazaqnaahum mmina aat-tayyibaati famaa aakhtal afu hattaa jaa'ahumu aul'il mu 'inna rabbaka yaqdi baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Fain kunta fi shakk mmimmaa 'anzal naa 'il ayka fasal i ail zeena yaqra'oona aal kitaaba min qablika laqad jaa'aka aal haqqu mir rrabbika fal aa takoonanna mina aal mumtareen
Wal aa takoonanna mina aal zeena kazzabu biayaati ail laahi fatakoona mina aal khaasireen
'inna aal zeena haqqat 'al ayhim kal imaatu rabbika laa yu'minoon
Wal aw jaa'athum kul lu 'ayatin hattaa yarawua aul'azaaba aal al eem
Fal awlaa kaanat qaryatun 'aamanat fanafa'ahaa 'eemaanuhaa 'il laa qawma yoonusa lammaa 'aamanu kashafnaa 'anhum 'azaaba aal khizyi fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wamatta'naahum 'il aa heen
Wal aw shaa'a rabbuka laamana man fi ail ardi kul luhum jamee'aan 'afaanta tukrihu aun-naasa hattaa yakoonu mu'mineen
Wamaa kaana linafsin 'an tu'mina 'il laa biizni ail laahi wayaj'al u aur-rijsa 'al aa aal zeena laa ya'qil oon
Qul u aunzuru maazaa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa tughni ail ayaatu waan-nuzuru 'an qawm llaa yu'minoon
Fahal yantaziroona 'il laa mithla 'ayyaami ail zeena khal awa min qablihim qul faantaziru 'inni ma'akum mmina aal muntazireen
Thumma nunajji rusul anaa waal zeena 'aamanu kazaal ika haqqaan 'al aynaa nunajji ail mu'mineen

Qul yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'in kuntum fi shakk mmin deeni fal aa 'a'budu aul zeena ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi wal aakin 'a'budu aul laaha aal zi yatawaffayaakum waumirtu 'an 'akoona mina aal mu'mineen
Waan 'aqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefa wal aa takoonanna mina aal mushrikeen
Wal aa tad'u min dooni ail laahi maa laa yanfa'uka wal aa yadurruka fain fa'al ta fainnaka 'iza mmina aaz-zaal imeen
Wainy yyamsaska aal laahu bidurr fal aa kaashifa lahu 'il laa hooa wainy yyuridka bikhayr fal aa raadda lifadlihi yuseebu bihi many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wahwa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Qul yayyuhaa aan-naasu qad jaa'akumu aul haqqu mir rrabbikum famani aihtadaa fainnamaa yahtadi linafsihi waman dal la fainnamaa yadil lu 'al ayhaa wamaa 'anaa 'al aykum biwakeel
Waattabi' maa yoohaa 'il ayka waasbir hattaa yahkuma aal laahu wahwa khayru aul haakimeen
'al aara kitaabun 'uhkimat 'ayaatuhu thumma fussil at mil lladun hakeemin khabeer
'al laa ta'budu 'il laa aal laaha 'innani lakum mminhu nazeer wabasheer
Waani aistaghfiru rabbakum thumma toobu 'il ayhi yumatti'kum mmataa'aan hasanaan 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma wayu'ti kul la zi fadl fadlahu wain tawal lawa fainneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawm kabeer
'il aa aal laahi marji'ukum wahwa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
'al aa 'innahum yathnoona sudoorahum leeastakhfu minhu 'al aa heena yastaghshoona theeaabahum ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoona 'innahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
Wamaa min daabbat fi ail ardi 'il laa 'al aa aal laahi rizquhaa waya'lamu mustaqarrahaa wamustawda'ahaa kul l fi kitaab mmubeen

Wahwa aal zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda fi sittati 'ayyaam wakaana 'arshuhu 'al aa aal maa'i leeablooakum 'ayyukum 'ahsanu 'amal a wal a'in qul ta 'innakum mmab'oothoona mim ba'di ail mawti layaqoolanna aal zeena kafaru 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Wal a'in 'akhkharnaa 'anhumu aul'azaaba 'il aa 'ummat mma'doodat llayaqoolunna maa yahbisuhu 'al aa yawma yateehim laysa masroofaan 'anhum wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Wal a'in 'azaqnaa aal insaana minnaa rahmat thumma naza'naahaa minhu 'innahu layaoos kafoor
Wal a'in 'azaqnaahu na'maa'a ba'da darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna zahaba aas-sayyiaatu 'anneea 'innahu lafarih fakhoor
'il laa aal zeena sabaru wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati 'ul aa'ika lahum mmaghfirat waajr kabeer

Fal a'al laka taariku ba'da maa yoohaa 'il ayka wadaa'iqu bihi sadruka 'any yyaqoolu lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi kanzun 'aw jaa'a ma'ahu mal akun 'innamaa 'anta nazeer waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' wakeel
'am yaqooloona aaftarayaahu qul fatu bi'ashri sooar mmithlihi muftarayaat waad'u mani aistata'tum mmin dooni ail laahi 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fail lam yastajeebu lakum faa'lamu 'annamaa 'unzil a bi'il mi ail laahi waal llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa fahal 'antum mmuslimoon
Man kaana yureedu aul hayawaata aad-dunyaa wazeenatahaa nooaffi 'il ayhim 'a'maal ahum feehaa wahum feehaa laa yubkhasoon
'ul aa'ika aal zeena laysa lahum fi ail aakhirati 'il laa aan-naaru wahabita maa sana'u feehaa wabaatil mmaa kaanu ya'mal oon

'afaman kaana 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbihi wayatloohu shaahid mminhu wamin qablihi kitaabu moosaa 'imaama warahmatan 'ul aa'ika yu'minoona bihi wamany yyakfur bihi mina aal ahzaabi faan-naaru maw'iduhu fal aa taku fi miryat mminhu 'innahu aul haqqu mir rrabbika wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yu'minoon

Waman 'azlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan 'ul aa'ika yu'radoona 'al aa rabbihim wayaqoolu aul ashhaadu haa'ul aa'i ail zeena kazabu 'al aa rabbihim 'al aa la'natu aul laahi 'al aa aaz-zaal imeen
Aal zeena yasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwaja wahum bial aakhirati hum kaafiroon
'ul aa'ika lam yakoonu mu'jizeena fi ail ardi wamaa kaana lahum mmin dooni ail laahi min 'awleeaa'a yudaa'afu lahumu aul'azaabu maa kaanu yastatee'oona aas-sam'a wamaa kaanu yubsiroon
'ul aa'ika aal zeena khasiru 'anfusahum wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon
Laa jarama 'annahum fi ail aakhirati humu aul akhsaroon
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati waakhbatu 'il aa rabbihim 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jannati hum feehaa khaal idoon
Mathal u aul fareeqayni kaal a'maa waal asammi waal baseeri waas-samee'i hal yastaweeaani mathal aan 'afal aa tazzakkaroon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa noohaan 'il aa qawmihi 'inni lakum nazeer mmubeen
'al llaa ta'budu 'il laa aal laaha 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawmin 'al eem

Faqaal a aal mal au aul zeena kafaru min qawmihi maa narayaaka 'il laa bashara mmithlanaa wamaa narayaaka aattaba'aka 'il laa aal zeena hum 'araazil unaa baadeea aar-rayi wamaa naraa lakum 'al aynaa min fadli bal nazunnukum kaazibeen
Qaal a yaaqawmi 'araytum 'in kuntu 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbi wa'aatayaani rahmat mmin 'indihi fa'ameeat 'al aykum 'anul zimukumoohaa waantum lahaa kaarihoon
Wayaaqawmi laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi maal aan 'in 'ajreea 'il laa 'al aa aal laahi wamaa 'anaa bitaaridi ail zeena 'aamanu 'innahum mmul aaqu rabbihim wal aakinneea 'arayaakum qawma tajhal oon
Wayaaqawmi many yyansuruni mina aal laahi 'in taradttuhum 'afal aa tazzakkaroon

Wal aa 'aqoolu lakum 'indi khazaa'inu aul laahi wal aa 'a'lamu aul ghayba wal aa 'aqoolu 'inni mal ak wal aa 'aqoolu lil zeena tazdari 'a'yunukum lany yyu'teeahumu aul laahu khayraan ail laahu 'a'lamu bimaa fi 'anfusihim 'inneea 'iza llamina aaz-zaal imeen
Qaal u yaanoohu qad jaadal tanaa faaktharta jidaal anaa fatinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Qaal a 'innamaa yateekum bihi ail laahu 'in shaa'a wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeen
Wal aa yanfa'ukum nusheea 'in 'aradttu 'an 'ansaha lakum 'in kaana aal laahu yureedu 'any yyughweeakum hooa rabbukum wail ayhi turja'oon
'am yaqooloona aaftarayaahu qul 'ini aiftaraytuhu fa'al ayya 'ijraami waanaa bariaa' mmimmaa tujrimoon
Waooheea 'il aa noohin 'annahu lany yyu'mina min qawmika 'il laa man qad 'aamana fal aa tabta'is bimaa kaanu yaf'al oon
Waasna'i ail ful ka bia'yuninaa wawahyinaa wal aa tukhaatibni fi ail zeena zal amu 'innahum mmughraqoon
Wayasna'u aul ful ka wakul lamaa marra 'al ayhi mal a mmin qawmihi sakhiru minhu qaal a 'in taskharu minnaa fainnaa naskharu minkum kamaa taskharoon
Fasawfa ta'lamoona many yyateehi 'azaab yukhzeehi wayahil lu 'al ayhi 'azaab mmuqeem
Hattaa 'izaa jaa 'amrunaa wafaara aat-tannooru qul naa aahmil feehaa min kul li zawjayni aithnayni waahlaka 'il laa man sabaqa 'al ayhi ail qawlu waman 'aamana wamaa 'aamana ma'ahu 'il laa qal eel
Waqaal a aarkabu feehaa bismi ail laahi mujrayaahaa wamursayaahaa 'inna rabbi laghafoor rraheem
Wahya tajri bihim fi mawj kaal jibaal i wanaadaa noohun aibnahu wakaana fi ma'zil yaabunayyi airkab mma'anaa wal aa takum mma'a aal kaafireen
Qaal a saawi 'il aa jabal ya'simuni mina aal maa'i qaal a laa 'aasima aal yawma min 'amri ail laahi 'il laa mar rrahima wahaal a baynahumaa aal mawju fakaana mina aal mughraqeen
Waqeela yaardu aubla'i maa'aki wayaasamaa'u aaqli'i wagheeda aal maa'u waqudeea aal amru waastawat 'al aa aal joodeeyi waqeela bu'da llil qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wanaadaa nooh rrabbahu faqaal a rabbi 'inna aabni min 'ahli wainna wa'daka aal haqqu waanta 'ahkamu aul haakimeen
Qaal a yaanoohu 'innahu laysa min 'ahlika 'innahu 'amal un ghayru saal ih fal aa tasal anni maa laysa laka bihi 'il mun 'inneea 'a'izuka 'an takoona mina aal jaahil een
Qaal a rabbi 'inneea 'a'oozu bika 'an 'asal aka maa laysa li bihi 'il m wail laa taghfir li watarhamni 'akum mmina aal khaasireen
Qeela yaanoohu auhbit bisal aam mminnaa wabarakaatin 'al ayka wa'al aa 'umam mmimmam mma'aka waumam sanumatti'uhum thumma yamassuhum mminnaa 'azaabun 'al eem
Til ka min 'anbaa'i ail ghaybi nooheehaa 'il ayka maa kunta ta'lamuhaa 'anta wal aa qawmuka min qabli haazaa faasbir 'inna aal'aaqibata lil muttaqeen
Wail aa 'aadin 'akhaahum hooda qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu 'in 'antum 'il laa muftaroon
Yaaqawmi laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi 'ajraan 'in 'ajreea 'il laa 'al aa aal zi fataraneea 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Wayaaqawmi aistaghfiru rabbakum thumma toobu 'il ayhi yursil i ais-samaa'a 'al aykum mmidraara wayazidkum qoowatan 'il aa qoowatikum wal aa tatawal lawa mujrimeen
Qaal u yaahoodu maa jeetanaa bibayyinat wamaa nahnu bitaariki 'aal ihatinaa 'an qawlika wamaa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
'in nnaqoolu 'il laa aa'tarayaaka ba'du 'aal ihatinaa bisooaa' qaal a 'inneea 'ushhidu aul laaha waashhadu 'anni bariaa' mmimmaa tushrikoona min doonihi fakeedooni jamee'a thumma laa tunziroon
'inni tawakkal tu 'al aa aal laahi rabbi warabbikum mmaa min daabbatin 'il laa hooa 'aakhizu binaaseeatihaa 'inna rabbi 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Fain tawal lawa faqad 'ablaghtukum mmaa 'ursil tu bihi 'il aykum wayastakhlifu rabbi qawmaan ghayrakum wal aa tadurroonahu shayaan 'inna rabbi 'al aa kul li sha'in hafeez
Wal ammaa jaa 'amrunaa najjaynaa hooda waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa wanajjaynaahum mmin 'azaabin ghal eez
Watil ka 'aad jahadu biayaati rabbihim wa'asawa rusul ahu waattaba'u 'amra kul li jabbaarin 'aneed
Wautbi'u fi haazihi aid-dunyaa la'nat wayawma aal qeeaamati 'al aa 'inna 'aada kafaru rabbahum 'al aa bu'da lli'aad qawmi hood

Wail aa thamooda 'akhaahum saal iha qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu hooa 'anshaakum mmina aal ardi waasta'marakum feehaa faastaghfiroohu thumma toobu 'il ayhi 'inna rabbi qareeb mmujeeb
Qaal u yaasaal ihu qad kunta feenaa marjoowa qabla haazaa 'atanhayaanaa 'an nna'buda maa ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa wainnanaa lafi shakk mmimmaa tad'oonaa 'il ayhi mureeb
Qaal a yaaqawmi 'araytum 'in kuntu 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbi wa'aatayaani minhu rahmat famany yyansuruni mina aal laahi 'in 'asaytuhu famaa tazeedoonani ghayra takhseer
Wayaaqawmi haazihi naaqatu aul laahi lakum 'ayat fazaroohaa takul fi 'ardi ail laahi wal aa tamassoohaa bisooaa' fayakhuzakum 'azaab qareeb
Fa'aqaroohaa faqaal a tamatta'u fi daarikum thal aathata 'ayyaam zaal ika wa'dun ghayru makzoob
Fal ammaa jaa 'amrunaa najjaynaa saal iha waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa wamin khizyi yawma'izin 'inna rabbaka hooa aal qaweeyu aul'azeez
Waakhaza aal zeena zal amu aus-sayhatu faasbahu fi deeaarihim jaathimeen
Kaal llam yaghnawa feehaa 'al aa 'inna thamooda kafaru rabbahum 'al aa bu'da llithamood
Wal aqad jaa'at rusul unaa 'ibraaheema bial bushraa qaal u sal aama qaal a sal aam famaa labitha 'an jaa'a bi'ijlin haneez
Fal ammaa ra'aa 'aydeeahum laa tasil u 'il ayhi nakirahum waawjasa minhum kheefat qaal u laa takhaf 'innaa 'ursil naa 'il aa qawmi looh
Waamraatuhu qaa'imat fadahikat fabashsharnaahaa biishaaqa waminw wwaraa 'ishaaqa ya'qoob
Qaal at yaawaylataa 'aal idu waanaa 'ajooz wahaazaa ba'li shaykhaan 'inna haazaa lasha'un 'ajeeb
Qaal u 'ata'jabeena min 'amri ail laahi rahmatu aul laahi wabarakaatuhu 'al aykum 'ahla aal bayti 'innahu hameed mmajeed
Fal ammaa zahaba 'an 'ibraaheema aar-raw'u wajaa'athu aul bushraa yujaadil unaa fi qawmi looh
'inna 'ibraaheema lahal eemun 'awwaah mmuneeb
Yaaibraaheemu 'a'rid 'an haazaa 'innahu qad jaa 'amru rabbika wainnahum 'aateehim 'azaabun ghayru mardood
Wal ammaa jaa'at rusul unaa loota saa'a bihim wadaaqa bihim zar'a waqaal a haazaa yawmun 'aseeb

Wajaa'ahu qawmuhu yuhra'oona 'il ayhi wamin qablu kaanu ya'mal oona aas-sayyiaati qaal a yaaqawmi haa'ul aa'i banaati hunna 'atharu lakum faattaqu aul laaha wal aa tukhzooni fi dayfeea 'al aysa minkum rajur-rasheed
Qaal u laqad 'al imta maa lanaa fi banaatika min haqq wainnaka lata'lamu maa nureed
Qaal a law 'anna li bikum qoowatan 'aw 'aawi 'il aa rukn shadeed

Qaal u yaal ootu 'innaa rusul u rabbika lany yyasil u 'il ayka faasri biahlika biqit' mmina aal yli wal aa yal tafit minkum 'ahadun 'il laa aamraataka 'innahu museebuhaa maa 'asaabahum 'inna maw'idahumu aus-subhu 'al aysa aas-subhu biqareeb
Fal ammaa jaa 'amrunaa ja'al naa 'aal eeahaa saafil ahaa waamtarnaa 'al ayhaa hijaarat mmin sijjeel
Mmandood mmusawwamatan 'inda rabbika wamaa heea mina aaz-zaal imeena biba'eed

Wail aa madyana 'akhaahum shu'ayba qaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu wal aa tanqusu aul mikyaal a waal meezaana 'inneea 'arayaakum bikhayr wainneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawm mmuheeh
Wayaaqawmi 'awfu aul mikyaal a waal meezaana bial qisti wal aa tabkhasu aun-naasa 'ashyaa'ahum wal aa ta'thawa fi ail ardi mufsideen
Baqiyyatu aul laahi khayr llakum 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wamaa 'anaa 'al aykum bihafeez
Qaal u yaashu'aybu 'asal awaatuka tamuruka 'an nnatruka maa ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa 'aw 'an nnaf'al a fi 'amwaal inaa maa nashaa'ua ainnaka laanta aal hal eemu aur-rasheed

Qaal a yaaqawmi 'araytum 'in kuntu 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbi warazaqani minhu rizqaan hasana wamaa 'ureedu 'an 'ukhaal ifakum 'il aa maa 'anhayaakum 'anhu 'in 'ureedu 'il laa aal islaaha maa aastata'tu wamaa tawfeeqeea 'il laa bial laahi 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wail ayhi 'uneeb
Wayaaqawmi laa yajrimannakum shiqaaqeea 'any yyuseebakum mmithlu maa 'asaaba qawma noohin 'aw qawma hoodin 'aw qawma saal ih wamaa qawmu loot mminkum biba'eed
Waastaghfiru rabbakum thumma toobu 'il ayhi 'inna rabbi raheem wadood
Qaal u yaashu'aybu maa nafqahu katheera mmimmaa taqoolu wainnaa lanarayaaka feenaa da'eefa wal awlaa rahtuka larajamnaaka wamaa 'anta 'al aynaa bi'azeez
Qaal a yaaqawmi 'arahteea 'a'azzu 'al aykum mmina aal laahi waattakhazttumoohu waraa'akum zihriyyaan 'inna rabbi bimaa ta'mal oona muheeh
Wayaaqawmi ai'mal u 'al aa makaanatikum 'inni 'aamil sawfa ta'lamoona many yyateehi 'azaab yukhzeehi waman hooa kaazib waartaqibu 'inni ma'akum raqeeb
Wal ammaa jaa 'amrunaa najjaynaa shu'ayba waal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu birahmat mminnaa waakhazati ail zeena zal amu aus-sayhatu faasbahu fi deeaarihim jaathimeen
Kaal llam yaghnawa feehaa 'al aa bu'da llimadyana kamaa ba'idat thamood
Wal aqad 'arsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa wasul taam mmubeen
'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi faattaba'u 'amra fir'awna wamaa 'amru fir'awna birasheed
Yaqdumu qawmahu yawma aal qeeaamati faawradahumu aun-naara wabeesa aal wirdu aul mawrood
Wautbi'u fi haazihi la'nat wayawma aal qeeaamati beesa aar-rifdu aul marfood
Zaal ika min 'anbaa'i ail quraa naqussuhu 'al ayka minhaa qaa'im wahaseed
Wamaa zal amnaahum wal aakin zal amu 'anfusahum famaa 'aghnat 'anhum 'aal ihatuhumu aul ti yad'oona min dooni ail laahi min sha' llammaa jaa 'amru rabbika wamaa zaadoohum ghayra tatbeeb
Wakazaal ika 'akhzu rabbika 'izaa 'akhaza aal quraa wahya zaal imatun 'inna 'akhzahu 'al eem shadeed
'inna fi zaal ika layat lliman khaafa 'azaaba aal aakhirati zaal ika yawm mmajmoo' llaahu aun-naasu wazaal ika yawm mmashhood
Wamaa nu'akhkhiruhu 'il laa liajal mma'dood
Yawma yati laa takal lamu nafsun 'il laa biiznihi faminhum shaqeey wasa'eed
Faammaa aal zeena shaqu fafi ain-naari lahum feehaa zafeer washaheeq
Khaal ideena feehaa maa daamati ais-samaawaatu waal ardu 'il laa maa shaa'a rabbuka 'inna rabbaka fa'aal-limaa yureed
Waammaa aal zeena sa'idu fafi ail jannati khaal ideena feehaa maa daamati ais-samaawaatu waal ardu 'il laa maa shaa'a rabbuka 'ataa'an ghayra majzooz
Fal aa taku fi miryat mmimmaa ya'budu haa'ul aa'i maa ya'budoona 'il laa kamaa ya'budu 'aabaa'uhum mmin qablu wainnaa lamooaffoohum naseebahum ghayra manqoos
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba faakhtul ifa feehi wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika laqudeea baynahum wainnahum lafi shakk mminhu mureeb
Wain kul la llamaa layooaffeeannahum rabbuka 'a'maal ahum 'innahu bimaa ya'mal oona khabeer
Faastaqim kamaa 'umirta waman taaba ma'aka wal aa tatghawa 'innahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Wal aa tarkanu 'il aa aal zeena zal amu fatamassakumu aun-naaru wamaa lakum mmin dooni ail laahi min 'awleeaa'a thumma laa tunsaroon
Waaqimi ais-sal awaata tarafayi ain-nahaari wazul afa mmina aal yli 'inna aal hasanaati yuzhibna aas-sayyiaati zaal ika zikraa liz-zaakireen
Waasbir fainna aal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajra aal muhsineen

Fal awlaa kaana mina aal qurooni min qablikum 'oolu baqiyyat yanhawna 'ani ail fasaadi fi ail ardi 'il laa qal eela mmimman 'anjaynaa minhum waattaba'a aal zeena zal amu maa 'utrifu feehi wakaanu mujrimeen
Wamaa kaana rabbuka leeuhlika aal quraa bizul m waahluhaa muslihoon

Wal aw shaa'a rabbuka laja'al a aan-naasa 'ummat waahidat wal aa yazaal oona mukhtal ifeena 'il laa mar rrahima rabbuka wal izaal ika khal aqahum watammat kal imatu rabbika laamlaanna jahannama mina aal jinnati waan-naasi 'ajma'een
Wakul la nnaqussu 'al ayka min 'anbaa'i air-rusul i maa nuthabbitu bihi fu'aadaka wajaa'aka fi haazihi ail haqqu wamaw'izat wazikraa lil mu'mineen
Waqul-lil zeena laa yu'minoona aa'mal u 'al aa makaanatikum 'innaa 'aamil oona waantaziru 'innaa muntaziroon
Wal il hi ghaybu aus-samaawaati waal ardi wail ayhi yurja'u aul amru kul luhu faa'budhu watawakkal 'al ayhi wamaa rabbuka bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
'al aara til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi ail mubeen
'innaa 'anzal naahu qur'aanaan 'arabiyya lla'al lakum ta'qil oon
Nahnu naqussu 'al ayka 'ahsana aal qasasi bimaa 'awhaynaa 'il ayka haazaa aal qur'aana wain kunta min qablihi lamina aal ghaafil een
'iz qaal a yoosufu liabeehi yaabati 'inni raytu 'ahada 'ashara kawkaba waash-shamsa waal qamara raytuhum li saajideen
Qaal a yaabunayyi laa taqsus ru'yaaka 'al aa 'ikhwatika fayakeedu laka kaydaan 'inna aash-shaytaana lil insaani 'adoow mmubeen

Wakazaal ika yajtabeeka rabbuka wayu'al limuka min taweeli ail ahaadeethi wayutimmu ni'matahu 'al ayka wa'al aa 'aal i ya'qooba kamaa 'atammahaa 'al aa 'abawayka min qablu 'ibraaheema waishaaqa 'inna rabbaka 'al eemun hakeem
Llaqad kaana fi yoosufa waikhwatihi 'ayaat llis-saa'il een
'iz qaal u layoosufu waakhoohu 'ahabbu 'il aa 'abeenaa minnaa wanahnu 'usbatun 'inna 'abaanaa lafi dal aal mmubeen
Auqtul u yoosufa 'awi aitrahoohu 'arda yakhlu lakum wajhu 'abeekum watakoonu mim ba'dihi qawma saal iheen
Qaal a qaa'il mminhum laa taqtul u yoosufa waal qoohu fi ghayaabaati ail jubbi yal taqithu ba'du aus-sayyaarati 'in kuntum faa'il een
Qaal u yaabaanaa maa laka laa tamannaa 'al aa yoosufa wainnaa lahu lanaasihoon
'arsil hu ma'anaa ghada yarta'i wayal'ab wainnaa lahu lahaafizoon
Qaal a 'inni layuhzinuneea 'an tazhabu bihi waakhaafu 'any yyakul ahu auz-zeebu waantum 'anhu ghaafil oon
Qaal u la'in 'akal ahu auz-zeebu wanahnu 'usbatun 'innaa 'iza llakhaasiroon
Fal ammaa zahabu bihi waajma'u 'any yyaj'al oohu fi ghayaabaati ail jubbi waawhaynaa 'il ayhi latunabbeeannahum biamrihim haazaa wahum laa yash'uroon
Wajaa'oo 'abaahum 'ishaa' yabkoon
Qaal u yaabaanaa 'innaa zahabnaa nastabiqu wataraknaa yoosufa 'inda mataa'inaa faakal ahu auz-zeebu wamaa 'anta bimu'mil llanaa wal aw kunnaa saadiqeen
Wajaa'oo 'al aa qameesihi bidam kazib qaal a bal sawwal at lakum 'anfusukum 'amra fasabr jameel waal laahu aul musta'aanu 'al aa maa tasifoon
Wajaa'at sayyaarat faarsal u waaridahum faadlaa dal wahu qaal a yaabushraya haazaa ghul aam waasarroohu bidaa'at waal laahu 'al eemu bimaa ya'mal oon
Washarawhu bithamani bakhs daraahima ma'doodat wakaanu feehi mina aaz-zaahideen

Waqaal a aal zi aishtarayaahu mim mmisra liamraatihi 'akrimi mathwayaahu 'asaa 'any yyanfa'anaa 'aw nattakhizahu wal ada wakazaal ika makkannaa leeoosufa fi ail ardi wal inu'al limahu min taweeli ail ahaadeethi waal laahu ghaal ibun 'al aa 'amrihi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wal ammaa bal agha 'ashuddahu 'aataynaahu hukma wa'il ma wakazaal ika najzi ail muhsineen
Waraawadathu aul ti hooa fi baytihaa 'an nnafsihi waghal laqati ail abwaaba waqaal at heeta laka qaal a ma'aaza aal laahi 'innahu rabbeea 'ahsana mathwaya 'innahu laa yuflihu auz-zaal imoon
Wal aqad hammat bihi wahamma bihaa lawlaa 'ar rra'aa burhaana rabbihi kazaal ika linasrifa 'anhu aus-sooaa'a waal fahshaa'a annahu min 'ibaadinaa aal mukhlaseen
Waastabaqaa aal baaba waqaddat qameesahu min dubur waal fayaa sayyidahaa ladaa aal baabi qaal at maa jazaa'u man 'araada biahlika sooaa'aan 'il laa 'any yyusjana 'aw 'azaabun 'al eem
Qaal a heea raawadatni 'an nnafsi washahida shaahid mmin 'ahlihaa 'in kaana qameesuhu qudda min qubul fasadaqat wahwa mina aal kaazibeen
Wain kaana qameesuhu qudda min dubur fakazabat wahwa mina aas-saadiqeen
Fal ammaa ra'aa qameesahu qudda min dubur qaal a 'innahu min kaydikunna 'inna kaydakunna 'azeem
Yoosufu 'a'rid 'an haazaa waastaghfiri lizanbiki 'innaki kunti mina aal khaatieen
Waqaal a niswat fi ail madeenati aimraatu aul'azeezi turaawidu fatayaahaa 'an nnafsihi qad shaghafahaa hubbaan 'innaa lanarayaahaa fi dal aal mmubeen

Fal ammaa sami'at bimakrihinna 'arsal at 'il ayhinna waa'tadat lahunna muttakaa wa'aatat kul la waahidat mminhunna sikkeena waqaal atu aukhruj 'al ayhinna fal ammaa raynahu 'akbarnahu waqatta'na 'aydeeahunna waqul na haasha lil hi maa haazaa basharaan 'in haazaa 'il laa mal ak kareem
Qaal at fazaal ikunna aal zi lumtunnani feehi wal aqad raawadttuhu 'an nnafsihi faasta'sama wal a'il llam yaf'al maa 'aamuruhu layusjananna wal ayakoona mmina aas-saaghireen
Qaal a rabbi ais-sijnu 'ahabbu 'il ayya mimmaa yad'oonani 'il ayhi wail laa tasrif 'anni kaydahunna 'asbu 'il ayhinna waakum mmina aal jaahil een
Faastajaaba lahu rabbuhu fasarafa 'anhu kaydahunna 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Thumma badaa lahum mmim ba'di maa raawua aul ayaati layasjununnahu hattaa heen

Wadakhal a ma'ahu aus-sijna fatayaani qaal a 'ahaduhumaa 'inneea 'arayaaneea 'a'siru khamra waqaal a aal aakharu 'inneea 'arayaaneea 'ahmil u fawqa rasi khubza takul u aut-tayru minhu nabbeenaa bitaweelihi 'innaa narayaaka mina aal muhsineen

Qaal a laa yateekumaa ta'aam turzaqaanihi 'il laa nabbatukumaa bitaweelihi qabla 'any yyateeakumaa zaal ikumaa mimmaa 'al lamani rabbeea 'inni taraktu mil lata qawm llaa yu'minoona bial laahi wahum bial aakhirati hum kaafiroon

Waattaba'tu mil lata 'aabaa'eea 'ibraaheema waishaaqa waya'qooba maa kaana lanaa 'an nnushrika bial laahi min sha' zaal ika min fadli ail laahi 'al aynaa wa'al aa aan-naasi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Yaasaahibayi ais-sijni 'aarbaab mmutafarriqoona khayrun 'ami ail laahu aul waahidu aul qahhaar

Maa ta'budoona min doonihi 'il laa 'asmaa' sammaytumoohaa 'antum wa'aabaa'ukum mmaa 'anzal a aal laahu bihaa min sul taanin 'ini ail hukmu 'il laa lil hi 'amara 'al laa ta'budu 'il laa 'iyyaahu zaal ika aad-deenu aul qayyimu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Yaasaahibayi ais-sijni 'ammaa 'ahadukumaa fayasqi rabbahu khamra waammaa aal aakharu fayuslabu fatakul u aut-tayru mir rrasihi qudeea aal amru aul zi feehi tastafteeaan
Waqaal a lil zi zanna 'annahu naaj mminhumaa aazkurni 'inda rabbika faansayaahu aush-shaytaanu zikra rabbihi fal abitha fi ais-sijni bid'a sineen

Waqaal a aal mal iku 'inneea 'araa sab'a baqaraat simaany yakul uhunna sab'un 'ijaaf wasab'a sunbul aatin khudr waukhara yaabisaat yayyuhaa aal mal au aaftooni fi ru'yaya 'in kuntum lir-ru'yaa ta'buroon
Qaal u 'adghaathu 'ahlaam wamaa nahnu bitaweeli ail ahlaami bi'aal imeen
Waqaal a aal zi najaa minhumaa waaddakara ba'da 'ummatin 'anaa 'unabbeeukum bitaweelihi faarsil oon
Yoosufu 'ayyuhaa aas-siddeequ 'aftinaa fi sab'i baqaraat simaany yakul uhunna sab'un 'ijaaf wasab'i sunbul aatin khudr waukhara yaabisaat lla'al leea 'arji'u 'il aa aan-naasi la'al laahum ya'lamoon
Qaal a tazra'oona sab'a sineena daba famaa hasadttum fazaroohu fi sunbul ihi 'il laa qal eela mmimmaa takul oon
Thumma yati mim ba'di zaal ika sab' shidaad yakul na maa qaddamtum lahunna 'il laa qal eela mmimmaa tuhsinoon
Thumma yati mim ba'di zaal ika 'aam feehi yughaathu aun-naasu wafeehi ya'siroon
Waqaal a aal mal iku auytooni bihi fal ammaa jaa'ahu aur-rasoolu qaal a aarji' 'il aa rabbika fasal hu maa baal u aun-niswati ail laati qatta'na 'aydeeahunna 'inna rabbi bikaydihinna 'al eem

Qaal a maa khatbukunna 'iz raawadttunna yoosufa 'an nnafsihi qul na haasha lil hi maa 'al imnaa 'al ayhi min sooaa' qaal ati aimraatu aul'azeezi ai'al aana hashasa aal haqqu 'anaa raawadttuhu 'an nnafsihi wainnahu lamina aas-saadiqeen
Zaal ika leea'lama 'anni lam 'akhunhu bial ghaybi waanna aal laaha laa yahdi kayda aal khaa'ineen
Wamaa 'ubarriu nafseea 'inna aan-nafsa laammaaratu bias-soowi 'il laa maa rahima rabbeea 'inna rabbi ghafoor rraheem
Waqaal a aal mal iku auytooni bihi 'astakhlishu linafsi fal ammaa kal lamahu qaal a 'innaka aal yawma ladaynaa makeenun 'ameen
Qaal a aaj'al ni 'al aa khazaa'ini ail ardi 'inni hafeezun 'al eem
Wakazaal ika makkannaa leeoosufa fi ail ardi yatabawwau minhaa haythu yashaa'u nuseebu birahmatinaa man nnashaa'u wal aa nudee'u 'ajra aal muhsineen
Wal aajru aul aakhirati khayr llil zeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Wajaa'a akhwatu yoosufa fadakhal u 'al ayhi fa'arafahum wahum lahu munkiroon
Wal ammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim qaal a aytooni biakh llakum mmin 'abeekum 'al aa tarawna 'anneea 'oofi ail kayla waanaa khayru aul munzil een
Fail llam tatooni bihi fal aa kayla lakum 'indi wal aa taqraboon
Qaal u sanuraawidu 'anhu 'abaahu wainnaa lafaa'il oon
Waqaal a lifityatihi aij'al u bidaa'atahum fi rihaal ihim la'al laahum ya'rifoonahaa 'izaa aanqal abu 'il aa 'ahlihim la'al laahum yarji'oon
Fal ammaa raja'u 'il aa 'abeehim qaal u yaabaanaa muni'a minnaa aal kaylu faarsil ma'anaa 'akhaanaa naktal wainnaa lahu lahaafizoon
Qaal a hal 'aamanukum 'al ayhi 'il laa kamaa 'amintukum 'al aa 'akheehi min qablu faal laahu khayrun hifza wahwa 'arhamu aur-raahimeen

Wal ammaa fatahu mataa'ahum wajadu bidaa'atahum ruddat 'il ayhim qaal u yaabaanaa maa nabghi haazihi bidaa'atunaa ruddat 'il aynaa wanameeru 'ahlanaa wanahfazu 'akhaanaa wanazdaadu kayla ba'eer zaal ika kayl yaseer
Qaal a lan 'ursil ahu ma'akum hattaa tu'tooni mawthiqa mmina aal laahi latatunnani bihi 'il laa 'any yyuhaata bikum fal ammaa 'aatawhu mawthiqahum qaal a aal laahu 'al aa maa naqoolu wakeel

Waqaal a yaabaniyya laa tadkhul u mim baab waahid waadkhul u min 'abwaab mmutafarriqat wamaa 'ughni 'ankum mmina aal laahi min sha'in 'ini ail hukmu 'il laa lil hi 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wa'al ayhi fal yatawakkal i ail mutawakkil oon

Wal ammaa dakhal u min haythu 'amarahum 'aboohum mmaa kaana yughni 'anhum mmina aal laahi min sha'in 'il laa haajat fi nafsi ya'qooba qadayaahaa wainnahu lazoo 'il m llimaa 'al lamnaahu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wal ammaa dakhal u 'al aa yoosufa 'aawaa 'il ayhi 'akhaahu qaal a 'inneea 'anaa 'akhooka fal aa tabta'is bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Fal ammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim ja'al a aas-siqayata fi rahli 'akheehi thumma 'azzana mu'azzinun 'ayyatuhaa aal'eeru 'innakum lasaariqoon
Qaal u waaqbal u 'al ayhim mmaazaa tafqidoon
Qaal u nafqidu sooaa'a aal mal iki wal iman jaa'a bihi himlu ba'eer waanaa bihi za'eem
Qaal u taal laahi laqad 'al imtum mmaa jeenaa linufsida fi ail ardi wamaa kunnaa saariqeen
Qaal u famaa jazaa'uhu 'in kuntum kaazibeen
Qaal u jazaa'uhu manw wwujida fi rahlihi fahwa jazaa'uhu kazaal ika najzi aiz-zaal imeen

Fabadaa biaw'eeatihim qabla wi'aa'i aakheehi thumma aastakhrajahaa minw wwi'aa'i aakheehi kazaal ika kidnaa leeoosufa maa kaana leeakhuza 'akhaahu fi deeni ail mal iki 'il laa 'any yyashaa'a aal laahu narfa'u darajaati man nnashaa'u wafawqa kul li zi 'il min 'al eem
Qaal u 'iny yyasriq faqad saraqa 'akh llaahu min qablu faasarrahaa yoosufu fi nafsihi wal am yubdihaa lahum qaal a 'antum sharr mmakaana waal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa tasifoon
Qaal u yayyuhaa aal'azeezu 'inna lahu 'aba shaykha kabeera fakhuz 'ahadanaa makaanahu 'innaa narayaaka mina aal muhsineen
Qaal a ma'aaza aal laahi 'an nnakhuza 'il laa manw wwajadnaa mataa'anaa 'indahu 'innaa 'iza llazaal imoon

Fal ammaa aastayasu minhu khal asu najiyya qaal a kabeeruhum 'al am ta'lamu 'anna 'abaakum qad 'akhaza 'al aykum mmawthiqa mmina aal laahi wamin qablu maa farratttum fi yoosufa fal an 'abraha aal arda hattaa yazana leea 'abeea 'aw yahkuma aal laahu li wahwa khayru aul haakimeen
Aarji'u 'il aa 'abeekum faqoolu yaabaanaa 'inna aabnaka saraqa wamaa shahidnaa 'il laa bimaa 'al imnaa wamaa kunnaa lil ghaybi haafizeen
Wasal i ail qaryata aal ti kunnaa feehaa waal'eera aal ti 'aqbal naa feehaa wainnaa lasaadiqoon
Qaal a bal sawwal at lakum 'anfusukum 'amra fasabr jameelun 'asaa aal laahu 'any yyateeani bihim jamee'aan 'innahu hooa aal'al eemu aul hakeem
Watawal laa 'anhum waqaal a yaasafaa 'al aa yoosufa waabyaddat 'aynaahu mina aal huzni fahwa kazeem
Qaal u taal laahi tafta'ua tazkuru yoosufa hattaa takoona haradaan 'aw takoona mina aal haal ikeen
Qaal a 'innamaa 'ashku baththi wahuzneea 'il aa aal laahi waa'lamu mina aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Yaabaniyya aazhabu fatahassasu miny yyoosufa waakheehi wal aa tayasu mir rrawhi ail laahi 'innahu laa yayasu mir rrawhi ail laahi 'il laa aal qawmu aul kaafiroon
Fal ammaa dakhal u 'al ayhi qaal u yayyuhaa aal'azeezu massanaa waahlanaa aad-durru wajeenaa bibidaa'at mmuzjayaat faawfi lanaa aal kayla watasaddaq 'al aynaa 'inna aal laaha yajzi ail mutasaddiqeen
Qaal a hal 'al imtum mmaa fa'al tum beeoosufa waakheehi 'iz 'antum jaahil oon
Qaal u 'aannaka laanta yoosufu qaal a 'anaa yoosufu wahaazaa 'akhi qad manna aal laahu 'al aynaa 'innahu many yyattaqi wayasbir fainna aal laaha laa yudee'u 'ajra aal muhsineen
Qaal u taal laahi laqad 'aatharaka aal laahu 'al aynaa wain kunnaa lakhaatieen
Qaal a laa tathreeba 'al aykumu aul yawma yaghfiru aul laahu lakum wahwa 'arhamu aur-raahimeen
Aazhabu biqameesi haazaa faal qoohu 'al aa wajhi 'abi yati baseera watooni biahlikum 'ajma'een
Wal ammaa fasal ati ail'eeru qaal a 'aboohum 'inni laajidu reeha yoosufa lawlaa 'an tufannidoon
Qaal u taal laahi 'innaka lafi dal aal ika aal qadeem
Fal ammaa 'an jaa'a aal basheeru 'al qayaahu 'al aa wajhihi faartadda baseera qaal a 'al am 'aqul-lakum 'inneea 'a'lamu mina aal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qaal u yaabaanaa aastaghfir lanaa zunoobanaa 'innaa kunnaa khaatieen
Qaal a sawfa 'astaghfiru lakum rabbeea 'innahu hooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Fal ammaa dakhal u 'al aa yoosufa 'aawaa 'il ayhi 'abawayhi waqaal a aadkhul u misra 'in shaa'a aal laahu 'aamineen

Warafa'a 'abawayhi 'al aa aal'arshi wakharru lahu sujjada waqaal a yaabati haazaa taweelu ru'yaya min qablu qad ja'al ahaa rabbi haqqa waqad 'ahsana beea 'iz 'akhrajani mina aas-sijni wajaa'a bikum mmina aal badwi mim ba'di 'an nnazagha aash-shaytaanu bayni wabayna 'ikhwati 'inna rabbi lateef llimaa yashaa'u ainnahu hooa aal'al eemu aul hakeem
Rabbi qad 'aataytani mina aal mul ki wa'al lamtani min taweeli ail ahaadeethi faatira aas-samaawaati waal ardi 'anta wal eeyi fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati tawaffani muslima waal hiqni bias-saal iheen
Zaal ika min 'anbaa'i ail ghaybi nooheehi 'il ayka wamaa kunta ladayhim 'iz 'ajma'u 'amrahum wahum yamkuroon
Wamaa 'aktharu aun-naasi wal aw harasta bimu'mineen
Wamaa tasal uhum 'al ayhi min 'ajrin 'in hooa 'il laa zikr llil'aal ameen
Wakayyim mmin 'ayat fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi yamurroona 'al ayhaa wahum 'anhaa mu'ridoon
Wamaa yu'minu 'aktharuhum bial laahi 'il laa wahum mmushrikoon
'afaaminu 'an tateeahum ghaasheeat mmin 'azaabi ail laahi 'aw tateeahumu aus-saa'atu baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Qul haazihi sabeeleea 'ad'u 'il aa aal laahi 'al aa baseeratin 'anaa wamani aittaba'ani wasubhaana aal laahi wamaa 'anaa mina aal mushrikeen

Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika 'il laa rijaal a yoohaa 'il ayhim mmin 'ahli ail quraa 'afal am yaseeru fi ail ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim wal adaaru aul aakhirati khayr llil zeena aattaqawa 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Hattaa 'izaa aastayasa aar-rusul u wazannu 'annahum qad kuzzibu jaa'ahum nasrunaa fanuji man nnashaa'u wal aa yuraddu basunaa 'ani ail qawmi ail mujrimeen
Laqad kaana fi qasasihim 'ibrat lliooli ail al baabi maa kaana hadeetha yuftaraa wal aakin tasdeeqa aal zi bayna yadayhi watafseela kul li sha' wahuda warahmat lliqawm yu'minoon
'al aammiaara til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi waal zi 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika aal haqqu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yu'minoon

Aal laahu aul zi rafa'a aas-samaawaati bighayri 'amad tarawnahaa thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi wasakhkhara aash-shamsa waal qamara kul l yajri liajal mmusamma yudabbiru aul amra yufassil u aul ayaati la'al lakum bil iqaa'i rabbikum tooqinoon

Wahwa aal zi madda aal arda waja'al a feehaa rawaaseea waanhaara wamin kul li aith-thamaraati ja'al a feehaa zawjayni aithnayni yughshi ail yla aan-nahaara 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon

Wafi ail ardi qita' mmutajaawiraat wajannaat mmin 'a'naab wazar' wanakheel sinwaanw waghayri sinwaan tusqaa bimaa' waahid wanufaddil u ba'dahaa 'al aa ba'd fi ail ukli 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wain ta'jab fa'ajab qawluhum 'aazaa kunnaa turaabaan 'innaa lafi khal q jadeed
'ul aa'ika aal zeena kafaru birabbihim waul aa'ika aal aghlaal u fi 'a'naaqihim waul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wayasta'jil oonaka bias-sayyeeati qabla aal hasanati waqad khal at min qablihimu aul mathul aatu wainna rabbaka lazoo maghfirat llin-naasi 'al aa zul mihim wainna rabbaka lashadeedu aul'iqaab
Wayaqoolu aul zeena kafaru lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi 'innamaa 'anta munzir wal ikul li qawmin haad
Ail laahu ya'lamu maa tahmil u kul lu 'unthaa wamaa tagheedu aul arhaamu wamaa tazdaadu wakul lu sha'in 'indahu bimiqdaar
'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati ail kabeeru aul muta'aal
Sawaa' mminkum mman 'asarra aal qawla waman jahara bihi waman hooa mustakhfi bial yli wasaaribu bian-nahaar

Lahu mu'aqqibaat mmim bayni yadayhi wamin khal fihi yahfazoonahu min 'amri ail laahi 'inna aal laaha laa yughayyiru maa biqawmin hattaa yughayyiru maa bianfusihim waizaa 'araada aal laahu biqawm sooaa'a fal aa maradda lahu wamaa lahum mmin doonihi minw wwaal
Hooa aal zi yureekumu aul barqa khawfa watama'a wayunshiu aus-sahaaba aath-thiqaal
Wayusabbihu aur-ra'du bihamdihi waal mal aa'ikatu min kheefatihi wayursil u aus-sawaa'iqa fayuseebu bihaa many yyashaa'u wahum yujaadil oona fi ail laahi wahwa shadeedu aul mihaal

Lahu da'watu aul haqqi waal zeena yad'oona min doonihi laa yastajeeboona lahum bisha'in 'il laa kabaasiti kaffayhi 'il aa aal maa'i leeablugha faahu wamaa hooa bibaal ighihi wamaa du'aa'u aul kaafireena 'il laa fi dal aal
Wal il hi yasjudu man fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi taw'a wakarha wazil aal uhum bial ghudoowi waal aasaal

Qul mar rrabbu aus-samaawaati waal ardi qul i ail laahu qul 'afaattakhazttum mmin doonihi 'awleeaa'a laa yamlikoona lianfusihim naf'a wal aa darra qul hal yastawi ail a'maa waal baseeru 'am hal tastawi aiz-zul umaatu waan-noor
'am ja'al u lil hi shurakaa'a khal aqu kakhal qihi fatashaabaha aal khal qu 'al ayhim qul i ail laahu khaal iqu kul li sha' wahwa aal waahidu aul qahhaar

'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' fasaal at 'awdeeatu biqadarihaa faahtamal a aas-saylu zabada rraabeea wamimmaa tooqidoona 'al ayhi fi ain-naari aibtighaa'a hil yatin 'aw mataa' zabad mmithluhu kazaal ika yadribu aul laahu aul haqqa waal baatil a faammaa aaz-zabadu fayazhabu jufaa' waammaa maa yanfa'u aun-naasa fayamkuthu fi ail ardi kazaal ika yadribu aul laahu aul amthaal

Lil zeena aastajaabu lirabbihimu aul husnaa waal zeena lam yastajeebu lahu law 'anna lahum mmaa fi ail ardi jamee'a wamithlahu ma'ahu laaftadawa bihi 'ul aa'ika lahum sooaa'u aul hisaabi wamawayaahum jahannamu wabeesa aal mihaad
'afamany yya'lamu 'annamaa 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika aal haqqu kaman hooa 'a'maa 'innamaa yatazakkaru 'oolu aul al baab
Ail zeena yoofoona bi'ahdi ail laahi wal aa yanqudoona aal meethaaq
Waal zeena yasil oona maa 'amara aal laahu bihi 'any yyoosal a wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhaafoona sooaa'a aal hisaab
Waal zeena sabaru aubtighaa'a wajhi rabbihim waaqaamu aus-sal awaata waanfaqu mimmaa razaqnaahum sirra wa'al aaneeat wayadra'oona bial hasanati ais-sayyeeata 'ul aa'ika lahum 'uqbaa aad-daar

Jannaatu 'adn yadkhul oonahaa waman sal aha min 'aabaa'ihim waazwaajihim wazurriyyaatihim waal mal aa'ikatu yadkhul oona 'al ayhim mmin kul li baab sal aamun 'al aykum bimaa sabartum fani'ma 'uqbaa aad-daar
Waal zeena yanqudoona 'ahda aal laahi mim ba'di meethaaqihi wayaqta'oona maa 'amara aal laahu bihi 'any yyoosal a wayufsidoona fi ail ardi 'ul aa'ika lahumu aul la'natu wal ahum sooaa'u aud-daar
Ail laahu yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru wafarihu bial hayawaati aid-dunyaa wamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunyaa fi ail aakhirati 'il laa mataa'
Wayaqoolu aul zeena kafaru lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayat mmir rrabbihi qul 'inna aal laaha yudil lu many yyashaa'u wayahdi 'il ayhi man 'anaab
Aal zeena 'aamanu watatma'innu qul oobuhum bizikri ail laahi 'al aa bizikri ail laahi tatma'innu aul qul oob
Aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati toobaa lahum wahusnu maab

Kazaal ika 'arsal naaka fi 'ummat qad khal at min qablihaa 'umam llitatlooaa 'al ayhimu aul zi 'awhaynaa 'il ayka wahum yakfuroona biar-rahmaani qul hooa rabbi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wail ayhi mataab

Wal aw 'anna qur'aana suyyirat bihi ail jibaal u 'aw qutti'at bihi ail ardu 'aw kul lima bihi ail mawtaa bal-lil hi ail amru jamee'aan 'afal am yayasi ail zeena 'aamanu 'al llaw yashaa'u aul laahu lahadaa aan-naasa jamee'a wal aa yazaal u aul zeena kafaru tuseebuhum bimaa sana'u qaari'atun 'aw tahul lu qareeba mmin daarihim hattaa yateea wa'du aul laahi 'inna aal laaha laa yukhlifu aul mee'aad
Wal aqadu austuhzia birusul mmin qablika faamlaytu lil zeena kafaru thumma 'akhazttuhum fakayfa kaana 'iqaab

'afaman hooa qaa'imun 'al aa kul li nafsi bimaa kasabat waja'al u lil hi shurakaa'a qul sammoohum 'am tunabbioonahu bimaa laa ya'lamu fi ail ardi 'am bizaahir mmina aal qawli bal zuyyina lil zeena kafaru makruhum wasaddu 'ani ais-sabeeli wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu min haad
Llaahum 'azaab fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wal a'azaabu aul aakhirati 'ashaqqu wamaa lahum mmina aal laahi minw wwaaq
Mmathal u aul jannati ail ti wu'ida aal muttaqoona tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru 'ukluhaa daa'im wazil luhaa til ka 'uqbaa aal zeena aattaqa wwa'uqbaa aal kaafireena aan-naar

Waal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba yafrahoona bimaa 'unzil a 'il ayka wamina aal ahzaabi many yyunkiru ba'dahu qul 'innamaa 'umirtu 'an 'a'buda aal laaha wal aa 'ushrika bihi 'il ayhi 'ad'u wail ayhi maab
Wakazaal ika 'anzal naahu hukmaan 'arabiyya wal a'ini aittaba'ta 'ahwaa'ahum ba'da maa jaa'aka mina aal'il mi maa laka mina aal laahi minw wwal eey wal aa waaq
Wal aqad 'arsal naa rusul a mmin qablika waja'al naa lahum 'azwaaja wazurriyyat wamaa kaana lirasoolin 'any yyateea biayatin 'il laa biizni ail laahi likul li 'ajal kitaab
Yamhu aul laahu maa yashaa'u wayuthabbitu wa'indahu 'ummu aul kitaab
Waim mmaa nureeannaka ba'da aal zi na'iduhum 'aw natawaffayannaka fainnamaa 'al ayka aal bal aaghu wa'al aynaa aal hisaab
'awal am yarawa 'annaa nati ail arda nanqusuhaa min 'atraafihaa waal laahu yahkumu laa mu'aqqiba lihukmihi wahwa saree'u aul hisaab
Waqad makara aal zeena min qablihim fal il hi ail makru jamee'a ya'lamu maa taksibu kul lu nafs wasaya'lamu aul kaafiru liman 'uqbaa aad-daar
Wayaqoolu aul zeena kafaru lasta mursal a qul kafaa bial laahi shaheedaa bayni wabaynakum waman 'indahu 'il mu aul kitaab
'al aara kitaabun 'anzal naahu 'il ayka litukhrija aan-naasa mina aaz-zul umaati 'il aa aan-noor
Biizni rabbihim 'il aa siraati ail'azeezi ail hameed
Ail laahu aul zi lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wawayl llil kaafireena min 'azaab shadeed
Ail zeena yastahibboona aal hayawaata aad-dunyaa 'al aa aal aakhirati wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwajaan 'ul aa'ika fi dal aal i ba'eed
Wamaa 'arsal naa mir rrasoolin 'il laa bil isaani qawmihi leeubayyina lahum fayudil lu aul laahu many yyashaa'u wayahdi many yyashaa'u wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Wal aqad 'arsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa 'an 'akhrij qawmaka mina aaz-zul umaati 'il aa aan-noor
Wazakkirhum biayyyaami ail laahi 'inna fi zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbaar shakoor

Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi aizkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykum 'iz 'anjayaakum mmin 'aal i fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooaa'a aal'azaabi wayuzabbihoona 'abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum wafi zaal ikum bal aa' mmir rrabbikum 'azeem
Waiz taazzana rabbukum la'in shakartum laazeedannakum wal a'in kafartum 'inna 'azaabi lashadeed
Waqaal a moosaa 'in takfuru 'antum waman fi ail ardi jamee'a fainna aal laaha laghaneeyun hameed
'al am yatikum naba'ua aul zeena min qablikum qawmi nooh wa'aad wathamood

Waal zeena mim ba'dihim laa ya'lamuhum 'il laa aal laahu jaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati faraddu 'aydeeahum fi 'afwaahihim waqaal u 'innaa kafarnaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi wainnaa lafi shakk mmimmaa tad'oonanaa 'il ayhi mureeb

Qaal at rusul uhum 'afi ail laahi shakk faatiri ais-samaawaati waal ardi yad'ookum leeaghfira lakum mmin zunoobikum wayu'akhkhirakum 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma qaal u 'in 'antum 'il laa bashar mmithlunaa tureedoona 'an tasuddoonaa 'ammaa kaana ya'budu 'aabaa'unaa fatoonaa bisul taam mmubeen

Qaal at lahum rusul uhum 'in nnahnu 'il laa bashar mmithlukum wal aakinna aal laaha yamunnu 'al aa many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wamaa kaana lanaa 'an nnateeakum bisul taanin 'il laa biizni ail laahi wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail mu'minoon
Wamaa lanaa 'al laa natawakkal a 'al aa aal laahi waqad hadayaanaa subul anaa wal anasbiranna 'al aa maa 'aazaytumoonaa wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail mutawakkil oon
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lirusul ihim lanukhrijannakum mmin 'ardinaa 'aw lata'oodunna fi mil latinaa faawhaa 'il ayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna aaz-zaal imeen
Wal anuskinannakumu aul arda mim ba'dihim zaal ika liman khaafa maqaami wakhaafa wa'eed
Waastaftahu wakhaaba kul lu jabbaarin 'aneed
Mminw wwaraa'ihi jahannamu wayusqaa mim mmaa' sadeed
Yatajarra'uhu wal aa yakaadu yuseeghuhu wayateehi ail mawtu min kul li makaanw wamaa hooa bimayyit waminw wwaraa'ihi 'azaabun ghal eez
Mmathal u aul zeena kafaru birabbihim 'a'maal uhum karamaadin aishtaddat bihi air-reeaahu fi yawmin 'aasif llaa yaqdiroona mimmaa kasabu 'al aa sha' zaal ika hooa aad-dal aal u aul ba'eed
'al am tara 'anna aal laaha khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda bial haqqi 'iny yyasha yuzhibkum wayati bikhal q jadeed wamaa zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi bi'azeez

Wabarazu lil hi jamee'a faqaal a aad-du'afaa'ua lil zeena aastakbaru 'innaa kunnaa lakum taba'a fahal 'antum mmughnoona 'annaa min 'azaabi ail laahi min sha' qaal u law hadayaanaa aal laahu lahadaynaakum sawaa'un 'al aynaa 'ajazi'naa 'am sabarnaa maa lanaa mim mmahees

Waqaal a aash-shaytaanu lammaa qudeea aal amru 'inna aal laaha wa'adakum wa'da aal haqqi wawa'adttukum faakhlaftukum wamaa kaana li 'al aykum mmin sul taanin 'il laa 'an da'awtukum faastajabtum li fal aa tal oomooni wal oomu 'anfusakum mmaa 'anaa bimusrikhikum wamaa 'antum bimusrikhiyya 'inni kafartu bimaa 'ashraktumooni min qablu 'inna aaz-zaal imeena lahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Waudkhil a aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa biizni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feehaa sal aam
'al am tara kayfa daraba aal laahu mathal a kal imat tayyibat kashajarat tayyibatin 'asluhaa thaabit wafar'uhaa fi ais-samaa'
Tu'ti 'uklahaa kul la heeni biizni rabbihaa wayadribu aul laahu aul amthaal a lin-naasi la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Wamathal u kal imatin khabeethat kashajaratin khabeethatin aujtuththat min fawqi ail ardi maa lahaa min qaraar
Yuthabbitu aul laahu aul zeena 'aamanu bial qawli aith-thaabiti fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wafi ail aakhirati wayudil lu aul laahu auz-zaal imeena wayaf'al u aul laahu maa yashaa'
Aal am tara 'il aa aal zeena baddal u ni'mata aal laahi kufra waahal lu qawmahum daara aal bawaar
Jahannama yaslawnahaa wabeesa aal qaraar
Waja'al u lil hi 'andaada lleeudil lu 'an sabeelihi qul tamatta'u fainna maseerakum 'il aa aan-naar
Qul-li'ibaadeea aal zeena 'aamanu yuqeemu aus-sal awaata wayunfiqu mimmaa razaqnaahum sirra wa'al aaneeat mmin qabli 'any yyateea yawm llaa bay' feehi wal aa khil aal

Ail laahu aul zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda waanzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faakhraja bihi mina aath-thamaraati rizqa llakum wasakhkhara lakumu aul ful ka litajreea fi ail bahri biamrihi wasakhkhara lakumu aul anhaar
Wasakhkhara lakumu aush-shamsa waal qamara daa'ibayni wasakhkhara lakumu aul yla waan-nahaar
Wa'aatayaakum mmin kul li maa saal tumoohu wain ta'uddu ni'mata aal laahi laa tuhsoohaa 'inna aal insaana lazal oom kaffaar
Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu rabbi aij'al haazaa aal bal ada 'aamina waajnubni wabaniyya 'an nna'buda aal asnaam
Rabbi 'innahunna 'adlal na katheera mmina aan-naasi faman tabi'ani fainnahu minni waman 'asaani fainnaka ghafoor rraheem

Rrabbanaa 'inneea 'askantu min zurriyyati biwaadin ghayri zi zar'in 'inda baytika aal muharrami rabbanaa leeuqeemu aus-sal awaata faaj'al 'afidat mmina aan-naasi tahwi 'il ayhim waarzuqhum mmina aath-thamaraati la'al laahum yashkuroon
Rabbanaa 'innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfi wamaa nu'linu wamaa yakhfaa 'al aa aal laahi min sha' fi ail ardi wal aa fi ais-samaa'
Ail hamdu lil hi ail zi wahaba li 'al aa aal kibari 'ismaa'eela waishaaqa 'inna rabbi lasamee'u aud-du'aa'
Rabbi aij'al ni muqeema aas-sal awaati wamin zurriyyati rabbanaa wataqabbal du'aa'
Rabbanaa aaghfir li wal iwaal idayya wal il mu'mineena yawma yaqoomu aul hisaab
Wal aa tahsibanna aal laaha ghaafil aan 'ammaa ya'mal u auz-zaal imoona 'innamaa yu'akhkhiruhum leeawm tashkhasu feehi ail absaar
Muhti'eena muqni'i ru'oosihim laa yartaddu 'il ayhim tarfuhum waafidatuhum hawaa'

Waanziri ain-naasa yawma yateehimu aul'azaabu fayaqoolu aul zeena zal amu rabbanaa 'akhkhirnaa 'il aa 'ajal qareeb nnujib da'wataka wanattabi'i air-rusul a 'awal am takoonu 'aqsamtum mmin qablu maa lakum mmin zawaal
Wasakantum fi masaakini ail zeena zal amu 'anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa fa'al naa bihim wadarabnaa lakumu aul amthaal
Waqad makaru makrahum wa'inda aal laahi makruhum wain kaana makruhum litazoola minhu aul jibaal
Fal aa tahsibanna aal laaha mukhlifa wa'dihi rusul ahu 'inna aal laaha 'azeez zoo auntiqaam
Yawma tubaddal u aul ardu ghayra aal ardi waas-samaawaatu wabarazu lil hi ail waahidi ail qahhaar
Wataraa aal mujrimeena yawma'iz mmuqarraneena fi ail asfaad
Saraabeeluhum mmin qatiraanw wataghshaa wujoohahumu aun-naar
Leeajzeea aal laahu kul la nafs mmaa kasabat 'inna aal laaha saree'u aul hisaab
Haazaa bal aagh llin-naasi wal eeunzaru bihi wal eea'lamu 'annamaa hooa 'il aah waahid wal eeazzakkara 'oolu aul al baab
'al aara til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi waqur'aam mmubeen
Rrubamaa yawaddu aul zeena kafaru law kaanu muslimeen
Zarhum yakul u wayatamatta'u wayul hihimu aul amal u fasawfa ya'lamoon
Wamaa 'ahlaknaa min qaryatin 'il laa wal ahaa kitaab mma'loom
Mmaa tasbiqu min 'ummatin 'ajal ahaa wamaa yastaakhiroon
Waqaal u yayyuhaa aal zi nuzzil a 'al ayhi aiz-zikru 'innaka lamajnoon
Llawmaa tateenaa bial mal aa'ikati 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Maa tanazzal u aul mal aa'ikatu 'il laa bial haqqi wamaa kaanu 'iza mmunzareen
'innaa nahnu nazzal naa aaz-zikra wainnaa lahu lahaafizoon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa min qablika fi sheea'i ail awwal een
Wamaa yateehim mmir rrasoolin 'il laa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Kazaal ika naslukuhu fi qul oobi ail mujrimeen
Laa yu'minoona bihi waqad khal at sunnatu aul awwal een
Wal aw fatahnaa 'al ayhim baaba mmina aas-samaa'i fazal lu feehi ya'rujoon
Laqaal u 'innamaa sukkirat 'absaarunaa bal nahnu qawm mmashooroon
Wal aqad ja'al naa fi ais-samaa'i burooja wazayyannaahaa lin-naazireen
Wahafiznaahaa min kul li shaytaar rrajeem
'il laa mani aistaraqa aas-sam'a faatba'ahu shihaab mmubeen
Waal arda madadnaahaa waal qaynaa feehaa rawaaseea waanbatnaa feehaa min kul li sha' mmawzoon
Waja'al naa lakum feehaa ma'ayisha wamal llastum lahu biraaziqeen
Waim mmin sha'in 'il laa 'indanaa khazaa'inuhu wamaa nunazzil uhu 'il laa biqadar mma'loom
Waarsal naa aar-reeaaha lawaaqiha faanzal naa mina aas-samaa'i maa' faasqaynaakumoohu wamaa 'antum lahu bikhaazineen
Wainnaa lanahnu nuhyi wanumeetu wanahnu aul waarithoon
Wal aqad 'al imnaa aal mustaqdimeena minkum wal aqad 'al imnaa aal mustaakhireen
Wainna rabbaka hooa yahshuruhum 'innahu hakeemun 'al eem
Wal aqad khal aqnaa aal insaana min sal saal mmin hama mmasnoon
Waal jaanna khal aqnaahu min qablu min nnaari ais-samoom
Waiz qaal a rabbuka lil mal aa'ikati 'inni khaal iqu bashara mmin sal saal mmin hama mmasnoon
Faizaa sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi mir rroohi faqa'u lahu saajideen
Fasajada aal mal aa'ikatu kul luhum 'ajma'oon
'il laa 'ibleesa 'abaa 'any yyakoona ma'a aas-saajideen
Qaal a yaaibleesu maa laka 'al laa takoona ma'a aas-saajideen
Qaal a lam 'akul lliasjuda libasharin khal aqtahu min sal saal mmin hama mmasnoon
Qaal a faakhruj minhaa fainnaka rajeem
Wainna 'al ayka aal la'nata 'il aa yawmi aid-deen
Qaal a rabbi faanzirni 'il aa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaal a fainnaka mina aal munzareen
'il aa yawmi ail waqti ail ma'loom
Qaal a rabbi bimaa 'aghwaytani lauzayyinanna lahum fi ail ardi wal aughweeannahum 'ajma'een
'il laa 'ibaadaka minhumu aul mukhlaseen
Qaal a haazaa siraatun 'al ayya mustaqeem
'inna 'ibaadi laysa laka 'al ayhim sul taanun 'il laa mani aittaba'aka mina aal ghaaween
Wainna jahannama lamaw'iduhum 'ajma'een
Lahaa sab'atu 'abwaab llikul li baab mminhum juz' mmaqsoom
'inna aal muttaqeena fi jannaat wa'uyoon
Audkhul oohaa bisal aamin 'aamineen
Wanaza'naa maa fi sudoorihim mmin ghil lin 'ikhwaanaan 'al aa surur mmutaqaabil een
Laa yamassuhum feehaa nasab wamaa hum mminhaa bimukhrajeen
Nabbi 'ibaadeea 'anneea 'anaa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Waanna 'azaabi hooa aal'azaabu aul al eem
Wanabbeehum 'an dayfi 'ibraaheem
'iz dakhal u 'al ayhi faqaal u sal aama qaal a 'innaa minkum wajil oon
Qaal u laa tawjal 'innaa nubashshiruka bighul aamin 'al eem
Qaal a 'abashshartumooni 'al aa 'am mmassaneea aal kibaru fabima tubashshiroon
Qaal u bashsharnaaka bial haqqi fal aa takum mmina aal qaaniteen
Qaal a wamany yyaqnatu mir rrahmati rabbihi 'il laa aad-daal loon
Qaal a famaa khatbukum 'ayyuhaa aal mursal oon
Qaal u 'innaa 'ursil naa 'il aa qawm mmujrimeen
'il laa 'aal a lootin 'innaa lamunajjoohum 'ajma'een
'il laa aamraatahu qaddarnaa 'innahaa lamina aal ghaabireen
Fal ammaa jaa 'aal a lootin ail mursal oon
Qaal a 'innakum qawm mmunkaroon
Qaal u bal jeenaaka bimaa kaanu feehi yamtaroon
Waataynaaka bial haqqi wainnaa lasaadiqoon
Faasri biahlika biqit' mmina aal yli waattabi' 'adbaarahum wal aa yal tafit minkum 'ahad waamdu haythu tu'maroon
Waqadaynaa 'il ayhi zaal ika aal amra 'anna daabira haa'ul aa'i maqtoo' mmusbiheen
Wajaa 'ahlu aul madeenati yastabshiroon
Qaal a 'inna haa'ul aa'i dayfi fal aa tafdahoon
Waattaqu aul laaha wal aa tukhzoon
Qaal u 'awal am nanhaka 'ani ail'aal ameen
Qaal a haa'ul aa'i banaateea 'in kuntum faa'il een
La'amruka 'innahum lafi sakratihim ya'mahoon
Faakhazathumu aus-sayhatu mushriqeen
Faja'al naa 'aal eeahaa saafil ahaa waamtarnaa 'al ayhim hijaarat mmin sijjeel
'inna fi zaal ika layaat llil mutawassimeen
Wainnahaa labisabeel mmuqeem
'inna fi zaal ika layat llil mu'mineen
Wain kaana 'ashaabu aul aykati lazaal imeen
Faantaqamnaa minhum wainnahumaa labiimaam mmubeen
Wal aqad kazzaba 'ashaabu aul hijri ail mursal een
Wa'aataynaahum 'ayaatinaa fakaanu 'anhaa mu'rideen
Wakaanu yanhitoona mina aal jibaal i beeootaan 'aamineen
Faakhazathumu aus-sayhatu musbiheen
Famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaksiboon
Wamaa khal aqnaa aas-samaawaati waal arda wamaa baynahumaa 'il laa bial haqqi wainna aas-saa'ata laateeat faasfahi ais-safha aal jameel
'inna rabbaka hooa aal khal laaqu aul'al eem
Wal aqad 'aataynaaka sab'a mmina aal mathaani waal qur'aana aal'azeem
Laa tamuddanna 'aynayka 'il aa maa matta'naa bihi 'azwaaja mminhum wal aa tahzan 'al ayhim waakhfid janaahaka lil mu'mineen
Waqul 'inneea 'anaa aan-nazeeru aul mubeen
Kamaa 'anzal naa 'al aa aal muqtasimeen
Aal zeena ja'al u aul qur'aana 'ideen
Fawarabbika lanasal annahum 'ajma'een
'ammaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Faasda' bimaa tu'maru waa'rid 'ani ail mushrikeen
'innaa kafaynaaka aal mustahzi'een
Aal zeena yaj'al oona ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan 'aakhara fasawfa ya'lamoon
Wal aqad na'lamu 'annaka yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon
Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakum mmina aas-saajideen
Waa'bud rabbaka hattaa yateeaka aal yaqeen
'ataa 'amru aul laahi fal aa tasta'jil oohu subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Yunazzil u aul mal aa'ikata biar-roohi min 'amrihi 'al aa many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi 'an 'anziru 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa 'anaa faattaqoon
Khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda bial haqqi ta'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Khal aqa aal insaana min nnutfat faizaa hooa khaseem mmubeen
Waal an'aama khal aqahaa lakum feehaa dif' wamanaafi'u waminhaa takul oon
Wal akum feehaa jamaal un heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoon
Watahmil u 'athqaal akum 'il aa bal ad llam takoonu baal igheehi 'il laa bishiqqi ail anfusi 'inna rabbakum lara'oof rraheem
Waal khayla waal bighaal a waal hameera litarkaboohaa wazeenat wayakhluqu maa laa ta'lamoon
Wa'al aa aal laahi qasdu aus-sabeeli waminhaa jaa'ir wal aw shaa'a lahadayaakum 'ajma'een
Hooa aal zi 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' llakum mminhu sharaab waminhu shajar feehi tuseemoon
Yunbitu lakum bihi aiz-zar'a waaz-zaytoona waan-nakheela waal a'naaba wamin kul li aith-thamaraati 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Wasakhkhara lakumu aul yla waan-nahaara waash-shamsa waal qamara waan-nujooma musakhkharaati biamrihi 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wamaa zaraa lakum fi ail ardi mukhtal ifaan 'al waanuhu 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm yazzakkaroon
Wahwa aal zi sakhkhara aal bahra litakul u minhu lahma tariyya watastakhriju minhu hil yat tal basoonahaa wataraa aal ful ka mawaakhira feehi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Waal qaa fi ail ardi rawaaseea 'an tameeda bikum waanhaara wasubul a lla'al lakum tahtadoon
Wa'al aamaat wabian-najmi hum yahtadoon
'afamany yyakhluqu kamal llaa yakhluqu 'afal aa tazzakkaroon
Wain ta'uddu ni'mata aal laahi laa tuhsoohaa 'inna aal laaha laghafoor rraheem
Waal laahu ya'lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu'linoon
Waal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi laa yakhluqoona shaya wahum yukhlaqoon
'amwaatun ghayru 'ahyaa' wamaa yash'uroona 'ayyaana yub'athoon
'il aahukum 'il aah waahid faal zeena laa yu'minoona bial aakhirati qul oobuhum mmunkirat wahum mmustakbiroon
Laa jarama 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoona 'innahu laa yuhibbu aul mustakbireen
Waizaa qeela lahum mmaazaa 'anzal a rabbukum qaal u 'asaateeru aul awwal een
Leeahmil u 'awzaarahum kaamil at yawma aal qeeaamati wamin 'awzaari ail zeena yudil loonahum bighayri 'il min 'al aa saa'a maa yaziroon
Qad makara aal zeena min qablihim faataa aal laahu bunyaanahum mmina aal qawaa'idi fakharra 'al ayhimu aus-saqfu min fawqihim waatayaahumu aul'azaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
Thumma yawma aal qeeaamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu 'ayna shurakaa'eea aal zeena kuntum tushaaqqooni feehim qaal a aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma 'inna aal khizya aal yawma waas-sooaa'a 'al aa aal kaafireen
Aal zeena tatawaffayaahumu aul mal aa'ikatu zaal imi 'anfusihim faal qawua aus-sal ama maa kunnaa na'mal u min sooaa'i bal aa 'inna aal laaha 'al eemu bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Faadkhul u 'abwaaba jahannama khaal ideena feehaa fal abeesa mathwaa aal mutakabbireen
Waqeela lil zeena aattaqawa maazaa 'anzal a rabbukum qaal u khayra llil zeena 'ahsanu fi haazihi aid-dunyaa hasanat wal adaaru aul aakhirati khayr wal ani'ma daaru aul muttaqeen
Jannaatu 'adn yadkhul oonahaa tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona kazaal ika yajzi ail laahu aul muttaqeen
Aal zeena tatawaffayaahumu aul mal aa'ikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona sal aamun 'al aykumu audkhul u aul jannata bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Hal yanzuroona 'il laa 'an tateeahumu aul mal aa'ikatu 'aw yateea 'amru rabbika kazaal ika fa'al a aal zeena min qablihim wamaa zal amahumu aul laahu wal aakin kaanu 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Faasaabahum sayyiaatu maa 'amil u wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon

Waqaal a aal zeena 'ashraku law shaa'a aal laahu maa 'abadnaa min doonihi min sha' nnahnu wal aa 'aabaa'unaa wal aa harramnaa min doonihi min sha' kazaal ika fa'al a aal zeena min qablihim fahal 'al aa aar-rusul i 'il laa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen

Wal aqad ba'athnaa fi kul li 'ummat rrasoolaan 'anu au'budu aul laaha waajtanibu aut-taaghoota faminhum mman hadaa aal laahu waminhum mman haqqat 'al ayhi aid-dal aal atu faseeru fi ail ardi faanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mukazzibeen
'in tahris 'al aa hudayaahum fainna aal laaha laa yuhdaa many yyudil lu wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Waaqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihim laa yab'athu aul laahu many yyamootu bal aa wa'daan 'al ayhi haqqa wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Leeubayyina lahumu aul zi yakhtal ifoona feehi wal eea'lama aal zeena kafaru 'annahum kaanu kaazibeen
'innamaa qawlunaa lisha'in 'izaa 'aradnaahu 'an nnaqoola lahu kun fayakoon
Waal zeena haajaru fi ail laahi mim ba'di maa zul imu lanubawweeannahum fi aid-dunyaa hasanat wal aajru aul aakhirati 'akbaru law kaanu ya'lamoon
Aal zeena sabaru wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika 'il laa rijaal a yoohaa 'il ayhim fasal u 'ahla aaz-zikri 'in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Bial bayyinaati waaz-zuburi waanzal naa 'il ayka aaz-zikra litubayyina lin-naasi maa nuzzil a 'il ayhim wal a'al laahum yatafakkaroon
'afaamina aal zeena makaru aus-sayyiaati 'any yyakhsifa aal laahu bihimu aul arda 'aw yateeahumu aul'azaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
'aw yakhuzahum fi taqal lubihim famaa hum bimu'jizeen
'aw yakhuzahum 'al aa takhawwuf fainna rabbakum lara'oof rraheem
'awal am yarawa 'il aa maa khal aqa aal laahu min sha' yatafayya'ua zil aal uhu 'ani ail yameeni waash-shamaa'il i sujjada llil hi wahum daakhiroon
Wal il hi yasjudu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi min daabbat waal mal aa'ikatu wahum laa yastakbiroon
Yakhaafoona rabbahum mmin fawqihim wayaf'al oona maa yu'maroon
Waqaal a aal laahu laa tattakhizu 'il aahayni aithnayni 'innamaa hooa 'il aah waahid faiyyaya faarhaboon
Wal ahu maa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi wal ahu aud-deenu waasibaan 'afaghayra aal laahi tattaqoon
Wamaa bikum mmin nni'mat famina aal laahi thumma 'izaa massakumu aud-durru fail ayhi tajaroon
Thumma 'izaa kashafa aad-durra 'ankum 'izaa fareeq mminkum birabbihim yushrikoon
Leeakfuru bimaa 'aataynaahum fatamatta'u fasawfa ta'lamoon
Wayaj'al oona limaa laa ya'lamoona naseeba mmimmaa razaqnaahum taal laahi latusal unna 'ammaa kuntum taftaroon
Wayaj'al oona lil hi ail banaati subhaanahu wal ahum mmaa yashtahoon
Waizaa bushshira 'ahaduhum bial unthaa zal la wajhuhu muswadda wahwa kazeem
Yatawaaraa mina aal qawmi min sooaa'i maa bushshira bihi 'ayumsikuhu 'al aa hoonin 'am yadussuhu fi ait-turaabi 'al aa saa'a maa yahkumoon
Lil zeena laa yu'minoona bial aakhirati mathal u aus-saw'i wal il hi ail mathal u aul a'laa wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Wal aw yu'aakhizu aul laahu aun-naasa bizul mihim mmaa taraka 'al ayhaa min daabbat wal aakiny yyu'akhkhiruhum 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma faizaa jaa 'ajal uhum laa yastaakhiroona saa'at wal aa yastaqdimoon
Wayaj'al oona lil hi maa yakrahoona watasifu 'al sinatuhumu aul kaziba 'anna lahumu aul husnaa laa jarama 'anna lahumu aun-naara waannahum mmufritoon
Taal laahi laqad 'arsal naa 'il aa 'umam mmin qablika fazayyana lahumu aush-shaytaanu 'a'maal ahum fahwa wal eeyuhumu aul yawma wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wamaa 'anzal naa 'al ayka aal kitaaba 'il laa litubayyina lahumu aul zi aikhtal afu feehi wahuda warahmat lliqawm yu'minoon
Waal laahu 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faahyaa bihi ail arda ba'da mawtihaa 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm yasma'oon
Wainna lakum fi ail an'aami la'ibrat nnasqeekum mmimmaa fi butoonihi mim bayni farth wadam llabanaan khaal isa saa'igha llish-shaaribeen
Wamin thamaraati ain-nakheeli waal a'naabi tattakhizoona minhu sakara warizqaan hasanaan 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Waawhaa rabbuka 'il aa aan-nahli 'ani aittakhizi mina aal jibaal i beeoota wamina aash-shajari wamimmaa ya'rishoon

Thumma kul i min kul li aith-thamaraati faasluki subul a rabbiki zul ul a yakhruju mim butoonihaa sharaab mmukhtal ifun 'al waanuhu feehi shifaa' llin-naasi 'inna fi zaal ika layat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Waal laahu khal aqakum thumma yatawaffayaakum waminkum mmany yyuraddu 'il aa 'arzal i ail'umuri lika laa ya'lama ba'da 'il m shayaan 'inna aal laaha 'al eem qadeer
Waal laahu faddal a ba'dakum 'al aa ba'd fi air-rizqi famaa aal zeena fuddil u biraaddi rizqihim 'al aa maa mal akat 'aymaanuhum fahum feehi sawaa'un 'afabini'mati ail laahi yajhadoon
Waal laahu ja'al a lakum mmin 'anfusikum 'azwaaja waja'al a lakum mmin 'azwaajikum baneena wahafadat warazaqakum mmina aat-tayyibaati 'afabial baatil i yu'minoona wabini'mati ail laahi hum yakfuroon
Waya'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa laa yamliku lahum rizqa mmina aas-samaawaati waal ardi shaya wal aa yastatee'oon
Fal aa tadribu lil hi ail amthaal a 'inna aal laaha ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon

Daraba aal laahu mathal aan 'abda mmamlooka llaa yaqdiru 'al aa sha' wamar rrazaqnaahu minnaa rizqaan hasana fahwa yunfiqu minhu sirra wajahraan hal yastawuna aal hamdu lil hi bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon

Wadaraba aal laahu mathal a rrajul ayni 'ahaduhumaa 'abkamu laa yaqdiru 'al aa sha' wahwa kal lun 'al aa mawlayaahu 'aynamaa yooajjihhhu laa yati bikhayrin hal yastawi hooa wamany yyamuru bial'adli wahwa 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal il hi ghaybu aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa 'amru aus-saa'ati 'il laa kal amhi ail basari 'aw hooa 'aqrabu 'inna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Waal laahu 'akhrajakum mmim butooni 'ummahaatikum laa ta'lamoona shaya waja'al a lakumu aus-sam'a waal absaara waal afidata la'al lakum tashkuroon
'al am yarawa 'il aa aat-tayri musakhkharaat fi jawwi ais-samaa'i maa yumsikuhunna 'il laa aal laahu 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yu'minoon

Waal laahu ja'al a lakum mmim beeootikum sakana waja'al a lakum mmin jul oodi ail an'aami beeoota tastakhiffoonahaa yawma za'anikum wayawma 'iqaamatikum wamin 'aswaafihaa waawbaarihaa waash'aarihaa 'athaatha wamataa'aan 'il aa heen

Waal laahu ja'al a lakum mmimmaa khal aqa zil aal a waja'al a lakum mmina aal jibaal i 'aknaana waja'al a lakum saraabeela taqeekumu aul harra wasaraabeela taqeekum basakum kazaal ika yutimmu ni'matahu 'al aykum la'al lakum tuslimoon
Fain tawal lawa fainnamaa 'al ayka aal bal aaghu aul mubeen
Ya'rifoona ni'mata aal laahi thumma yunkiroonahaa waaktharuhumu aul kaafiroon
Wayawma nab'athu min kul li 'ummat shaheeda thumma laa yu'zanu lil zeena kafaru wal aa hum yusta'taboon
Waizaa ra'aa aal zeena zal amu aul'azaaba fal aa yukhaffafu 'anhum wal aa hum yunzaroon
Waizaa ra'aa aal zeena 'ashraku shurakaa'ahum qaal u rabbanaa haa'ul aa'i shurakaa'unaa aal zeena kunnaa nad'u min doonika faal qawa 'il ayhimu aul qawla 'innakum lakaaziboon
Waal qawa 'il aa aal laahi yawma'izin ais-sal ama wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon
Aal zeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi zidnaahum 'azaaba fawqa aal'azaabi bimaa kaanu yufsidoon

Wayawma nab'athu fi kul li 'ummat shaheedaan 'al ayhim mmin 'anfusihim wajeenaa bika shaheedaan 'al aa haa'ul aa'i wanazzal naa 'al ayka aal kitaaba tibyaana llikul li sha' wahuda warahmat wabushraa lil muslimeen
'inna aal laaha yamuru bial'adli waal ihsaani waeetaa'i zi ail qurbaa wayanhaa 'ani ail fahshaa'i waal munkari waal baghyi ya'izukum la'al lakum tazzakkaroon
Waawfu bi'ahdi ail laahi 'izaa 'aahadttum wal aa tanqudu aul aymaana ba'da tawkeedihaa waqad ja'al tumu aul laaha 'al aykum kafeelaan 'inna aal laaha ya'lamu maa taf'al oon

Wal aa takoonu kaal ti naqadat ghazlahaa mim ba'di qoowatin 'ankaatha tattakhizoona 'aymaanakum dakhal aa baynakum 'an takoona 'ummatun heea 'arbaa min 'ummatin 'innamaa yablookumu aul laahu bihi wal ayubayyinanna lakum yawma aal qeeaamati maa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
Wal aw shaa'a aal laahu laja'al akum 'ummat waahidat wal aakiny yyudil lu many yyashaa'u wayahdi many yyashaa'u wal atusal unna 'ammaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Wal aa tattakhizu 'aymaanakum dakhal aa baynakum fatazil la qadamu ba'da thubootihaa watazooqu aus-sooaa'a bimaa sadadttum 'an sabeeli ail laahi wal akum 'azaabun 'azeem
Wal aa tashtaru bi'ahdi ail laahi thamana qal eelaan 'innamaa 'inda aal laahi hooa khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Maa 'indakum yanfadu wamaa 'inda aal laahi baaq wal ayajzeeanna aal zeena sabaru 'ajrahum biahsani maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Man 'amil a saal iha mmin zakarin 'aw 'unthaa wahwa mu'min fal anuhyeeannahu hayawaat tayyibat wal anajzeeannahum 'ajrahum biahsani maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Faizaa qarata aal qur'aana faasta'iz bial laahi mina aash-shaytaani air-rajeem
'innahu laysa lahu sul taanun 'al aa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
'innamaa sul taanuhu 'al aa aal zeena yatawal lawnahu waal zeena hum bihi mushrikoon
Waizaa baddal naa 'ayat mmakaana 'ayat waal laahu 'a'lamu bimaa yunazzil u qaal u 'innamaa 'anta muftari bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Qul nazzal ahu roohu aul qudusi mir rrabbika bial haqqi leeuthabbita aal zeena 'aamanu wahuda wabushraa lil muslimeen
Wal aqad na'lamu 'annahum yaqooloona 'innamaa yu'al limuhu bashar llisaanu aul zi yul hidoona 'il ayhi 'a'jameey wahaazaa lisaanun 'arabeey mmubeen
'inna aal zeena laa yu'minoona biayaati ail laahi laa yahdeehimu aul laahu wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
'innamaa yaftari ail kaziba aal zeena laa yu'minoona biayaati ail laahi waul aa'ika humu aul kaaziboon
Man kafara bial laahi mim ba'di 'eemaanihi 'il laa man 'ukriha waqal buhu mutma'innu bial eemaani wal aakim mman sharaha bial kufri sadra fa'al ayhim ghadab mmina aal laahi wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Zaal ika biannahumu austahabbu aul hayawaata aad-dunyaa 'al aa aal aakhirati waanna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aal kaafireen
'ul aa'ika aal zeena taba'a aal laahu 'al aa qul oobihim wasam'ihim waabsaarihim waul aa'ika humu aul ghaafil oon
Laa jarama 'annahum fi ail aakhirati humu aul khaasiroon
Thumma 'inna rabbaka lil zeena haajaru mim ba'di maa futinu thumma jaahadu wasabaru 'inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoor rraheem
Yawma tati kul lu nafs tujaadil u 'an nnafsihaa watooaffaa kul lu nafs mmaa 'amil at wahum laa yuzlamoon

Wadaraba aal laahu mathal a qaryat kaanat 'aaminat mmutma'innat yateehaa rizquhaa raghada mmin kul li makaan fakafarat bian'umi ail laahi faazaaqahaa aal laahu libaasa aal joo'i waal khawfi bimaa kaanu yasna'oon
Wal aqad jaa'ahum rasool mminhum fakazzaboohu faakhazahumu aul'azaabu wahum zaal imoon
Fakul u mimmaa razaqakumu aul laahu hal aal a tayyiba waashkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'in kuntum 'iyyaahu ta'budoon
'innamaa harrama 'al aykumu aul maytata waad-dama wal ahma aal khinzeeri wamaa 'uhil la lighayri ail laahi bihi famanu audturra ghayra baagh wal aa 'aad fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Wal aa taqoolu limaa tasifu 'al sinatukumu aul kaziba haazaa hal aal wahaazaa haraam llitaftaru 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba 'inna aal zeena yaftaroona 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba laa yuflihoon
Mataa' qal eel wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wa'al aa aal zeena haadu harramnaa maa qasasnaa 'al ayka min qablu wamaa zal amnaahum wal aakin kaanu 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Thumma 'inna rabbaka lil zeena 'amil u aus-sooaa'a bijahaal at thumma taabu mim ba'di zaal ika waaslahu 'inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoor rraheem
'inna 'ibraaheema kaana 'ummat qaanita llil hi haneefa wal am yaku mina aal mushrikeen
Shaakira llian'umihi aijtabayaahu wahadayaahu 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wa'aataynaahu fi aid-dunyaa hasanat wainnahu fi ail aakhirati lamina aas-saal iheen
Thumma 'awhaynaa 'il ayka 'ani aittabi' mil lata 'ibraaheema haneefa wamaa kaana mina aal mushrikeen
'innamaa ju'il a aas-sabtu 'al aa aal zeena aakhtal afu feehi wainna rabbaka layahkumu baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Aad'u 'il aa sabeeli rabbika bial hikmati waal maw'izati ail hasanati wajaadil hum bial ti heea 'ahsanu 'inna rabbaka hooa 'a'lamu biman dal la 'an sabeelihi wahwa 'a'lamu bial muhtadeen
Wain 'aaqabtum fa'aaqibu bimithli maa 'ooqibtum bihi wal a'in sabartum lahwa khayr llis-saabireen
Waasbir wamaa sabruka 'il laa bial laahi wal aa tahzan 'al ayhim wal aa taku fi dayq mmimmaa yamkuroon
'inna aal laaha ma'a aal zeena aattaqa wwaal zeena hum mmuhsinoon
Subhaana aal zi 'asraa bi'abdihi layla mmina aal masjidi ail haraami 'il aa aal masjidi ail aqsaa aal zi baaraknaa hawlahu linureeahu min 'ayaatinaa 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul baseer
Wa'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba waja'al naahu huda llibani 'israa'eela 'al laa tattakhizu min dooni wakeel
Zurriyyata man hamal naa ma'a noohin 'innahu kaana 'abda shakoor
Waqadaynaa 'il aa bani 'israa'eela fi ail kitaabi latufsidunna fi ail ardi marratayni wal ata'lunna 'ul oowa kabeer
Faizaa jaa'a wa'du 'oolayaahumaa ba'athnaa 'al aykum 'ibaada llanaa 'ooli bas shadeed fajaasu khil aal a aad-deeaari wakaana wa'da mmaf'ool
Thumma radadnaa lakumu aul karrata 'al ayhim waamdadnaakum biamwaal wabaneena waja'al naakum 'akthara nafeera

'in 'ahsantum 'ahsantum lianfusikum wain 'asatum fal ahaa faizaa jaa'a wa'du aul aakhirati leeasuu wujoohakum wal eeadkhul u aul masjida kamaa dakhal oohu 'awwal a marrat wal eeutabbiru maa 'al awa tatbeera
'asaa rabbukum 'any yyarhamakum wain 'udttum 'udnaa waja'al naa jahannama lil kaafireena haseera
'inna haazaa aal qur'aana yahdi lil ti heea 'aqwamu wayubashshiru aul mu'mineena aal zeena ya'mal oona aas-saal ihaati 'anna lahum 'ajra kabeer
Waanna aal zeena laa yu'minoona bial aakhirati 'a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabaan 'al eem
Wayad'u aul insaanu biash-sharri du'aa'ahu bial khayri wakaana aal insaanu 'ajool

Waja'al naa aal yla waan-nahaara 'ayatayni famahawnaa 'ayata aal yli waja'al naa 'ayata aan-nahaari mubsirat llitabtaghu fadla mmir rrabbikum wal ita'lamu 'adada aas-sineena waal hisaaba wakul la sha' fassal naahu tafseel
Wakul la 'insaanin 'al zamnaahu taa'irahu fi 'unuqihi wanukhriju lahu yawma aal qeeaamati kitaaba yal qayaahu manshoora
Aiqra kitaabaka kafaa binafsika aal yawma 'al ayka haseeb
Mmani aihtadaa fainnamaa yahtadi linafsihi waman dal la fainnamaa yadil lu 'al ayhaa wal aa taziru waazirat wizra 'ukhraa wamaa kunnaa mu'azzibeena hattaa nab'atha rasool
Waizaa 'aradnaa 'an nnuhlika qaryatan 'amarnaa mutrafeehaa fafasaqu feehaa fahaqqa 'al ayhaa aal qawlu fadammarnaahaa tadmeer
Wakam 'ahlaknaa mina aal qurooni mim ba'di nooh wakafaa birabbika bizunoobi 'ibaadihi khabeeraa baseer
Mman kaana yureedu aul'aajil ata 'ajjal naa lahu feehaa maa nashaa'u liman nnureedu thumma ja'al naa lahu jahannama yaslayaahaa mazmooma mmadhoor
Waman 'araada aal aakhirata wasa'aa lahaa sa'yahaa wahwa mu'min faul aa'ika kaana sa'yuhum mmashkoor
Kul la nnumiddu haa'ul aa'i wahaa'ul aa'i min 'ataa'i rabbika wamaa kaana 'ataa'u rabbika mahzoora
Aunzur kayfa faddal naa ba'dahum 'al aa ba'd wal al aakhiratu 'akbaru darajaat waakbaru tafdeel
Llaa taj'al ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan 'aakhara fataq'uda mazmooma mmakhzool

Waqadaa rabbuka 'al laa ta'budu 'il laa 'iyyaahu wabial waal idayni 'ihsaanaan 'immaa yablughanna 'indaka aal kibara 'ahaduhumaa 'aw kil aahumaa fal aa taqul-laahumaa 'uff wal aa tanharhumaa waqul-laahumaa qawla kareem
Waakhfid lahumaa janaaha aaz-zul li mina aar-rahmati waqur-rabbi airhamhumaa kamaa rabbayaani sagheer
Rrabbukum 'a'lamu bimaa fi nufoosikum 'in takoonu saal iheena fainnahu kaana lil awwaabeena ghafoor
Wa'aati zaa aal qurbaa haqqahu waal miskeena waabna aas-sabeeli wal aa tubazzir tabzeera
'inna aal mubazzireena kaanu 'ikhwaana aash-shayaateeni wakaana aash-shaytaanu lirabbihi kafoor
Waimmaa tu'ridanna 'anhumu aubtighaa'a rahmat mmir rrabbika tarjoohaa faqul-laahum qawla mmaysoor
Wal aa taj'al yadaka maghloolatan 'il aa 'unuqika wal aa tabsuthaa kul la aal basti fataq'uda mal ooma mmahsoora
'inna rabbaka yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru 'innahu kaana bi'ibaadihi khabeeraa baseer
Wal aa taqtul u 'awlaadakum khashyata 'imlaaq nnahnu narzuquhum waiyyaakum 'inna qatlahum kaana khita kabeer
Wal aa taqrabu auz-zinaa 'innahu kaana faahishat wasaa'a sabeel
Wal aa taqtul u aun-nafsa aal ti harrama aal laahu 'il laa bial haqqi waman qutil a mazlooma faqad ja'al naa liwal eeyihi sul taana fal aa yusrif ffi ail qatli 'innahu kaana mansoor
Wal aa taqrabu maal a aal yateemi 'il laa bial ti heea 'ahsanu hattaa yablugha 'ashuddahu waawfu bial'ahdi 'inna aal'ahda kaana masool
Waawfu aul kayla 'izaa kil tum wazinu bial qustaasi ail mustaqeemi zaal ika khayr waahsanu taweel
Wal aa taqfu maa laysa laka bihi 'il mun 'inna aas-sam'a waal basara waal fu'aada kul lu 'ul aa'ika kaana 'anhu masool
Wal aa tamshi fi ail ardi marahaan 'innaka lan takhriqa aal arda wal an tablugha aal jibaal a tool
Kul lu zaal ika kaana sayyeeatan 'inda rabbika makrooh
Zaal ika mimmaa 'awhaa 'il ayka rabbuka mina aal hikmati wal aa taj'al ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan 'aakhara fatul qaa fi jahannama mal ooma mmadhoora
'afaasfayaakum rabbukum bial baneena waattakhaza mina aal mal aa'ikati 'inaathaan 'innakum lataqooloona qawlaan 'azeem
Wal aqad sarrafnaa fi haazaa aal qur'aani leeazzakkaru wamaa yazeeduhum 'il laa nufoor
Qul-law kaana ma'ahu 'aal ihat kamaa taqooloona 'iza llaabtaghawa 'il aa zi ail'arshi sabeel
Subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yaqooloona 'ul oowa kabeer
Yusabbihu lahu aus-samaawaatu aus-sab'u waal ardu waman feehinna waim mmin sha'in 'il laa yusabbihu bihamdihi wal aakil llaa tafqahoona tasbeehahum 'innahu kaana hal eemaan ghafoor
Waizaa qarata aal qur'aana ja'al naa baynaka wabayna aal zeena laa yu'minoona bial aakhirati hijaaba mmastoor
Waja'al naa 'al aa qul oobihim 'akinnatan 'any yyafqahoohu wafi 'aazaanihim waqra waizaa zakarta rabbaka fi ail qur'aani wahdahu wal lawa 'al aa 'adbaarihim nufoor
Nnahnu 'a'lamu bimaa yastami'oona bihi 'iz yastami'oona 'il ayka waiz hum najwaa 'iz yaqoolu auz-zaal imoona 'in tattabi'oona 'il laa rajul a mmashoora
Aunzur kayfa darabu laka aal amthaal a fadal lu fal aa yastatee'oona sabeel
Waqaal u 'aazaa kunnaa 'izaama warufaataan 'innaa lamab'oothoona khal qa jadeed
Qul koonu hijaaratan 'aw hadeeda

'aw khal qa mmimmaa yakburu fi sudoorikum fasayaqooloona many yyu'eedunaa qul i ail zi fatarakum 'awwal a marrat fasayunghidoona 'il ayka ru'oosahum wayaqooloona mataa hooa qul 'asaa 'any yyakoona qareeb
Yawma yad'ookum fatastajeeboona bihamdihi watazunnoona 'il llabithtum 'il laa qal eel
Waqul-li'ibaadi yaqoolu aul ti heea 'ahsanu 'inna aash-shaytaana yanzaghu baynahum 'inna aash-shaytaana kaana lil insaani 'adoowa mmubeen
Rrabbukum 'a'lamu bikum 'iny yyasha yarhamkum 'aw 'iny yyasha yu'azzibkum wamaa 'arsal naaka 'al ayhim wakeel
Warabbuka 'a'lamu biman fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi wal aqad faddal naa ba'da aan-nabeeaaina 'al aa ba'd wa'aataynaa daawuda zaboor
Qul u aud'u aul zeena za'amtum mmin doonihi fal aa yamlikoona kashfa aad-durri 'ankum wal aa tahweela
'ul aa'ika aal zeena yad'oona yabtaghoona 'il aa rabbihimu aul waseelata 'ayyuhum 'aqrabu wayarjoona rahmatahu wayakhaafoona 'azaabahu 'inna 'azaaba rabbika kaana mahzoor
Waim mmin qaryatin 'il laa nahnu muhlikoohaa qabla yawmi ail qeeaamati 'aw mu'azziboohaa 'azaaba shadeeda kaana zaal ika fi ail kitaabi mastoor
Wamaa mana'anaa 'an nnursil a bial ayaati 'il laa 'an kazzaba bihaa aal awwal oona wa'aataynaa thamooda aan-naaqata mubsirat fazal amu bihaa wamaa nursil u bial ayaati 'il laa takhweef

Waiz qul naa laka 'inna rabbaka 'ahaata bian-naasi wamaa ja'al naa aar-ru'yaa aal ti 'araynaaka 'il laa fitnat llin-naasi waash-shajarata aal mal'oonata fi ail qur'aani wanukhawwifuhum famaa yazeeduhum 'il laa tughyaana kabeer
Waiz qul naa lil mal aa'ikati aisjudu liaadama fasajadu 'il laa 'ibleesa qaal a 'aasjudu liman khal aqta teen
Qaal 'araytaka haazaa aal zi karramta 'al ayya la'in 'akhkhartani 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati laahtanikanna zurriyyatahu 'il laa qal eel
Qaal a aazhab faman tabi'aka minhum fainna jahannama jazaa'ukum jazaa' mmawfoor
Waastafziz mani aistata'ta minhum bisawtika waajlib 'al ayhim bikhaylika warajlika washaarikhum fi ail amwaal i waal awlaadi wa'idhum wamaa ya'iduhumu aush-shaytaanu 'il laa ghuroora
'inna 'ibaadi laysa laka 'al ayhim sul taanw wakafaa birabbika wakeel
Rrabbukumu aul zi yuzji lakumu aul ful ka fi ail bahri litabtaghu min fadlihi 'innahu kaana bikum raheem
Waizaa massakumu aud-durru fi ail bahri dal la man tad'oona 'il laa 'iyyaahu fal ammaa najjayaakum 'il aa aal barri 'a'radtum wakaana aal insaanu kafoora
'afaamintum 'any yyakhsifa bikum jaaniba aal barri 'aw yursil a 'al aykum haasiba thumma laa tajidu lakum wakeela
'am 'amintum 'any yyu'eedakum feehi taaratan 'ukhraa fayursil a 'al aykum qaasifa mmina aar-reehi fayughriqakum bimaa kafartum thumma laa tajidu lakum 'al aynaa bihi tabee'
Wal aqad karramnaa bani 'aadama wahamal naahum fi ail barri waal bahri warazaqnaahum mmina aat-tayyibaati wafaddal naahum 'al aa katheer mmimman khal aqnaa tafdeel
Yawma nad'u kul la 'unaasi biimaamihim faman 'ooteea kitaabahu beeameenihi faul aa'ika yaqra'oona kitaabahum wal aa yuzlamoona fateel
Waman kaana fi haazihi 'a'maa fahwa fi ail aakhirati 'a'maa waadal lu sabeel
Wain kaadu layaftinoonaka 'ani ail zi 'awhaynaa 'il ayka litaftareea 'al aynaa ghayrahu waiza llaattakhazooka khal eel
Wal awlaa 'an thabbatnaaka laqad kidtta tarkanu 'il ayhim shaya qal eela
'iza llaazaqnaaka di'fa aal hayawaati wadi'fa aal mamaati thumma laa tajidu laka 'al aynaa naseer
Wain kaadu layastafizzoonaka mina aal ardi leeukhrijooka minhaa waiza llaa yal bathoona khal faka 'il laa qal eel
Sunnata man qad 'arsal naa qablaka mir rrusul inaa wal aa tajidu lisunnatinaa tahweela
'aqimi ais-sal awaata lidul ooki aish-shamsi 'il aa ghasaqi ail yli waqur'aana aal fajri 'inna qur'aana aal fajri kaana mashhood
Wamina aal yli fatahajjad bihi naafil at llaka 'asaa 'any yyab'athaka rabbuka maqaama mmahmood
Waqur-rabbi 'adkhil ni mudkhal a sidq waakhrijni mukhraja sidq waaj'al-li mil lladunka sul taana nnaseer
Waqul jaa'a aal haqqu wazahaqa aal baatil u 'inna aal baatil a kaana zahooq
Wanunazzil u mina aal qur'aani maa hooa shifaa' warahmat llil mu'mineena wal aa yazeedu auz-zaal imeena 'il laa khasaar
Waizaa 'an'amnaa 'al aa aal insaani 'a'rada wanaa bijaanibihi waizaa massahu aush-sharru kaana yaoos
Qul kul l ya'mal u 'al aa shaakil atihi farabbukum 'a'lamu biman hooa 'ahdaa sabeel
Wayasal oonaka 'ani air-roohi qul i air-roohu min 'amri rabbi wamaa 'ooteetum mmina aal'il mi 'il laa qal eel
Wal a'in sheenaa lanazhabanna bial zi 'awhaynaa 'il ayka thumma laa tajidu laka bihi 'al aynaa wakeela
'il laa rahmat mmir rrabbika 'inna fadlahu kaana 'al ayka kabeer
Qul-la'ini aijtama'ati ail insu waal jinnu 'al aa 'any yyatu bimithli haazaa aal qur'aani laa yatoona bimithlihi wal aw kaana ba'duhum liba'd zaheer
Wal aqad sarrafnaa lin-naasi fi haazaa aal qur'aani min kul li mathal faabaa 'aktharu aun-naasi 'il laa kufoor
Waqaal u lan nnu'mina laka hattaa tufajjira lanaa mina aal ardi yanboo'a
'aw takoona laka jannat mmin nnakheel wa'inab fatufajjira aal anhaara khil aal ahaa tafjeera
'aw tusqita aas-samaa'a kamaa za'amta 'al aynaa kisafaan 'aw tateea bial laahi waal mal aa'ikati qabeela
'aw yakoona laka bayt mmin zukhrufin 'aw tarqaa fi ais-samaa'i wal an nnu'mina liruqeeyika hattaa tunazzil a 'al aynaa kitaaba nnaqra'uhu qul subhaana rabbi hal kuntu 'il laa bashara rrasool
Wamaa mana'a aan-naasa 'any yyu'minu 'iz jaa'ahumu aul hudaa 'il laa 'an qaal u 'aba'atha aal laahu bashara rrasool
