Qul-law kaana fi ail ardi mal aa'ikat yamshoona mutma'inneena lanazzal naa 'al ayhim mmina aas-samaa'i mal aka rrasool
Qul kafaa bial laahi shaheedaa bayni wabaynakum 'innahu kaana bi'ibaadihi khabeeraa baseer

Wamany yyahdi ail laahu fahwa aal muhtadi wamany yyudlil fal an tajida lahum 'awleeaa'a min doonihi wanahshuruhum yawma aal qeeaamati 'al aa wujoohihim 'umya wabukma wasumma mmawayaahum jahannamu kul lamaa khabat zidnaahum sa'eer
Zaal ika jazaa'uhum biannahum kafaru biayaatinaa waqaal u 'aazaa kunnaa 'izaama warufaataan 'innaa lamab'oothoona khal qa jadeeda
'awal am yarawa 'anna aal laaha aal zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda qaadirun 'al aa 'any yyakhluqa mithlahum waja'al a lahum 'ajal a llaa rayba feehi faabaa aaz-zaal imoona 'il laa kufoor
Qul-law 'antum tamlikoona khazaa'ina rahmati rabbeea 'iza llaamsaktum khashyata aal infaaqi wakaana aal insaanu qatoor
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa tis'a 'ayaati bayyinaat fasal bani 'israa'eela 'iz jaa'ahum faqaal a lahu fir'awnu 'inni laazunnuka yaamoosaa mashoor
Qaal a laqad 'al imta maa 'anzal a haa'ul aa 'il laa rabbu aus-samaawaati waal ardi basaa'ira wainni laazunnuka yaafir'awnu mathboor
Faaraada 'any yyastafizzahum mmina aal ardi faaghraqnaahu wamam mma'ahu jamee'
Waqul naa mim ba'dihi libani 'israa'eela aaskunu aul arda faizaa jaa'a wa'du aul aakhirati jeenaa bikum lafeef
Wabial haqqi 'anzal naahu wabial haqqi nazal a wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa mubashshira wanazeer
Waqur'aana faraqnaahu litaqraahu 'al aa aan-naasi 'al aa mukth wanazzal naahu tanzeel
Qul 'aaminu bihi 'aw laa tu'minu 'inna aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma min qablihi 'izaa yutlaa 'al ayhim yakhirroona lil azqaani sujjada wayaqooloona subhaana rabbinaa 'in kaana wa'du rabbinaa lamaf'ool
Wayakhirroona lil azqaani yabkoona wayazeeduhum khushoo'
Qul u aud'u aul laaha 'awu aud'u aur-rahmaana 'ayya mmaa tad'u fal ahu aul asmaa'u aul husnaa wal aa tajhar bisal aatika wal aa tukhaafit bihaa waabtaghi bayna zaal ika sabeel
Waqul i ail hamdu lil hi ail zi lam yattakhiz wal ada wal am yakul llaahu shareek fi ail mul ki wal am yakul llaahu wal eey mmina aaz-zul li wakabbirhu takbeera
Ail hamdu lil hi ail zi 'anzal a 'al aa 'abdihi ail kitaaba wal am yaj'al-laahu 'iwaj
Qayyima lleeunzira basa shadeeda mmil lladunhu wayubashshira aal mu'mineena aal zeena ya'mal oona aas-saal ihaati 'anna lahum 'ajraan hasan
Mmaakitheena feehi 'abad
Wayunzira aal zeena qaal u auttakhaza aal laahu wal ad
Mmaa lahum bihi min 'il m wal aa liaabaa'ihim kaburat kal imat takhruju min 'afwaahihim 'iny yyaqooloona 'il laa kazib
Fal a'al laka baakhi' nnafsaka 'al aa 'aathaarihim 'il llam yu'minu bihaazaa aal hadeethi 'asafa
'innaa ja'al naa maa 'al aa aal ardi zeenat llaahaa linablooahum 'ayyuhum 'ahsanu 'amal
Wainnaa lajaa'il oona maa 'al ayhaa sa'eeda juruza
'am hasibta 'anna 'ashaaba aal kahfi waar-raqeemi kaanu min 'ayaatinaa 'ajaba
'iz 'awaa aal fityatu 'il aa aal kahfi faqaal u rabbanaa 'aatinaa mil lladunka rahmat wahayyi lanaa min 'amrinaa rashad
Fadarabnaa 'al aa 'aazaanihim fi ail kahfi sineena 'adad
Thumma ba'athnaahum lina'lama 'ayyu aul hizbayni 'ahsaa limaa labithu 'amad
Nnahnu naqussu 'al ayka nabaahum bial haqqi 'innahum fityatun 'aamanu birabbihim wazidnaahum hud
Warabatnaa 'al aa qul oobihim 'iz qaamu faqaal u rabbunaa rabbu aus-samaawaati waal ardi lan nnad'ooaa min doonihi 'il aaha llaqad qul naa 'iza shatata
Haa'ul aa'i qawmunaa aattakhazu min doonihi 'aal ihat llawlaa yatoona 'al ayhim bisul taani bayyin faman 'azlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazib
Waizi ai'tazal tumoohum wamaa ya'budoona 'il laa aal laaha fawua 'il aa aal kahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum mmir rrahmatihi wayuhayyi lakum mmin 'amrikum mmarfiq

Wataraa aash-shamsa 'izaa tal a'at ttazzaawaru 'an kahfihim zaata aal yameeni waizaa gharabat ttaqriduhum zaata aash-shimaal i wahum fi fajwat mminhu zaal ika min 'ayaati ail laahi many yyahdi ail laahu fahwa aal muhtadi wamany yyudlil fal an tajida lahu wal iyya mmurshid

Watahsibuhum 'ayqaaza wahum ruqood wanuqal libuhum zaata aal yameeni wazaata aash-shimaal i wakal buhum baasit ziraa'ayhi bial waseedi lawi aittal a'ta 'al ayhim lawal layta minhum firaara wal amul leeta minhum ru'b

Wakazaal ika ba'athnaahum leeatasaa'al u baynahum qaal a qaa'il mminhum kam labithtum qaal u labithnaa yawmaan 'aw ba'da yawm qaal u rabbukum 'a'lamu bimaa labithtum faab'athu 'ahadakum biwariqikum haazihi 'il aa aal madeenati fal yanzur 'ayyuhaa 'azkaa ta'aama fal yatikum birizq mminhu wal yatal attaf wal aa yush'iranna bikum 'ahada
'innahum 'iny yyazharu 'al aykum yarjumookum 'aw yu'eedookum fi mil latihim wal an tuflihu 'izaan 'abad

Wakazaal ika 'a'tharnaa 'al ayhim leea'lamu 'anna wa'da aal laahi haqq waanna aas-saa'ata laa rayba feehaa 'iz yatanaaza'oona baynahum 'amrahum faqaal u aubnu 'al ayhim bunyaana rrabbuhum 'a'lamu bihim qaal a aal zeena ghal abu 'al aa 'amrihim lanattakhizanna 'al ayhim mmasjid

Sayaqooloona thal aathat rraabi'uhum kal buhum wayaqooloona khamsat saadisuhum kal buhum rajmaa bial ghaybi wayaqooloona sab'at wathaaminuhum kal buhum qur-rabbeea 'a'lamu bi'iddatihim mmaa ya'lamuhum 'il laa qal eel
Fal aa tumaari feehim 'il laa miraa' zaahira wal aa tastafti feehim mminhum 'ahad
Wal aa taqoolanna lishaa'in 'inni faa'il zaal ika ghadaan 'il laa 'any yyashaa'a aal laahu waazkur rrabbaka 'izaa naseeta waqul 'asaa 'any yyahdeeani rabbi liaqraba min haazaa rashad
Wal abithu fi kahfihim thal aatha miayat sineena waazdaadu tis'
Qul i ail laahu 'a'lamu bimaa labithu lahu ghaybu aus-samaawaati waal ardi 'absir bihi waasmi' maa lahum mmin doonihi minw wwal eey wal aa yushriku fi hukmihi 'ahad
Waatlu maa 'ooheea 'il ayka min kitaabi rabbika laa mubaddil a likal imaatihi wal an tajida min doonihi mul tahad

Waasbir nafsaka ma'a aal zeena yad'oona rabbahum bial ghadawaati waal'asheeyi yureedoona wajhahu wal aa ta'du 'aynaaka 'anhum tureedu zeenata aal hayawaati aid-dunyaa wal aa tuti' man 'aghfal naa qal bahu 'an zikrinaa waattaba'a hawayaahu wakaana 'amruhu furuh

Waqul i ail haqqu mir rrabbikum faman shaa'a fal yu'minw wwaman shaa'a fal yakfur 'innaa 'a'tadnaa liz-zaal imeena naaraan 'ahaata bihim suraadiquhaa wainy yyastagheethu yughaathu bimaa' kaal muhli yashwi ail wujooha beesa aash-sharaabu wasaa'at murtafaqa
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati 'innaa laa nudee'u 'ajra man 'ahsana 'amal a

'ul aa'ika lahum jannaatu 'adn tajri min tahtihimu aul anhaaru yuhal lawna feehaa min 'asaawira min zahab wayal basoona theeaabaan khudra mmin sundus waistabraq mmuttakieena feehaa 'al aa aal araa'iki ni'ma aath-thawaabu wahasunat murtafaq
Waadrib lahum mmathal a rrajul ayni ja'al naa liahadihimaa jannatayni min 'a'naab wahafafnaahumaa binakhl waja'al naa baynahumaa zar'
Kil taa aal jannatayni 'aatat 'uklahaa wal am tazlim mminhu shaya wafajjarnaa khil aal ahumaa nahar
Wakaana lahu thumur faqaal a lisaahibihi wahwa yuhaawiruhu 'anaa 'aktharu minka maal a waa'azzu nafar
Wadakhal a jannatahu wahwa zaal im llinafsihi qaal a maa 'azunnu 'an tabeeda haazihi 'abada wamaa 'azunnu aus-saa'ata qaa'imat wal a'ir rrudidttu 'il aa rabbi laajidanna khayra mminhumaa munqal ab
Qaal a lahu saahibuhu wahwa yuhaawiruhu 'akafarta bial zi khal aqaka min turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma sawwayaaka rajul
Llaakinnaa hooa aal laahu rabbi wal aa 'ushriku birabbeea 'ahad
Wal awlaa 'iz dakhal ta jannataka qul ta maa shaa'a aal laahu laa qoowata 'il laa bial laahi 'in tarani 'anaa 'aqal la minka maal a wawal ad
Fa'asaa rabbeea 'any yyu'teeani khayra mmin jannatika wayursil a 'al ayhaa husbaana mmina aas-samaa'i fatusbiha sa'eeda zal aqa
'aw yusbiha maa'uhaa ghawra fal an tastatee'a lahu tal ab
Wauheeta bithumurihi faasbaha yuqal libu kaffayhi 'al aa maa 'anfaqa feehaa wahya khaaweeatun 'al aa 'urooshihaa wayaqoolu yaal aytani lam 'ushrik birabbeea 'ahad
Wal am takul llaahu feeat yansuroonahu min dooni ail laahi wamaa kaana muntasira
Hunaal ika aal wal ayatu lil hi ail haqqi hooa khayr thawaaba wakhayrun 'uqub

Waadrib lahum mmathal a aal hayawaati aid-dunyaa kamaa'in 'anzal naahu mina aas-samaa'i faakhtal ata bihi nabaatu aul ardi faasbaha hasheema tazroohu aur-reeaahu wakaana aal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' mmuqtadira
Ail maal u waal banoona zeenatu aul hayawaati aid-dunyaa waal baaqeeaatu aus-saal ihaatu khayrun 'inda rabbika thawaaba wakhayrun 'amal
Wayawma nusayyiru aul jibaal a wataraa aal arda baarizat wahasharnaahum fal am nughaadir minhum 'ahad
Wa'uridu 'al aa rabbika saffa llaqad jeetumoonaa kamaa khal aqnaakum 'awwal a marrati bal za'amtum 'al lan nnaj'al a lakum mmaw'id

Wawudi'a aal kitaabu fataraa aal mujrimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa feehi wayaqooloona yaawaylatanaa maal i haazaa aal kitaabi laa yughaadiru sagheerat wal aa kabeeratan 'il laa 'ahsayaahaa wawajadu maa 'amil u haadira wal aa yazlimu rabbuka 'ahad

Waiz qul naa lil mal aa'ikati aisjudu liaadama fasajadu 'il laa 'ibleesa kaana mina aal jinni fafasaqa 'an 'amri rabbihi 'afatattakhizoonahu wazurriyyatahu 'awleeaa'a min dooni wahum lakum 'adoowu beesa liz-zaal imeena badal
Mmaa 'ashhadttuhum khal qa aas-samaawaati waal ardi wal aa khal qa 'anfusihim wamaa kuntu muttakhiza aal mudil leena 'adud
Wayawma yaqoolu naadu shurakaa'eea aal zeena za'amtum fada'awhum fal am yastajeebu lahum waja'al naa baynahum mmawbiq
Wara'aa aal mujrimoona aan-naara fazannu 'annahum mmooaaqi'oohaa wal am yajidu 'anhaa masrif
Wal aqad sarrafnaa fi haazaa aal qur'aani lin-naasi min kul li mathal wakaana aal insaanu 'akthara sha' jadal
Wamaa mana'a aan-naasa 'any yyu'minu 'iz jaa'ahumu aul hudaa wayastaghfiru rabbahum 'il laa 'an tateeahum sunnatu aul awwal eena 'aw yateeahumu aul'azaabu qibal
Wamaa nursil u aul mursal eena 'il laa mubashshireena wamunzireena wayujaadil u aul zeena kafaru bial baatil i leeudhidu bihi ail haqqa waattakhazu 'ayaati wamaa 'unziru huzu'

Waman 'azlamu mimman zukkira biayaati rabbihi faa'rada 'anhaa wanaseea maa qaddamat yadaahu 'innaa ja'al naa 'al aa qul oobihim 'akinnatan 'any yyafqahoohu wafi 'aazaanihim waqra wain tad'uhum 'il aa aal hudaa fal any yyahtadu 'izaan 'abad
Warabbuka aal ghafooru zoo aur-rahmati law yu'aakhizuhum bimaa kasabu la'ajjal a lahumu aul'azaaba bal-laahum mmaw'id llany yyajidu min doonihi maw'il
Watil ka aal quraa 'ahlaknaahum lammaa zal amu waja'al naa limuhlakihim mmaw'id
Waiz qaal a moosaa lifatayaahu laa 'abrahu hattaa 'ablugha majma'a aal bahrayni 'aw 'amdeea huqub
Fal ammaa bal aghaa majma'a baynihimaa naseeaa hootahumaa faattakhaza sabeelahu fi ail bahri sarab
Fal ammaa jaawazaa qaal a lifatayaahu 'aatinaa ghadaa'anaa laqad laqeenaa min safarinaa haazaa nasab
Qaal a 'arayta 'iz 'awaynaa 'il aa aas-sakhrati fainni naseetu aul hoota wamaa 'ansayaaneehi 'il laa aash-shaytaanu 'an 'azkurahu waattakhaza sabeelahu fi ail bahri 'ajab
Qaal a zaal ika maa kunnaa nabghi faartaddaa 'al aa 'aathaarihimaa qasas
Fawajadaa 'abda mmin 'ibaadinaa 'aataynaahu rahmat mmin 'indinaa wa'al lamnaahu mil lladunnaa 'il m
Qaal a lahu moosaa hal 'attabi'uka 'al aa 'an tu'al limani mimmaa 'ul limta rushd
Qaal a 'innaka lan tastatee'a ma'i sabr
Wakayfa tasbiru 'al aa maa lam tuhit bihi khubr
Qaal a satajiduneea 'in shaa'a aal laahu saabira wal aa 'a'si laka 'amr
Qaal a faini aittaba'tani fal aa tasal anni 'an sha'in hattaa 'uhditha laka minhu zikr
Faantal aqaa hattaa 'izaa rakibaa fi ais-safeenati kharaqahaa qaal a 'akharaqtahaa litughriqa 'ahlahaa laqad jeeta shayaan 'imr
Qaal a 'al am 'aqul 'innaka lan tastatee'a ma'i sabr
Qaal a laa tu'aakhizni bimaa naseetu wal aa turhiqni min 'amri 'usr
Faantal aqaa hattaa 'izaa laqeeaa ghul aama faqatal ahu qaal a 'aqatal ta nafsa zaakeeata bighayri nafs llaqad jeeta shaya nnukur
Qaal a 'al am 'aqul-laka 'innaka lan tastatee'a ma'i sabr
Qaal a 'in saal tuka 'an sha'i ba'dahaa fal aa tusaahibni qad bal aghta mil lladuni 'uzr

Faantal aqaa hattaa 'izaa 'atayaa 'ahla qaryatin aistat'amaa 'ahlahaa faabawa 'any yyudayyifoohumaa fawajadaa feehaa jidaara yureedu 'any yyanqadda faaqaamahu qaal a law sheeta lattakhaztta 'al ayhi 'ajr
Qaal a haazaa firaaqu bayni wabaynika saunabbeeuka bitaweeli maa lam tastati' 'al ayhi sabra
'ammaa aas-safeenatu fakaanat limasaakeena ya'mal oona fi ail bahri faaradttu 'an 'a'eebahaa wakaana waraa'ahum mmal ik yakhuzu kul la safeenatin ghasb
Waammaa aal ghul aamu fakaana 'abawaahu mu'minayni fakhasheenaa 'any yyurhiqahumaa tughyaana wakufr
Faaradnaa 'any yyubaddil ahumaa rabbuhumaa khayra mminhu zakawaat waaqraba ruhm

Waammaa aal jidaaru fakaana lighul aamayni yateemayni fi ail madeenati wakaana tahtahu kanz llaahumaa wakaana 'aboohumaa saal iha faaraada rabbuka 'any yyablughaa 'ashuddahumaa wayastakhrijaa kanzahumaa rahmat mmir rrabbika wamaa fa'al tuhu 'an 'amri zaal ika taweelu maa lam tasti' 'al ayhi sabr
Wayasal oonaka 'an zi ail qarnayni qul saatlu 'al aykum mminhu zikra
'innaa makkannaa lahu fi ail ardi wa'aataynaahu min kul li sha' sabab

Faattaba'a sababaan hattaa 'izaa bal agha maghriba aash-shamsi wajadahaa taghrubu fi 'aynin hameeat wawajada 'indahaa qawma qul naa yaazaa aal qarnayni 'immaa 'an tu'azziba waimmaa 'an tattakhiza feehim husn
Qaal a 'ammaa man zal ama fasawfa nu'azzibuhu thumma yuraddu 'il aa rabbihi fayu'azzibuhu 'azaaba nnukur
Waammaa man 'aamana wa'amil a saal iha fal ahu jazaa'u aul husnaa wasanaqoolu lahu min 'amrinaa yusr
Thumma aattaba'a sababaan hattaa 'izaa bal agha matli'a aash-shamsi wajadahaa tatlu'u 'al aa qawm llam naj'al-laahum mmin doonihaa sitr
Kazaal ika waqad 'ahatnaa bimaa ladayhi khubr
Thumma aattaba'a sababaan hattaa 'izaa bal agha bayna aas-suddayni wajada min doonihimaa qawma llaa yakaadoona yafqahoona qawl
Qaal u yaazaa aal qarnayni 'inna yaajooja wamaajooja mufsidoona fi ail ardi fahal naj'al u laka kharjaan 'al aa 'an taj'al a baynanaa wabaynahum sudd
Qaal a maa makkanni feehi rabbi khayr faa'eenooni biqoowatin 'aj'al baynakum wabaynahum radma
'aatooni zubara aal hadeedi hattaa 'izaa saawaa bayna aas-sadafayni qaal a aanfukhu hattaa 'izaa ja'al ahu naara qaal a 'aatooni 'ufrigh 'al ayhi qitr
Famaa aastaa'u 'any yyazharoohu wamaa aastataa'u lahu naqb
Qaal a haazaa rahmat mmir rrabbi faizaa jaa'a wa'du rabbi ja'al ahu dakka wakaana wa'du rabbi haqq
Wataraknaa ba'dahum yawma'iz yamooju fi ba'd wanufikha fi ais-soori fajama'naahum jam'
Wa'aradnaa jahannama yawma'iz llil kaafireena 'arda
Ail zeena kaanat 'a'yunuhum fi ghitaa'in 'an zikri wakaanu laa yastatee'oona sam'a
'afahasiba aal zeena kafaru 'any yyattakhizu 'ibaadi min dooneea 'awleeaa'a annaa 'a'tadnaa jahannama lil kaafireena nuzul
Qul hal nunabbeeukum bial akhsareena 'a'maal aan ail zeena dal la sa'yuhum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wahum yahsiboona 'annahum yuhsinoona sun'a
'ul aa'ika aal zeena kafaru biayaati rabbihim wal iqaa'ihi fahabitat 'a'maal uhum fal aa nuqeemu lahum yawma aal qeeaamati wazn
Zaal ika jazaa'uhum jahannamu bimaa kafaru waattakhazu 'ayaati warusul i huzu'a
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati kaanat lahum jannaatu aul firdawsi nuzul a
Khaal ideena feehaa laa yabghoona 'anhaa hiwal
Qul-law kaana aal bahru midaada llikal imaati rabbi lanafida aal bahru qabla 'an tanfada kal imaatu rabbi wal aw jeenaa bimithlihi madad
Qul 'innamaa 'anaa bashar mmithlukum yoohaa 'il ayya 'annamaa 'il aahukum 'il aah waahid faman kaana yarju liqaa'a rabbihi fal ya'mal 'amal a saal iha wal aa yushrik bi'ibaadati rabbihi 'ahada
Kaahaya'aasaa zikru rahmati rabbika 'abdahu zakariyyaa'
Az naadaa rabbahu nidaa'an khafiyy

Wainni khiftu aul mawaal eea minw wwaraa'i wakaanati aimraati 'aaqira fahab li mil lladunka wal iyy
Yarithuni wayarithu min 'aal i ya'qooba waaj'al hu rabbi radiyy
Yaazakariyyaa'u ainnaa nubashshiruka bighul aamin aismuhu yahyaa lam naj'al-laahu min qablu samiyy
Qaal a rabbi 'annaa yakoonu li ghul aam wakaanati aimraati 'aaqira waqad bal aghtu mina aal kibari 'utiyy
Qaal a kazaal ika qaal a rabbuka hooa 'al ayya hayyinw waqad khal aqtuka min qablu wal am taku shay
Qaal a rabbi aij'al-leea 'ayat qaal a 'ayatuka 'al laa tukal lima aan-naasa thal aatha layaal sawiyy
Fakharaja 'al aa qawmihi mina aal mihraabi faawhaa 'il ayhim 'an sabbihu bukrat wa'ashiyy
Yayahyaa khuzi ail kitaaba biqoowat wa'aataynaahu aul hukma sabiyy
Wahanaana mmil lladunnaa wazakawaat wakaana taqiyy
Wabarraa biwaal idayhi wal am yakun jabbaaraan 'asiyy

Wal aw 'annaa 'ahlaknaahum bi'azaab mmin qablihi laqaal u rabbanaa lawlaa 'arsal ta 'il aynaa rasoola fanattabi'a 'ayaatika min qabli 'an nnazil la wanakhza
Qul kul l mmutarabbis fatarabbasu fasata'lamoona man 'ashaabu aus-siraati ais-saweeyi wamani aihtada
Aiqtaraba lin-naasi hisaabuhum wahum fi ghaflat mmu'ridoon
Maa yateehim mmin zikr mmir rrabbihim mmuhdathin 'il laa aastama'oohu wahum yal'aboon
Laaheeat qul oobuhum waasarru aun-najwaa aal zeena zal amu hal haazaa 'il laa bashar mmithlukum 'afatatoona aas-sihra waantum tubsiroon
Qur-rabbi ya'lamu aul qawla fi ais-samaa'i waal ardi wahwa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Bal qaal u 'adghaathu 'ahlaami bal i aiftarayaahu bal hooa shaa'ir fal yatinaa biayat kamaa 'ursil a aal awwal oon
Maa 'aamanat qablahum mmin qaryatin 'ahlaknaahaa 'afahum yu'minoon
Wamaa 'arsal naa qablaka 'il laa rijaal a yoohaa 'il ayhim fasal u 'ahla aaz-zikri 'in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Wamaa ja'al naahum jasada llaa yakul oona aat-ta'aama wamaa kaanu khaal ideen
Thumma sadaqnaahumu aul wa'da faanjaynaahum waman nnashaa'u waahlaknaa aal musrifeen
Laqad 'anzal naa 'il aykum kitaaba feehi zikrukum 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Wakam qasamnaa min qaryat kaanat zaal imat waanshanaa ba'dahaa qawmaan 'aakhareen
Fal ammaa 'ahassu basanaa 'izaa hum mminhaa yarkudoon
Laa tarkudu waarji'u 'il aa maa 'utriftum feehi wamasaakinikum la'al lakum tusal oon
Qaal u yaawaylanaa 'innaa kunnaa zaal imeen
Famaa zaal at ttil ka da'wayaahum hattaa ja'al naahum haseedaan khaamideen
Wamaa khal aqnaa aas-samaa'a waal arda wamaa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
Law 'aradnaa 'an nnattakhiza lahwa llaattakhaznaahu mil lladunnaa 'in kunnaa faa'il een
Bal naqzifu bial haqqi 'al aa aal baatil i fayadmaghuhu faizaa hooa zaahiq wal akumu aul waylu mimmaa tasifoon
Wal ahu man fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi waman 'indahu laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihi wal aa yastahsiroon
Yusabbihoona aal yla waan-nahaara laa yafturoon
'ami aittakhazu 'aal ihat mmina aal ardi hum yunshiroon
Law kaana feehimaa 'aal ihatun 'il laa aal laahu lafasadataa fasubhaana aal laahi rabbi ail'arshi 'ammaa yasifoon
Laa yusal u 'ammaa yaf'al u wahum yusal oon
'ami aittakhazu min doonihi 'aal ihat qul haatu burhaanakum haazaa zikru mam mma'i wazikru man qabli bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'lamoona aal haqqa fahum mmu'ridoon
Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika mir rrasoolin 'il laa yoohaa 'il ayhi 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa 'anaa faa'budoon
Waqaal u auttakhaza aar-rahmaanu wal ada subhaanahu bal 'ibaad mmukramoon
Laa yasbiqoonahu bial qawli wahum biamrihi ya'mal oon
Ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wal aa yashfa'oona 'il laa limani airtadaa wahum mmin khashyatihi mushfiqoon
Wamany yyaqul minhum 'inneea 'il aah mmin doonihi fazaal ika najzeehi jahannama kazaal ika najzi aiz-zaal imeen
'awal am yara aal zeena kafaru 'anna aas-samaawaati waal arda kaanataa ratqa fafataqnaahumaa waja'al naa mina aal maa'i kul la sha'in hayyin 'afal aa yu'minoon
Waja'al naa fi ail ardi rawaaseea 'an tameeda bihim waja'al naa feehaa fijaaja subul a lla'al laahum yahtadoon
Waja'al naa aas-samaa'a saqfa mmahfooza wahum 'an 'ayaatihaa mu'ridoon
Wahwa aal zi khal aqa aal yla waan-nahaara waash-shamsa waal qamara kul l fi fal ak yasbahoon
Wamaa ja'al naa libashar mmin qablika aal khul da 'afaeen mmitta fahumu aul khaal idoon
Kul lu nafs zaa'iqatu aul mawti wanablookum biash-sharri waal khayri fitnat wail aynaa turja'oon
Waizaa ra'aaka aal zeena kafaru 'iny yyattakhizoonaka 'il laa huzu'aan 'ahaazaa aal zi yazkuru 'aal ihatakum wahum bizikri air-rahmaani hum kaafiroon
Khul iqa aal insaanu min 'ajal saooreekum 'ayaati fal aa tasta'jil oon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaa aal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Law ya'lamu aul zeena kafaru heena laa yakuffoona 'anw wwujoohihimu aun-naara wal aa 'an zuhoorihim wal aa hum yunsaroon
Bal tateehim baghtat fatabhatuhum fal aa yastatee'oona raddahaa wal aa hum yunzaroon
Wal aqadu austuhzia birusul mmin qablika fahaaqa bial zeena sakhiru minhum mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Qul many yyakla'ukum bial yli waan-nahaari mina aar-rahmaani bal hum 'an zikri rabbihim mmu'ridoon
'am lahum 'aal ihat tamna'uhum mmin dooninaa laa yastatee'oona nasra 'anfusihim wal aa hum mminnaa yushaboon
Bal matta'naa haa'ul aa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa taal a 'al ayhimu aul'umuru 'afal aa yarawna 'annaa nati ail arda nanqusuhaa min 'atraafihaa 'afahumu aul ghaal iboon
Qul 'innamaa 'unzirukum bial wahyi wal aa yasma'u aus-summu aud-du'aa'a azaa maa yunzaroon
Wal a'im mmassathum nafhat mmin 'azaabi rabbika layaqoolunna yaawaylanaa 'innaa kunnaa zaal imeen
Wanada'u aul mawaazeena aal qista leeawmi ail qeeaamati fal aa tuzlamu nafs shaya wain kaana mithqaal u habbat mmin khardal in 'ataynaa bihaa wakafaa binaa haasibeen
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa wahaaroona aal furqaana wadeeaa' wazikra llil muttaqeen
Aal zeena yakhshawna rabbahum bial ghaybi wahum mmina aas-saa'ati mushfiqoon
Wahaazaa zikr mmubaarakun 'anzal naahu 'afaantum lahu munkiroon
Wal aqad 'aataynaa 'ibraaheema rushdahu min qablu wakunnaa bihi 'aal imeen
'iz qaal a liabeehi waqawmihi maa haazihi ait-tamaatheelu aul ti 'antum lahaa 'aakifoon
Qaal u wajadnaa 'aabaa'anaa lahaa 'aabideen
Qaal a laqad kuntum 'antum wa'aabaa'ukum fi dal aal mmubeen
Qaal u 'ajeetanaa bial haqqi 'am 'anta mina aal laa'ibeen
Qaal a bar-rabbukum rabbu aus-samaawaati waal ardi ail zi fatarahunna waanaa 'al aa zaal ikum mmina aash-shaahideen
Wataal laahi laakeedanna 'asnaamakum ba'da 'an tooal lu mudbireen
Faja'al ahum juzaazaan 'il laa kabeera llaahum la'al laahum 'il ayhi yarji'oon
Qaal u man fa'al a haazaa biaal ihatinaa 'innahu lamina aaz-zaal imeen
Qaal u sami'naa fata yazkuruhum yuqaal u lahu 'ibraaheem
Qaal u fatu bihi 'al aa 'a'yuni ain-naasi la'al laahum yashhadoon
Qaal u 'aanta fa'al ta haazaa biaal ihatinaa yaaibraaheem
Qaal a bal fa'al ahu kabeeruhum haazaa fasal oohum 'in kaanu yantiqoon
Faraja'u 'il aa 'anfusihim faqaal u 'innakum 'antumu auz-zaal imoon
Thumma nukisu 'al aa ru'oosihim laqad 'al imta maa haa'ul aa'i yantiqoon
Qaal a 'afata'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa laa yanfa'ukum shaya wal aa yadurrukum 'uff llakum wal imaa ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Qaal u harriqoohu waansuru 'aal ihatakum 'in kuntum faa'il een
Qul naa yaanaaru kooni barda wasal aamaan 'al aa 'ibraaheem
Waaraadu bihi kayda faja'al naahumu aul akhsareen
Wanajjaynaahu wal ootaan 'il aa aal ardi ail ti baaraknaa feehaa lil'aal ameen
Wawahabnaa lahu 'ishaaqa waya'qooba naafil at wakul la ja'al naa saal iheen
Waja'al naahum 'a'immat yahdoona biamrinaa waawhaynaa 'il ayhim fi'la aal khayraati waiqaama aas-sal awaati waeetaa'a aaz-zakawaati wakaanu lanaa 'aabideen
Wal ootaan 'aataynaahu hukma wa'il ma wanajjaynaahu mina aal qaryati ail ti kaanat tta'mal u aul khabaa'itha 'innahum kaanu qawma saw' faasiqeen
Waadkhal naahu fi rahmatinaa 'innahu mina aas-saal iheen
Wanoohaan 'iz naadaa min qablu faastajabnaa lahu fanajjaynaahu waahlahu mina aal karbi ail'azeem
Wanasarnaahu mina aal qawmi ail zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa 'innahum kaanu qawma saw' faaghraqnaahum 'ajma'een
Wadaawuda wasul aymaana 'iz yahkumaani fi ail harthi 'iz nafashat feehi ghanamu aul qawmi wakunnaa lihukmihim shaahideen
Fafahhamnaahaa sul aymaana wakul laan 'aataynaa hukma wa'il ma wasakhkharnaa ma'a daawuda aal jibaal a yusabbihna waat-tayra wakunnaa faa'il een
Wa'al lamnaahu san'ata laboos llakum leeuhsinakum mmim basikum fahal 'antum shaakiroon
Wal isul aymaana aar-reeha 'aasifat tajri biamrihi 'il aa aal ardi ail ti baaraknaa feehaa wakunnaa bikul li sha'in 'aal imeen
Wamina aash-shayaateeni many yyaghoosoona lahu waya'mal oona 'amal a doona zaal ika wakunnaa lahum haafizeen
Wayyooba 'iz naadaa rabbahu 'anni massaneea aad-durru waanta 'arhamu aur-raahimeen
Faastajabnaa lahu fakashafnaa maa bihi min durr wa'aataynaahu 'ahlahu wamithlahum mma'ahum rahmat mmin 'indinaa wazikraa lil'aabideen
Waismaa'eela waidreesa wazaa aal kifli kul l mmina aas-saabireen
Waadkhal naahum fi rahmatinaa 'innahum mmina aas-saal iheen
Wazaa aan-nooni 'iz zzahaba mughaadiba fazanna 'al llan nnaqdira 'al ayhi fanaadaa fi aiz-zul umaati 'al llaa 'il aaha 'il laa 'anta subhaanaka 'inni kuntu mina aaz-zaal imeen
Faastajabnaa lahu wanajjaynaahu mina aal ghammi wakazaal ika nuji ail mu'mineen
Wazakariyyaa'a az naadaa rabbahu rabbi laa tazarni farda waanta khayru aul waaritheen
Faastajabnaa lahu wawahabnaa lahu yahyaa waaslahnaa lahu zawjahu 'innahum kaanu yusaari'oona fi ail khayraati wayad'oonanaa raghaba warahaba wakaanu lanaa khaashi'een
Waal ti 'ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehaa mir rroohinaa waja'al naahaa waabnahaa 'ayat llil'aal ameen
'inna haazihi 'ummatukum 'ummat waahidat waanaa rabbukum faa'budoon
Wataqatta'u 'amrahum baynahum kul lun 'il aynaa raaji'oon
Famany yya'mal mina aas-saal ihaati wahwa mu'min fal aa kufraana lisa'yihi wainnaa lahu kaatiboon
Waharaamun 'al aa qaryatin 'ahlaknaahaa 'annahum laa yarji'oon
Hattaa 'izaa futihat yaajooju wamaajooju wahum mmin kul li hadab yansil oon
Waaqtaraba aal wa'du aul haqqu faizaa heea shaakhisatun 'absaaru aul zeena kafaru yaawaylanaa qad kunnaa fi ghaflat mmin haazaa bal kunnaa zaal imeen
'innakum wamaa ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi hasabu jahannama 'antum lahaa waaridoon
Law kaana haa'ul aa'i aal ihat mmaa waradoohaa wakul l feehaa khaal idoon
Lahum feehaa zafeer wahum feehaa laa yasma'oon
'inna aal zeena sabaqat lahum mminnaa aal husnaa 'ul aa'ika 'anhaa mub'adoon
Laa yasma'oona haseesahaa wahum fi maa aashtahat 'anfusuhum khaal idoon
Laa yahzunuhumu aul faza'u aul akbaru watatal aqqayaahumu aul mal aa'ikatu haazaa yawmukumu aul zi kuntum too'adoon
Yawma natwi ais-samaa'a katayyi ais-sijil li lil kitaabi kamaa badanaa 'awwal a khal q nnu'eeduhu wa'daan 'al aynaa 'innaa kunnaa faa'il een
Wal aqad katabnaa fi aiz-zaboori mim ba'di aiz-zikri 'anna aal arda yarithuhaa 'ibaadeea aas-saal ihoon
'inna fi haazaa labal aagha lliqawmin 'aabideen
Wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa rahmat llil'aal ameen
Qul 'innamaa yoohaa 'il ayya 'annamaa 'il aahukum 'il aah waahid fahal 'antum mmuslimoon
Fain tawal lawa faqul 'aazantukum 'al aa sawaa' wain 'adri 'aqareebun 'am ba'eed mmaa too'adoon
'innahu ya'lamu aul jahra mina aal qawli waya'lamu maa taktumoon
Wain 'adri la'al laahu fitnat llakum wamataa'un 'il aa heen
Qur-rabbi aihkum bial haqqi warabbunaa aar-rahmaanu aul musta'aanu 'al aa maa tasifoon
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu auttaqu rabbakum 'inna zal zal ata aas-saa'ati sha'un 'azeem
Yawma tarawnahaa tazhal u kul lu murdi'atin 'ammaa 'arda'at watada'u kul lu zaati hamlin hamlahaa wataraa aan-naasa sukaaraa wamaa hum bisukaaraa wal aakinna 'azaaba aal laahi shadeed
Wamina aan-naasi many yyujaadil u fi ail laahi bighayri 'il m wayattabi'u kul la shaytaam mmareed
Kutiba 'al ayhi 'annahu man tawal laahu faannahu yudil luhu wayahdeehi 'il aa 'azaabi ais-sa'eer

Yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'in kuntum fi rayb mmina aal ba'thi fainnaa khal aqnaakum mmin turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma min 'al aqat thumma mim mmudghat mmukhal laqat waghayri mukhal laqat llinubayyina lakum wanuqirru fi ail arhaami maa nashaa'u ail aa 'ajal mmusamma thumma nukhrijukum tifla thumma litablughu 'ashuddakum waminkum mmany yyutawaffaa waminkum mmany yyuraddu 'il aa 'arzal i ail'umuri likaylaa ya'lama mim ba'di 'il m shaya wataraa aal arda haamidat faizaa 'anzal naa 'al ayhaa aal maa'a aahtazzat warabat waanbatat min kul li zawji baheej
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha hooa aal haqqu waannahu yuhyi ail mawtaa waannahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Waanna aas-saa'ata 'aateeat llaa rayba feehaa waanna aal laaha yab'athu man fi ail quboor
Wamina aan-naasi many yyujaadil u fi ail laahi bighayri 'il m wal aa huda wal aa kitaab mmuneer
Thaaneea 'itfihi leeudil la 'an sabeeli ail laahi lahu fi aid-dunyaa khizy wanuzeequhu yawma aal qeeaamati 'azaaba aal hareeq
Zaal ika bimaa qaddamat yadaaka waanna aal laaha laysa bizal laam llil'abeed

Wamina aan-naasi many yya'budu aul laaha 'al aa harf fain 'asaabahu khayrun aitmaanna bihi wain 'asaabathu fitnatun ainqal aba 'al aa wajhihi khasira aad-dunyaa waal aakhirata zaal ika hooa aal khusraanu aul mubeen
Yad'u min dooni ail laahi maa laa yadurruhu wamaa laa yanfa'uhu zaal ika hooa aad-dal aal u aul ba'eed
Yad'u laman darruhu 'aqrabu min nnaf'ihi labeesa aal mawlaa wal abeesa aal'asheer
'inna aal laaha yudkhil u aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru 'inna aal laaha yaf'al u maa yureed
Man kaana yazunnu 'al llany yyansurahu aul laahu fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati fal yamdud bisababin 'il aa aas-samaa'i thumma lyaqta' fal yanzur hal yuzhibanna kayduhu maa yagheez
Wakazaal ika 'anzal naahu 'ayaati bayyinaat waanna aal laaha yahdi many yyureed
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu waal zeena haadu waas-saabeena waan-nasaaraa waal majoosa waal zeena 'ashraku 'inna aal laaha yafsil u baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati 'inna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' shaheed

'al am tara 'anna aal laaha yasjudu lahu man fi ais-samaawaati waman fi ail ardi waash-shamsu waal qamaru waan-nujoomu waal jibaal u waash-shajaru waad-dawaabbu wakatheer mmina aan-naasi wakatheerun haqqa 'al ayhi ail'azaabu wamany yyuhini ail laahu famaa lahu mim mmukrimin 'inna aal laaha yaf'al u maa yashaa'

Haazaani khasmaani aikhtasamu fi rabbihim faal zeena kafaru qutti'at lahum theeaab mmin nnaar yusabbu min fawqi ru'oosihimu aul hameemu yusharu bihi maa fi butoonihim waal jul oodu wal ahum mmaqaami'u min hadeed
Kul lamaa 'araadu 'any yyakhruju minhaa min ghammin 'u'eedu feehaa wazooqu 'azaaba aal hareeq
'inna aal laaha yudkhil u aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru yuhal lawna feehaa min 'asaawira min zahab wal u'lu'a wal ibaasuhum feehaa hareer
Wahudu 'il aa aat-tayyibi mina aal qawli wahudu 'il aa siraati ail hameed

'inna aal zeena kafaru wayasuddoona 'an sabeeli ail laahi waal masjidi ail haraami ail zi ja'al naahu lin-naasi sawaa'un ail'aakifu feehi waal baadi wamany yyurid feehi biil haadi bizul m nnuziqhu min 'azaabin 'al eem
Waiz bawwanaa liibraaheema makaana aal bayti 'al llaa tushrik bi shaya watahhir bayteea lit-taa'ifeena waal qaa'imeena waar-rukka'i ais-sujood
Waazzin fi ain-naasi bial hajji yatooka rijaal a wa'al aa kul li daamir yateena min kul li fajjin 'ameeq
Lleeashhadu manaafi'a lahum wayazkuru ausma aal laahi fi 'ayyaam mma'loomaatin 'al aa maa razaqahum mmim baheemati ail an'aami fakul u minhaa waat'imu aul baa'isa aal faqeer
Thumma lyaqdu tafathahum wal yoofu nuzoorahum wal yattawwafu bial bayti ail'ateeq

Zaal ika wamany yyu'azzim hurumaati ail laahi fahwa khayr llaahu 'inda rabbihi wauhil lat lakumu aul an'aamu 'il laa maa yutlaa 'al aykum faajtanibu aur-rijsa mina aal awthaani waajtanibu qawla aaz-zoor
Hunafaa'a lil hi ghayra mushrikeena bihi wamany yyushrik bial laahi fakaannamaa kharra mina aas-samaa'i fatakhattafuhu aut-tayru 'aw tahwi bihi air-reehu fi makaan saheeq
Zaal ika wamany yyu'azzim sha'aa'ira aal laahi fainnahaa min taqwaa aal qul oob
Lakum feehaa manaafi'u 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma thumma mahil luhaa 'il aa aal bayti ail'ateeq
Wal ikul li 'ummat ja'al naa mansaka lleeazkuru ausma aal laahi 'al aa maa razaqahum mmim baheemati ail an'aami fail aahukum 'il aah waahid fal ahu 'aslimu wabashshiri ail mukhbiteen
Aal zeena 'izaa zukira aal laahu wajil at qul oobuhum waas-saabireena 'al aa maa 'asaabahum waal muqeemi ais-sal awaati wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon

Waal budna ja'al naahaa lakum mmin sha'aa'iri ail laahi lakum feehaa khayr faazkuru ausma aal laahi 'al ayhaa sawaaffa faizaa wajabat junoobuhaa fakul u minhaa waat'imu aul qaani'a waal mu'tarra kazaal ika sakhkharnaahaa lakum la'al lakum tashkuroon
Lany yyanaal a aal laaha luhoomuhaa wal aa dimaa'uhaa wal aakiny yyanaal uhu aut-taqwaa minkum kazaal ika sakhkharahaa lakum litukabbiru aul laaha 'al aa maa hadayaakum wabashshiri ail muhsineen
'inna aal laaha yudaafi'u 'ani ail zeena 'aamanu 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu kul la khawwaan kafoor
'uzina lil zeena yuqaatal oona biannahum zul imu wainna aal laaha 'al aa nasrihim laqadeer

Ail zeena 'ukhriju min deeaarihim bighayri haqqin 'il laa 'any yyaqoolu rabbunaa aal laahu wal awlaa difaa'u aul laahi ain-naasa ba'dahum biba'd llaahudimat sawaami'u wabeea' wasal awaat wamasaajidu yuzkaru feehaa aasmu aul laahi katheera wal ayansuranna aal laahu many yyansuruhu 'inna aal laaha laqaweeyun 'azeez
Ail zeena 'im mmakkannaahum fi ail ardi 'aqaamu aus-sal awaata wa'aatawua auz-zakawaata waamaru bial ma'roofi wanahawa 'ani ail munkari wal il hi 'aaqibatu aul umoor
Wainy yyukazzibooka faqad kazzabat qablahum qawmu nooh wa'aad wathamood
Waqawmu 'ibraaheema waqawmu looh
Waashaabu madyana wakuzziba moosaa faamlaytu lil kaafireena thumma 'akhazttuhum fakayfa kaana nakeer
Fakayyim mmin qaryatin 'ahlaknaahaa wahya zaal imat fahya khaaweeatun 'al aa 'urooshihaa wabeer mmu'attal at waqasr mmasheed
'afal am yaseeru fi ail ardi fatakoona lahum qul oob ya'qil oona bihaa 'aw 'aazaany yasma'oona bihaa fainnahaa laa ta'maa aal absaaru wal aakin ta'maa aal qul oobu aul ti fi ais-sudoor
Wayasta'jil oonaka bial'azaabi wal any yyukhlifa aal laahu wa'dahu wainna yawmaan 'inda rabbika kaal fi sanat mmimmaa ta'uddoon
Wakayyim mmin qaryatin 'amlaytu lahaa wahya zaal imat thumma 'akhazttuhaa wail ayya aal maseer
Qul yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'innamaa 'anaa lakum nazeer mmubeen
Faal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Waal zeena sa'awa fi 'ayaatinaa mu'aajizeena 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jaheem

Wamaa 'arsal naa min qablika mir rrasool wal aa nabiaa'in 'il laa 'izaa tamannaa 'al qaa aash-shaytaanu fi 'umniyyatihi fayansakhu aul laahu maa yul qi aish-shaytaanu thumma yuhkimu aul laahu 'ayaatihi waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Lleeaj'al a maa yul qi aish-shaytaanu fitnat llil zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad waal qaaseeati qul oobuhum wainna aaz-zaal imeena lafi shiqaaqi ba'eed
Wal eea'lama aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma 'annahu aul haqqu mir rrabbika fayu'minu bihi fatukhbita lahu qul oobuhum wainna aal laaha lahaadi ail zeena 'aamanu 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal aa yazaal u aul zeena kafaru fi miryat mminhu hattaa tateeahumu aus-saa'atu baghtatan 'aw yateeahum 'azaabu yawmin 'aqeem
Ail mul ku yawma'iz llil hi yahkumu baynahum faal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fi jannaati ain-na'eem
Waal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa faul aa'ika lahum 'azaab mmuheen
Waal zeena haajaru fi sabeeli ail laahi thumma qutil u 'aw maatu layarzuqannahumu aul laahu rizqaan hasana wainna aal laaha lahwa khayru aur-raaziqeen
Layudkhil annahum mmadkhal a yardawnahu wainna aal laaha la'al eemun hal eem
Zaal ika waman 'aaqaba bimithli maa 'ooqiba bihi thumma bugheea 'al ayhi layansurannahu aul laahu 'inna aal laaha la'afoowun ghafoor
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha yooliju aul yla fi ain-nahaari wayooliju aun-nahaara fi ail yli waanna aal laaha samee'u baseer
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha hooa aal haqqu waanna maa tad'oona min doonihi hooa aal baatil u waanna aal laaha hooa aal'al eeyu aul kabeer
'al am tara 'anna aal laaha 'anzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' fatusbihu aul ardu mukhdarratan 'inna aal laaha lateefun khabeer
Llaahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wainna aal laaha lahwa aal ghaneeyu aul hameed

'al am tara 'anna aal laaha sakhkhara lakum mmaa fi ail ardi waal ful ka tajri fi ail bahri biamrihi wayumsiku aus-samaa 'an taqa'a 'al aa aal ardi 'il laa biiznihi 'inna aal laaha bian-naasi lara'oof rraheem
Wahwa aal zi 'ahyaakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum 'inna aal insaana lakafoor
Llikul li 'ummat ja'al naa mansakaan hum naasikoohu fal aa yunaazi'unnaka fi ail amri waad'u 'il aa rabbika 'innaka la'al aa huda mmustaqeem
Wain jaadal ooka faqul i ail laahu 'a'lamu bimaa ta'mal oon
Aal laahu yahkumu baynakum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kuntum feehi takhtal ifoon
'al am ta'lam 'anna aal laaha ya'lamu maa fi ais-samaa'i waal ardi 'inna zaal ika fi kitaabin 'inna zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Waya'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa lam yunazzil bihi sul taana wamaa laysa lahum bihi 'il m wamaa liz-zaal imeena min nnaseer

Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat ta'rifu fi wujoohi ail zeena kafaru aul munkara yakaadoona yastoona bial zeena yatloona 'al ayhim 'ayaatinaa qul 'afaunabbeeukum bisharr mmin zaal ikumu aun-naaru wa'adahaa aal laahu aul zeena kafaru wabeesa aal maseer

Yayyuhaa aan-naasu duriba mathal faastami'u lahu 'inna aal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi lany yyakhluqu zubaaba wal awi aijtama'u lahu wainy yyaslubhumu auz-zubaabu shaya llaa yastanqizoohu minhu da'ufa aat-taal ibu waal matloob
Maa qadaru aul laaha haqqa qadrihi 'inna aal laaha laqaweeyun 'azeez
Ail laahu yastafi mina aal mal aa'ikati rusul a wamina aan-naasi 'inna aal laaha samee'u baseer
Ya'lamu maa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wail aa aal laahi turja'u aul umoor
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu aurka'u waasjudu waa'budu rabbakum waaf'al u aul khayra la'al lakum tuflihoon

Wajaahidu fi ail laahi haqqa jihaadihi hooa aajtabayaakum wamaa ja'al a 'al aykum fi aid-deeni min haraj mmil lata 'abeekum 'ibraaheema hooa sammayaakumu aul muslimeena min qablu wafi haazaa leeakoona aar-rasoolu shaheedaan 'al aykum watakoonu shuhadaa'a 'al aa aan-naasi faaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata waa'tasimu bial laahi hooa mawlayaakum fani'ma aal mawlaa wani'ma aan-naseer
Qad 'aflaha aal mu'minoon
Aal zeena hum fi sal aatihim khaashi'oon
Waal zeena hum 'ani ail laghwi mu'ridoon
Waal zeena hum liz-zakawaati faa'il oon
Waal zeena hum lifuroojihim haafizoon
'il laa 'al aa 'azwaajihim 'aw maa mal akat 'aymaanuhum fainnahum ghayru mal oomeen
Famani aibtaghaa waraa'a zaal ika faul aa'ika humu aul'aadoon
Waal zeena hum liamaanaatihim wa'ahdihim raa'oon
Waal zeena hum 'al aa sal awaatihim yuhaafizoon
'ul aa'ika humu aul waarithoon
Aal zeena yarithoona aal firdawsa hum feehaa khaal idoon
Wal aqad khal aqnaa aal insaana min sul aal at mmin teen
Thumma ja'al naahu nutfat fi qaraar mmakeen

Thumma khal aqnaa aan-nutfata 'al aqat fakhal aqnaa aal'al aqata mudghat fakhal aqnaa aal mudghata 'izaama fakasawnaa aal'izaama lahma thumma 'anshanaahu khal qaan 'aakhara fatabaaraka aal laahu 'ahsanu aul khaal iqeen
Thumma 'innakum ba'da zaal ika lamayyitoon
Thumma 'innakum yawma aal qeeaamati tub'athoon
Wal aqad khal aqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraa'iqa wamaa kunnaa 'ani ail khal qi ghaafil een
Waanzal naa mina aas-samaa'i maa'a biqadar faaskannaahu fi ail ardi wainnaa 'al aa zahaabi bihi laqaadiroon
Faanshanaa lakum bihi jannaat mmin nnakheel waa'naab llakum feehaa fawaakihu katheerat waminhaa takul oon
Washajarat takhruju min toori seenaa'a tanbutu biad-duhni wasibgh llil aakil een
Wainna lakum fi ail an'aami la'ibrat nnasqeekum mmimmaa fi butoonihaa wal akum feehaa manaafi'u katheerat waminhaa takul oon
Wa'al ayhaa wa'al aa aal ful ki tuhmal oon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa noohaan 'il aa qawmihi faqaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu 'afal aa tattaqoon

Faqaal a aal mal a'ua aul zeena kafaru min qawmihi maa haazaa 'il laa bashar mmithlukum yureedu 'any yyatafaddal a 'al aykum wal aw shaa'a aal laahu laanzal a mal aa'ikat mmaa sami'naa bihaazaa fi 'aabaa'inaa aal awwal een
'in hooa 'il laa rajul u bihi jinnat fatarabbasu bihi hattaa heen
Qaal a rabbi ainsurni bimaa kazzaboon

Faawhaynaa 'il ayhi 'ani aisna'i ail ful ka bia'yuninaa wawahyinaa faizaa jaa 'amrunaa wafaara aat-tannooru faasluk feehaa min kul li zawjayni aithnayni waahlaka 'il laa man sabaqa 'al ayhi ail qawlu minhum wal aa tukhaatibni fi ail zeena zal amu 'innahum mmughraqoon
Faizaa aastawayta 'anta wamam mma'aka 'al aa aal ful ki faqul i ail hamdu lil hi ail zi najjayaanaa mina aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Waqur-rabbi 'anzil ni munzal a mmubaaraka waanta khayru aul munzil een
'inna fi zaal ika layaat wain kunnaa lamubtal een
Thumma 'anshanaa mim ba'dihim qarnaan 'aakhareen
Faarsal naa feehim rasoola mminhum 'anu au'budu aul laaha maa lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayruhu 'afal aa tattaqoon

Waqaal a aal mal au min qawmihi ail zeena kafaru wakazzabu bil iqaa'i ail aakhirati waatrafnaahum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa maa haazaa 'il laa bashar mmithlukum yakul u mimmaa takul oona minhu wayashrabu mimmaa tashraboon
Wal a'in 'ata'tum bashara mmithlakum 'innakum 'iza llakhaasiroon
'aya'idukum 'annakum 'izaa mittum wakuntum turaaba wa'izaamaan 'annakum mmukhrajoon
Hayhaata hayhaata limaa too'adoon
'in heea 'il laa hayaatunaa aad-dunyaa namootu wanahyaa wamaa nahnu bimab'ootheen
'in hooa 'il laa rajul un aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kaziba wamaa nahnu lahu bimu'mineen
Qaal a rabbi ainsurni bimaa kazzaboon
Qaal a 'ammaa qal eel llayusbihunna naadimeen
Faakhazathumu aus-sayhatu bial haqqi faja'al naahum ghuthaa' fabu'da llil qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Thumma 'anshanaa mim ba'dihim quroonaan 'aakhareen
Maa tasbiqu min 'ummatin 'ajal ahaa wamaa yastaakhiroon
Thumma 'arsal naa rusul anaa tatraa kul la maa jaa'a ammat rrasooluhaa kazzaboohu faatba'naa ba'dahum ba'da waja'al naahum 'ahaadeetha fabu'da lliqawm llaa yu'minoon
Thumma 'arsal naa moosaa waakhaahu haaroon
Biayaatinaa wasul taam mmubeen
'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi faastakbaru wakaanu qawmaan 'aal een
Faqaal u 'anu'minu libasharayni mithlinaa waqawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon
Fakazzaboohumaa fakaanu mina aal muhlakeen
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba la'al laahum yahtadoon
Waja'al naa aabna maryama waummahu 'ayat wa'aawaynaahumaa 'il aa rubwat zaati qaraar wama'een
Yayyuhaa aar-rusul u kul u mina aat-tayyibaati waa'mal u saal ihaan 'inni bimaa ta'mal oona 'al eem
Waanna haazihi 'ummatukum 'ummat waahidat waanaa rabbukum faattaqoon
Fataqatta'u 'amrahum baynahum zubura kul lu hizbi bimaa ladayhim farihoon
Fazarhum fi ghamratihim hattaa heen
'ayahsiboona 'annamaa numidduhum bihi mim mmaal wabaneen
Nusaari'u lahum fi ail khayraati bal-laa yash'uroon
'inna aal zeena hum mmin khashyati rabbihim mmushfiqoon
Waal zeena hum biayaati rabbihim yu'minoon
Waal zeena hum birabbihim laa yushrikoon
Waal zeena yu'toona maa 'aata wwaqul oobuhum wajil atun 'annahum 'il aa rabbihim raaji'oon
'ul aa'ika yusaari'oona fi ail khayraati wahum lahaa saabiqoon
Wal aa nukal lifu nafsaan 'il laa wus'ahaa wal adaynaa kitaab yantiqu bial haqqi wahum laa yuzlamoon
Bal qul oobuhum fi ghamrat mmin haazaa wal ahum 'a'maal mmin dooni zaal ika hum lahaa 'aamil oon
Hattaa 'izaa 'akhaznaa mutrafeehim bial'azaabi 'izaa hum yajaroon
Laa tajaru aul yawma 'innakum mminnaa laa tunsaroon
Qad kaanat 'ayaati tutlaa 'al aykum fakuntum 'al aa 'a'qaabikum tankisoon
Mustakbireena bihi saamira tuhjiroon
'afal am yaddabbaru aul qawla 'am jaa'ahum mmaa lam yati 'aabaa'ahumu aul awwal een
'am lam ya'rifu rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroon
'am yaqooloona bihi jinnatu bal jaa'ahum bial haqqi waaktharuhum lil haqqi kaarihoon
Wal awi aittaba'a aal haqqu 'ahwaa'ahum lafasadati ais-samaawaatu waal ardu waman feehinna bal 'ataynaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mmu'ridoon
'am tasal uhum kharja fakharaaju rabbika khayr wahwa khayru aur-raaziqeen
Wainnaka latad'oohum 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wainna aal zeena laa yu'minoona bial aakhirati 'ani ais-siraati lanaakiboon
Wal aw rahimnaahum wakashafnaa maa bihim mmin durr llal ajju fi tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
Wal aqad 'akhaznaahum bial'azaabi famaa aastakaanu lirabbihim wamaa yatadarra'oon
Hattaa 'izaa fatahnaa 'al ayhim baaba zaa 'azaab shadeedin 'izaa hum feehi mublisoon
Wahwa aal zi 'anshaa lakumu aus-sam'a waal absaara waal afidata qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Wahwa aal zi zaraakum fi ail ardi wail ayhi tuhsharoon
Wahwa aal zi yuhyi wayumeetu wal ahu aukhtil aafu aul yli waan-nahaari 'afal aa ta'qil oon
Bal qaal u mithla maa qaal a aal awwal oon
Qaal u 'aazaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaaba wa'izaamaan 'innaa lamab'oothoon
Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa'aabaa'unaa haazaa min qablu 'in haazaa 'il laa 'asaateeru aul awwal een
Qul-limani ail ardu waman feehaa 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Sayaqooloona lil hi qul 'afal aa tazzakkaroon
Qul mar rrabbu aus-samaawaati ais-sab'i warabbu aul'arshi ail'azeem
Sayaqooloona lil hi qul 'afal aa tattaqoon
Qul mam beeadihi mal akootu kul li sha' wahwa yujeeru wal aa yujaaru 'al ayhi 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Sayaqooloona lil hi qul faannaa tusharoon
Bal 'ataynaahum bial haqqi wainnahum lakaaziboon
Maa aattakhaza aal laahu minw wwal ad wamaa kaana ma'ahu min 'il aahin 'iza llazahaba kul lu 'il aahi bimaa khal aqa wal a'al aa ba'duhum 'al aa ba'd subhaana aal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon
'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati fata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Qur-rabbi 'immaa tureeanni maa yoo'adoon
Rabbi fal aa taj'al ni fi ail qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wainnaa 'al aa 'an nnureeaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon
Aadfa' bial ti heea 'ahsanu aus-sayyeeata nahnu 'a'lamu bimaa yasifoon
Waqur-rabbi 'a'oozu bika min hamazaati aish-shayaateen
Waa'oozu bika rabbi 'any yyahduroon
Hattaa 'izaa jaa 'ahadahumu aul mawtu qaal a rabbi airji'oon
La'al leea 'a'mal u saal iha feemaa taraktu kal laa 'innahaa kal imatun hooa qaa'il uhaa waminw wwaraa'ihim barzakhun 'il aa yawmi yub'athoon
Faizaa nufikha fi ais-soori fal aa 'ansaaba baynahum yawma'iz wal aa yatasaa'al oon
Faman thaqul at mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Waman khaffat mawaazeenuhu faul aa'ika aal zeena khasiru 'anfusahum fi jahannama khaal idoon
Tal fahu wujoohahumu aun-naaru wahum feehaa kaal ihoon
'al am takun 'ayaati tutlaa 'al aykum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon
Qaal u rabbanaa ghal abat 'al aynaa shiqwatunaa wakunnaa qawma daal leen
Rabbanaa 'akhrijnaa minhaa fain 'udnaa fainnaa zaal imoon
Qaal a aakhsau feehaa wal aa tukal limoon
'innahu kaana fareeq mmin 'ibaadi yaqooloona rabbanaa 'aamannaa faaghfir lanaa waarhamnaa waanta khayru aur-raahimeen
Faattakhazttumoohum sukhriyyaan hattaa 'ansawkum zikri wakuntum mminhum tadhakoon
'inni jazaytuhumu aul yawma bimaa sabaru 'annahum humu aul faa'izoon
Qaal a kam labithtum fi ail ardi 'adada sineen
Qaal u labithnaa yawmaan 'aw ba'da yawm fasal i ail'aaddeen
Qaal a 'il llabithtum 'il laa qal eela llaw 'annakum kuntum ta'lamoon
'afahasibtum 'annamaa khal aqnaakum 'abatha waannakum 'il aynaa laa turja'oon
Fata'aal aa aal laahu aul mal iku aul haqqu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa rabbu aul'arshi ail kareem
Wamany yyad'u ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan 'aakhara laa burhaana lahu bihi fainnamaa hisaabuhu 'inda rabbihi 'innahu laa yuflihu aul kaafiroon
Waqur-rabbi aighfir waarham waanta khayru aur-raahimeen
Sooratun 'anzal naahaa wafaradnaahaa waanzal naa feehaa 'ayaati bayyinaat lla'al lakum tazzakkaroon

Aaz-zaaneeatu waaz-zaani faajlidu kul la waahid mminhumaa miayata jal dat wal aa takhuzkum bihimaa rafat fi deeni ail laahi 'in kuntum tu'minoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri wal yashhad 'azaabahumaa taa'ifat mmina aal mu'mineen
Aaz-zaani laa yankihu 'il laa zaaneeatan 'aw mushrikat waaz-zaaneeatu laa yankihuhaa 'il laa zaanin 'aw mushrik wahurrima zaal ika 'al aa aal mu'mineen
Waal zeena yarmoona aal muhsanaati thumma lam yatu biarba'ati shuhadaa'a faajlidoohum thamaaneena jal dat wal aa taqbal u lahum shahaadatan 'abada waul aa'ika humu aul faasiqoon
'il laa aal zeena taabu mim ba'di zaal ika waaslahu fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Waal zeena yarmoona 'azwaajahum wal am yakul llaahum shuhadaa'u ail laa 'anfusuhum fashahaadatu 'ahadihim 'arba'a shahaadaati bial laahi 'innahu lamina aas-saadiqeen
Waal khaamisatu 'al lla'natu aul laahi 'al ayhi 'in kaana mina aal kaazibeen
Wayadra'ua 'anhaa aal'azaaba 'an tashhada 'arba'a shahaadaati bial laahi 'innahu lamina aal kaazibeen
Waal khaamisatu 'an ghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhaa 'in kaana mina aas-saadiqeen
Wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu waanna aal laaha tawwaabun hakeem

'inna aal zeena jaa'oo bial ifki 'usbat mminkum laa tahsiboohu sharra llakum bal hooa khayr llakum likul li aimri mminhum mmaa aaktasaba mina aal ithmi waal zi tawal laa kibrahu minhum lahu 'azaabun 'azeem
Llawlaa 'iz sami'tumoohu zanna aal mu'minoona waal mu'minaatu bianfusihim khayra waqaal u haazaa 'ifk mmubeen
Llawlaa jaa'oo 'al ayhi biarba'ati shuhadaa'a faiz lam yatu biash-shuhadaa'i faul aa'ika 'inda aal laahi humu aul kaaziboon
Wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati lamassakum fi maa 'afadtum feehi 'azaabun 'azeem
'iz tal aqqawnahu bial sinatikum wataqooloona biafwaahikum mmaa laysa lakum bihi 'il m watahsiboonahu hayyina wahwa 'inda aal laahi 'azeem
Wal awlaa 'iz sami'tumoohu qul tum mmaa yakoonu lanaa 'an nnatakal lama bihaazaa subhaanaka haazaa buhtaanun 'azeem
Ya'izukumu aul laahu 'an ta'oodu limithlihi 'abadaan 'in kuntum mmu'mineen
Wayubayyinu aul laahu lakumu aul ayaati waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
'inna aal zeena yuhibboona 'an tashee'a aal faahishatu fi ail zeena 'aamanu lahum 'azaabun 'al eem fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati waal laahu ya'lamu waantum laa ta'lamoon
Wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu waanna aal laaha ra'oof rraheem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattabi'u khutwaati aish-shaytaani wamany yyattabi' khutwaati aish-shaytaani fainnahu yamuru bial fahshaa'i waal munkari wal awlaa fadlu aul laahi 'al aykum warahmatuhu maa zakaa minkum mmin 'ahadin 'abada wal aakinna aal laaha yuzakki many yyashaa'u waal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Wal aa yatal i 'oolu aul fadli minkum waas-sa'ati 'any yyu'tu 'ooli ail qurbaa waal masaakeena waal muhaajireena fi sabeeli ail laahi wal ya'fu wal yasfahu 'al aa tuhibboona 'any yyaghfira aal laahu lakum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
'inna aal zeena yarmoona aal muhsanaati ail ghaafil aati ail mu'minaati lu'inu fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Yawma tashhadu 'al ayhim 'al sinatuhum waydeehim waarjul uhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Yawma'iz yooaffeehimu aul laahu deenahumu aul haqqa waya'lamoona 'anna aal laaha hooa aal haqqu aul mubeen

Aul khabeethaatu lil khabeetheena waal khabeethoona lil khabeethaati waat-tayyibaatu lit-tayyibeena waat-tayyiboona lit-tayyibaati 'ul aa'ika mubarra'oona mimmaa yaqooloona lahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tadkhul u beeootaan ghayra beeootikum hattaa tastanisu watusal limu 'al aa 'ahlihaa zaal ikum khayr llakum la'al lakum tazzakkaroon
Fail llam tajidu feehaa 'ahada fal aa tadkhul oohaa hattaa yu'zana lakum wain qeela lakumu aurji'u faarji'u hooa 'azkaa lakum waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona 'al eem
Llaysa 'al aykum junaahun 'an tadkhul u beeootaan ghayra maskoonat feehaa mataa' llakum waal laahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
Qul-lil mu'mineena yaghuddu min 'absaarihim wayahfazu furoojahum zaal ika 'azkaa lahum 'inna aal laaha khabeeru bimaa yasna'oon

Waqul-lil mu'minaati yaghdudna min 'absaarihinna wayahfazna furoojahunna wal aa yubdeena zeenatahunna 'il laa maa zahara minhaa wal yadribna bikhumurihinna 'al aa juyoobihinna wal aa yubdeena zeenatahunna 'il laa libu'oolatihinna 'aw 'aabaa'ihinna 'aw 'aabaa'i bu'oolatihinna 'aw 'abnaa'ihinna 'aw 'abnaa'i bu'oolatihinna 'aw 'ikhwaanihinna 'aw bani 'ikhwaanihinna 'aw bani 'akhawaatihinna 'aw nisaa'ihinna 'aw maa mal akat 'aymaanuhunna 'awi ait-taabi'eena ghayri 'ooli ail irbati mina aar-rijaal i 'awi ait-tifli ail zeena lam yazharu 'al aa 'awraati ain-nisaa'i wal aa yadribna biarjul ihinna leeu'lama maa yukhfeena min zeenatihinna watoobu 'il aa aal laahi jamee'aan 'ayyuha aal mu'minoona la'al lakum tuflihoon
Waankihu aul ayaamaa minkum waas-saal iheena min 'ibaadikum waimaa'ikum 'iny yyakoonu fuqaraa'a yughnihimu aul laahu min fadlihi waal laahu waasi'un 'al eem

Wal yasta'fifi ail zeena laa yajidoona nikaahaan hattaa yughneeahumu aul laahu min fadlihi waal zeena yabtaghoona aal kitaaba mimmaa mal akat 'aymaanukum fakaatiboohum 'in 'al imtum feehim khayra wa'aatoohum mmim mmaal i ail laahi ail zi 'aatayaakum wal aa tukrihu fatayaatikum 'al aa aal bighaa 'in 'aradna tahassuna llitabtaghu 'arada aal hayawaati aid-dunyaa wamany yyukrihhhunna fainna aal laaha mim ba'di 'ikraahihinna ghafoor rraheem
Wal aqad 'anzal naa 'il aykum 'ayaat mmubayyanaat wamathal a mmina aal zeena khal awa min qablikum wamaw'izat llil muttaqeen

Aal laahu nooru aus-samaawaati waal ardi mathal u noorihi kamishkawaat feehaa misbaahun ail misbaahu fi zujaajatin aiz-zujaajatu kaannahaa kawkab durreey yooqadu min shajarat mmubaarakat zaytoonat llaa sharqiyyat wal aa gharbiyyat yakaadu zaytuhaa yudiaa'u wal aw lam tamsashu naar nnoorun 'al aa noor yahdi ail laahu linoorihi many yyashaa'u wayadribu aul laahu aul amthaal a lin-naasi waal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Fi beeootin 'azina aal laahu 'an turfa'a wayuzkara feehaa aasmuhu yusabbihu lahu feehaa bial ghudoowi waal aasaal i  rijaal-laa tul heehim tijaarat wal aa bay'un 'an zikri ail laahi waiqaami ais-sal awaati waeetaa'i aiz-zakawaati yakhaafoona yawma tataqal labu feehi ail qul oobu waal absaar
Leeajzeeahumu aul laahu 'ahsana maa 'amil u wayazeedahum mmin fadlihi waal laahu yarzuqu many yyashaa'u bighayri hisaab
Waal zeena kafaru 'a'maal uhum kasaraabi biqee'at yahsibuhu auz-zamaanu maa'an hattaa 'izaa jaa'ahu lam yajidhu shaya wawajada aal laaha 'indahu fawaffayaahu hisaabahu waal laahu saree'u aul hisaab

'aw kazul umaat fi bahr llujjeey yaghshayaahu mawj mmin fawqihi mawj mmin fawqihi sahaab zul umaatu ba'duhaa fawqa ba'din 'izaa 'akhraja yadahu lam yakad yarayaahaa wamal llam yaj'al i ail laahu lahu noora famaa lahu min nnoor
'al am tara 'anna aal laaha yusabbihu lahu man fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi waat-tayru saaffaat kul l qad 'al ima sal aatahu watasbeehahu waal laahu 'al eemu bimaa yaf'al oon
Wal il hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi wail aa aal laahi ail maseer

'al am tara 'anna aal laaha yuzji sahaaba thumma yu'al lifu baynahu thumma yaj'al uhu rukaama fataraa aal wadqa yakhruju min khil aal ihi wayunazzil u mina aas-samaa'i min jibaal feehaa mim barad fayuseebu bihi many yyashaa'u wayasrifuhu 'am mmany yyashaa'u yakaadu sanaa barqihi yazhabu bial absaari  yuqal libu aul laahu aul yla waan-nahaara 'inna fi zaal ika la'ibrat lliooli ail absaar

Waal laahu khal aqa kul la daabbat mmim mmaa' faminhum mmany yyamshi 'al aa batnihi waminhum mmany yyamshi 'al aa rijlayni waminhum mmany yyamshi 'al aa 'arba' yakhluqu aul laahu maa yashaa'u ainna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Llaqad 'anzal naa 'ayaat mmubayyanaat waal laahu yahdi many yyashaa'u ail aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wayaqooloona 'aamannaa bial laahi wabiar-rasooli waata'naa thumma yatawal laa fareeq mminhum mmim ba'di zaal ika wamaa 'ul aa'ika bial mu'mineen
Waizaa du'u 'il aa aal laahi warasoolihi leeahkuma baynahum 'izaa fareeq mminhum mmu'ridoon
Wainy yyakul llaahumu aul haqqu yatu 'il ayhi muz'ineen
'afi qul oobihim mmaradun 'ami airtaabu 'am yakhaafoona 'any yyaheefa aal laahu 'al ayhim warasooluhu bal 'ul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon
'innamaa kaana qawla aal mu'mineena 'izaa du'u 'il aa aal laahi warasoolihi leeahkuma baynahum 'any yyaqoolu sami'naa waata'naa waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Wamany yyuti'i ail laaha warasoolahu wayakhsha aal laaha wayattaqihi faul aa'ika humu aul faa'izoon
Waaqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihim la'in 'amartahum layakhrujunna qul-laa tuqsimu taa'at mma'roofatun 'inna aal laaha khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon

Qul 'atee'u aul laaha waatee'u aur-rasoola fain tawal lawa fainnamaa 'al ayhi maa hummil a wa'al aykum mmaa hummil tum wain tutee'oohu tahtadu wamaa 'al aa aar-rasooli 'il laa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen

Wa'ada aal laahu aul zeena 'aamanu minkum wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati layastakhlifannahum fi ail ardi kamaa aastakhlafa aal zeena min qablihim wal ayumakkinanna lahum deenahumu aul zi airtadaa lahum wal ayubaddil annahum mmim ba'di khawfihim 'amna ya'budoonani laa yushrikoona bi shaya waman kafara ba'da zaal ika faul aa'ika humu aul faasiqoon
Waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata waatee'u aur-rasoola la'al lakum turhamoon
Laa tahsibanna aal zeena kafaru mu'jizeena fi ail ardi wamawayaahumu aun-naaru wal abeesa aal maseer

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu leeastaazinkumu aul zeena mal akat 'aymaanukum waal zeena lam yablughu aul hul uma minkum thal aatha marraat mmin qabli sal awaati ail fajri waheena tada'oona theeaabakum mmina aaz-zaheerati wamim ba'di sal awaati ail'ishaa'i thal aathu 'awraat llakum laysa 'al aykum wal aa 'al ayhim junaahu ba'dahunna tawwaafoona 'al aykum ba'dukum 'al aa ba'd kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakumu aul ayaati waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Waizaa bal agha aal atfaal u minkumu aul hul uma fal yastaazinu kamaa aastaazana aal zeena min qablihim kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakum 'ayaatihi waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem

Waal qawaa'idu mina aan-nisaa'i ail laati laa yarjoona nikaaha fal aysa 'al ayhinna junaahun 'any yyada'na theeaabahunna ghayra mutabarrijaati bizeenat waany yyasta'fifna khayr llaahunna waal laahu samee'un 'al eem

Llaysa 'al aa aal a'maa haraj wal aa 'al aa aal a'raji haraj wal aa 'al aa aal mareedi haraj wal aa 'al aa 'anfusikum 'an takul u mim beeootikum 'aw beeooti 'aabaa'ikum 'aw beeooti 'ummahaatikum 'aw beeooti 'ikhwaanikum 'aw beeooti 'akhawaatikum 'aw beeooti 'a'maamikum 'aw beeooti 'ammaatikum 'aw beeooti 'akhwaal ikum 'aw beeooti khaal aatikum 'aw maa mal aktum mmafaatihahu 'aw sadeeqikum laysa 'al aykum junaahun 'an takul u jamee'aan 'aw 'ashtaata faizaa dakhal tum beeoota fasal limu 'al aa 'anfusikum tahiyyat mmin 'indi ail laahi mubaarakat tayyibat kazaal ika yubayyinu aul laahu lakumu aul ayaati la'al lakum ta'qil oon

'innamaa aal mu'minoona aal zeena 'aamanu bial laahi warasoolihi waizaa kaanu ma'ahu 'al aa 'amr jaami' llam yazhabu hattaa yastaazinoohu 'inna aal zeena yastaazinoonaka 'ul aa'ika aal zeena yu'minoona bial laahi warasoolihi faizaa aastaazanooka liba'di shanihim fazal lliman sheeta minhum waastaghfir lahumu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem

Llaa taj'al u du'aa'a aar-rasooli baynakum kadu'aa'i ba'dikum ba'da qad ya'lamu aul laahu aul zeena yatasal lal oona minkum liwaaza fal yahzari ail zeena yukhaal ifoona 'an 'amrihi 'an tuseebahum fitnatun 'aw yuseebahum 'azaabun 'al eem
'al aa 'inna lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi qad ya'lamu maa 'antum 'al ayhi wayawma yurja'oona 'il ayhi fayunabbeeuhum bimaa 'amil u waal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Tabaaraka aal zi nazzal a aal furqaana 'al aa 'abdihi leeakoona lil'aal ameena nazeera
Ail zi lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi wal am yattakhiz wal ada wal am yakul llaahu shareek fi ail mul ki wakhal aqa kul la sha' faqaddarahu taqdeer
Waattakhazu min doonihi 'aal ihat llaa yakhluqoona shaya wahum yukhlaqoona wal aa yamlikoona lianfusihim darra wal aa naf'a wal aa yamlikoona mawta wal aa hayawaat wal aa nushoor
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru 'in haazaa 'il laa 'ifkun aiftarayaahu waa'aanahu 'al ayhi qawmun 'aakharoona faqad jaa'oo zul ma wazoor
Waqaal u 'asaateeru aul awwal eena aaktatabahaa fahya tumlaa 'al ayhi bukrat waaseel
Qul 'anzal ahu aul zi ya'lamu aus-sirra fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi 'innahu kaana ghafoora rraheem
Waqaal u maal i haazaa aar-rasooli yakul u aut-ta'aama wayamshi fi ail aswaaqi lawlaa 'unzil a 'il ayhi mal ak fayakoona ma'ahu nazeera
'aw yul qaa 'il ayhi kanzun 'aw takoonu lahu jannat yakul u minhaa waqaal a aaz-zaal imoona 'in tattabi'oona 'il laa rajul a mmashoora
Aunzur kayfa darabu laka aal amthaal a fadal lu fal aa yastatee'oona sabeel
Tabaaraka aal zi 'in shaa'a ja'al a laka khayra mmin zaal ika jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru wayaj'al-laka qusoora
Bal kazzabu bias-saa'ati waa'tadnaa liman kazzaba bias-saa'ati sa'eera
'izaa raathum mmim mmakaani ba'eed sami'u lahaa taghayyuza wazafeer
Waizaa 'ul qu minhaa makaana dayyiqa mmuqarraneena da'awa hunaal ika thuboor
Llaa tad'u aul yawma thuboora waahida waad'u thuboora katheer
Qul 'azaal ika khayrun 'am jannatu aul khul di ail ti wu'ida aal muttaqoona kaanat lahum jazaa' wamaseer
Llaahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona khaal ideena kaana 'al aa rabbika wa'da mmasool
Wayawma nahshuruhum wamaa ya'budoona min dooni ail laahi fayaqoolu 'aantum 'adlal tum 'ibaadi haa'ul aa'i aam hum dal lu aus-sabeel
Qaal u subhaanaka maa kaana yanbaghi lanaa 'an nnattakhiza min doonika min 'awleeaa'a wal aakim mmatta'tahum wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa nasu auz-zikra wakaanu qawmaa boor
Faqad kazzabookum bimaa taqooloona famaa yastatee'oona sarfa wal aa nasra wamany yyazlim mminkum nuziqhu 'azaaba kabeer
Wamaa 'arsal naa qablaka mina aal mursal eena 'il laa 'innahum layakul oona aat-ta'aama wayamshoona fi ail aswaaqi waja'al naa ba'dakum liba'd fitnatan 'atasbiroona wakaana rabbuka baseer
Waqaal a aal zeena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa lawlaa 'unzil a 'al aynaa aal mal aa'ikatu 'aw naraa rabbanaa laqadi aistakbaru fi 'anfusihim wa'ataw 'utoowa kabeer
Yawma yarawna aal mal aa'ikata laa bushraa yawma'iz llil mujrimeena wayaqooloona hijra mmahjoor
Waqadimnaa 'il aa maa 'amil u min 'amal faja'al naahu habaa' mmanthoora
'ashaabu aul jannati yawma'izin khayr mmustaqarra waahsanu maqeel
Wayawma tashshaqqaqu aus-samaa'u bial ghamaami wanuzzil a aal mal aa'ikatu tanzeela
Ail mul ku yawma'izin ail haqqu lir-rahmaani wakaana yawmaan 'al aa aal kaafireena 'aseer
Wayawma ya'addu auz-zaal imu 'al aa yadayhi yaqoolu yaal aytani aittakhazttu ma'a aar-rasooli sabeel
Yaawaylataa laytani lam 'attakhiz ful aanaan khal eel
Llaqad 'adal lani 'ani aiz-zikri ba'da 'iz jaa'ani wakaana aash-shaytaanu lil insaani khazool
Waqaal a aar-rasoolu yaarabbi 'inna qawmeea aattakhazu haazaa aal qur'aana mahjoor
Wakazaal ika ja'al naa likul li nabiaa'in 'adoowa mmina aal mujrimeena wakafaa birabbika haadeea wanaseer
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lawlaa nuzzil a 'al ayhi ail qur'aanu jumlat waahidat kazaal ika linuthabbita bihi fu'aadaka warattal naahu tarteel
Wal aa yatoonaka bimathal in 'il laa jeenaaka bial haqqi waahsana tafseera
Ail zeena yuhsharoona 'al aa wujoohihim 'il aa jahannama 'ul aa'ika sharr mmakaana waadal lu sabeel
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba waja'al naa ma'ahu 'akhaahu haaroona wazeer
Faqul naa aazhabaa 'il aa aal qawmi ail zeena kazzabu biayaatinaa fadammarnaahum tadmeer
Waqawma nooh llammaa kazzabu aur-rusul a 'aghraqnaahum waja'al naahum lin-naasi 'ayat waa'tadnaa liz-zaal imeena 'azaabaan 'al eem
Wa'aada wathamooda waashaaba aar-rassi waquroonaa bayna zaal ika katheer
Wakul la darabnaa lahu aul amthaal a wakul la tabbarnaa tatbeer
Wal aqad 'atawa 'al aa aal qaryati ail ti 'umtirat matara aas-saw'i aafal am yakoonu yarawnahaa bal kaanu laa yarjoona nushoor
Waizaa raawka 'iny yyattakhizoonaka 'il laa huzu'aan 'ahaazaa aal zi ba'atha aal laahu rasoola
'in kaada layudil lunaa 'an 'aal ihatinaa lawlaa 'an sabarnaa 'al ayhaa wasawfa ya'lamoona heena yarawna aal'azaaba man 'adal lu sabeela
'arayta mani aittakhaza 'il aahahu hawayaahu 'afaanta takoonu 'al ayhi wakeela
'am tahsibu 'anna 'aktharahum yasma'oona 'aw ya'qil oona 'in hum 'il laa kaal an'aami bal hum 'adal lu sabeela
'al am tara 'il aa rabbika kayfa madda aaz-zil la wal aw shaa'a laja'al ahu saakina thumma ja'al naa aash-shamsa 'al ayhi dal eel
Thumma qabadnaahu 'il aynaa qabda yaseer
Wahwa aal zi ja'al a lakumu aul yla libaasa waan-nawma subaata waja'al a aan-nahaara nushoor
Wahwa aal zi 'arsal a aar-reeaaha nushuraa bayna yada rahmatihi waanzal naa mina aas-samaa'i maa' tahoor
Llinuheea bihi bal dat mmayta wanusqeeahu mimmaa khal aqnaa 'an'aama waanaasiyya katheer
Wal aqad sarrafnaahu baynahum leeazzakkaru faabaa 'aktharu aun-naasi 'il laa kufoor
Wal aw sheenaa laba'athnaa fi kul li qaryat nnazeer
Fal aa tuti'i ail kaafireena wajaahidhum bihi jihaada kabeer
Wahwa aal zi maraja aal bahrayni haazaa 'azb furaat wahaazaa mil hun 'ujaaj waja'al a baynahumaa barzakha wahijra mmahjoor
Wahwa aal zi khal aqa mina aal maa'i bashara faja'al ahu nasaba wasihra wakaana rabbuka qadeer
Waya'budoona min dooni ail laahi maa laa yanfa'uhum wal aa yadurruhum wakaana aal kaafiru 'al aa rabbihi zaheer
Wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa mubashshira wanazeer
Qul maa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi min 'ajrin 'il laa man shaa 'any yyattakhiza 'il aa rabbihi sabeel
Watawakkal 'al aa aal hayyi ail zi laa yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafaa bihi bizunoobi 'ibaadihi khabeera
Ail zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda wamaa baynahumaa fi sittati 'ayyaam thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi air-rahmaanu fasal bihi khabeer
Waizaa qeela lahumu ausjudu lir-rahmaani qaal u wamaa aar-rahmaanu 'anasjudu limaa tamurunaa wazaadahum nufoor
Tabaaraka aal zi ja'al a fi ais-samaa'i burooja waja'al a feehaa siraaja waqamara mmuneer
Wahwa aal zi ja'al a aal yla waan-nahaara khil fat lliman 'araada 'any yyazzakkara 'aw 'araada shukoor
Wa'ibaadu aur-rahmaani ail zeena yamshoona 'al aa aal ardi hawna waizaa khaatabahumu aul jaahil oona qaal u sal aam
Waal zeena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjada waqeeaam
Waal zeena yaqooloona rabbanaa aasrif 'annaa 'azaaba jahannama 'inna 'azaabahaa kaana gharaama
'innahaa saa'at mustaqarra wamuqaam
Waal zeena 'izaa 'anfaqu lam yusrifu wal am yuqtiru wakaana bayna zaal ika qawaam
Waal zeena laa yad'oona ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan 'aakhara wal aa yaqtul oona aan-nafsa aal ti harrama aal laahu 'il laa bial haqqi wal aa yaznoona wamany yyaf'al zaal ika yal qa 'athaam
Yudaa'af lahu aul'azaabu yawma aal qeeaamati wayakhlud feehi muhaana
'il laa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amil a 'amal a saal iha faul aa'ika yubaddil u aul laahu sayyiaatihim hasanaat wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheem
Waman taaba wa'amil a saal iha fainnahu yatoobu 'il aa aal laahi mataab
Waal zeena laa yashhadoona aaz-zoora waizaa marru bial laghwi marru kiraam
Waal zeena 'izaa zukkiru biayaati rabbihim lam yakhirru 'al ayhaa summa wa'umyaan
Waal zeena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min 'azwaajinaa wazurriyyaatinaa qurrata 'a'yunw waaj'al naa lil muttaqeena 'imaama
'ul aa'ika yujzawna aal ghurfata bimaa sabaru wayul aqqawna feehaa tahiyyat wasal aama
Khaal ideena feehaa hasunat mustaqarra wamuqaam
Qul maa ya'ba'ua bikum rabbi lawlaa du'aa'ukum faqad kazzabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaama
Tasiaammiaa til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi ail mubeen
La'al laka baakhi' nnafsaka 'al laa yakoonu mu'mineen
'in nnasha nunazzil 'al ayhim mmina aas-samaa'i ayat fazal lat 'a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een
Wamaa yateehim mmin zikr mmina aar-rahmaani muhdathin 'il laa kaanu 'anhu mu'rideen
Faqad kazzabu fasayateehim 'anbaa'ua maa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
'awal am yarawa 'il aa aal ardi kam 'anbatnaa feehaa min kul li zawj kareem
'inna fi zaal ika layat wamaa kaana 'aktharuhum mmu'mineen
Wainna rabbaka lahwa aal'azeezu aur-raheem
Waiz naadaa rabbuka moosaa 'ani aeeti ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Qawma fir'awna 'al aa yattaqoon
Qaal a rabbi 'inneea 'akhaafu 'any yyukazziboon
Wayadeequ sadri wal aa yantal iqu lisaani faarsil 'il aa haaroon
Wal ahum 'al ayya zanb faakhaafu 'any yyaqtul oon
Qaal a kal laa faazhabaa biayaatinaa 'innaa ma'akum mmustami'oon
Fateeaa fir'awna faqoolaa 'innaa rasoolu rabbi ail'aal ameen
'an 'arsil ma'anaa bani 'israa'eel
Qaal a 'al am nurabbika feenaa wal eeda wal abithta feenaa min 'umurika sineen
Wafa'al ta fa'lataka aal ti fa'al ta waanta mina aal kaafireen
Qaal a fa'al tuhaa 'iza waanaa mina aad-daal leen
Fafarartu minkum lammaa khiftukum fawahaba li rabbi hukma waja'al ani mina aal mursal een
Watil ka ni'mat tamunnuhaa 'al ayya 'an 'abbadtta bani 'israa'eel
Qaal a fir'awnu wamaa rabbu aul'aal ameen
Qaal a rabbu aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa baynahumaa 'in kuntum mmooqineen
Qaal a liman hawlahu 'al aa tastami'oon
Qaal a rabbukum warabbu 'aabaa'ikumu aul awwal een
Qaal a 'inna rasoolakumu aul zi 'ursil a 'il aykum lamajnoon
Qaal a rabbu aul mashriqi waal maghribi wamaa baynahumaa 'in kuntum ta'qil oon
Qaal a la'ini aittakhaztta 'il aahaan ghayri laaj'al annaka mina aal masjooneen
Qaal a 'awal aw jeetuka bisha' mmubeen
Qaal a fati bihi 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Faal qaa 'asaahu faizaa heea thu'baam mmubeen
Wanaza'a yadahu faizaa heea baydaa'u lin-naazireen
Qaal a lil mal ai hawlahu 'inna haazaa lasaahirun 'al eem
Yureedu 'any yyukhrijakum mmin 'ardikum bisihrihi famaazaa tamuroon
Qaal u 'arjihi waakhaahu waab'ath fi ail madaa'ini haashireen
Yatooka bikul li sahhaarin 'al eem
Fajumi'a aas-saharatu limeeqaati yawm mma'loom
Waqeela lin-naasi hal 'antum mmujtami'oon
La'al lanaa nattabi'u aus-saharata 'in kaanu humu aul ghaal ibeen
Fal ammaa jaa'a aas-saharatu qaal u lifir'awna 'aa'inna lanaa laajraan 'in kunnaa nahnu aul ghaal ibeen
Qaal a na'am wainnakum 'iza llamina aal muqarrabeen
Qaal a lahum mmoosaa 'al qu maa 'antum mmul qoon
Faal qawa hibaal ahum wa'isiyyahum waqaal u bi'izzati fir'awna 'innaa lanahnu aul ghaal iboon
Faal qaa moosaa 'asaahu faizaa heea tal aqqafu maa yafikoon
Faul qeea aas-saharatu saajideen
Qaal u 'aamannaa birabbi ail'aal ameen
