Wawaqa'a aal qawlu 'al ayhim bimaa zal amu fahum laa yantiqoon
'al am yarawa 'annaa ja'al naa aal yla leeaskunu feehi waan-nahaara mubsiraan 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yu'minoon
Wayawma yunfakhu fi ais-soori fafazi'a man fi ais-samaawaati waman fi ail ardi 'il laa man shaa'a aal laahu wakul lun 'aatoohu daakhireen
Wataraa aal jibaal a tahsibuhaa jaamidat wahya tamurru marra aas-sahaabi sun'a aal laahi ail zi 'atqana kul la sha'in 'innahu khabeeru bimaa taf'al oon
Man jaa'a bial hasanati fal ahu khayr mminhaa wahum mmin faza'i yawma'izin 'aaminoon
Waman jaa'a bias-sayyeeati fakubbat wujoohuhum fi ain-naari hal tujzawna 'il laa maa kuntum ta'mal oon
'innamaa 'umirtu 'an 'a'buda rabba haazihi ail bal dati ail zi harramahaa wal ahu kul lu sha' waumirtu 'an 'akoona mina aal muslimeen
Waan 'atlooaa aal qur'aana famani aihtadaa fainnamaa yahtadi linafsihi waman dal la faqul 'innamaa 'anaa mina aal munzireen
Waqul i ail hamdu lil hi sayureekum 'ayaatihi fata'rifoonahaa wamaa rabbuka bighaafil in 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Tasiaammiaa til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi ail mubeen
Natlu 'al ayka min nnabai moosaa wafir'awna bial haqqi liqawm yu'minoon
'inna fir'awna 'al aa fi ail ardi waja'al a 'ahlahaa sheea'a yastad'ifu taa'ifat mminhum yuzabbihu 'abnaa'ahum wayastahyi nisaa'ahum 'innahu kaana mina aal mufsideen
Wanureedu 'an nnamunna 'al aa aal zeena aastud'ifu fi ail ardi wanaj'al ahum 'a'immat wanaj'al ahumu aul waaritheen
Wanumakkina lahum fi ail ardi wanureea fir'awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa minhum mmaa kaanu yahzaroon
Waawhaynaa 'il aa 'ummi moosaa 'an 'ardi'eehi faizaa khifti 'al ayhi faal qeehi fi ail yammi wal aa takhaafi wal aa tahzani 'innaa raaddoohu 'il ayki wajaa'il oohu mina aal mursal een
Faal taqatahu 'aal u fir'awna leeakoona lahum 'adoowa wahazanaan 'inna fir'awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa kaanu khaatieen
Waqaal ati aimraatu fir'awna qurratu 'ayn lli wal aka laa taqtul oohu 'asaa 'any yyanfa'anaa 'aw nattakhizahu wal ada wahum laa yash'uroon
Waasbaha fu'aadu 'ummi moosaa faarighaan 'in kaadat latubdi bihi lawlaa 'ar rrabatnaa 'al aa qal bihaa litakoona mina aal mu'mineen
Waqaal at liukhtihi qusseehi fabasurat bihi 'an junub wahum laa yash'uroon
Waharramnaa 'al ayhi ail maraadi'a min qablu faqaal at hal 'adul lukum 'al aa 'ahli bayt yakful oonahu lakum wahum lahu naasihoon
Faradadnaahu 'il aa 'ummihi ka taqarra 'aynuhaa wal aa tahzana wal ita'lama 'anna wa'da aal laahi haqq wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wal ammaa bal agha 'ashuddahu waastawaa 'aataynaahu hukma wa'il ma wakazaal ika najzi ail muhsineen

Wadakhal a aal madeenata 'al aa heeni ghaflat mmin 'ahlihaa fawajada feehaa rajul ayni yaqtatil aani haazaa min shee'atihi wahaazaa min 'adoowihi faastaghaathahu aul zi min shee'atihi 'al aa aal zi min 'adoowihi fawakazahu moosaa faqadaa 'al ayhi qaal a haazaa min 'amal i aish-shaytaani 'innahu 'adoow mmudil l mmubeen
Qaal a rabbi 'inni zal amtu nafsi faaghfir li faghafara lahu 'innahu hooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Qaal a rabbi bimaa 'an'amta 'al ayya fal an 'akoona zaheera llil mujrimeen
Faasbaha fi ail madeenati khaa'ifa yataraqqabu faizaa aal zi aistansarahu bial amsi yastasrikhuhu qaal a lahu moosaa 'innaka laghaweey mmubeen

Fal ammaa 'an 'araada 'any yyabtisha bial zi hooa 'adoow llaahumaa qaal a yaamoosaa 'atureedu 'an taqtul ani kamaa qatal ta nafsaa bial amsi 'in tureedu 'il laa 'an takoona jabbaara fi ail ardi wamaa tureedu 'an takoona mina aal musliheen
Wajaa'a rajul mmin 'aqsaa aal madeenati yas'aa qaal a yaamoosaa 'inna aal mal aa yatamiroona bika leeaqtul ooka faakhruj 'inni laka mina aan-naasiheen
Fakharaja minhaa khaa'ifa yataraqqabu qaal a rabbi najjini mina aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Wal ammaa tawajjaha til qaa'a madyana qaal a 'asaa rabbeea 'any yyahdeeani sawaa'a aas-sabeel
Wal ammaa warada maa'a madyana wajada 'al ayhi 'ummat mmina aan-naasi yasqoon
Wawajada min doonihimu aumraatayni tazoodaani qaal a maa khatbukumaa qaal ataa laa nasqi hattaa yusdira aar-ri'aa'u waaboonaa shaykh kabeer
Fasaqaa lahumaa thumma tawal laa 'il aa aaz-zil li faqaal a rabbi 'inni limaa 'anzal ta 'il ayya min khayr faqeer

Fajaa'athu 'ihdayaahumaa tamshi 'al aa aastihyaa' qaal at 'inna 'abi yad'ooka leeajzeeaka 'ajra maa saqayta lanaa fal ammaa jaa'ahu waqassa 'al ayhi ail qasasa qaal a laa takhaf najawta mina aal qawmi aiz-zaal imeen
Qaal at 'ihdayaahumaa yaabati aistaajirhu 'inna khayra mani aistaajarta aal qaweeyu aul ameen

Qaal a 'inneea 'ureedu 'an 'unkihaka 'ihdaa aabnatayya haatayni 'al aa 'an tajurani thamaaneea hijaj fain 'atmamta 'ashra famin 'indika wamaa 'ureedu 'an 'ashuqqa 'al ayka satajiduneea 'in shaa'a aal laahu mina aas-saal iheen
Qaal a zaal ika bayni wabaynaka 'ayyamaa aal ajal ayni qadaytu fal aa 'udwaana 'al ayya waal laahu 'al aa maa naqoolu wakeel

Fal ammaa qadaa moosaa aal ajal a wasaara biahlihi 'aanasa min jaanibi ait-toori naara qaal a liahlihi aimkuthu 'inneea 'aanastu naara lla'al leea 'aateekum mminhaa bikhabarin 'aw jizwat mmina aan-naari la'al lakum tastal oon
Fal ammaa 'atayaahaa noodeea min shaatii ail waadi ail aymani fi ail buq'ati ail mubaarakati mina aash-shajarati 'any yyaamoosaa 'inneea 'anaa aal laahu rabbu aul'aal ameen
Waan 'al qi 'asaaka fal ammaa ra'aahaa tahtazzu kaannahaa jaann wal laa mudbira wal am yu'aqqib yaamoosaa 'aqbil wal aa takhaf 'innaka mina aal aamineen
Aasluk yadaka fi jaybika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri sooaa' waadmum 'il ayka janaahaka mina aar-rahabi fazaanika burhaanaani mir rrabbika 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi 'innahum kaanu qawma faasiqeen
Qaal a rabbi 'inni qatal tu minhum nafsa faakhaafu 'any yyaqtul oon
Waakhi haaroonu hooa 'afsahu minni lisaana faarsil hu ma'i rida yusaddiqni 'inneea 'akhaafu 'any yyukazziboon
Qaal a sanashuddu 'adudaka biakheeka wanaj'al u lakumaa sul taana fal aa yasil oona 'il aykumaa biayaatinaa 'antumaa wamani aittaba'akumaa aal ghaal iboon
Fal ammaa jaa'ahum mmoosaa biayaatinaa bayyinaat qaal u maa haazaa 'il laa sihr mmuftara wamaa sami'naa bihaazaa fi 'aabaa'inaa aal awwal een
Waqaal a moosaa rabbeea 'a'lamu biman jaa'a bial hudaa min 'indihi waman takoonu lahu 'aaqibatu aud-daari 'innahu laa yuflihu auz-zaal imoon

Waqaal a fir'awnu yayyuhaa aal mal au maa 'al imtu lakum mmin 'il aahin ghayri faawqid li yaahaamaanu 'al aa aat-teeni faaj'al-li sarha lla'al leea 'attal i'u 'il aa 'il aahi moosaa wainni laazunnuhu mina aal kaazibeen
Waastakbara hooa wajunooduhu fi ail ardi bighayri ail haqqi wazannu 'annahum 'il aynaa laa yarji'oon
Faakhaznaahu wajunoodahu fanabaznaahum fi ail yammi faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu auz-zaal imeen
Waja'al naahum 'a'immat yad'oona 'il aa aan-naari wayawma aal qeeaamati laa yunsaroon
Waatba'naahum fi haazihi aid-dunyaa la'nat wayawma aal qeeaamati hum mmina aal maqbooheen
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba mim ba'di maa 'ahlaknaa aal quroona aal oolaa basaa'ira lin-naasi wahuda warahmat lla'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Wamaa kunta bijaanibi ail gharbeeyi 'iz qadaynaa 'il aa moosaa aal amra wamaa kunta mina aash-shaahideen
Wal aakinnaa 'anshanaa quroona fatataawal a 'al ayhimu aul'umuru wamaa kunta thaaweea fi 'ahli madyana tatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatinaa wal aakinnaa kunnaa mursil een
Wamaa kunta bijaanibi ait-toori 'iz naadaynaa wal aakir rrahmat mmir rrabbika litunzira qawma mmaa 'atayaahum mmin nnazeer mmin qablika la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Wal awlaa 'an tuseebahum mmuseebatu bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim fayaqoolu rabbanaa lawlaa 'arsal ta 'il aynaa rasoola fanattabi'a 'ayaatika wanakoona mina aal mu'mineen

Fal ammaa jaa'ahumu aul haqqu min 'indinaa qaal u lawlaa 'ooteea mithla maa 'ooteea moosaa 'awal am yakfuru bimaa 'ooteea moosaa min qablu qaal u saahiraani tazaaharaa waqaal u 'innaa bikul l kaafiroon
Qul fatu bikitaab mmin 'indi ail laahi hooa 'ahdaa minhumaa 'attabi'hu 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Fail llam yastajeebu laka faa'lam 'annamaa yattabi'oona 'ahwaa'ahum waman 'adal lu mimmani aittaba'a hawayaahu bighayri huda mmina aal laahi 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Wal aqad wassal naa lahumu aul qawla la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Aal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba min qablihi hum bihi yu'minoon
Waizaa yutlaa 'al ayhim qaal u 'aamannaa bihi 'innahu aul haqqu mir rrabbinaa 'innaa kunnaa min qablihi muslimeen
'ul aa'ika yu'tawna 'ajrahum mmarratayni bimaa sabaru wayadra'oona bial hasanati ais-sayyeeata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Waizaa sami'u aul laghwa 'a'radu 'anhu waqaal u lanaa 'a'maal unaa wal akum 'a'maal ukum sal aamun 'al aykum laa nabtaghi ail jaahil een
'innaka laa tahdi man 'ahbabta wal aakinna aal laaha yahdi many yyashaa'u wahwa 'a'lamu bial muhtadeen

Waqaal u 'in nnattabi'i ail hudaa ma'aka nutakhattaf min 'ardinaa 'awal am numakkil llaahum haramaan 'aamina tujbaa 'il ayhi thamaraatu kul li sha' rrizqa mmil lladunnaa wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wakam 'ahlaknaa min qaryati batirat ma'eeshatahaa fatil ka masaakinuhum lam tuskam mmim ba'dihim 'il laa qal eela wakunnaa nahnu aul waaritheen
Wamaa kaana rabbuka muhlika aal quraa hattaa yab'atha fi 'ummihaa rasoola yatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatinaa wamaa kunnaa muhliki ail quraa 'il laa waahluhaa zaal imoon
Wamaa 'ooteetum mmin sha' famataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunyaa wazeenatuhaa wamaa 'inda aal laahi khayr waabqaa 'afal aa ta'qil oon
'afamanw wwa'adnaahu wa'daan hasana fahwa laaqeehi kamam mmatta'naahu mataa'a aal hayawaati aid-dunyaa thumma hwa yawma aal qeeaamati mina aal muhdareen
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu 'ayna shurakaa'eea aal zeena kuntum taz'umoon
Qaal a aal zeena haqqa 'al ayhimu aul qawlu rabbanaa haa'ul aa'i ail zeena 'aghwaynaa 'aghwaynaahum kamaa ghawaynaa tabarranaa 'il ayka maa kaanu 'iyyaanaa ya'budoon
Waqeela aad'u shurakaa'akum fada'awhum fal am yastajeebu lahum waraawua aul'azaaba law 'annahum kaanu yahtadoon
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu maazaa 'ajabtumu aul mursal een
Fa'ameeat 'al ayhimu aul anbaa'u yawma'iz fahum laa yatasaa'al oon
Faammaa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amil a saal iha fa'asaa 'any yyakoona mina aal mufliheen
Warabbuka yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wayakhtaaru maa kaana lahumu aul kheearatu subhaana aal laahi wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Warabbuka ya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wamaa yu'linoon
Wahwa aal laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa lahu aul hamdu fi ail oolaa waal aakhirati wal ahu aul hukmu wail ayhi turja'oon
Qul 'araytum 'in ja'al a aal laahu 'al aykumu aul yla sarmadaan 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati man 'il aahun ghayru aul laahi yateekum bideeaa'in 'afal aa tasma'oon
Qul 'araytum 'in ja'al a aal laahu 'al aykumu aun-nahaara sarmadaan 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati man 'il aahun ghayru aul laahi yateekum bil ayl taskunoona feehi 'afal aa tubsiroon
Wamir rrahmatihi ja'al a lakumu aul yla waan-nahaara litaskunu feehi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu 'ayna shurakaa'eea aal zeena kuntum taz'umoon
Wanaza'naa min kul li 'ummat shaheeda faqul naa haatu burhaanakum fa'al imu 'anna aal haqqa lil hi wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaftaroon

'inna qaaroona kaana min qawmi moosaa fabaghaa 'al ayhim wa'aataynaahu mina aal kunoozi maa 'inna mafaatihahu latanooaau bial'usbati 'ooli ail qoowati 'iz qaal a lahu qawmuhu laa tafrah 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul fariheen

Waabtaghi feemaa 'aatayaaka aal laahu aud-daara aal aakhirata wal aa tansa naseebaka mina aad-dunyaa waahsin kamaa 'ahsana aal laahu 'il ayka wal aa tabghi ail fasaada fi ail ardi 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu aul mufsideen

Qaal a 'innamaa 'ooteetuhu 'al aa 'il min 'indeea 'awal am ya'lam 'anna aal laaha qad 'ahlaka min qablihi mina aal qurooni man hooa 'ashaddu minhu qoowat waaktharu jam'a wal aa yusal u 'an zunoobihimu aul mujrimoon
Fakharaja 'al aa qawmihi fi zeenatihi qaal a aal zeena yureedoona aal hayawaata aad-dunyaa yaal ayta lanaa mithla maa 'ooteea qaaroonu 'innahu lazoo hazzin 'azeem
Waqaal a aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma waylakum thawaabu aul laahi khayr lliman 'aamana wa'amil a saal iha wal aa yul aqqayaahaa 'il laa aas-saabiroon
Fakhasafnaa bihi wabidaarihi ail arda famaa kaana lahu min feeat yansuroonahu min dooni ail laahi wamaa kaana mina aal muntasireen

Waasbaha aal zeena tamannawa makaanahu bial amsi yaqooloona waykaanna aal laaha yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wayaqdiru lawlaa 'am mmanna aal laahu 'al aynaa lakhusifa binaa waykaannahu laa yuflihu aul kaafiroon
Til ka aad-daaru aul aakhiratu naj'al uhaa lil zeena laa yureedoona 'ul oowa fi ail ardi wal aa fasaada waal'aaqibatu lil muttaqeen
Man jaa'a bial hasanati fal ahu khayr mminhaa waman jaa'a bias-sayyeeati fal aa yujzaa aal zeena 'amil u aus-sayyiaati 'il laa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
'inna aal zi farada 'al ayka aal qur'aana laraadduka 'il aa ma'aad qur-rabbeea 'a'lamu man jaa'a bial hudaa waman hooa fi dal aal mmubeen
Wamaa kunta tarju 'any yyul qaa 'il ayka aal kitaabu 'il laa rahmat mmir rrabbika fal aa takoonanna zaheera llil kaafireen
Wal aa yasuddunnaka 'an 'ayaati ail laahi ba'da 'iz 'unzil at 'il ayka waad'u 'il aa rabbika wal aa takoonanna mina aal mushrikeen
Wal aa tad'u ma'a aal laahi 'il aahaan 'aakhara laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa kul lu sha'in haal ikun 'il laa wajhahu lahu aul hukmu wail ayhi turja'oon
'al aammiaa 'ahasiba aan-naasu 'any yyutraku 'any yyaqoolu 'aamannaa wahum laa yuftanoon
Wal aqad fatannaa aal zeena min qablihim fal aya'lamanna aal laahu aul zeena sadaqu wal aya'lamanna aal kaazibeen
'am hasiba aal zeena ya'mal oona aas-sayyiaati 'any yyasbiqoonaa saa'a maa yahkumoon
Man kaana yarju liqaa'a aal laahi fainna 'ajal a aal laahi laat wahwa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Waman jaahada fainnamaa yujaahidu linafsihi 'inna aal laaha laghaneeyun 'ani ail'aal ameen
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lanukaffiranna 'anhum sayyiaatihim wal anajzeeannahum 'ahsana aal zi kaanu ya'mal oon
Wawassaynaa aal insaana biwaal idayhi husna wain jaahadaaka litushrika bi maa laysa laka bihi 'il m fal aa tuti'humaa 'il ayya marji'ukum faunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lanudkhil annahum fi ais-saal iheen

Wamina aan-naasi many yyaqoolu 'aamannaa bial laahi faizaa 'oozeea fi ail laahi ja'al a fitnata aan-naasi ka'azaabi ail laahi wal a'in jaa'a nasr mmir rrabbika layaqoolunna 'innaa kunnaa ma'akum 'awal aysa aal laahu bia'lama bimaa fi sudoori ail'aal ameen
Wal aya'lamanna aal laahu aul zeena 'aamanu wal aya'lamanna aal munaafiqeen
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lil zeena 'aamanu auttabi'u sabeelanaa wal nahmil khatayaakum wamaa hum bihaamil eena min khatayaahum mmin sha'in 'innahum lakaaziboon
Wal ayahmil unna 'athqaal ahum waathqaal a mma'a 'athqaal ihim wal ayusal unna yawma aal qeeaamati 'ammaa kaanu yaftaroon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa noohaan 'il aa qawmihi fal abitha feehim 'al fa sanatin 'il laa khamseena 'aama faakhazahumu aut-toofaanu wahum zaal imoon
Faanjaynaahu waashaaba aas-safeenati waja'al naahaa 'ayat llil'aal ameen
Waibraaheema 'iz qaal a liqawmihi ai'budu aul laaha waattaqoohu zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon

'innamaa ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi 'awthaana watakhluqoona 'ifkaan 'inna aal zeena ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi laa yamlikoona lakum rizqa faabtaghu 'inda aal laahi air-rizqa waa'budoohu waashkuru lahu 'il ayhi turja'oon
Wain tukazzibu faqad kazzaba 'umam mmin qablikum wamaa 'al aa aar-rasooli 'il laa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen
'awal am yarawa kayfa yubdiu aul laahu aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu 'inna zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Qul seeru fi ail ardi faanzuru kayfa badaa aal khal qa thumma aal laahu yunshiu aun-nashata aal aakhirata 'inna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Yu'azzibu many yyashaa'u wayarhamu many yyashaa'u wail ayhi tuqlaboon
Wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeena fi ail ardi wal aa fi ais-samaa'i wamaa lakum mmin dooni ail laahi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer
Waal zeena kafaru biayaati ail laahi wal iqaa'ihi 'ul aa'ika ya'isu mir rrahmati waul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihi 'il laa 'an qaal u auqtul oohu 'aw harriqoohu faanjayaahu aul laahu mina aan-naari 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yu'minoon

Waqaal a 'innamaa aattakhazttum mmin dooni ail laahi 'awthaana mmawaddata baynakum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa thumma yawma aal qeeaamati yakfuru ba'dukum biba'd wayal'anu ba'dukum ba'da wamawayaakumu aun-naaru wamaa lakum mmin nnaasireen
Faamana lahu loot waqaal a 'inni muhaajirun 'il aa rabbeea 'innahu hooa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Wawahabnaa lahu 'ishaaqa waya'qooba waja'al naa fi zurriyyatihi ain-nubooaa'ata waal kitaaba wa'aataynaahu 'ajrahu fi aid-dunyaa wainnahu fi ail aakhirati lamina aas-saal iheen
Wal ootaan 'iz qaal a liqawmihi 'innakum latatoona aal faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa min 'ahad mmina aal'aal ameen
'aa'innakum latatoona aar-rijaal a wataqta'oona aas-sabeel
Watatoona fi naadeekumu aul munkara famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihi 'il laa 'an qaal u auytinaa bi'azaabi ail laahi 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Qaal a rabbi ainsurni 'al aa aal qawmi ail mufsideen
Wal ammaa jaa'at rusul unaa 'ibraaheema bial bushraa qaal u 'innaa muhliku 'ahli haazihi ail qaryati 'inna 'ahlahaa kaanu zaal imeen
Qaal a 'inna feehaa loota qaal u nahnu 'a'lamu biman feehaa lanunajjeeannahu waahlahu 'il laa aamraatahu kaanat mina aal ghaabireen
Wal ammaa 'an jaa'at rusul unaa loota saa'a bihim wadaaqa bihim zar'a waqaal u laa takhaf wal aa tahzan 'innaa munajjooka waahlaka 'il laa aamraataka kaanat mina aal ghaabireen
'innaa munzil oona 'al aa 'ahli haazihi ail qaryati rijza mmina aas-samaa'i bimaa kaanu yafsuqoon
Wal aqad ttaraknaa minhaa 'ayata bayyinat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wail aa madyana 'akhaahum shu'ayba faqaal a yaaqawmi ai'budu aul laaha waarju aul yawma aal aakhira wal aa ta'thawa fi ail ardi mufsideen
Fakazzaboohu faakhazathumu aur-rajfatu faasbahu fi daarihim jaathimeen
Wa'aada wathamooda waqad ttabayyana lakum mmim mmasaakinihim wazayyana lahumu aush-shaytaanu 'a'maal ahum fasaddahum 'ani ais-sabeeli wakaanu mustabsireen
Waqaaroona wafir'awna wahaamaana wal aqad jaa'ahum mmoosaa bial bayyinaati faastakbaru fi ail ardi wamaa kaanu saabiqeen

Fakul laan 'akhaznaa bizanbihi faminhum mman 'arsal naa 'al ayhi haasiba waminhum mman 'akhazathu aus-sayhatu waminhum mman khasafnaa bihi ail arda waminhum mman 'aghraqnaa wamaa kaana aal laahu leeazlimahum wal aakin kaanu 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Mathal u aul zeena aattakhazu min dooni ail laahi 'awleeaa'a kamathal i ail'ankabooti aittakhazat bayta wainna 'awhana aal beeooti labaytu aul'ankabooti law kaanu ya'lamoon
'inna aal laaha ya'lamu maa tad'oona min doonihi min sha' wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Watil ka aal amthaal u nadribuhaa lin-naasi wamaa ya'qil uhaa 'il laa aal'aal imoon
Khal aqa aal laahu aus-samaawaati waal arda bial haqqi 'inna fi zaal ika layat llil mu'mineen
Aatlu maa 'ooheea 'il ayka mina aal kitaabi waaqimi ais-sal awaata 'inna aas-sal awaata tanhaa 'ani ail fahshaa'i waal munkari wal azikru aul laahi 'akbaru waal laahu ya'lamu maa tasna'oon

Wal aa tujaadil u 'ahla aal kitaabi 'il laa bial ti heea 'ahsanu 'il laa aal zeena zal amu minhum waqoolu 'aamannaa bial zi 'unzil a 'il aynaa waunzil a 'il aykum wail aahunaa wail aahukum waahid wanahnu lahu muslimoon
Wakazaal ika 'anzal naa 'il ayka aal kitaaba faal zeena 'aataynaahumu aul kitaaba yu'minoona bihi wamin haa'ul aa'i many yyu'minu bihi wamaa yajhadu biayaatinaa 'il laa aal kaafiroon
Wamaa kunta tatlu min qablihi min kitaab wal aa takhuttuhu beeameenika 'iza llaartaaba aal mubtil oon
Bal hooa 'ayaatu bayyinaat fi sudoori ail zeena 'ootu aul'il ma wamaa yajhadu biayaatinaa 'il laa aaz-zaal imoon
Waqaal u lawlaa 'unzil a 'al ayhi 'ayaat mmir rrabbihi qul 'innamaa aal ayaatu 'inda aal laahi wainnamaa 'anaa nazeer mmubeen
'awal am yakfihim 'annaa 'anzal naa 'al ayka aal kitaaba yutlaa 'al ayhim 'inna fi zaal ika larahmat wazikraa liqawm yu'minoon
Qul kafaa bial laahi bayni wabaynakum shaheeda ya'lamu maa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi waal zeena 'aamanu bial baatil i wakafaru bial laahi 'ul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
Wayasta'jil oonaka bial'azaabi wal awlaa 'ajal mmusamma llajaa'ahumu aul'azaabu wal ayateeannahum baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Yasta'jil oonaka bial'azaabi wainna jahannama lamuheetatu bial kaafireen
Yawma yaghshayaahumu aul'azaabu min fawqihim wamin tahti 'arjul ihim wayaqoolu zooqu maa kuntum ta'mal oon
Yaa'ibaadeea aal zeena 'aamanu 'inna 'ardi waasi'at faiyyaya faa'budoon
Kul lu nafs zaa'iqatu aul mawti thumma 'il aynaa turja'oon
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lanubawweeannahum mmina aal jannati ghurafa tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa ni'ma 'ajru aul'aamil een
Aal zeena sabaru wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Wakayyim mmin daabbat llaa tahmil u rizqahaa aal laahu yarzuquhaa waiyyaakum wahwa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda wasakhkhara aash-shamsa waal qamara layaqoolunna aal laahu faannaa yu'fakoon
Aal laahu yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wayaqdiru lahu 'inna aal laaha bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Wal a'in saal tahum mman nnazzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa' faahyaa bihi ail arda mim ba'di mawtihaa layaqoolunna aal laahu qul i ail hamdu lil hi bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'qil oon
Wamaa haazihi ail hayawaatu aud-dunyaa 'il laa lahw wal a'ib wainna aad-daara aal aakhirata lahya aal hayawaanu law kaanu ya'lamoon
Faizaa rakibu fi ail ful ki da'awua aul laaha mukhliseena lahu aud-deena fal ammaa najjayaahum 'il aa aal barri 'izaa hum yushrikoon
Leeakfuru bimaa 'aataynaahum wal yatamatta'u fasawfa ya'lamoon
'awal am yarawa 'annaa ja'al naa haramaan 'aamina wayutakhattafu aun-naasu min hawlihim 'afabial baatil i yu'minoona wabini'mati ail laahi yakfuroon
Waman 'azlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan 'aw kazzaba bial haqqi lammaa jaa'ahu 'al aysa fi jahannama mathwa llil kaafireen
Waal zeena jaahadu feenaa lanahdeeannahum subul anaa wainna aal laaha lama'a aal muhsineen
'al aammiaa ghul ibati air-roomu fi 'adnaa aal ardi wahum mmim ba'di ghal abihim sayaghliboon
Fi bid'i sineen
Lil hi ail amru min qablu wamim ba'du wayawma'iz yafrahu aul mu'minoon
Binasri ail laahi yansuru many yyashaa'u wahwa aal'azeezu aur-raheem
Wa'da aal laahi laa yukhlifu aul laahu wa'dahu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Ya'lamoona zaahira mmina aal hayawaati aid-dunyaa wahum 'ani ail aakhirati hum ghaafil oon
'awal am yatafakkaru fi 'anfusihim mmaa khal aqa aal laahu aus-samaawaati waal arda wamaa baynahumaa 'il laa bial haqqi waajal mmusamma wainna katheera mmina aan-naasi bil iqaa'i rabbihim lakaafiroon

'awal am yaseeru fi ail ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim kaanu 'ashadda minhum qoowat waathaaru aul arda wa'amaroohaa 'akthara mimmaa 'amaroohaa wajaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati famaa kaana aal laahu leeazlimahum wal aakin kaanu 'anfusahum yazlimoon
Thumma kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena 'asaau aus-sooaa 'an kazzabu biayaati ail laahi wakaanu bihaa yastahzi'oon
Aal laahu yabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu thumma 'il ayhi turja'oon
Wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu yublisu aul mujrimoon
Wal am yakul llaahum mmin shurakaa'ihim shufa'aa'ua wakaanu bishurakaa'ihim kaafireen
Wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu yawma'iz yatafarraqoon
Faammaa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fahum fi rawdat yuhbaroon
Waammaa aal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa wal iqaa'i ail aakhirati faul aa'ika fi ail'azaabi muhdaroon
Fasubhaana aal laahi heena tumsoona waheena tusbihoon
Wal ahu aul hamdu fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi wa'ashiyya waheena tuzhiroon
Yukhriju aul hayya mina aal mayyiti wayukhriju aul mayyita mina aal hayyi wayuhyi ail arda ba'da mawtihaa wakazaal ika tukhrajoon
Wamin 'ayaatihi 'an khal aqakum mmin turaab thumma 'izaa 'antum bashar tantashiroon
Wamin 'ayaatihi 'an khal aqa lakum mmin 'anfusikum 'azwaaja llitaskunu 'il ayhaa waja'al a baynakum mmawaddat warahmatan 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Wamin 'ayaatihi khal qu aus-samaawaati waal ardi waakhtil aafu 'al sinatikum waal waanikum 'inna fi zaal ika layaat llil'aal ameen
Wamin 'ayaatihi manaamukum bial yli waan-nahaari waabtighaa'ukum mmin fadlihi 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yasma'oon
Wamin 'ayaatihi yureekumu aul barqa khawfa watama'a wayunazzil u mina aas-samaa'i maa' fayuhyi bihi ail arda ba'da mawtihaa 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Wamin 'ayaatihi 'an taqooma aas-samaa'u waal ardu biamrihi thumma 'izaa da'aakum da'wat mmina aal ardi 'izaa 'antum takhrujoon
Wal ahu man fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi kul l llaahu qaanitoon
Wahwa aal zi yabda'ua aul khal qa thumma yu'eeduhu wahwa 'ahwanu 'al ayhi wal ahu aul mathal u aul a'laa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Daraba lakum mmathal a mmin 'anfusikum hal-lakum mmim mmaa mal akat 'aymaanukum mmin shurakaa'a fi maa razaqnaakum faantum feehi sawaa' takhaafoonahum kakheefatikum 'anfusakum kazaal ika nufassil u aul ayaati liqawm ya'qil oon
Bal i aittaba'a aal zeena zal amu 'ahwaa'ahum bighayri 'il m famany yyahdi man 'adal la aal laahu wamaa lahum mmin nnaasireen
Faaqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefa fitrata aal laahi ail ti fatara aan-naasa 'al ayhaa laa tabdeela likhal qi ail laahi zaal ika aad-deenu aul qayyimu wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Muneebeena 'il ayhi waattaqoohu waaqeemu aus-sal awaata wal aa takoonu mina aal mushrikeen
Mina aal zeena farraqu deenahum wakaanu sheea'a kul lu hizbi bimaa ladayhim farihoon
Waizaa massa aan-naasa durr da'awa rabbahum mmuneebeena 'il ayhi thumma 'izaa 'azaaqahum mminhu rahmatan 'izaa fareeq mminhum birabbihim yushrikoon
Leeakfuru bimaa 'aataynaahum fatamatta'u fasawfa ta'lamoon
'am 'anzal naa 'al ayhim sul taana fahwa yatakal lamu bimaa kaanu bihi yushrikoon
Waizaa 'azaqnaa aan-naasa rahmat farihu bihaa wain tusibhum sayyeeatu bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim 'izaa hum yaqnatoon
'awal am yarawa 'anna aal laaha yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yu'minoon
Faati zaa aal qurbaa haqqahu waal miskeena waabna aas-sabeeli zaal ika khayr llil zeena yureedoona wajha aal laahi waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Wamaa 'aataytum mmir rriba lliturbu fi 'amwaal i ain-naasi fal aa yarbu 'inda aal laahi wamaa 'aataytum mmin zakawaat tureedoona wajha aal laahi faul aa'ika humu aul mud'ifoon
Aal laahu aul zi khal aqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum hal min shurakaa'ikum mmany yyaf'al u min zaal ikum mmin sha' subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Zahara aal fasaadu fi ail barri waal bahri bimaa kasabat 'aydi ain-naasi leeuzeeqahum ba'da aal zi 'amil u la'al laahum yarji'oon
Qul seeru fi ail ardi faanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablu kaana 'aktharuhum mmushrikeen
Faaqim wajhaka lid-deeni ail qayyimi min qabli 'any yyateea yawm llaa maradda lahu mina aal laahi yawma'iz yassadda'oon
Man kafara fa'al ayhi kufruhu waman 'amil a saal iha fal ianfusihim yamhadoon
Leeajzeea aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati min fadlihi 'innahu laa yuhibbu aul kaafireen
Wamin 'ayaatihi 'any yyursil a aar-reeaaha mubashshiraat wal eeuzeeqakum mmir rrahmatihi wal itajreea aal ful ku biamrihi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa min qablika rusul aan 'il aa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bial bayyinaati faantaqamnaa mina aal zeena 'ajramu wakaana haqqaan 'al aynaa nasru aul mu'mineen

Aal laahu aul zi yursil u aur-reeaaha fatutheeru sahaaba fayabsutuhu fi ais-samaa'i kayfa yashaa'u wayaj'al uhu kisafa fataraa aal wadqa yakhruju min khil aal ihi faizaa 'asaaba bihi many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi 'izaa hum yastabshiroon
Wain kaanu min qabli 'any yyunazzal a 'al ayhim mmin qablihi lamubliseen
Faanzur 'il aa 'athari rahmati ail laahi kayfa yuhyi ail arda ba'da mawtihaa 'inna zaal ika lamuhyi ail mawtaa wahwa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wal a'in 'arsal naa reeha faraawhu musfarra llazal lu mim ba'dihi yakfuroon
Fainnaka laa tusmi'u aul mawtaa wal aa tusmi'u aus-summa aad-du'aa'a azaa wal lawa mudbireen
Wamaa 'anta bihaadi ail'umyi 'an dal aal atihim 'in tusmi'u 'il laa many yyu'minu biayaatinaa fahum mmuslimoon
Aal laahu aul zi khal aqakum mmin du'f thumma ja'al a mim ba'di du'f qoowat thumma ja'al a mim ba'di qoowat du'fa washaybat yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wahwa aal'al eemu aul qadeer
Wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu yuqsimu aul mujrimoona maa labithu ghayra saa'at kazaal ika kaanu yu'fakoon
Waqaal a aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma waal eemaana laqad labithtum fi kitaabi ail laahi 'il aa yawmi ail ba'thi fahaazaa yawmu aul ba'thi wal aakinnakum kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Fayawma'iz llaa tanfa'u aul zeena zal amu ma'ziratuhum wal aa hum yusta'taboon
Wal aqad darabnaa lin-naasi fi haazaa aal qur'aani min kul li mathal wal a'in jeetahum biayat llayaqoolanna aal zeena kafaru 'in 'antum 'il laa mubtil oon
Kazaal ika yatba'u aul laahu 'al aa qul oobi ail zeena laa ya'lamoon
Faasbir 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq wal aa yastakhiffannaka aal zeena laa yooqinoon
'al aammiaa til ka 'ayaatu aul kitaabi ail hakeem
Huda warahmat llil muhsineen
Aal zeena yuqeemoona aas-sal awaata wayu'toona aaz-zakawaata wahum bial aakhirati hum yooqinoon
'ul aa'ika 'al aa huda mmir rrabbihim waul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
Wamina aan-naasi many yyashtari lahwa aal hadeethi leeudil la 'an sabeeli ail laahi bighayri 'il m wayattakhizuhaa huzu'aan 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaab mmuheen
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhi 'ayaatunaa wal laa mustakbira kaal llam yasma'haa kaanna fi 'uznayhi waqra fabashshirhu bi'azaabin 'al eem
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lahum jannaatu aun-na'eem
Khaal ideena feehaa wa'da aal laahi haqqa wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Khal aqa aas-samaawaati bighayri 'amad tarawnahaa waal qaa fi ail ardi rawaaseea 'an tameeda bikum wabaththa feehaa min kul li daabbat waanzal naa mina aas-samaa'i maa' faanbatnaa feehaa min kul li zawj kareem
Haazaa khal qu aul laahi faarooni maazaa khal aqa aal zeena min doonihi bal i aiz-zaal imoona fi dal aal mmubeen
Wal aqad 'aataynaa luqmaana aal hikmata 'anu aushkur lil hi wamany yyashkur fainnamaa yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainna aal laaha ghaneeyun hameed
Waiz qaal a luqmaanu liabnihi wahwa ya'izuhu yaabunayyi laa tushrik bial laahi 'inna aash-shirka lazul mun 'azeem
Wawassaynaa aal insaana biwaal idayhi hamal athu 'ummuhu wahnaan 'al aa wahn wafisaal uhu fi 'aamayni 'anu aushkur li wal iwaal idayka 'il ayya aal maseer

Wain jaahadaaka 'al aa 'an tushrika bi maa laysa laka bihi 'il m fal aa tuti'humaa wasaahibhumaa fi aid-dunyaa ma'roofa waattabi' sabeela man 'anaaba 'il ayya thumma 'il ayya marji'ukum faunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Yaabunayyi 'innahaa 'in taku mithqaal u habbat mmin khardal fatakun fi sakhratin 'aw fi ais-samaawaati 'aw fi ail ardi yati bihaa aal laahu 'inna aal laaha lateefun khabeer
Yaabunayyi 'aqimi ais-sal awaata wamur bial ma'roofi waanha 'ani ail munkari waasbir 'al aa maa 'asaabaka 'inna zaal ika min 'azmi ail umoor
Wal aa tusaa'ir khaddaka lin-naasi wal aa tamshi fi ail ardi marahaan 'inna aal laaha laa yuhibbu kul la mukhtaal fakhoor
Waaqsid fi mashyika waaghdud min sawtika 'inna 'ankara aal aswaati lasawtu aul hameer

'al am tarawa 'anna aal laaha sakhkhara lakum mmaa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi waasbagha 'al aykum ni'amahu zaahirat wabaatinat wamina aan-naasi many yyujaadil u fi ail laahi bighayri 'il m wal aa huda wal aa kitaab mmuneer
Waizaa qeela lahumu auttabi'u maa 'anzal a aal laahu qaal u bal nattabi'u maa wajadnaa 'al ayhi 'aabaa'anaa 'awal aw kaana aash-shaytaanu yad'oohum 'il aa 'azaabi ais-sa'eer
Wamany yyuslim wajhahu 'il aa aal laahi wahwa muhsin faqadi aistamsaka bial'urwati ail wuthqaa wail aa aal laahi 'aaqibatu aul umoor
Waman kafara fal aa yuhzinka kufruhu 'il aynaa marji'uhum fanunabbeeuhum bimaa 'amil u 'inna aal laaha 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
Numatti'uhum qal eela thumma nadtarruhum 'il aa 'azaabin ghal eez
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda layaqoolunna aal laahu qul i ail hamdu lil hi bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi 'inna aal laaha hooa aal ghaneeyu aul hameed
Wal aw 'annamaa fi ail ardi min shajaratin 'aqlaam waal bahru yamudduhu mim ba'dihi sab'atu 'abhur mmaa nafidat kal imaatu aul laahi 'inna aal laaha 'azeezun hakeem
Mmaa khal qukum wal aa ba'thukum 'il laa kanafs waahidatin 'inna aal laaha samee'u baseer

'al am tara 'anna aal laaha yooliju aul yla fi ain-nahaari wayooliju aun-nahaara fi ail yli wasakhkhara aash-shamsa waal qamara kul l yajri 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma waanna aal laaha bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha hooa aal haqqu waanna maa tad'oona min doonihi ail baatil u waanna aal laaha hooa aal'al eeyu aul kabeer
'al am tara 'anna aal ful ka tajri fi ail bahri bini'mati ail laahi leeureeakum mmin 'ayaatihi 'inna fi zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbaar shakoor
Waizaa ghasheeahum mmawj kaaz-zul al i da'awua aul laaha mukhliseena lahu aud-deena fal ammaa najjayaahum 'il aa aal barri faminhum mmuqtasid wamaa yajhadu biayaatinaa 'il laa kul lu khattaar kafoor

Yayyuhaa aan-naasu auttaqu rabbakum waakhshawa yawma llaa yajzi waal idun 'anw wwal adihi wal aa mawloodun hooa jaazin 'anw wwaal idihi shayaan 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq fal aa taghurrannakumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunyaa wal aa yaghurrannakum bial laahi ail gharoor

'inna aal laaha 'indahu 'il mu aus-saa'ati wayunazzil u aul ghaytha waya'lamu maa fi ail arhaami wamaa tadri nafs mmaazaa taksibu ghada wamaa tadri nafsu biayyi 'ard tamootu 'inna aal laaha 'al eemun khabeer
'al aammiaa tanzeelu aul kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rrabbi ail'aal ameen
'am yaqooloona aaftarayaahu bal hooa aal haqqu mir rrabbika litunzira qawma mmaa 'atayaahum mmin nnazeer mmin qablika la'al laahum yahtadoon
Aal laahu aul zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda wamaa baynahumaa fi sittati 'ayyaam thumma aastawaa 'al aa aal'arshi maa lakum mmin doonihi minw wwal eey wal aa shafee'in 'afal aa tatazakkaroon
Yudabbiru aul amra mina aas-samaa 'il aa aal ardi thumma ya'ruju 'il ayhi fi yawm kaana miqdaaruhu 'al fa sanat mmimmaa ta'uddoon
Zaal ika 'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati ail'azeezu aur-raheem
Aul zi 'ahsana kul la sha'in khal aqahu wabadaa khal qa aal insaani min teen
Thumma ja'al a naslahu min sul aal at mmim mmaa' mmaheen
Thumma sawwayaahu wanafakha feehi mir rroohihi waja'al a lakumu aus-sam'a waal absaara waal afidata qal eela mmaa tashkuroon
Waqaal u 'aazaa dal al naa fi ail ardi 'innaa lafi khal q jadeed
Bal hum bil iqaa'i rabbihim kaafiroon
Qul yatawaffayaakum mmal aku aul mawti ail zi wukkil a bikum thumma 'il aa rabbikum turja'oon
Wal aw taraa 'izi ail mujrimoona naakisu ru'oosihim 'inda rabbihim rabbanaa 'absarnaa wasami'naa faarji'naa na'mal saal ihaan 'innaa mooqinoon
Wal aw sheenaa laataynaa kul la nafsin hudayaahaa wal aakin haqqa aal qawlu minni laamlaanna jahannama mina aal jinnati waan-naasi 'ajma'een
Fazooqu bimaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa 'innaa naseenaakum wazooqu 'azaaba aal khul di bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
'innamaa yu'minu biayaatinaa aal zeena 'izaa zukkiru bihaa kharru sujjada wasabbahu bihamdi rabbihim wahum laa yastakbiroon
Tatajaafaa junoobuhum 'ani ail madaaji'i yad'oona rabbahum khawfa watama'a wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Fal aa ta'lamu nafs mmaa 'ukhfeea lahum mmin qurrati 'a'yun jazaa'a bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
'afaman kaana mu'mina kaman kaana faasiqa llaa yastawun
'ammaa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fal ahum jannaatu aul mawaa nuzul aa bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waammaa aal zeena fasaqu famawayaahumu aun-naaru kul lamaa 'araadu 'any yyakhruju minhaa 'u'eedu feehaa waqeela lahum zooqu 'azaaba aan-naari ail zi kuntum bihi tukazziboon
Wal anuzeeqannahum mmina aal'azaabi ail adnaa doona aal'azaabi ail akbari la'al laahum yarji'oon
Waman 'azlamu mimman zukkira biayaati rabbihi thumma 'a'rada 'anhaa 'innaa mina aal mujrimeena muntaqimoon
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba fal aa takun fi miryat mmil lliqaa'ihi waja'al naahu huda llibani 'israa'eel
Waja'al naa minhum 'a'immat yahdoona biamrinaa lammaa sabaru wakaanu biayaatinaa yooqinoon
'inna rabbaka hooa yafsil u baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
'awal am yahdi lahum kam 'ahlaknaa min qablihim mmina aal qurooni yamshoona fi masaakinihim 'inna fi zaal ika layaatin 'afal aa yasma'oon
'awal am yarawa 'annaa nasooqu aul maa'a al aa aal ardi ail juruzi fanukhriju bihi zar'a takul u minhu 'an'aamuhum waanfusuhum 'afal aa yubsiroon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaa aal fathu 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul yawma aal fathi laa yanfa'u aul zeena kafaru 'eemaanuhum wal aa hum yunzaroon
Faa'rid 'anhum waantazir 'innahum mmuntaziroon
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u auttaqi ail laaha wal aa tuti'i ail kaafireena waal munaafiqeena 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al eemaan hakeem
Waattabi' maa yoohaa 'il ayka mir rrabbika 'inna aal laaha kaana bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Watawakkal 'al aa aal laahi wakafaa bial laahi wakeel

Mmaa ja'al a aal laahu lirajul mmin qal bayni fi jawfihi wamaa ja'al a 'azwaajakumu aul laa'i tazzahharoona minhunna 'ummahaatikum wamaa ja'al a 'ad'eeaa'akum 'abnaa'akum zaal ikum qawlukum biafwaahikum waal laahu yaqoolu aul haqqa wahwa yahdi ais-sabeel

Aad'oohum liaabaa'ihim hooa 'aqsatu 'inda aal laahi fail llam ta'lamu 'aabaa'ahum faikhwaanukum fi aid-deeni wamawaal eekum wal aysa 'al aykum junaah feemaa 'akhtatum bihi wal aakim mmaa ta'ammadat qul oobukum wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheema

Ain-nabiaa'u aawlaa bial mu'mineena min 'anfusihim waazwaajuhu 'ummahaatuhum waoolu aul arhaami ba'duhum 'awlaa biba'd fi kitaabi ail laahi mina aal mu'mineena waal muhaajireena 'il laa 'an taf'al u 'il aa 'awleeaa'ikum mma'roofa kaana zaal ika fi ail kitaabi mastoor
Waiz 'akhaznaa mina aan-nabeeaaina meethaaqahum waminka wamin nnooh waibraaheema wamoosaa wa'eesaa aabni maryama waakhaznaa minhum mmeethaaqaan ghal eez
Lleeasal a aas-saadiqeena 'an sidqihim waa'adda lil kaafireena 'azaabaan 'al eem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auzkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykum 'iz jaa'atkum junood faarsal naa 'al ayhim reeha wajunooda llam tarawhaa wakaana aal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseera
'iz jaa'ookum mmin fawqikum wamin 'asfal a minkum waiz zaaghati ail absaaru wabal aghati ail qul oobu aul hanaajira watazunnoona bial laahi aiz-zunoona
Hunaal ika aabtul eea aal mu'minoona wazul zil u zil zaal a shadeed
Waiz yaqoolu aul munaafiqoona waal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad mmaa wa'adanaa aal laahu warasooluhu 'il laa ghuroor

Waiz qaal at ttaa'ifat mminhum yaahla yathriba laa maqaama lakum faarji'u wayastaazinu fareeq mminhumu aun-nabiaa'a yaqooloona 'inna beeootanaa 'awrat wamaa heea bi'awratin 'iny yyureedoona 'il laa firaar
Wal aw dukhil at 'al ayhim mmin 'aqtaarihaa thumma su'il u aul fitnata laatawhaa wamaa tal abbathu bihaa 'il laa yaseer
Wal aqad kaanu 'aahadu aul laaha min qablu laa yooal loona aal adbaara wakaana 'ahdu aul laahi masool
Qul-lany yyanfa'akumu aul firaaru 'in farartum mmina aal mawti 'awi ail qatli waiza llaa tumatta'oona 'il laa qal eel
Qul man zaa aal zi ya'simukum mmina aal laahi 'in 'araada bikum sooaa'aan 'aw 'araada bikum rahmat wal aa yajidoona lahum mmin dooni ail laahi wal iyya wal aa naseer
Qad ya'lamu aul laahu aul mu'awwiqeena minkum waal qaa'il eena liikhwaanihim hal umma 'il aynaa wal aa yatoona aal basa 'il laa qal eela

'ashihhatan 'al aykum faizaa jaa'a aal khawfu raytahum yanzuroona 'il ayka tadooru 'a'yunuhum kaal zi yughshaa 'al ayhi mina aal mawti faizaa zahaba aal khawfu sal aqookum bial sinatin hidaadin 'ashihhatan 'al aa aal khayri 'ul aa'ika lam yu'minu faahbata aal laahu 'a'maal ahum wakaana zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Yahsiboona aal ahzaaba lam yazhabu wainy yyati ail ahzaabu yawaddu law 'annahum baadoona fi ail a'raabi yasal oona 'an 'anbaa'ikum wal aw kaanu feekum mmaa qaatal u 'il laa qal eel
Llaqad kaana lakum fi rasooli ail laahi 'iswatun hasanat lliman kaana yarju aul laaha waal yawma aal aakhira wazakara aal laaha katheer
Wal ammaa ra'aa aal mu'minoona aal ahzaaba qaal u haazaa maa wa'adanaa aal laahu warasooluhu wasadaqa aal laahu warasooluhu wamaa zaadahum 'il laa 'eemaana watasleem
Mmina aal mu'mineena rijaal sadaqu maa 'aahadu aul laaha 'al ayhi faminhum mman qadaa nahbahu waminhum mmany yyantaziru wamaa baddal u tabdeel
Lleeajzeea aal laahu aus-saadiqeena bisidqihim wayu'azziba aal munaafiqeena 'in shaa 'aw yatooba 'al ayhim 'inna aal laaha kaana ghafoora rraheem
Waradda aal laahu aul zeena kafaru bighayzihim lam yanaal u khayra wakafaa aal laahu aul mu'mineena aal qitaal a wakaana aal laahu qawiyyaan 'azeez
Waanzal a aal zeena zaaharoohum mmin 'ahli ail kitaabi min sayaaseehim waqazafa fi qul oobihimu aur-ru'ba fareeqa taqtul oona watasiroona fareeq
Waawrathakum 'ardahum wadeeaarahum waamwaal ahum waarda llam tataoohaa wakaana aal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u qul-liazwaajika 'in kuntunna turidna aal hayawaata aad-dunyaa wazeenatahaa fata'aal ayna 'umatti'kunna wausarrihkunna saraaha jameel
Wain kuntunna turidna aal laaha warasoolahu waad-daara aal aakhirata fainna aal laaha 'a'adda lil muhsinaati minkunna 'ajraan 'azeem
Yaanisaa'a aan-nabiaa'i many yyati minkunna bifaahishat mmubayyinat yudaa'af lahaa aal'azaabu di'fayni wakaana zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Wamany yyaqnut minkunna lil hi warasoolihi wata'mal saal iha nnu'tihaa 'ajrahaa marratayni waa'tadnaa lahaa rizqa kareem
Yaanisaa'a aan-nabiaa'i lastunna kaahad mmina aan-nisaa 'ini aittaqaytunna fal aa takhda'na bial qawli fayatma'a aal zi fi qal bihi marad waqul na qawla mma'roof

Waqarna fi beeootikunna wal aa tabarrajna tabarruja aal jaahil iyyati ail oolaa waaqimna aas-sal awaata wa'aateena aaz-zakawaata waati'na aal laaha warasoolahu 'innamaa yureedu aul laahu leeuzhiba 'ankumu aur-rijsa 'ahla aal bayti wayutahhirakum tatheer
Waazkurna maa yutlaa fi beeootikunna min 'ayaati ail laahi waal hikmati 'inna aal laaha kaana lateefaan khabeera

'inna aal muslimeena waal muslimaati waal mu'mineena waal mu'minaati waal qaaniteena waal qaanitaati waas-saadiqeena waas-saadiqaati waas-saabireena waas-saabiraati waal khaashi'eena waal khaashi'aati waal mutasaddiqeena waal mutasaddiqaati waas-saa'imeena waas-saa'imaati waal haafizeena furoojahum waal haafizaati waaz-zaakireena aal laaha katheera waaz-zaakiraati 'a'adda aal laahu lahum mmaghfirat waajraan 'azeem
Wamaa kaana limu'minw wal aa mu'minatin 'izaa qadaa aal laahu warasooluhu 'amraan 'an takoona lahumu aul kheearatu min 'amrihim wamany yya'si ail laaha warasoolahu faqad dal la dal aal a mmubeen

Waiz taqoolu lil zi 'an'ama aal laahu 'al ayhi waan'amta 'al ayhi 'amsik 'al ayka zawjaka waattaqi ail laaha watukhfi fi nafsika maa aal laahu mubdeehi watakhshaa aan-naasa waal laahu 'ahaqqu 'an takhshayaahu fal ammaa qadaa zayd mminhaa watara zawwajnaakahaa lika laa yakoona 'al aa aal mu'mineena haraj fi 'azwaaji 'ad'eeaa'ihim 'izaa qadawa minhunna watara wakaana 'amru aul laahi maf'ool
Mmaa kaana 'al aa aan-nabiaa'i min haraj feemaa farada aal laahu lahu sunnata aal laahi fi ail zeena khal awa min qablu wakaana 'amru aul laahi qadara mmaqdoora
Ail zeena yubal lighoona risaal aati ail laahi wayakhshawnahu wal aa yakhshawna 'ahadaan 'il laa aal laaha wakafaa bial laahi haseeb
Mmaa kaana muhammadun 'abaa 'ahad mmir rrijaal ikum wal aakir rrasoola aal laahi wakhaatima aan-nabeeaaina wakaana aal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auzkuru aul laaha zikra katheer
Wasabbihoohu bukrat waaseela
Hooa aal zi yusal li 'al aykum wamal aa'ikatuhu leeukhrijakum mmina aaz-zul umaati 'il aa aan-noori wakaana bial mu'mineena raheem
Tahiyyatuhum yawma yal qawnahu sal aam waa'adda lahum 'ajra kareem
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u ainnaa 'arsal naaka shaahida wamubashshira wanazeer
Wadaa'eeaan 'il aa aal laahi biiznihi wasiraaja mmuneer
Wabashshiri ail mu'mineena bianna lahum mmina aal laahi fadla kabeer
Wal aa tuti'i ail kaafireena waal munaafiqeena wada' 'azayaahum watawakkal 'al aa aal laahi wakafaa bial laahi wakeel

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa nakahtumu aul mu'minaati thumma tal laqtumoohunna min qabli 'an tamassoohunna famaa lakum 'al ayhinna min 'iddat ta'taddoonahaa famatti'oohunna wasarrihoohunna saraaha jameel

Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u ainnaa 'ahlal naa laka 'azwaajaka aal laati 'aatayta 'ujoorahunna wamaa mal akat yameenuka mimmaa 'afaa'a aal laahu 'al ayka wabanaati 'ammika wabanaati 'ammaatika wabanaati khaal ika wabanaati khaal aatika aal laati haajarna ma'aka waamraat mmu'minatan 'inw wwahabat nafsahaa lin-nabeeyi 'in 'araada aan-nabiaa'u aany yyastankihahaa khaal isat llaka min dooni ail mu'mineena qad 'al imnaa maa faradnaa 'al ayhim fi 'azwaajihim wamaa mal akat 'aymaanuhum likaylaa yakoona 'al ayka haraj wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheem

Turji man tashaa'u minhunna watooi 'il ayka man tashaa'u wamani aibtaghayta mimman 'azal ta fal aa junaaha 'al ayka zaal ika 'adnaa 'an taqarra 'a'yunuhunna wal aa yahzanna wayardayna bimaa 'aataytahunna kul luhunna waal laahu ya'lamu maa fi qul oobikum wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hal eem
Llaa yahil lu laka aan-nisaa'u mim ba'du wal aa 'an tabaddal a bihinna min 'azwaaj wal aw 'a'jabaka husnuhunna 'il laa maa mal akat yameenuka wakaana aal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' rraqeeb

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tadkhul u beeoota aan-nabeeyi 'il laa 'any yyu'zana lakum 'il aa ta'aamin ghayra naazireena 'inayaahu wal aakin 'izaa du'eetum faadkhul u faizaa ta'imtum faantashiru wal aa mustaaniseena lihadeethin 'inna zaal ikum kaana yu'zi ain-nabiaa'a fayastahyi minkum waal laahu laa yastahyi mina aal haqqi waizaa saal tumoohunna mataa'a fasal oohunna minw wwaraa'i hijaab zaal ikum 'atharu liqul oobikum waqul oobihinna wamaa kaana lakum 'an tu'zu rasoola aal laahi wal aa 'an tankihu 'azwaajahu mim ba'dihi 'abadaan 'inna zaal ikum kaana 'inda aal laahi 'azeema
'in tubdu shayaan 'aw tukhfoohu fainna aal laaha kaana bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Llaa junaaha 'al ayhinna fi 'aabaa'ihinna wal aa 'abnaa'ihinna wal aa 'ikhwaanihinna wal aa 'abnaa 'ikhwaanihinna wal aa 'abnaa'i aakhawaatihinna wal aa nisaa'ihinna wal aa maa mal akat 'aymaanuhunna waattaqeena aal laaha 'inna aal laaha kaana 'al aa kul li sha' shaheeda
'inna aal laaha wamal aa'ikatahu yusal loona 'al aa aan-nabiaa'i yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu sal lu 'al ayhi wasal limu tasleema
'inna aal zeena yu'zoona aal laaha warasoolahu la'anahumu aul laahu fi aid-dunyaa waal aakhirati waa'adda lahum 'azaaba mmuheen
Waal zeena yu'zoona aal mu'mineena waal mu'minaati bighayri maa aaktasabu faqadi aihtamal u buhtaana waithma mmubeen
Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u qul-liazwaajika wabanaatika wanisaa'i ail mu'mineena yudneena 'al ayhinna min jal aabeebihinna zaal ika 'adnaa 'any yyu'rafna fal aa yu'zayna wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheem
Lla'il llam yantahi ail munaafiqoona waal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad waal murjifoona fi ail madeenati lanughreeannaka bihim thumma laa yujaawiroonaka feehaa 'il laa qal eel
Mmal'ooneena 'aynamaa thuqifu 'ukhizu waquttil u taqteel
Sunnata aal laahi fi ail zeena khal awa min qablu wal an tajida lisunnati ail laahi tabdeel
Yasal uka aan-naasu 'ani ais-saa'ati qul 'innamaa 'il muhaa 'inda aal laahi wamaa yudreeka la'al la aas-saa'ata takoonu qareeba
'inna aal laaha la'ana aal kaafireena waa'adda lahum sa'eera
Khaal ideena feehaa 'abada llaa yajidoona wal iyya wal aa naseer
Yawma tuqal labu wujoohuhum fi ain-naari yaqooloona yaal aytanaa 'ata'naa aal laaha waata'naa aar-rasoola
Waqaal u rabbanaa 'innaa 'ata'naa saadatanaa wakubaraa'anaa faadal loonaa aas-sabeela
Rabbanaa 'aatihim di'fayni mina aal'azaabi waal'anhum la'na katheer
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa takoonu kaal zeena 'aazawa moosaa fabarraahu aul laahu mimmaa qaal u wakaana 'inda aal laahi wajeeh
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auttaqu aul laaha waqoolu qawla sadeed
Yuslih lakum 'a'maal akum wayaghfir lakum zunoobakum wamany yyuti'i ail laaha warasoolahu faqad faaza fawzaan 'azeema
'innaa 'aradnaa aal amaanata 'al aa aas-samaawaati waal ardi waal jibaal i faabayna 'any yyahmil nahaa waashfaqna minhaa wahamal ahaa aal insaanu 'innahu kaana zal ooma jahool
Lleeu'azziba aal laahu aul munaafiqeena waal munaafiqaati waal mushrikeena waal mushrikaati wayatooba aal laahu 'al aa aal mu'mineena waal mu'minaati wakaana aal laahu ghafoora rraheema
Ail hamdu lil hi ail zi lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wal ahu aul hamdu fi ail aakhirati wahwa aal hakeemu aul khabeer
Ya'lamu maa yal iju fi ail ardi wamaa yakhruju minhaa wamaa yanzil u mina aas-samaa'i wamaa ya'ruju feehaa wahwa aar-raheemu aul ghafoor

Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru laa tateenaa aas-saa'atu qul bal aa warabbi latateeannakum 'aal imu aul ghaybi laa ya'zubu 'anhu mithqaal u zarrat fi ais-samaawaati wal aa fi ail ardi wal aa 'asgharu min zaal ika wal aa 'akbaru 'il laa fi kitaab mmubeen
Lleeajzeea aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati 'ul aa'ika lahum mmaghfirat warizq kareem
Waal zeena sa'aw fi 'ayaatinaa mu'aajizeena 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaab mmir rrijzin 'al eem
Wayaraa aal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma aal zi 'unzil a 'il ayka mir rrabbika hooa aal haqqa wayahdi 'il aa siraati ail'azeezi ail hameed
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru hal nadul lukum 'al aa rajul yunabbeeukum 'izaa muzziqtum kul la mumazzaqin 'innakum lafi khal q jadeed
'aftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kazibaan 'am bihi jinnatu bal i ail zeena laa yu'minoona bial aakhirati fi ail'azaabi waad-dal aal i ail ba'eed

'afal am yarawa 'il aa maa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum mmina aas-samaa'i waal ardi 'in nnasha nakhsif bihimu aul arda 'aw nusqit 'al ayhim kisfa mmina aas-samaa 'inna fi zaal ika layat llikul li 'abd mmuneeb
Wal aqad 'aataynaa daawuda minnaa fadla yaajibaal u 'awwibi ma'ahu waat-tayra waal annaa lahu aul hadeed
'ani ai'mal saabighaat waqaddir fi ais-sardi waa'mal u saal ihaan 'inni bimaa ta'mal oona baseer

Wal isul aymaana aar-reeha ghudoowuhaa shahr warawaahuhaa shahr waasal naa lahu 'ayna aal qitri wamina aal jinni many yya'mal u bayna yadayhi biizni rabbihi wamany yyazigh minhum 'an 'amrinaa nuziqhu min 'azaabi ais-sa'eer
Ya'mal oona lahu maa yashaa'u mim mmahaareeba watamaatheela wajifaan kaal jawaabi waqudoor rraaseeaatin ai'mal u 'aal a daawuda shukra waqal eel mmin 'ibaadeea aash-shakoor

Fal ammaa qadaynaa 'al ayhi ail mawta maa dal laahum 'al aa mawtihi 'il laa daabbatu aul ardi takul u minsaatahu fal ammaa kharra tabayyanati ail jinnu 'al llaw kaanu ya'lamoona aal ghayba maa labithu fi ail'azaabi ail muheen
Laqad kaana lisaba fi masaakinihim 'ayat jannataani 'any yyameen washimaal kul u mir rrizqi rabbikum waashkuru lahu bal dat tayyibat warabbun ghafoor
Faa'radu faarsal naa 'al ayhim sayla aal'arimi wabaddal naahum bijannatayhim jannatayni zawaata 'uklin khamt waathl washa' mmin sidr qal eel
Zaal ika jazaynaahum bimaa kafaru wahal yujaazaa 'il laa aal kafoor
Waja'al naa baynahum wabayna aal quraa aal ti baaraknaa feehaa qura zaahirat waqaddarnaa feehaa aas-sayra seeru feehaa layaal eea wayyaamaan 'aamineen
Faqaal u rabbanaa baa'id bayna 'asfaarinaa wazal amu 'anfusahum faja'al naahum 'ahaadeetha wamazzaqnaahum kul la mumazzaqin 'inna fi zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbaar shakoor
Wal aqad sadaqa 'al ayhim 'ibleesu zannahu faattaba'oohu 'il laa fareeqa mmina aal mu'mineen
Wamaa kaana lahu 'al ayhim mmin sul taanin 'il laa lina'lama many yyu'minu bial aakhirati mimman hooa minhaa fi shakk warabbuka 'al aa kul li sha'in hafeez
Qul u aud'u aul zeena za'amtum mmin dooni ail laahi laa yamlikoona mithqaal a zarrat fi ais-samaawaati wal aa fi ail ardi wamaa lahum feehimaa min shirk wamaa lahu minhum mmin zaheer
Wal aa tanfa'u aush-shafaa'atu 'indahu 'il laa liman 'azina lahu hattaa 'izaa fuzzi'a 'an qul oobihim qaal u maazaa qaal a rabbukum qaal u aul haqqa wahwa aal'al eeyu aul kabeer
Qul many yyarzuqukum mmina aas-samaawaati waal ardi qul i ail laahu wainnaa 'aw 'iyyaakum la'al aa hudaan 'aw fi dal aal mmubeen
Qul-laa tusal oona 'ammaa 'ajramnaa wal aa nusal u 'ammaa ta'mal oon
Qul yajma'u baynanaa rabbunaa thumma yaftahu baynanaa bial haqqi wahwa aal fattaahu aul'al eem
Qul 'arooneea aal zeena 'al haqtum bihi shurakaa'a kal laa bal hooa aal laahu aul'azeezu aul hakeem
Wamaa 'arsal naaka 'il laa kaaffat llin-naasi basheera wanazeera wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wayaqooloona mataa haazaa aal wa'du 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul-lakum mmee'aadu yawm llaa tastaakhiroona 'anhu saa'at wal aa tastaqdimoon

Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lan nnu'mina bihaazaa aal qur'aani wal aa bial zi bayna yadayhi wal aw taraa 'izi aiz-zaal imoona mawqoofoona 'inda rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhum 'il aa ba'din ail qawla yaqoolu aul zeena aastud'ifu lil zeena aastakbaru lawlaa 'antum lakunnaa mu'mineen
Qaal a aal zeena aastakbaru lil zeena aastud'ifu 'anahnu sadadnaakum 'ani ail hudaa ba'da 'iz jaa'akum bal kuntum mmujrimeen

Waqaal a aal zeena aastud'ifu lil zeena aastakbaru bal makru aul yli waan-nahaari 'iz tamuroonanaa 'an nnakfura bial laahi wanaj'al a lahu 'andaada waasarru aun-nadaamata lammaa raawua aul'azaaba waja'al naa aal aghlaal a fi 'a'naaqi ail zeena kafaru hal yujzawna 'il laa maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Wamaa 'arsal naa fi qaryat mmin nnazeerin 'il laa qaal a mutrafoohaa 'innaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi kaafiroon
Waqaal u nahnu 'aktharu 'amwaal a waawlaada wamaa nahnu bimu'azzabeen
Qul 'inna rabbi yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa 'amwaal ukum wal aa 'awlaadukum bial ti tuqarribukum 'indanaa zul faa 'il laa man 'aamana wa'amil a saal iha faul aa'ika lahum jazaa'u aud-di'fi bimaa 'amil u wahum fi ail ghurufaati 'aaminoon
Waal zeena yas'awna fi 'ayaatinaa mu'aajizeena 'ul aa'ika fi ail'azaabi muhdaroon
Qul 'inna rabbi yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi wayaqdiru lahu wamaa 'anfaqtum mmin sha' fahwa yukhlifuhu wahwa khayru aur-raaziqeen
Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'a thumma naqoolu lil mal aa'ikati 'ahaa'ul aa 'iyyaakum kaanu ya'budoon
Qaal u subhaanaka 'anta wal eeyunaa min doonihim bal kaanu ya'budoona aal jinna 'aktharuhum bihim mmu'minoon
Faal yawma laa yamliku ba'dukum liba'd nnaf'a wal aa darra wanaqoolu lil zeena zal amu zooqu 'azaaba aan-naari ail ti kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat qaal u maa haazaa 'il laa rajul yureedu 'any yyasuddakum 'ammaa kaana ya'budu 'aabaa'ukum waqaal u maa haazaa 'il laa 'ifk mmuftara waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lil haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum 'in haazaa 'il laa sihr mmubeen
Wamaa 'aataynaahum mmin kutub yadrusoonahaa wamaa 'arsal naa 'il ayhim qablaka min nnazeer
Wakazzaba aal zeena min qablihim wamaa bal aghu mi'shaara maa 'aataynaahum fakazzabu rusul i fakayfa kaana nakeer
Qul 'innamaa 'a'izukum biwaahidatin 'an taqoomu lil hi mathnaa wafuraadaa thumma tatafakkaru maa bisaahibikum mmin jinnatin 'in hooa 'il laa nazeer llakum bayna yada 'azaab shadeed
Qul maa saal tukum mmin 'ajr fahwa lakum 'in 'ajreea 'il laa 'al aa aal laahi wahwa 'al aa kul li sha' shaheed
Qul 'inna rabbi yaqzifu bial haqqi 'al laamu aul ghuyoob

Qul 'in dal al tu fainnamaa 'adil lu 'al aa nafsi waini aihtadaytu fabimaa yoohi 'il ayya rabbeea 'innahu samee' qareeb
Wal aw taraa 'iz fazi'u fal aa fawta waukhizu mim mmakaan qareeb
Waqaal u 'aamannaa bihi waannaa lahumu aut-tanaawushu mim mmakaani ba'eed
Waqad kafaru bihi min qablu wayaqzifoona bial ghaybi mim mmakaani ba'eed
Waheela baynahum wabayna maa yashtahoona kamaa fu'il a biashyaa'ihim mmin qablu 'innahum kaanu fi shakk mmureeb

Ail hamdu lil hi faatiri ais-samaawaati waal ardi jaa'il i ail mal aa'ikati rusul aan 'ooli 'ajnihat mmathnaa wathul aatha warubaa'a yazeedu fi ail khal qi maa yashaa'u ainna aal laaha 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Mmaa yaftahi ail laahu lin-naasi mir rrahmat fal aa mumsika lahaa wamaa yumsik fal aa mursil a lahu mim ba'dihi wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu auzkuru ni'mata aal laahi 'al aykum hal min khaal iqin ghayru aul laahi yarzuqukum mmina aas-samaa'i waal ardi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa faannaa tu'fakoon
Wainy yyukazzibooka faqad kuzzibat rusul mmin qablika wail aa aal laahi turja'u aul umoor
Yayyuhaa aan-naasu 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq fal aa taghurrannakumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunyaa wal aa yaghurrannakum bial laahi ail gharoor
'inna aash-shaytaana lakum 'adoow faattakhizoohu 'adoowaan 'innamaa yad'u hizbahu leeakoonu min 'ashaabi ais-sa'eer
Ail zeena kafaru lahum 'azaab shadeed waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lahum mmaghfirat waajr kabeer

'afaman zuyyina lahu sooaa'u 'amal ihi fara'aahu hasana fainna aal laaha yudil lu many yyashaa'u wayahdi many yyashaa'u fal aa tazhab nafsuka 'al ayhim hasaraatin 'inna aal laaha 'al eemu bimaa yasna'oon
Waal laahu aul zi 'arsal a aar-reeaaha fatutheeru sahaaba fasuqnaahu 'il aa bal ad mmayyit faahyaynaa bihi ail arda ba'da mawtihaa kazaal ika aan-nushoor

Man kaana yureedu aul'izzata fal il hi ail'izzatu jamee'aan 'il ayhi yas'adu aul kal imu aut-tayyibu waal'amal u aus-saal ihu yarfa'uhu waal zeena yamkuroona aas-sayyiaati lahum 'azaab shadeed wamakru 'ul aa'ika hooa yaboor

Waal laahu khal aqakum mmin turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma ja'al akum 'azwaaja wamaa tahmil u min 'unthaa wal aa tada'u 'il laa bi'il mihi wamaa yu'ammaru mim mmu'ammar wal aa yunqasu min 'umurihi 'il laa fi kitaabin 'inna zaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer

Wamaa yastawi ail bahraani haazaa 'azb furaat saa'igh sharaabuhu wahaazaa mil hun 'ujaaj wamin kul l takul oona lahma tariyya watastakhrijoona hil yat tal basoonahaa wataraa aal ful ka feehi mawaakhira litabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon

Wamina aan-naasi waad-dawaabbi waal an'aami mukhtal ifun 'al waanuhu kazaal ika 'innamaa yakhshaa aal laaha min 'ibaadihi ail'ul amaa'ua ainna aal laaha 'azeezun ghafoor

Leeooaffeeahum 'ujoorahum wayazeedahum mmin fadlihi 'innahu ghafoor shakoor
Waal zi 'awhaynaa 'il ayka mina aal kitaabi hooa aal haqqu musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi 'inna aal laaha bi'ibaadihi lakhabeeru baseer
Thumma 'awrathnaa aal kitaaba aal zeena aastafaynaa min 'ibaadinaa faminhum zaal im llinafsihi waminhum mmuqtasid waminhum saabiqu bial khayraati biizni ail laahi zaal ika hooa aal fadlu aul kabeer
Jannaatu 'adn yadkhul oonahaa yuhal lawna feehaa min 'asaawira min zahab wal u'lu'a wal ibaasuhum feehaa hareer
Waqaal u aul hamdu lil hi ail zi 'azhaba 'annaa aal hazana 'inna rabbanaa laghafoor shakoor
Ail zi 'ahal lanaa daara aal muqaamati min fadlihi laa yamassunaa feehaa nasab wal aa yamassunaa feehaa lughoob
Waal zeena kafaru lahum naaru jahannama laa yuqdaa 'al ayhim fayamootu wal aa yukhaffafu 'anhum mmin 'azaabihaa kazaal ika najzi kul la kafoor

Wahum yastarikhoona feehaa rabbanaa 'akhrijnaa na'mal saal ihaan ghayra aal zi kunnaa na'mal u 'awal am nu'ammirkum mmaa yatazakkaru feehi man tazakkara wajaa'akumu aun-nazeeru fazooqu famaa liz-zaal imeena min nnaseer
'inna aal laaha 'aal imu ghaybi ais-samaawaati waal ardi 'innahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor

Hooa aal zi ja'al akum khal aa'ifa fi ail ardi faman kafara fa'al ayhi kufruhu wal aa yazeedu aul kaafireena kufruhum 'inda rabbihim 'il laa maqta wal aa yazeedu aul kaafireena kufruhum 'il laa khasaar

Qul 'araytum shurakaa'akumu aul zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi 'arooni maazaa khal aqu mina aal ardi 'am lahum shirk fi ais-samaawaati 'am 'aataynaahum kitaaba fahum 'al aa bayyinaat mminhu bal 'iny yya'idu auz-zaal imoona ba'duhum ba'daan 'il laa ghuroora
'inna aal laaha yumsiku aus-samaawaati waal arda 'an tazoolaa wal a'in zaal ataa 'in 'amsakahumaa min 'ahad mmim ba'dihi 'innahu kaana hal eemaan ghafoor
Waaqsamu bial laahi jahda 'aymaanihim la'in jaa'ahum nazeer llayakoonunna 'ahdaa min 'ihdaa aal umami fal ammaa jaa'ahum nazeer mmaa zaadahum 'il laa nufoora
Aistikbaara fi ail ardi wamakra aas-sayyi'i wal aa yaheequ aul makru aus-sayyiu ail laa biahlihi fahal yanzuroona 'il laa sunnata aal awwal eena fal an tajida lisunnati ail laahi tabdeel

'awal am yaseeru fi ail ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim wakaanu 'ashadda minhum qoowat wamaa kaana aal laahu leeu'jizahu min sha' fi ais-samaawaati wal aa fi ail ardi 'innahu kaana 'al eema qadeer

Wal aw yu'aakhizu aul laahu aun-naasa bimaa kasabu maa taraka 'al aa zahrihaa min daabbat wal aakiny yyu'akhkhiruhum 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma faizaa jaa 'ajal uhum fainna aal laaha kaana bi'ibaadihi baseera

Wajaa'a min 'aqsaa aal madeenati rajul yas'aa qaal a yaaqawmi aittabi'u aul mursal een

'inneea 'aamantu birabbikum faasma'oon

Laa aash-shamsu yanbaghi lahaa 'an tudrika aal qamara wal aa aal ylu saabiqu aun-nahaari wakul l fi fal ak yasbahoon

'am lahum mmul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa baynahumaa fal yartaqu fi ail asbaab
Jund mmaa hunaal ika mahzoom mmina aal ahzaab
Kazzabat qablahum qawmu nooh wa'aad wafir'awnu zoo aul awtaad
Wathamoodu waqawmu loot waashaabu laykata 'ul aa'ika aal ahzaab

Waqaal u rabbanaa 'ajjil-lanaa qittanaa qabla yawmi ail hisaab
Aisbir 'al aa maa yaqooloona waazkur 'abdanaa daawuda zaa aal aydi 'innahu 'awwaab
'innaa sakhkharnaa aal jibaal a ma'ahu yusabbihna bial'asheeyi waal ishraaq

Wamaa khal aqnaa aas-samaa'a waal arda wamaa baynahumaa baatil a zaal ika zannu aul zeena kafaru fawayl llil zeena kafaru mina aan-naar

Kitaabun 'anzal naahu 'il ayka mubaarak lleeaddabbaru 'ayaatihi wal eeatazakkara 'oolu aul al baab

Ail laahu nazzal a 'ahsana aal hadeethi kitaaba mmutashaabiha mmathaaneea taqsha'irru minhu jul oodu aul zeena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma tal eenu jul ooduhum waqul oobuhum 'il aa zikri ail laahi zaal ika hudaa aal laahi yahdi bihi many yyashaa'u wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu min haad
'afamany yyattaqi biwajhihi sooaa'a aal'azaabi yawma aal qeeaamati waqeela liz-zaal imeena zooqu maa kuntum taksiboon

Wal aqad darabnaa lin-naasi fi haazaa aal qur'aani min kul li mathal-la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Qur'aanaan 'arabiyyaan ghayra zi 'iwaj lla'al laahum yattaqoon
Daraba aal laahu mathal a rrajul a feehi shurakaa'u mutashaakisoona warajul a sal ama llirajul in hal yastaweeaani mathal aan ail hamdu lil hi bal 'aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
'innaka mayyit wainnahum mmayyitoon
Thumma 'innakum yawma aal qeeaamati 'inda rabbikum takhtasimoon
Faman 'azlamu mimman kazaba 'al aa aal laahi wakazzaba bias-sidqi 'iz jaa'ahu 'al aysa fi jahannama mathwa llil kaafireen
Waal zi jaa'a bias-sidqi wasaddaqa bihi 'ul aa'ika humu aul muttaqoon
Lahum mmaa yashaa'oona 'inda rabbihim zaal ika jazaa'ua aul muhsineen
Leeukaffira aal laahu 'anhum 'aswaa aal zi 'amil u wayajzeeahum 'ajrahum biahsani ail zi kaanu ya'mal oon

Qul yaaqawmi ai'mal u 'al aa makaanatikum 'inni 'aamil fasawfa ta'lamoona many yyateehi 'azaab yukhzeehi wayahil lu 'al ayhi 'azaab mmuqeem
