Ail laahu yatawaffaa aal anfusa heena mawtihaa waal ti lam tamut fi manaamihaa fayumsiku aul ti qadaa 'al ayhaa aal mawta wayursil u aul ukhraa 'il aa 'ajal mmusammaan 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
'ami aittakhazu min dooni ail laahi shufa'aa'a qul 'awal aw kaanu laa yamlikoona shaya wal aa ya'qil oon
Qul-lil hi aish-shafaa'atu jamee'a llaahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi thumma 'il ayhi turja'oon
Waizaa zukira aal laahu wahdahu aushmaazzat qul oobu aul zeena laa yu'minoona bial aakhirati waizaa zukira aal zeena min doonihi 'izaa hum yastabshiroon
Qul i ail laahumma faatira aas-samaawaati waal ardi 'aal ima aal ghaybi waash-shahaadati 'anta tahkumu bayna 'ibaadika fi maa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Wal aw 'anna lil zeena zal amu maa fi ail ardi jamee'a wamithlahu ma'ahu laaftadawa bihi min sooaa'i ail'azaabi yawma aal qeeaamati wabadaa lahum mmina aal laahi maa lam yakoonu yahtasiboon
Wabadaa lahum sayyiaatu maa kasabu wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Faizaa massa aal insaana durr da'aanaa thumma 'izaa khawwal naahu ni'mat mminnaa qaal a 'innamaa 'ooteetuhu 'al aa 'il mi bal heea fitnat wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Qad qaal ahaa aal zeena min qablihim famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaksiboon
Faasaabahum sayyiaatu maa kasabu waal zeena zal amu min haa'ul aa'i sayuseebuhum sayyiaatu maa kasabu wamaa hum bimu'jizeen
'awal am ya'lamu 'anna aal laaha yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yu'minoon
Qul yaa'ibaadeea aal zeena 'asrafu 'al aa 'anfusihim laa taqnatu mir rrahmati ail laahi 'inna aal laaha yaghfiru auz-zunooba jamee'aan 'innahu hooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Waaneebu 'il aa rabbikum waaslimu lahu min qabli 'any yyateeakumu aul'azaabu thumma laa tunsaroon
Waattabi'u 'ahsana maa 'unzil a 'il aykum mmir rrabbikum mmin qabli 'any yyateeakumu aul'azaabu baghtat waantum laa tash'uroon
'an taqoola nafs yaahasrataa 'al aa maa farratttu fi janbi ail laahi wain kuntu lamina aas-saakhireen
'aw taqoola law 'anna aal laaha hadayaani lakuntu mina aal muttaqeen
'aw taqoola heena taraa aal'azaaba law 'anna li karrat faakoona mina aal muhsineen
Bal aa qad jaa'atka 'ayaati fakazzabta bihaa waastakbarta wakunta mina aal kaafireen
Wayawma aal qeeaamati taraa aal zeena kazabu 'al aa aal laahi wujoohuhum mmuswaddatun 'al aysa fi jahannama mathwa llil mutakabbireen
Wayunajji ail laahu aul zeena aattaqawa bimafaazatihim laa yamassuhumu aus-sooaa'u wal aa hum yahzanoon
Aal laahu khaal iqu kul li sha' wahwa 'al aa kul li sha' wakeel
Llaahu maqaal eedu aus-samaawaati waal ardi waal zeena kafaru biayaati ail laahi 'ul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
Qul 'afaghayra aal laahi tamurooneea 'a'budu 'ayyuhaa aal jaahil oon
Wal aqad 'ooheea 'il ayka wail aa aal zeena min qablika la'in 'ashrakta layahbatanna 'amal uka wal atakoonanna mina aal khaasireen
Bal i ail laaha faa'bud wakum mmina aash-shaakireen
Wamaa qadaru aul laaha haqqa qadrihi waal ardu jamee'a qabdatuhu yawma aal qeeaamati waas-samaawaatu matwiyyaatu beeameenihi subhaanahu wata'aal aa 'ammaa yushrikoon
Wanufikha fi ais-soori fasa'iqa man fi ais-samaawaati waman fi ail ardi 'il laa man shaa'a aal laahu thumma nufikha feehi 'ukhraa faizaa hum qeeaam yanzuroon
Waashraqati ail ardu binoori rabbihaa wawudi'a aal kitaabu wajiaa'a bian-nabeeaaina waash-shuhadaa'i waqudeea baynahum bial haqqi wahum laa yuzlamoon
Wawuffeeat kul lu nafs mmaa 'amil at wahwa 'a'lamu bimaa yaf'al oon

Waseeqa aal zeena kafaru 'il aa jahannama zumaraan hattaa 'izaa jaa'oohaa futtihat 'abwaabuhaa waqaal a lahum khazanatuhaa 'al am yatikum rusul mminkum yatloona 'al aykum 'ayaati rabbikum wayunziroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa qaal u bal aa wal aakin haqqat kal imatu aul'azaabi 'al aa aal kaafireen
Qeela aadkhul u 'abwaaba jahannama khaal ideena feehaa fabeesa mathwaa aal mutakabbireen
Waseeqa aal zeena aattaqawa rabbahum 'il aa aal jannati zumaraan hattaa 'izaa jaa'oohaa wafuttihat 'abwaabuhaa waqaal a lahum khazanatuhaa sal aamun 'al aykum tibtum faadkhul oohaa khaal ideen
Waqaal u aul hamdu lil hi ail zi sadaqanaa wa'dahu waawrathanaa aal arda natabawwau mina aal jannati haythu nashaa'u fani'ma 'ajru aul'aamil een
Wataraa aal mal aa'ikata haaffeena min hawli ail'arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim waqudeea baynahum bial haqqi waqeela aal hamdu lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Hamiaa tanzeelu aul kitaabi mina aal laahi ail'azeezi ail'al eem
Ghaafiri aiz-zanbi waqaabil i ait-tawbi shadeedi ail'iqaabi zi ait-tawli laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'il ayhi ail maseer
Maa yujaadil u fi 'ayaati ail laahi 'il laa aal zeena kafaru fal aa yaghrurka taqal lubuhum fi ail bil aad
Kazzabat qablahum qawmu nooh waal ahzaabu mim ba'dihim wahammat kul lu 'ummati birasoolihim leeakhuzoohu wajaadal u bial baatil i leeudhidu bihi ail haqqa faakhazttuhum fakayfa kaana 'iqaab
Wakazaal ika haqqat kal imaatu rabbika 'al aa aal zeena kafaru 'annahum 'ashaabu aun-naar

Ail zeena yahmil oona aal'arsha waman hawlahu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayu'minoona bihi wayastaghfiroona lil zeena 'aamanu rabbanaa wasi'ta kul la sha' rrahmat wa'il ma faaghfir lil zeena taabu waattaba'u sabeelaka waqihim 'azaaba aal jaheem
Rabbanaa waadkhil hum jannaati 'adnin ail ti wa'adttahum waman sal aha min 'aabaa'ihim waazwaajihim wazurriyyaatihim 'innaka 'anta aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Waqihimu aus-sayyiaati waman taqi ais-sayyiaati yawma'iz faqad rahimtahu wazaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem
'inna aal zeena kafaru yunaadawna lamaqtu aul laahi 'akbaru mim mmaqtikum 'anfusakum 'iz tud'awna 'il aa aal eemaani fatakfuroon
Qaal u rabbanaa 'amattanaa aathnatayni waahyaytanaa aathnatayni faa'tarafnaa bizunoobinaa fahal 'il aa khurooj mmin sabeel
Zaal ikum biannahu 'izaa du'eea aal laahu wahdahu kafartum wainy yyushrak bihi tu'minu faal hukmu lil hi ail'al eeyi ail kabeer
Hooa aal zi yureekum 'ayaatihi wayunazzil u lakum mmina aas-samaa'i rizqa wamaa yatazakkaru 'il laa many yyuneeb
Faad'u aul laaha mukhliseena lahu aud-deena wal aw kariha aal kaafiroon
Rafee'u aud-darajaati zoo aul'arshi yul qi air-rooha min 'amrihi 'al aa many yyashaa'u min 'ibaadihi leeunzira yawma aat-tal aaq
Yawma hum baarizoona laa yakhfaa 'al aa aal laahi minhum sha' llimani ail mul ku aul yawma lil hi ail waahidi ail qahhaar
Ail yawma tujzaa kul lu nafsi bimaa kasabat laa zul ma aal yawma 'inna aal laaha saree'u aul hisaab
Waanzirhum yawma aal aazifati 'izi ail qul oobu ladaa aal hanaajiri kaazimeen
Maa liz-zaal imeena min hameem wal aa shafee' yutaa'
Ya'lamu khaa'inata aal a'yuni wamaa tukhfi ais-sudoor
Waal laahu yaqdi bial haqqi waal zeena tad'oona min doonihi laa yaqdoona bisha'in 'inna aal laaha hooa aas-samee'u aul baseer

'awal am yaseeru fi ail ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena kaanu min qablihim kaanu hum 'ashadda minhum qoowat wa'aathaara fi ail ardi faakhazahumu aul laahu bizunoobihim wamaa kaana lahum mmina aal laahi minw wwaaq
Zaal ika biannahum kaanat ttateehim rusul uhum bial bayyinaati fakafaru faakhazahumu aul laahu 'innahu qaweey shadeedu aul'iqaab
Wal aqad 'arsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa wasul taam mmubeen
'il aa fir'awna wahaamaana waqaaroona faqaal u saahir kazzaab
Fal ammaa jaa'ahum bial haqqi min 'indinaa qaal u auqtul u 'abnaa'a aal zeena 'aamanu ma'ahu waastahyu nisaa'ahum wamaa kaydu aul kaafireena 'il laa fi dal aal
Waqaal a fir'awnu zarooni 'aqtul moosaa wal yad'u rabbahu 'inneea 'akhaafu 'any yyubaddil a deenakum waany yyuzhira fi ail ardi ail fasaad
Waqaal a moosaa 'inni 'uztu birabbi warabbikum mmin kul li mutakabbir llaa yu'minu beeawmi ail hisaab

Waqaal a rajul mmu'mim mmin 'aal i fir'awna yaktumu 'eemaanahu 'ataqtul oona rajul aan 'any yyaqoola rabbeea aal laahu waqad jaa'akum bial bayyinaati mir rrabbikum wainy yyaku kaaziba fa'al ayhi kazibuhu wainy yyaku saadiqa yusibkum ba'du aul zi ya'idukum 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi man hooa musrif kazzaab

Yaaqawmi lakumu aul mul ku aul yawma zaahireena fi ail ardi famany yyansurunaa mim basi ail laahi 'in jaa'anaa qaal a fir'awnu maa 'ureekum 'il laa maa 'araa wamaa 'ahdeekum 'il laa sabeela aar-rashaad
Waqaal a aal zi 'aamana yaaqawmi 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum mmithla yawmi ail ahzaab
Mithla dabi qawmi nooh wa'aad wathamooda waal zeena mim ba'dihim wamaa aal laahu yureedu zul ma llil'ibaad
Wayaaqawmi 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum yawma aat-tanaad
Yawma tooal loona mudbireena maa lakum mmina aal laahi min 'aasim wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu min haad

Wal aqad jaa'akum yoosufu min qablu bial bayyinaati famaa zil tum fi shakk mmimmaa jaa'akum bihi hattaa 'izaa hal aka qul tum lany yyab'atha aal laahu mim ba'dihi rasoola kazaal ika yudil lu aul laahu man hooa musrif mmurtaab

Ail zeena yujaadil oona fi 'ayaati ail laahi bighayri sul taanin 'atayaahum kabura maqtaan 'inda aal laahi wa'inda aal zeena 'aamanu kazaal ika yatba'u aul laahu 'al aa kul li qal bi mutakabbir jabbaar
Waqaal a fir'awnu yaahaamaanu aubni li sarha lla'al leea 'ablughu aul asbaab
'asbaaba aas-samaawaati faattal i'u 'il aa 'il aahi moosaa wainni laazunnuhu kaaziba wakazaal ika zuyyina lifir'awna sooaa'u 'amal ihi wasadda 'ani ais-sabeeli wamaa kaydu fir'awna 'il laa fi tabaab
Waqaal a aal zi 'aamana yaaqawmi aittabi'ooni 'ahdikum sabeela aar-rashaad
Yaaqawmi 'innamaa haazihi ail hayawaatu aud-dunyaa mataa' wainna aal aakhirata heea daaru aul qaraar
Man 'amil a sayyeeat fal aa yujzaa 'il laa mithlahaa waman 'amil a saal iha mmin zakarin 'aw 'unthaa wahwa mu'min faul aa'ika yadkhul oona aal jannata yurzaqoona feehaa bighayri hisaab
Wayaaqawmi maa leea 'ad'ookum 'il aa aan-najawaati watad'oonani 'il aa aan-naar
Tad'oonani liakfura bial laahi waushrika bihi maa laysa li bihi 'il m waanaa 'ad'ookum 'il aa aal'azeezi ail ghaffaar
Laa jarama 'annamaa tad'oonani 'il ayhi laysa lahu da'wat fi aid-dunyaa wal aa fi ail aakhirati waanna maraddanaa 'il aa aal laahi waanna aal musrifeena hum 'ashaabu aun-naar
Fasatazkuroona maa 'aqoolu lakum waufawwidu 'amreea 'il aa aal laahi 'inna aal laaha baseeru bial'ibaad
Fawaqayaahu aul laahu sayyiaati maa makaru wahaaqa biaal i fir'awna sooaa'u aul'azaab
Ain-naaru yu'radoona 'al ayhaa ghudoowa wa'ashiyya wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu 'adkhil u 'aal a fir'awna 'ashadda aal'azaab
Waiz yatahaajjoona fi ain-naari fayaqoolu aud-du'afaa'ua lil zeena aastakbaru 'innaa kunnaa lakum taba'a fahal 'antum mmughnoona 'annaa naseeba mmina aan-naar
Qaal a aal zeena aastakbaru 'innaa kul l feehaa 'inna aal laaha qad hakama bayna aal'ibaad
Waqaal a aal zeena fi ain-naari likhazanati jahannama aad'u rabbakum yukhaffif 'annaa yawma mmina aal'azaab
Qaal u 'awal am taku tateekum rusul ukum bial bayyinaati qaal u bal aa qaal u faad'u wamaa du'aa'ua aul kaafireena 'il laa fi dal aal
'innaa lanansuru rusul anaa waal zeena 'aamanu fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wayawma yaqoomu aul ashhaad
Yawma laa yanfa'u auz-zaal imeena ma'ziratuhum wal ahumu aul la'natu wal ahum sooaa'u aud-daar
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa aal hudaa waawrathnaa bani 'israa'eela aal kitaaba huda wazikraa liooli ail al baab
Faasbir 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq waastaghfir lizanbika wasabbih bihamdi rabbika bial'asheeyi waal ibkaar
'inna aal zeena yujaadil oona fi 'ayaati ail laahi bighayri sul taanin 'atayaahum 'in fi sudoorihim 'il laa kibr mmaa hum bibaal igheehi faasta'iz bial laahi 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul baseer
Lakhal qu aus-samaawaati waal ardi 'akbaru min khal qi ain-naasi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wamaa yastawi ail a'maa waal baseer
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati wal aa aal musiaa'u qal eela mmaa yatazakkaroon
'inna aas-saa'ata laateeat llaa rayba feehaa wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yu'minoon
Waqaal a rabbukumu aud'ooni 'astajib lakum 'inna aal zeena yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadati sayadkhul oona jahannama daakhireen
Aal laahu aul zi ja'al a lakumu aul yla litaskunu feehi waan-nahaara mubsiraan 'inna aal laaha lazoo fadlin 'al aa aan-naasi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukum khaal iqu kul li sha' llaa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa faannaa tu'fakoon
Kazaal ika yu'faku aul zeena kaanu biayaati ail laahi yajhadoon

Aal laahu aul zi ja'al a lakumu aul arda qaraara waas-samaa'a binaa' wasawwarakum faahsana sooarakum warazaqakum mmina aat-tayyibaati zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbukum fatabaaraka aal laahu rabbu aul'aal ameen
Hooa aal hayyu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa faad'oohu mukhliseena lahu aud-deena aal hamdu lil hi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Qul 'inni nuheetu 'an 'a'buda aal zeena tad'oona min dooni ail laahi lammaa jaa'aneea aal bayyinaatu mir rrabbi waumirtu 'an 'uslima lirabbi ail'aal ameen

Hooa aal zi khal aqakum mmin turaab thumma min nnutfat thumma min 'al aqat thumma yukhrijukum tifla thumma litablughu 'ashuddakum thumma litakoonu shuyookha waminkum mmany yyutawaffaa min qablu wal itablughu 'ajal a mmusamma wal a'al lakum ta'qil oon
Hooa aal zi yuhyi wayumeetu faizaa qadaa 'amra fainnamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena yujaadil oona fi 'ayaati ail laahi 'annaa yusrafoon
Aal zeena kazzabu bial kitaabi wabimaa 'arsal naa bihi rusul anaa fasawfa ya'lamoon
'izi ail aghlaal u fi 'a'naaqihim waas-sal aasil u yushaboon
Fi ail hameemi thumma fi ain-naari yusjaroon
Thumma qeela lahum 'ayna maa kuntum tushrikoona min dooni ail laahi qaal u dal lu 'annaa bal-lam nakun nnad'u min qablu shaya kazaal ika yudil lu aul laahu aul kaafireen
Zaal ikum bimaa kuntum tafrahoona fi ail ardi bighayri ail haqqi wabimaa kuntum tamrahoon
Aadkhul u 'abwaaba jahannama khaal ideena feehaa fabeesa mathwaa aal mutakabbireen
Faasbir 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq faimmaa nureeannaka ba'da aal zi na'iduhum 'aw natawaffayannaka fail aynaa yurja'oon

Wal aqad 'arsal naa rusul a mmin qablika minhum mman qasasnaa 'al ayka waminhum mmal llam naqsus 'al ayka wamaa kaana lirasoolin 'any yyateea biayatin 'il laa biizni ail laahi faizaa jaa 'amru aul laahi qudeea bial haqqi wakhasira hunaal ika aal mubtil oon
Aal laahu aul zi ja'al a lakumu aul an'aama litarkabu minhaa waminhaa takul oon
Wal akum feehaa manaafi'u wal itablughu 'al ayhaa haajat fi sudoorikum wa'al ayhaa wa'al aa aal ful ki tuhmal oon
Wayureekum 'ayaatihi fayya 'ayaati ail laahi tunkiroon
'afal am yaseeru fi ail ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim kaanu 'akthara minhum waashadda qoowat wa'aathaara fi ail ardi famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum mmaa kaanu yaksiboon
Fal ammaa jaa'athum rusul uhum bial bayyinaati farihu bimaa 'indahum mmina aal'il mi wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Fal ammaa raawa basanaa qaal u 'aamannaa bial laahi wahdahu wakafarnaa bimaa kunnaa bihi mushrikeen
Fal am yaku yanfa'uhum 'eemaanuhum lammaa raawa basanaa sunnata aal laahi ail ti qad khal at fi 'ibaadihi wakhasira hunaal ika aal kaafiroon
Hamiaa tanzeel mmina aar-rahmaani air-raheem
Kitaab fussil at 'ayaatuhu qur'aanaan 'arabiyya lliqawm ya'lamoon
Basheera wanazeera faa'rada 'aktharuhum fahum laa yasma'oon
Waqaal u qul oobunaa fi 'akinnat mmimmaa tad'oonaa 'il ayhi wafi 'aazaaninaa waqr wamim bayninaa wabaynika hijaab faa'mal 'innanaa 'aamil oon
Qul 'innamaa 'anaa bashar mmithlukum yoohaa 'il ayya 'annamaa 'il aahukum 'il aah waahid faastaqeemu 'il ayhi waastaghfiroohu wawayl llil mushrikeen
Aal zeena laa yu'toona aaz-zakawaata wahum bial aakhirati hum kaafiroon
'inna aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati lahum 'ajrun ghayru mamnoon
Qul 'aa'innakum latakfuroona bial zi khal aqa aal arda fi yawmayni wataj'al oona lahu 'andaada zaal ika rabbu aul'aal ameen
Waja'al a feehaa rawaaseea min fawqihaa wabaaraka feehaa waqaddara feehaa 'aqwaatahaa fi 'arba'ati 'ayyaam sawaa' llis-saa'il een
Thumma aastawaa 'il aa aas-samaa'i wahya dukhaan faqaal a lahaa wal il ardi aeeteeaa taw'aan 'aw karha qaal ataa 'ataynaa taa'i'een
Faqadayaahunna sab'a samaawaat fi yawmayni waawhaa fi kul li samaa'in 'amrahaa wazayyannaa aas-samaa'a aad-dunyaa bimasaabeeha wahifza zaal ika taqdeeru aul'azeezi ail'al eem
Fain 'a'radu faqul 'anzartukum saa'iqat mmithla saa'iqati 'aad wathamood
'iz jaa'athumu aur-rusul u mim bayni 'aydeehim wamin khal fihim 'al laa ta'budu 'il laa aal laaha qaal u law shaa'a rabbunaa laanzal a mal aa'ikat fainnaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi kaafiroon

Faammaa 'aad faastakbaru fi ail ardi bighayri ail haqqi waqaal u man 'ashaddu minnaa qoowatan 'awal am yarawa 'anna aal laaha aal zi khal aqahum hooa 'ashaddu minhum qoowat wakaanu biayaatinaa yajhadoon
Faarsal naa 'al ayhim reeha sarsara fi 'ayyaam nnahsaat llinuzeeqahum 'azaaba aal khizyi fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wal a'azaabu aul aakhirati 'akhzaa wahum laa yunsaroon
Waammaa thamoodu fahadaynaahum faastahabbu aul'amaa 'al aa aal hudaa faakhazathum saa'iqatu aul'azaabi ail hooni bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
Wanajjaynaa aal zeena 'aamanu wakaanu yattaqoon
Wayawma nahshuru 'a'daa'a aal laahi 'il aa aan-naari fahum yooza'oon
Hattaa 'izaa maa jaa'oohaa shahida 'al ayhim sam'uhum waabsaaruhum wajul ooduhum bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon
Waqaal u lijul oodihim lima shahidttum 'al aynaa qaal u 'antaqanaa aal laahu aul zi 'antaqa kul la sha' wahwa khal aqakum 'awwal a marrat wail ayhi turja'oon
Wamaa kuntum tastatiroona 'any yyashhada 'al aykum sam'ukum wal aa 'absaarukum wal aa jul oodukum wal aakin zanantum 'anna aal laaha laa ya'lamu katheera mmimmaa ta'mal oon
Wazaal ikum zannukumu aul zi zanantum birabbikum 'ardayaakum faasbahtum mmina aal khaasireen
Fainy yyasbiru faan-naaru mathwa llaahum wainy yyasta'tibu famaa hum mmina aal mu'tabeen
Waqayyadnaa lahum quranaa'a fazayyanu lahum mmaa bayna 'aydeehim wamaa khal fahum wahaqqa 'al ayhimu aul qawlu fi 'umam qad khal at min qablihim mmina aal jinni waal insi 'innahum kaanu khaasireen
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru laa tasma'u lihaazaa aal qur'aani waal ghawa feehi la'al lakum taghliboon
Fal anuzeeqanna aal zeena kafaru 'azaaba shadeeda wal anajzeeannahum 'aswaa aal zi kaanu ya'mal oon
Zaal ika jazaa'u aa'daa'i ail laahi ain-naaru lahum feehaa daaru aul khul di jazaa'a bimaa kaanu biayaatinaa yajhadoon
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru rabbanaa 'arinaa aal zayni 'adal laanaa mina aal jinni waal insi naj'al humaa tahta 'aqdaaminaa leeakoonaa mina aal asfal een
'inna aal zeena qaal u rabbunaa aal laahu thumma aastaqaamu tatanazzal u 'al ayhimu aul mal aa'ikatu 'al laa takhaafu wal aa tahzanu waabshiru bial jannati ail ti kuntum too'adoon
Nahnu 'awleeaa'ukum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa wafi ail aakhirati wal akum feehaa maa tashtahi 'anfusukum wal akum feehaa maa tadda'oon
Nuzul a mmin ghafoor rraheem
Waman 'ahsanu qawla mmimman da'aa 'il aa aal laahi wa'amil a saal iha waqaal a 'innani mina aal muslimeen
Wal aa tastawi ail hasanatu wal aa aas-sayyeeatu audfa' bial ti heea 'ahsanu faizaa aal zi baynaka wabaynahu 'adaawat kaannahu wal eeyun hameem
Wamaa yul aqqayaahaa 'il laa aal zeena sabaru wamaa yul aqqayaahaa 'il laa zoo hazzin 'azeem
Waimmaa yanzaghannaka mina aash-shaytaani nazgh faasta'iz bial laahi 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Wamin 'ayaatihi ail ylu waan-nahaaru waash-shamsu waal qamaru laa tasjudu lish-shamsi wal aa lil qamari waasjudu lil hi ail zi khal aqahunna 'in kuntum 'iyyaahu ta'budoon
Faini aistakbaru faal zeena 'inda rabbika yusabbihoona lahu bial yli waan-nahaari wahum laa yasamoon
Wamin 'ayaatihi 'annaka taraa aal arda khaashi'at faizaa 'anzal naa 'al ayhaa aal maa'a aahtazzat warabat 'inna aal zi 'ahyaahaa lamuhyi ail mawtaa 'innahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

'inna aal zeena yul hidoona fi 'ayaatinaa laa yakhfawna 'al aynaa 'afamany yyul qaa fi ain-naari khayrun 'am mmany yyati 'aamina yawma aal qeeaamati ai'mal u maa sheetum 'innahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
'inna aal zeena kafaru biaz-zikri lammaa jaa'ahum wainnahu lakitaabun 'azeez
Llaa yateehi ail baatil u mim bayni yadayhi wal aa min khal fihi tanzeel mmin hakeemin hameed
Mmaa yuqaal u laka 'il laa maa qad qeela lir-rusul i min qablika 'inna rabbaka lazoo maghfirat wazoo 'iqaabin 'al eem

Wal aw ja'al naahu qur'aanaan 'a'jamiyya llaqaal u lawlaa fussil at 'ayaatuhu 'aa'jameey wa'arabeey qul hooa lil zeena 'aamanu huda washifaa' waal zeena laa yu'minoona fi 'aazaanihim waqr wahwa 'al ayhim 'amaan 'ul aa'ika yunaadawna mim mmakaani ba'eed
Wal aqad 'aataynaa moosaa aal kitaaba faakhtul ifa feehi wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika laqudeea baynahum wainnahum lafi shakk mminhu mureeb
Mman 'amil a saal iha fal inafsihi waman 'asaa'a fa'al ayhaa wamaa rabbuka bizal laam llil'abeed

'il ayhi yuraddu 'il mu aus-saa'ati wamaa takhruju min thamaraat mmin 'akmaamihaa wamaa tahmil u min 'unthaa wal aa tada'u 'il laa bi'il mihi wayawma yunaadeehim 'ayna shurakaa'i qaal u 'aazannaaka maa minnaa min shaheed
Wadal la 'anhum mmaa kaanu yad'oona min qablu wazannu maa lahum mmim mmahees
Llaa yasamu aul insaanu min du'aa'i ail khayri waim mmassahu aush-sharru fayaoos qanooh

Wal a'in 'azaqnaahu rahmat mminnaa mim ba'di darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna haazaa li wamaa 'azunnu aus-saa'ata qaa'imat wal a'ir rruji'tu 'il aa rabbeea 'inna li 'indahu lal husnaa fal anunabbeeanna aal zeena kafaru bimaa 'amil u wal anuzeeqannahum mmin 'azaabin ghal eez
Waizaa 'an'amnaa 'al aa aal insaani 'a'rada wanaa bijaanibihi waizaa massahu aush-sharru fazoo du'aa'in 'areed
Qul 'araytum 'in kaana min 'indi ail laahi thumma kafartum bihi man 'adal lu mimman hooa fi shiqaaqi ba'eed
Sanureehim 'ayaatinaa fi ail aafaaqi wafi 'anfusihim hattaa yatabayyana lahum 'annahu aul haqqu 'awal am yakfi birabbika 'annahu 'al aa kul li sha' shaheed
'al aa 'innahum fi miryat mmil lliqaa'i rabbihim 'al aa 'innahu bikul li sha' mmuheeh
Hamiaa 'aasiaaqaa kazaal ika yoohi 'il ayka wail aa aal zeena min qablika aal laahu aul'azeezu aul hakeem
Lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wahwa aal'al eeyu aul'azeem
Yakaadu aus-samaawaatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna waal mal aa'ikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fi ail ardi 'al aa 'inna aal laaha hooa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Waal zeena aattakhazu min doonihi 'awleeaa'a aal laahu hafeezun 'al ayhim wamaa 'anta 'al ayhim biwakeel
Wakazaal ika 'awhaynaa 'il ayka qur'aanaan 'arabiyya llitunzira 'umma aal quraa waman hawlahaa watunzira yawma aal jam'i laa rayba feehi fareeq fi ail jannati wafareeq fi ais-sa'eer
Wal aw shaa'a aal laahu laja'al ahum 'ummat waahidat wal aakiny yyudkhil u many yyashaa'u fi rahmatihi waaz-zaal imoona maa lahum mminw wwal eey wal aa naseer
'ami aittakhazu min doonihi 'awleeaa'a faal laahu hooa aal wal eeyu wahwa yuhyi ail mawtaa wahwa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wamaa aakhtal aftum feehi min sha' fahukmuhu 'il aa aal laahi zaal ikumu aul laahu rabbi 'al ayhi tawakkal tu wail ayhi 'uneeb
Faatiru aus-samaawaati waal ardi ja'al a lakum mmin 'anfusikum 'azwaaja wamina aal an'aami 'azwaaja yazra'ukum feehi laysa kamithlihi sha' wahwa aas-samee'u aul baseer
Lahu maqaal eedu aus-samaawaati waal ardi yabsutu aur-rizqa limany yyashaa'u wayaqdiru 'innahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem

Shara'a lakum mmina aad-deeni maa wassaa bihi nooha waal zi 'awhaynaa 'il ayka wamaa wassaynaa bihi 'ibraaheema wamoosaa wa'eesaa 'an 'aqeemu aud-deena wal aa tatafarraqu feehi kabura 'al aa aal mushrikeena maa tad'oohum 'il ayhi ail laahu yajtabi 'il ayhi many yyashaa'u wayahdi 'il ayhi many yyuneeb

Wamaa tafarraqu 'il laa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumu aul'il mu baghyaa baynahum wal awlaa kal imat sabaqat mir rrabbika 'il aa 'ajal mmusamma llaqudeea baynahum wainna aal zeena 'oorithu aul kitaaba mim ba'dihim lafi shakk mminhu mureeb

Fal izaal ika faad'u waastaqim kamaa 'umirta wal aa tattabi' 'ahwaa'ahum waqul 'aamantu bimaa 'anzal a aal laahu min kitaab waumirtu lia'dil a baynakumu aul laahu rabbunaa warabbukum lanaa 'a'maal unaa wal akum 'a'maal ukum laa hujjata baynanaa wabaynakumu aul laahu yajma'u baynanaa wail ayhi ail maseer
Waal zeena yuhaajjoona fi ail laahi mim ba'di maa aastujeeba lahu hujjatuhum daahidatun 'inda rabbihim wa'al ayhim ghadab wal ahum 'azaab shadeed
Ail laahu aul zi 'anzal a aal kitaaba bial haqqi waal meezaana wamaa yudreeka la'al la aas-saa'ata qareeb
Yasta'jil u bihaa aal zeena laa yu'minoona bihaa waal zeena 'aamanu mushfiqoona minhaa waya'lamoona 'annahaa aal haqqu 'al aa 'inna aal zeena yumaaroona fi ais-saa'ati lafi dal aal i ba'eed
Ail laahu lateefu bi'ibaadihi yarzuqu many yyashaa'u wahwa aal qaweeyu aul'azeez
Man kaana yureedu hartha aal aakhirati nazid lahu fi harthihi waman kaana yureedu hartha aad-dunyaa nu'tihi minhaa wamaa lahu fi ail aakhirati min nnaseeb
'am lahum shurakaa'ua shara'u lahum mmina aad-deeni maa lam yazam bihi ail laahu wal awlaa kal imatu aul fasli laqudeea baynahum wainna aaz-zaal imeena lahum 'azaabun 'al eem

Taraa aaz-zaal imeena mushfiqeena mimmaa kasabu wahwa waaqi'u bihim waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fi rawdaati ail jannaati lahum mmaa yashaa'oona 'inda rabbihim zaal ika hooa aal fadlu aul kabeer

Zaal ika aal zi yubashshiru aul laahu 'ibaadahu aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati qul-laa 'asal ukum 'al ayhi 'ajraan 'il laa aal mawaddata fi ail qurbaa wamany yyaqtarif hasanat nnazid lahu feehaa husnaan 'inna aal laaha ghafoor shakoor
'am yaqooloona aaftaraa 'al aa aal laahi kaziba fainy yyashai ail laahu yakhtim 'al aa qal bika wayamhu aul laahu aul baatil a wayuhiqqu aul haqqa bikal imaatihi 'innahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
Wahwa aal zi yaqbal u aut-tawbata 'an 'ibaadihi waya'fu 'ani ais-sayyiaati waya'lamu maa yaf'al oon
Wayastajeebu aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati wayazeeduhum mmin fadlihi waal kaafiroona lahum 'azaab shadeed
Wal aw basata aal laahu aur-rizqa li'ibaadihi labaghawa fi ail ardi wal aakiny yyunazzil u biqadar mmaa yashaa'u ainnahu bi'ibaadihi khabeeru baseer
Wahwa aal zi yunazzil u aul ghaytha mim ba'di maa qanatu wayanshuru rahmatahu wahwa aal wal eeyu aul hameed
Wamin 'ayaatihi khal qu aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa baththa feehimaa min daabbat wahwa 'al aa jam'ihim 'izaa yashaa'u qadeer
Wamaa 'asaabakum mmim mmuseebati bimaa kasabat 'aydeekum waya'fu 'an katheer
Wamaa 'antum bimu'jizeena fi ail ardi wamaa lakum mmin dooni ail laahi minw wwal eey wal aa naseer
Wamin 'ayaatihi ail jawaari fi ail bahri kaal a'laami 'iny yyasha yuskini air-reeaaha fayazlal na rawaakida 'al aa zahrihi 'inna fi zaal ika layaat llikul li sabbaar shakoor
'aw yoobiqhunna bimaa kasabu waya'fu 'an katheer
Waya'lamu aul zeena yujaadil oona fi 'ayaatinaa maa lahum mmim mmahees
Famaa 'ooteetum mmin sha' famataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunyaa wamaa 'inda aal laahi khayr waabqaa lil zeena 'aamanu wa'al aa rabbihim yatawakkal oon
Waal zeena yajtaniboona kabaa'ira aal ithmi waal fawaahisha waizaa maa ghadibu hum yaghfiroon
Waal zeena aastajaabu lirabbihim waaqaamu aus-sal awaata waamruhum shooraa baynahum wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Waal zeena 'izaa 'asaabahumu aul baghyu hum yantasiroon
Wajazaa'ua sayyeeat sayyeeat mmithluhaa faman 'afaa waaslaha faajruhu 'al aa aal laahi 'innahu laa yuhibbu auz-zaal imeen
Wal amani aintasara ba'da zul mihi faul aa'ika maa 'al ayhim mmin sabeel
'innamaa aas-sabeelu 'al aa aal zeena yazlimoona aan-naasa wayabghoona fi ail ardi bighayri ail haqqi 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Wal aman sabara waghafara 'inna zaal ika lamin 'azmi ail umoor
Wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu minw wwal eey mmim ba'dihi wataraa aaz-zaal imeena lammaa raawua aul'azaaba yaqooloona hal 'il aa maradd mmin sabeel

Watarayaahum yu'radoona 'al ayhaa khaashi'eena mina aaz-zul li yanzuroona min tarfin khafeey waqaal a aal zeena 'aamanu 'inna aal khaasireena aal zeena khasiru 'anfusahum waahleehim yawma aal qeeaamati 'al aa 'inna aaz-zaal imeena fi 'azaab mmuqeem
Wamaa kaana lahum mmin 'awleeaa'a yansuroonahum mmin dooni ail laahi wamany yyudlil i ail laahu famaa lahu min sabeel
Aistajeebu lirabbikum mmin qabli 'any yyateea yawm llaa maradda lahu mina aal laahi maa lakum mmim mmal ja yawma'iz wamaa lakum mmin nnakeer

Fain 'a'radu famaa 'arsal naaka 'al ayhim hafeezaan 'in 'al ayka 'il laa aal bal aaghu wainnaa 'izaa 'azaqnaa aal insaana minnaa rahmat fariha bihaa wain tusibhum sayyeeatu bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim fainna aal insaana kafoor
Llil hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi yakhluqu maa yashaa'u yahabu limany yyashaa'u ainaatha wayahabu limany yyashaa'u auz-zukoor
'aw yuzawwijuhum zukraana wainaatha wayaj'al u many yyashaa'u 'aqeemaan 'innahu 'al eem qadeer
Wamaa kaana libasharin 'any yyukal limahu aul laahu 'il laa wahyaan 'aw minw wwaraa'i hijaabin 'aw yursil u rasoola fayoohi biiznihi maa yashaa'u ainnahu 'al eeyun hakeem

Wakazaal ika 'awhaynaa 'il ayka rooha mmin 'amrinaa maa kunta tadri maa aal kitaabu wal aa aal eemaanu wal aakin ja'al naahu noora nnahdi bihi man nnashaa'u min 'ibaadinaa wainnaka latahdi 'il aa siraat mmustaqeem
Siraati ail laahi ail zi lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi 'al aa 'il aa aal laahi taseeru aul umoor
Hamiaa waal kitaabi ail mubeen
'innaa ja'al naahu qur'aanaan 'arabiyya lla'al lakum ta'qil oon
Wainnahu fi 'ummi ail kitaabi ladaynaa la'al eeyun hakeem
'afanadribu 'ankumu auz-zikra safhaan 'in kuntum qawma mmusrifeen
Wakam 'arsal naa min nnabiaa' fi ail awwal een
Wamaa yateehim mmin nnabiaa'in 'il laa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Faahlaknaa 'ashadda minhum batsha wamadaa mathal u aul awwal een
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda layaqoolunna khal aqahunna aal'azeezu aul'al eem
Aul zi ja'al a lakumu aul arda mihaada waja'al a lakum feehaa subul a lla'al lakum tahtadoon
Waal zi nazzal a mina aas-samaa'i maa'a biqadar faansharnaa bihi bal dat mmayta kazaal ika tukhrajoon
Waal zi khal aqa aal azwaaja kul laahaa waja'al a lakum mmina aal ful ki waal an'aami maa tarkaboon
Litastawua 'al aa zuhoorihi thumma tazkuru ni'mata rabbikum 'izaa aastawaytum 'al ayhi wataqoolu subhaana aal zi sakhkhara lanaa haazaa wamaa kunnaa lahu muqrineen
Wainnaa 'il aa rabbinaa lamunqal iboon
Waja'al u lahu min 'ibaadihi juz'aan 'inna aal insaana lakafoor mmubeen
'ami aittakhaza mimmaa yakhluqu banaat waasfayaakum bial baneen
Waizaa bushshira 'ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir-rahmaani mathal a zal la wajhuhu muswadda wahwa kazeem
'awamany yyansha'ua fi ail hil yati wahwa fi ail khisaami ghayru mubeen
Waja'al u aul mal aa'ikata aal zeena hum 'inda aar-rahmaani 'inaathaan 'aashhidu khal qahum satuktabu shahaadatuhum wayusal oon
Waqaal u law shaa'a aar-rahmaanu maa 'abadnaahum mmaa lahum bizaal ika min 'il min 'in hum 'il laa yakhrusoon
'am 'aataynaahum kitaaba mmin qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoon
Bal qaal u 'innaa wajadnaa 'aabaa'anaa 'al aa 'ummat wainnaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim mmuhtadoon
Wakazaal ika maa 'arsal naa min qablika fi qaryat mmin nnazeerin 'il laa qaal a mutrafoohaa 'innaa wajadnaa 'aabaa'anaa 'al aa 'ummat wainnaa 'al aa 'aathaarihim mmuqtadoon
Qul 'awal aw jeetukum biahdaa mimmaa wajadttum 'al ayhi 'aabaa'akum qaal u 'innaa bimaa 'ursil tum bihi kaafiroon
Faantaqamnaa minhum faanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul mukazzibeen
Waiz qaal a 'ibraaheemu liabeehi waqawmihi 'innani baraa' mmimmaa ta'budoon
'il laa aal zi fatarani fainnahu sayahdeen
Waja'al ahaa kal imata baaqeeat fi 'aqibihi la'al laahum yarji'oon
Bal matta'tu haa'ul aa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa jaa'ahumu aul haqqu warasool mmubeen
Wal ammaa jaa'ahumu aul haqqu qaal u haazaa sihr wainnaa bihi kaafiroon
Waqaal u lawlaa nuzzil a haazaa aal qur'aanu 'al aa rajul mmina aal qaryatayni 'azeem

'ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamnaa baynahum mma'eeshatahum fi ail hayawaati aid-dunyaa warafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'd darajaat lleeattakhiza ba'duhum ba'da sukhriyya warahmatu rabbika khayr mmimmaa yajma'oon
Wal awlaa 'any yyakoona aan-naasu 'ummat waahidat llaja'al naa limany yyakfuru biar-rahmaani libeeootihim suqufa mmin fiddat wama'aarija 'al ayhaa yazharoon
Wal ibeeootihim 'abwaaba wasururaan 'al ayhaa yattakioon
Wazukhrufa wain kul lu zaal ika lamaa mataa'u aul hayawaati aid-dunyaa waal aakhiratu 'inda rabbika lil muttaqeen
Wamany yya'shu 'an zikri air-rahmaani nuqayyid lahu shaytaana fahwa lahu qareen
Wainnahum layasuddoonahum 'ani ais-sabeeli wayahsiboona 'annahum mmuhtadoon
Hattaa 'izaa jaa'aanaa qaal a yaal ayta bayni wabaynaka bu'da aal mashriqayni fabeesa aal qareen
Wal any yyanfa'akumu aul yawma 'iz zzal amtum 'annakum fi ail'azaabi mushtarikoon
'afaanta tusmi'u aus-summa 'aw tahdi ail'umya waman kaana fi dal aal mmubeen
Faimmaa nazhabanna bika fainnaa minhum mmuntaqimoon
'aw nureeannaka aal zi wa'adnaahum fainnaa 'al ayhim mmuqtadiroon
Faastamsik bial zi 'ooheea 'il ayka 'innaka 'al aa siraat mmustaqeem
Wainnahu lazikr llaka wal iqawmika wasawfa tusal oon
Wasal man 'arsal naa min qablika mir rrusul inaa 'aja'al naa min dooni air-rahmaani 'aal ihat yu'badoon
Wal aqad 'arsal naa moosaa biayaatinaa 'il aa fir'awna wamal aeehi faqaal a 'inni rasoolu rabbi ail'aal ameen
Fal ammaa jaa'ahum biayaatinaa 'izaa hum mminhaa yadhakoon
Wamaa nureehim mmin 'ayatin 'il laa heea 'akbaru min 'ukhtihaa waakhaznaahum bial'azaabi la'al laahum yarji'oon
Waqaal u yayyuha aas-saahiru aud'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka 'innanaa lamuhtadoon
Fal ammaa kashafnaa 'anhumu aul'azaaba 'izaa hum yankuthoon
Wanaadaa fir'awnu fi qawmihi qaal a yaaqawmi 'al aysa li mul ku misra wahaazihi ail anhaaru tajri min tahteea 'afal aa tubsiroon
'am 'anaa khayr mmin haazaa aal zi hooa maheen
Wal aa yakaadu yubeen
Fal awlaa 'ul qeea 'al ayhi 'asaawirat mmin zahabin 'aw jaa'a ma'ahu aul mal aa'ikatu muqtarineen
Faastakhaffa qawmahu faataa'oohu 'innahum kaanu qawma faasiqeen
Fal ammaa 'aasafoonaa aantaqamnaa minhum faaghraqnaahum 'ajma'een
Faja'al naahum sal afa wamathal a llil aakhireen
Wal ammaa duriba aabnu maryama mathal aan 'izaa qawmuka minhu yasuddoon
Waqaal u 'aal ihatunaa khayrun 'am hooa maa daraboohu laka 'il laa jadal aa bal hum qawmun khasimoon
'in hooa 'il laa 'abdun 'an'amnaa 'al ayhi waja'al naahu mathal a llibani 'israa'eel
Wal aw nashaa'u laja'al naa minkum mmal aa'ikat fi ail ardi yakhlufoon
Wainnahu la'il m llis-saa'ati fal aa tamtarunna bihaa waattabi'ooni haazaa siraat mmustaqeem
Wal aa yasuddannakumu aush-shaytaanu 'innahu lakum 'adoow mmubeen
Wal ammaa jaa'a 'eesaa bial bayyinaati qaal a qad jeetukum bial hikmati wal iubayyina lakum ba'da aal zi takhtal ifoona feehi faattaqu aul laaha waatee'oon
'inna aal laaha hooa rabbi warabbukum faa'budoohu haazaa siraat mmustaqeem
Faakhtal afa aal ahzaabu mim baynihim fawayl llil zeena zal amu min 'azaabi yawmin 'al eem
Hal yanzuroona 'il laa aas-saa'ata 'an tateeahum baghtat wahum laa yash'uroon
Aal akhil laa'u yawma'izi ba'duhum liba'din 'adoowun 'il laa aal muttaqeen
Yaa'ibaadi laa khawfun 'al aykumu aul yawma wal aa 'antum tahzanoon
Aal zeena 'aamanu biayaatinaa wakaanu muslimeen
Aadkhul u aul jannata 'antum waazwaajukum tuhbaroon
Yutaafu 'al ayhim bisihaaf mmin zahab waakwaab wafeehaa maa tashtaheehi ail anfusu watal azzu aul a'yunu waantum feehaa khaal idoon
Watil ka aal jannatu aul ti 'oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Lakum feehaa faakihat katheerat mminhaa takul oon
'inna aal mujrimeena fi 'azaabi jahannama khaal idoon
Laa yufattaru 'anhum wahum feehi mublisoon
Wamaa zal amnaahum wal aakin kaanu humu auz-zaal imeen
Wanaadawa yaamaal iku leeaqdi 'al aynaa rabbuka qaal a 'innakum mmaakithoon
Laqad jeenaakum bial haqqi wal aakinna 'aktharakum lil haqqi kaarihoon
'am 'abramu 'amra fainnaa mubrimoon
'am yahsiboona 'annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum wanajwayaahum bal aa warusul unaa ladayhim yaktuboon
Qul 'in kaana lir-rahmaani wal ad faanaa 'awwal u aul'aabideen
Subhaana rabbi ais-samaawaati waal ardi rabbi ail'arshi 'ammaa yasifoon
Fazarhum yakhoodu wayal'abu hattaa yul aaqu yawmahumu aul zi yoo'adoon
Wahwa aal zi fi ais-samaa 'il aah wafi ail ardi 'il aah wahwa aal hakeemu aul'al eem
Watabaaraka aal zi lahu mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa baynahumaa wa'indahu 'il mu aus-saa'ati wail ayhi turja'oon
Wal aa yamliku aul zeena yad'oona min doonihi aish-shafaa'ata 'il laa man shahida bial haqqi wahum ya'lamoon
Wal a'in saal tahum mman khal aqahum layaqoolunna aal laahu faannaa yu'fakoon
Waqeelahu yaarabbi 'inna haa'ul aa'i qawm llaa yu'minoon
Faasfah 'anhum waqul sal aam fasawfa ta'lamoon
Hamiaa waal kitaabi ail mubeen
'innaa 'anzal naahu fi laylat mmubaarakatin 'innaa kunnaa munzireen
Feehaa yufraqu kul lu 'amrin hakeem
'amra mmin 'indinaa 'innaa kunnaa mursil een
Rahmat mmir rrabbika 'innahu hooa aas-samee'u aul'al eem
Rabbu aus-samaawaati waal ardi wamaa baynahumaa 'in kuntum mmooqineen
Laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa yuhyi wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu 'aabaa'ikumu aul awwal een
Bal hum fi shakk yal'aboon
Faartaqib yawma tati ais-samaa'u bidukhaam mmubeen
Yaghshaa aan-naasa haazaa 'azaabun 'al eem
Rrabbanaa aakshif 'annaa aal'azaaba 'innaa mu'minoon
'annaa lahumu auz-zikraa waqad jaa'ahum rasool mmubeen
Thumma tawal lawa 'anhu waqaal u mu'al lam mmajnoon
'innaa kaashifu aul'azaabi qal eelaan 'innakum 'aa'idoon
Yawma nabtishu aul batshata aal kubraa 'innaa muntaqimoon
Wal aqad fatannaa qablahum qawma fir'awna wajaa'ahum rasool kareem
'an 'addu 'il ayya 'ibaada aal laahi 'inni lakum rasoolun 'ameen
Waal llaa ta'lu 'al aa aal laahi 'inneea 'aateekum bisul taam mmubeen
Wainni 'uztu birabbi warabbikum 'an tarjumoon
Wail llam tu'minu lee faa'tazil oon
Fada'aa rabbahu 'anna haa'ul aa'i qawm mmujrimoon
Faasri bi'ibaadi laylaan 'innakum mmuttaba'oon
Waatruki ail bahra rahwaan 'innahum jund mmughraqoon
Kam taraku min jannaat wa'uyoon
Wazuroo' wamaqaam kareem
Wana'mat kaanu feehaa faakiheen
Kazaal ika waawrathnaahaa qawmaan 'aakhareen
Famaa bakat 'al ayhimu aus-samaa'u waal ardu wamaa kaanu munzareen
Wal aqad najjaynaa bani 'israa'eela mina aal'azaabi ail muheen
Min fir'awna 'innahu kaana 'aal eea mmina aal musrifeen
Wal aqadi aikhtarnaahum 'al aa 'il min 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Wa'aataynaahum mmina aal ayaati maa feehi bal aa'a mmubeen
'inna haa'ul aa'i layaqooloona 'in heea 'il laa mawtatunaa aal oolaa wamaa nahnu bimunshareen
Fatu biaabaa'inaa 'in kuntum saadiqeen
'ahum khayrun 'am qawmu tubba' waal zeena min qablihim 'ahlaknaahum 'innahum kaanu mujrimeen
Wamaa khal aqnaa aas-samaawaati waal arda wamaa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
Maa khal aqnaahumaa 'il laa bial haqqi wal aakinna 'aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
'inna yawma aal fasli meeqaatuhum 'ajma'een
Yawma laa yughni mawlaan 'am mmawla shaya wal aa hum yunsaroon
'il laa mar rrahima aal laahu 'innahu hooa aal'azeezu aur-raheem
'inna shajarata aaz-zaqqoomi ta'aamu aul atheem
Kaal muhli taghli fi ail butoon
Kaghal yi ail hameem
Khuzoohu faa'tul oohu 'il aa sawaa'i ail jaheem
Thumma subbu fawqa rasihi min 'azaabi ail hameem
Zuq 'innaka 'anta aal'azeezu aul kareem
'inna haazaa maa kuntum bihi tamtaroon
'inna aal muttaqeena fi muqaamin 'ameen
Fi jannaat wa'uyoon
Yal basoona min sundus waistabraq mmutaqaabil een
Kazaal ika wazawwajnaahum bihoorin 'een
Yad'oona feehaa bikul li faakihatin 'aamineen
Laa yazooqoona feehaa aal mawta 'il laa aal mawtata aal oolaa wawaqayaahum 'azaaba aal jaheem
Fadla mmir rrabbika zaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul'azeem
Fainnamaa yassarnaahu bil isaanika la'al laahum yatazakkaroon
Faartaqib 'innahum mmurtaqiboon
Hamiaa tanzeelu aul kitaabi mina aal laahi ail'azeezi ail hakeem
'inna fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi layaat llil mu'mineen
Wafi khal qikum wamaa yabuththu min daabbatin 'ayaat lliqawm yooqinoon
Waakhtil aafi ail yli waan-nahaari wamaa 'anzal a aal laahu mina aas-samaa'i mir rrizq faahyaa bihi ail arda ba'da mawtihaa watasreefi air-reeaahi 'ayaat lliqawm ya'qil oon
Til ka 'ayaatu aul laahi natloohaa 'al ayka bial haqqi fabiayyi hadeethi ba'da aal laahi wa'ayaatihi yu'minoon
Wayl llikul li 'affaakin 'atheem
Yasma'u 'ayaati ail laahi tutlaa 'al ayhi thumma yusirru mustakbira kaal llam yasma'haa fabashshirhu bi'azaabin 'al eem
Waizaa 'al ima min 'ayaatinaa shayaan aittakhazahaa huzu'aan 'ul aa'ika lahum 'azaab mmuheen
Mminw wwaraa'ihim jahannamu wal aa yughni 'anhum mmaa kasabu shaya wal aa maa aattakhazu min dooni ail laahi 'awleeaa'a wal ahum 'azaabun 'azeem
Haazaa huda waal zeena kafaru biayaati rabbihim lahum 'azaab mmir rrijzin 'al eem
Ail laahu aul zi sakhkhara lakumu aul bahra litajreea aal ful ku feehi biamrihi wal itabtaghu min fadlihi wal a'al lakum tashkuroon
Wasakhkhara lakum mmaa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi jamee'a mminhu 'inna fi zaal ika layaat lliqawm yatafakkaroon
Qul-lil zeena 'aamanu yaghfiru lil zeena laa yarjoona 'ayyaama aal laahi leeajzeea qawmaa bimaa kaanu yaksiboon
Man 'amil a saal iha fal inafsihi waman 'asaa'a fa'al ayhaa thumma 'il aa rabbikum turja'oon
Wal aqad 'aataynaa bani 'israa'eela aal kitaaba waal hukma waan-nubooaa'ata warazaqnaahum mmina aat-tayyibaati wafaddal naahum 'al aa aal'aal ameen
Wa'aataynaahum bayyinaat mmina aal amri famaa aakhtal afu 'il laa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumu aul'il mu baghyaa baynahum 'inna rabbaka yaqdi baynahum yawma aal qeeaamati feemaa kaanu feehi yakhtal ifoon
Thumma ja'al naaka 'al aa sharee'at mmina aal amri faattabi'haa wal aa tattabi' 'ahwaa'a aal zeena laa ya'lamoon
'innahum lany yyughnu 'anka mina aal laahi shaya wainna aaz-zaal imeena ba'duhum 'awleeaa'u ba'd waal laahu wal eeyu aul muttaqeen
Haazaa basaa'iru lin-naasi wahuda warahmat lliqawm yooqinoon
'am hasiba aal zeena aajtarahu aus-sayyiaati 'an nnaj'al ahum kaal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati sawaa' mmahyaahum wamamaatuhum saa'a maa yahkumoon
Wakhal aqa aal laahu aus-samaawaati waal arda bial haqqi wal itujzaa kul lu nafsi bimaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon

'afarayta mani aittakhaza 'il aahahu hawayaahu waadal laahu aul laahu 'al aa 'il m wakhatama 'al aa sam'ihi waqal bihi waja'al a 'al aa basarihi ghishaawat famany yyahdeehi mim ba'di ail laahi 'afal aa tazzakkaroon
Waqaal u maa heea 'il laa hayaatunaa aad-dunyaa namootu wanahyaa wamaa yuhlikunaa 'il laa aad-dahru wamaa lahum bizaal ika min 'il min 'in hum 'il laa yazunnoon
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat mmaa kaana hujjatahum 'il laa 'an qaal u auytu biaabaa'inaa 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Qul i ail laahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajma'ukum 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati laa rayba feehi wal aakinna 'akthara aan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wal il hi mul ku aus-samaawaati waal ardi wayawma taqoomu aus-saa'atu yawma'iz yakhsaru aul mubtil oon
Wataraa kul la 'ummat jaatheeat kul lu 'ummat tud'aa 'il aa kitaabihaa aal yawma tujzawna maa kuntum ta'mal oon
Haazaa kitaabunaa yantiqu 'al aykum bial haqqi 'innaa kunnaa nastansikhu maa kuntum ta'mal oon
Faammaa aal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati fayudkhil uhum rabbuhum fi rahmatihi zaal ika hooa aal fawzu aul mubeen
Waammaa aal zeena kafaru 'afal am takun 'ayaati tutlaa 'al aykum faastakbartum wakuntum qawma mmujrimeen
Waizaa qeela 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq waas-saa'atu laa rayba feehaa qul tum mmaa nadri maa aas-saa'atu 'in nnazunnu 'il laa zanna wamaa nahnu bimustayqineen
Wabadaa lahum sayyiaatu maa 'amil u wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Waqeela aal yawma nansayaakum kamaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haazaa wamawayaakumu aun-naaru wamaa lakum mmin nnaasireen
Zaal ikum biannakumu auttakhazttum 'ayaati ail laahi huzu'a wagharratkumu aul hayawaatu aud-dunyaa faal yawma laa yukhrajoona minhaa wal aa hum yusta'taboon
Fal il hi ail hamdu rabbi ais-samaawaati warabbi ail ardi rabbi ail'aal ameen
Wal ahu aul kibreeaa'u fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Hamiaa tanzeelu aul kitaabi mina aal laahi ail'azeezi ail hakeem
Maa khal aqnaa aas-samaawaati waal arda wamaa baynahumaa 'il laa bial haqqi waajal mmusamma waal zeena kafaru 'ammaa 'unziru mu'ridoon

Qul 'araytum mmaa tad'oona min dooni ail laahi 'arooni maazaa khal aqu mina aal ardi 'am lahum shirk fi ais-samaawaati aeetooni bikitaab mmin qabli haazaa 'aw 'athaarat mmin 'il min 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Waman 'adal lu mimmany yyad'u min dooni ail laahi mal llaa yastajeebu lahu 'il aa yawmi ail qeeaamati wahum 'an du'aa'ihim ghaafil oon
Waizaa hushira aan-naasu kaanu lahum 'a'daa' wakaanu bi'ibaadatihim kaafireen
Waizaa tutlaa 'al ayhim 'ayaatunaa bayyinaat qaal a aal zeena kafaru lil haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum haazaa sihr mmubeen
'am yaqooloona aaftarayaahu qul 'ini aiftaraytuhu fal aa tamlikoona li mina aal laahi shayaan hooa 'a'lamu bimaa tufeedoona feehi kafaa bihi shaheedaa bayni wabaynakum wahwa aal ghafooru aur-raheem
Qul maa kuntu bid'a mmina aar-rusul i wamaa 'adri maa yuf'al u bi wal aa bikum 'in 'attabi'u 'il laa maa yoohaa 'il ayya wamaa 'anaa 'il laa nazeer mmubeen
Qul 'araytum 'in kaana min 'indi ail laahi wakafartum bihi washahida shaahid mmim bani 'israa'eela 'al aa mithlihi faamana waastakbartum 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Waqaal a aal zeena kafaru lil zeena 'aamanu law kaana khayra mmaa sabaqoonaa 'il ayhi waiz lam yahtadu bihi fasayaqooloona haazaa 'ifk qadeem
Wamin qablihi kitaabu moosaa 'imaama warahmat wahaazaa kitaab mmusaddiq llisaanaan 'arabiyya llitunzira aal zeena zal amu wabushraa lil muhsineen
'inna aal zeena qaal u rabbunaa aal laahu thumma aastaqaamu fal aa khawfun 'al ayhim wal aa hum yahzanoon
'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aul jannati khaal ideena feehaa jazaa'a bimaa kaanu ya'mal oon

Wawassaynaa aal insaana biwaal idayhi husnaan hamal athu 'ummuhu karha wawada'athu karha wahamluhu wafisaal uhu thal aathoona shahraan hattaa 'izaa bal agha 'ashuddahu wabal agha 'arba'eena sanat qaal a rabbi 'awzi'ni 'an 'ashkura ni'mataka aal ti 'an'amta 'al ayya wa'al aa waal idayya waan 'a'mal a saal iha tardayaahu waaslih li fi zurriyyati 'inni tubtu 'il ayka wainni mina aal muslimeen
'ul aa'ika aal zeena yutaqabbal u 'anhum 'ahsanu maa 'amil u wayutajaawazu 'an sayyiaatihim fi 'ashaabi ail jannati wa'da aas-sidqi ail zi kaanu yoo'adoon

Waal zi qaal a liwaal idayhi 'uff llakumaa 'ata'idaanineea 'an 'ukhraja waqad khal ati ail quroonu min qabli wahumaa yastagheethaani ail laaha waylaka 'aamin 'inna wa'da aal laahi haqq fayaqoolu maa haazaa 'il laa 'asaateeru aul awwal een
'ul aa'ika aal zeena haqqa 'al ayhimu aul qawlu fi 'umam qad khal at min qablihim mmina aal jinni waal insi 'innahum kaanu khaasireen
Wal ikul l darajaat mmimmaa 'amil u wal inooaffeeahum 'a'maal ahum wahum laa yuzlamoon

Wayawma yu'radu aul zeena kafaru 'al aa aan-naari 'azhabtum tayyibaatikum fi hayaatikumu aud-dunyaa waastamta'tum bihaa faal yawma tujzawna 'azaaba aal hooni bimaa kuntum tastakbiroona fi ail ardi bighayri ail haqqi wabimaa kuntum tafsuqoon
Waazkur 'akhaa 'aadin 'iz 'anzara qawmahu bial ahqaafi waqad khal ati ain-nuzuru mim bayni yadayhi wamin khal fihi 'al laa ta'budu 'il laa aal laaha 'inneea 'akhaafu 'al aykum 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem
Qaal u 'ajeetanaa litafikanaa 'an 'aal ihatinaa fatinaa bimaa ta'idunaa 'in kunta mina aas-saadiqeen
Qaal a 'innamaa aal'il mu 'inda aal laahi waubal lighukum mmaa 'ursil tu bihi wal aakinneea 'arayaakum qawma tajhal oon
Fal ammaa raawhu 'aarida mmustaqbil a 'awdeeatihim qaal u haazaa 'aarid mmumtirunaa bal hooa maa aasta'jal tum bihi reeh feehaa 'azaabun 'al eem
Tudammiru kul la sha'i biamri rabbihaa faasbahu laa taraa 'il laa masaakinahum kazaal ika najzi ail qawma aal mujrimeen

Wal aqad makkannaahum feemaa 'im mmakkannaakum feehi waja'al naa lahum sam'a waabsaara waafidat famaa 'aghnaa 'anhum sam'uhum wal aa 'absaaruhum wal aa 'afidatuhum mmin sha'in 'iz kaanu yajhadoona biayaati ail laahi wahaaqa bihim mmaa kaanu bihi yastahzi'oon
Wal aqad 'ahlaknaa maa hawlakum mmina aal quraa wasarrafnaa aal ayaati la'al laahum yarji'oon
Fal awlaa nasarahumu aul zeena aattakhazu min dooni ail laahi qurbaanaan 'aal ihata bal dal lu 'anhum wazaal ika 'ifkuhum wamaa kaanu yaftaroon
Waiz sarafnaa 'il ayka nafara mmina aal jinni yastami'oona aal qur'aana fal ammaa hadaroohu qaal u 'ansitu fal ammaa qudeea wal lawa 'il aa qawmihim mmunzireen
Qaal u yaaqawmanaa 'innaa sami'naa kitaabaan 'unzil a mim ba'di moosaa musaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayhi yahdi 'il aa aal haqqi wail aa tareeq mmustaqeem
Yaaqawmanaa 'ajeebu daa'eea aal laahi wa'aaminu bihi yaghfir lakum mmin zunoobikum wayujirkum mmin 'azaabin 'al eem
Wamal llaa yujib daa'eea aal laahi fal aysa bimu'jiz fi ail ardi wal aysa lahu min doonihi 'awleeaa 'ul aa'ika fi dal aal mmubeen
'awal am yarawa 'anna aal laaha aal zi khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda wal am ya'ya bikhal qihinna biqaadirin 'al aa 'any yyuheea aal mawtaa bal aa 'innahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Wayawma yu'radu aul zeena kafaru 'al aa aan-naari 'al aysa haazaa bial haqqi qaal u bal aa warabbinaa qaal a fazooqu aul'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon

Faasbir kamaa sabara 'oolu aul'azmi mina aar-rusul i wal aa tasta'jil-laahum kaannahum yawma yarawna maa yoo'adoona lam yal bathu 'il laa saa'at mmin nnahaari bal aagh fahal yuhlaku 'il laa aal qawmu aul faasiqoon
Ail zeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi 'adal la 'a'maal ahum
Waal zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati wa'aamanu bimaa nuzzil a 'al aa muhammad wahwa aal haqqu mir rrabbihim kaffara 'anhum sayyiaatihim waaslaha baal ahum
Zaal ika bianna aal zeena kafaru auttaba'u aul baatil a waanna aal zeena 'aamanu auttaba'u aul haqqa mir rrabbihim kazaal ika yadribu aul laahu lin-naasi 'amthaal ahum
Faizaa laqeetumu aul zeena kafaru fadarba aar-riqaabi hattaa 'izaa 'athkhantumoohum fashuddu aul wathaaqa faimmaa mannaa ba'du waimmaa fidaa'an hattaa tada'a aal harbu 'awzaaraha
Zaal ika wal aw yashaa'u aul laahu laantasara minhum wal aakil lleeablooaa ba'dakum biba'd waal zeena qaatal u fi sabeeli ail laahi fal any yyudil la 'a'maal ahum
Sayahdeehim wayuslihu baal ahum
Wayudkhil uhumu aul jannata 'arrafahaa lahum
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'in tansuru aul laaha yansurkum wayuthabbit 'aqdaamakum
Waal zeena kafaru fata'sa llaahum waadal la 'a'maal ahum
Zaal ika biannahum karihu maa 'anzal a aal laahu faahbata 'a'maal ahum
'afal am yaseeru fi ail ardi fayanzuru kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu aul zeena min qablihim dammara aal laahu 'al ayhim wal il kaafireena 'amthaal uha
Zaal ika bianna aal laaha mawlaa aal zeena 'aamanu waanna aal kaafireena laa mawlaa lahum

'inna aal laaha yudkhil u aul zeena 'aamanu wa'amil u aus-saal ihaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru waal zeena kafaru yatamatta'oona wayakul oona kamaa takul u aul an'aamu waan-naaru mathwa llaahum
Wakayyim mmin qaryatin heea 'ashaddu qoowat mmin qaryatika aal ti 'akhrajatka 'ahlaknaahum fal aa naasira lahum
'afaman kaana 'al aa bayyinat mmir rrabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sooaa'u 'amal ihi waattaba'u 'ahwaa'ahum

Mmathal u aul jannati ail ti wu'ida aal muttaqoona feehaa 'anhaar mmim mmaa'in ghayri 'aasinw waanhaar mmil llabal llam yataghayyar ta'muhu waanhaar mmin khamr llazzat llish-shaaribeena waanhaar mmin 'asal mmusaffa wal ahum feehaa min kul li aith-thamaraati wamaghfirat mmir rrabbihim kaman hooa khaal id fi ain-naari wasuqu maa'an hameema faqatta'a 'am'aa'ahum

Waminhum mmany yyastami'u 'il ayka hattaa 'izaa kharaju min 'indika qaal u lil zeena 'ootu aul'il ma maazaa qaal a 'aanifaan 'ul aa'ika aal zeena taba'a aal laahu 'al aa qul oobihim waattaba'u 'ahwaa'ahum
Waal zeena aahtadawa zaadahum huda wa'aatayaahum taqwayaahum
Fahal yanzuroona 'il laa aas-saa'ata 'an tateeahum baghtat faqad jaa 'ashraatuhaa faannaa lahum 'izaa jaa'athum zikrayaahum
Faa'lam 'annahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa aal laahu waastaghfir lizanbika wal il mu'mineena waal mu'minaati waal laahu ya'lamu mutaqal labakum wamathwayaakum

Wayaqoolu aul zeena 'aamanu lawlaa nuzzil at soorat faizaa 'unzil at soorat mmuhkamat wazukira feehaa aal qitaal u rayta aal zeena fi qul oobihim mmarad yanzuroona 'il ayka nazara aal maghsheeyi 'al ayhi mina aal mawti faawlaa lahum
Taa'at waqawl mma'roof faizaa 'azama aal amru fal aw sadaqu aul laaha lakaana khayra llaahum
Fahal 'aseetum 'in tawal laytum 'an tufsidu fi ail ardi watuqatti'u 'arhaamakum
'ul aa'ika aal zeena la'anahumu aul laahu faasammahum waa'maa 'absaarahum
'afal aa yatadabbaroona aal qur'aana 'am 'al aa qul oobin 'aqfaal uha
'inna aal zeena aartaddu 'al aa 'adbaarihim mmim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumu aul hudaa aash-shaytaanu sawwal a lahum waamlaa lahum
Zaal ika biannahum qaal u lil zeena karihu maa nazzal a aal laahu sanutee'ukum fi ba'di ail amri waal laahu ya'lamu 'asraarahum
Fakayfa 'izaa tawaffathumu aul mal aa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbaarahum
Zaal ika biannahumu auttaba'u maa 'askhata aal laaha wakarihu ridwaanahu faahbata 'a'maal ahum
'am hasiba aal zeena fi qul oobihim mmaradun 'al llany yyukhrija aal laahu 'adghaanahum
Wal aw nashaa'u laaraynaakahum fal a'araftahum biseemaahum wal ata'rifannahum fi lahni ail qawli waal laahu ya'lamu 'a'maal akum
Wal anablooannakum hattaa na'lama aal mujaahideena minkum waas-saabireena wanablooaa 'akhbaarakum
'inna aal zeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi washaaqqu aur-rasoola mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumu aul hudaa lany yyadurru aul laaha shaya wasayuhbitu 'a'maal ahum
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'atee'u aul laaha waatee'u aur-rasoola wal aa tubtil u 'a'maal akum
'inna aal zeena kafaru wasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi thumma maatu wahum kuffaar fal any yyaghfira aal laahu lahum
Fal aa tahinu watad'u 'il aa aas-sal mi waantumu aul a'lawna waal laahu ma'akum wal any yyatirakum 'a'maal akum
'innamaa aal hayawaatu aud-dunyaa la'ib wal ahw wain tu'minu watattaqu yu'tikum 'ujoorakum wal aa yasal kum 'amwaal akum
'iny yyasal kumoohaa fayuhfikum tabkhal u wayukhrij 'adghaanakum

Haantum haa'ul aa'i tud'awna litunfiqu fi sabeeli ail laahi faminkum mmany yyabkhal u wamany yyabkhal fainnamaa yabkhal u 'an nnafsihi waal laahu aul ghaneeyu waantumu aul fuqaraa'u wain tatawal lawa yastabdil qawmaan ghayrakum thumma laa yakoonu 'amthaal akum
'innaa fatahnaa laka fatha mmubeen
Lleeaghfira laka aal laahu maa taqaddama min zanbika wamaa taakhkhara wayutimma ni'matahu 'al ayka wayahdeeaka siraata mmustaqeem
Wayansuraka aal laahu nasraan 'azeeza
Hooa aal zi 'anzal a aas-sakeenata fi qul oobi ail mu'mineena leeazdaadu 'eemaana mma'a 'eemaanihim wal il hi junoodu aus-samaawaati waal ardi wakaana aal laahu 'al eemaan hakeem
Lleeudkhil a aal mu'mineena waal mu'minaati jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa wayukaffira 'anhum sayyiaatihim wakaana zaal ika 'inda aal laahi fawzaan 'azeem

Wayu'azziba aal munaafiqeena waal munaafiqaati waal mushrikeena waal mushrikaati aiz-zaanneena bial laahi zanna aas-saw'i 'al ayhim daa'iratu aus-saw'i waghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhim wal a'anahum waa'adda lahum jahannama wasaa'at maseer
Wal il hi junoodu aus-samaawaati waal ardi wakaana aal laahu 'azeezaan hakeema
'innaa 'arsal naaka shaahida wamubashshira wanazeer
Llitu'minu bial laahi warasoolihi watu'azziroohu watooaqqiroohu watusabbihoohu bukrat waaseela

'inna aal zeena yubayi'oonaka 'innamaa yubayi'oona aal laaha yadu aul laahi fawqa 'aydeehim faman nnakatha fainnamaa yankuthu 'al aa nafsihi waman 'awfaa bimaa 'aahada 'al ayhi ail laaha fasanu'teehi 'ajraan 'azeem

Sayaqoolu laka aal mukhal lafoona mina aal a'raabi shaghal atnaa 'amwaal unaa waahloonaa faastaghfir lanaa yaqooloona bial sinatihim mmaa laysa fi qul oobihim qul famany yyamliku lakum mmina aal laahi shayaan 'in 'araada bikum darraan 'aw 'araada bikum naf'aa bal kaana aal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeera
Bal zanantum 'al llany yyanqal iba aar-rasoolu waal mu'minoona 'il aa 'ahleehim 'abada wazuyyina zaal ika fi qul oobikum wazanantum zanna aas-saw'i wakuntum qawmaa boor

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tuqaddimu bayna yadayi ail laahi warasoolihi waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha samee'un 'al eem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tarfa'u 'aswaatakum fawqa sawti ain-nabiaa'i wal aa tajharu lahu bial qawli kajahri ba'dikum liba'din 'an tahbata 'a'maal ukum waantum laa tash'uroon
'inna aal zeena yaghuddoona 'aswaatahum 'inda rasooli ail laahi 'ul aa'ika aal zeena aamtahana aal laahu qul oobahum lit-taqwaa lahum mmaghfirat waajrun 'azeem

Wal aw 'annahum sabaru hattaa takhruja 'il ayhim lakaana khayra llaahum waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'in jaa'akum faasiqu binaba fatabayyanu 'an tuseebu qawmaa bijahaal at fatusbihu 'al aa maa fa'al tum naadimeen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa yaskhar qawm mmin qawmin 'asaa 'any yyakoonu khayra mminhum wal aa nisaa' mmin nnisaa'in 'asaa 'any yyakunna khayra mminhunna wal aa tal mizu 'anfusakum wal aa tanaabazu bial al qaabi beesa aal iasmu aul fusooqu ba'da aal eemaani wamal llam yatub faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa tanaajaytum fal aa tatanaajawa bial ithmi waal'udwaani wama'seeati air-rasooli watanaajawa bial birri waat-taqwaa waattaqu aul laaha aal zi 'il ayhi tuhsharoon
'innamaa aan-najwaa mina aash-shaytaani leeuhzina aal zeena 'aamanu wal aysa bidaarrihim shayaan 'il laa biizni ail laahi wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail mu'minoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa qeela lakum tafassahu fi ail majlisi faafsahu yafsahi ail laahu lakum waizaa qeela aanshuzu faanshuzu yarfa'i ail laahu aul zeena 'aamanu minkum waal zeena 'ootu aul'il ma darajaat waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa naajaytumu aur-rasoola faqaddimu bayna yada najwayaakum sadaqat zaal ika khayr llakum waatharu fail llam tajidu fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem

'aashfaqtum 'an tuqaddimu bayna yada najwayaakum sadaqaat faiz lam taf'al u wataaba aal laahu 'al aykum faaqeemu aus-sal awaata wa'aatu auz-zakawaata waatee'u aul laaha warasoolahu waal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena tawal lawa qawmaan ghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhim mmaa hum mminkum wal aa minhum wayahlifoona 'al aa aal kazibi wahum ya'lamoon
'a'adda aal laahu lahum 'azaaba shadeedaan 'innahum saa'a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Aattakhazu 'aymaanahum junnat fasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi fal ahum 'azaab mmuheen
Llan tughneea 'anhum 'amwaal uhum wal aa 'awlaaduhum mmina aal laahi shayaan 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari hum feehaa khaal idoon
Yawma yab'athuhumu aul laahu jamee'a fayahlifoona lahu kamaa yahlifoona lakum wayahsiboona 'annahum 'al aa sha'in 'al aa 'innahum humu aul kaaziboon
Aastahwaza 'al ayhimu aush-shaytaanu faansayaahum zikra aal laahi 'ul aa'ika hizbu aush-shaytaani 'al aa 'inna hizba aash-shaytaani humu aul khaasiroon
'inna aal zeena yuhaaddoona aal laaha warasoolahu 'ul aa'ika fi ail azal leena kataba aal laahu laaghlibanna 'anaa warusul eea 'inna aal laaha qaweeyun 'azeez

Llaa tajidu qawma yu'minoona bial laahi waal yawmi ail aakhiri yooaaddoona man haadda aal laaha warasoolahu wal aw kaanu 'aabaa'ahum 'aw 'abnaa'ahum 'aw 'ikhwaanahum 'aw 'asheeratahum 'ul aa'ika kataba fi qul oobihimu aul eemaana wayyadahum birooh mminhu wayudkhil uhum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa radeea aal laahu 'anhum waradu 'anhu 'ul aa'ika hizbu aul laahi 'al aa 'inna hizba aal laahi humu aul muflihoon
Sabbaha lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Hooa aal zi 'akhraja aal zeena kafaru min 'ahli ail kitaabi min deeaarihim liawwal i ail hashri maa zanantum 'any yyakhruju wazannu 'annahum mmaani'atuhum husoonuhum mmina aal laahi faatayaahumu aul laahu min haythu lam yahtasibu waqazafa fi qul oobihimu aur-ru'ba yukhriboona beeootahum biaydeehim waydi ail mu'mineena faa'tabiru yaaooli ail absaar
Wal awlaa 'an kataba aal laahu 'al ayhimu aul jal aa'a la'azzabahum fi aid-dunyaa wal ahum fi ail aakhirati 'azaabu aun-naar
Zaal ika biannahum shaaqqu aul laaha warasoolahu wamany yyushaaqqi ail laaha fainna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab
Maa qata'tum mmil lleenatin 'aw taraktumoohaa qaa'imatan 'al aa 'usoolihaa fabiizni ail laahi wal eeukhzeea aal faasiqeen
Wamaa 'afaa'a aal laahu 'al aa rasoolihi minhum famaa 'awjaftum 'al ayhi min khayl wal aa rikaab wal aakinna aal laaha yusal litu rusul ahu 'al aa many yyashaa'u waal laahu 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer

Mmaa 'afaa'a aal laahu 'al aa rasoolihi min 'ahli ail quraa fal il hi wal ir-rasooli wal izi ail qurbaa waal yataamaa waal masaakeeni waabni ais-sabeeli ka laa yakoona doolata bayna aal aghneeaa'i minkum wamaa 'aatayaakumu aur-rasoolu fakhuzoohu wamaa nahayaakum 'anhu faantahu waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha shadeedu aul'iqaab
Lil fuqaraa'i ail muhaajireena aal zeena 'ukhriju min deeaarihim waamwaal ihim yabtaghoona fadla mmina aal laahi waridwaana wayansuroona aal laaha warasoolahu 'ul aa'ika humu aus-saadiqoon

Waal zeena tabawwa'oo aud-daara waal eemaana min qablihim yuhibboona man haajara 'il ayhim wal aa yajidoona fi sudoorihim haajat mmimmaa 'ootu wayu'thiroona 'al aa 'anfusihim wal aw kaana bihim khasaasat wamany yyooqa shuhha nafsihi faul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon

Waal zeena jaa'oo mim ba'dihim yaqooloona rabbanaa aaghfir lanaa wal iikhwaaninaa aal zeena sabaqoonaa bial eemaani wal aa taj'al fi qul oobinaa ghil la llil zeena 'aamanu rabbanaa 'innaka ra'oof rraheem

'al am tara 'il aa aal zeena naafaqu yaqooloona liikhwaanihimu aul zeena kafaru min 'ahli ail kitaabi la'in 'ukhrijtum lanakhrujanna ma'akum wal aa nutee'u feekum 'ahadaan 'abada wain qootil tum lanansurannakum waal laahu yashhadu 'innahum lakaaziboon
La'in 'ukhriju laa yakhrujoona ma'ahum wal a'in qootil u laa yansuroonahum wal a'in nnasaroohum layooal lunna aal adbaara thumma laa yunsaroon
Laantum 'ashaddu rahbat fi sudoorihim mmina aal laahi zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa yafqahoon
Laa yuqaatil oonakum jamee'aan 'il laa fi qura mmuhassanatin 'aw minw wwaraa'i juduri basuhum baynahum shadeed tahsibuhum jamee'a waqul oobuhum shattaa zaal ika biannahum qawm llaa ya'qil oon
Kamathal i ail zeena min qablihim qareeba zaaqu wabaal a 'amrihim wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Kamathal i aish-shaytaani 'iz qaal a lil insaani aikfur fal ammaa kafara qaal a 'inni bariaa' mminka 'inneea 'akhaafu aul laaha rabba aal'aal ameen
Fakaana 'aaqibatahumaa 'annahumaa fi ain-naari khaal idayni feehaa wazaal ika jazaa'ua auz-zaal imeen
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu auttaqu aul laaha wal tanzur nafs mmaa qaddamat lighad waattaqu aul laaha 'inna aal laaha khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Wal aa takoonu kaal zeena nasu aul laaha faansayaahum 'anfusahum 'ul aa'ika humu aul faasiqoon
Laa yastawi 'ashaabu aun-naari waashaabu aul jannati 'ashaabu aul jannati humu aul faa'izoon
Law 'anzal naa haazaa aal qur'aana 'al aa jabal-laraytahu khaashi'a mmutasaddi'a mmin khashyati ail laahi watil ka aal amthaal u nadribuhaa lin-naasi la'al laahum yatafakkaroon
Hooa aal laahu aul zi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa 'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati hooa aar-rahmaanu aur-raheem
Hooa aal laahu aul zi laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa aal mal iku aul quddoosu aus-sal aamu aul mu'minu aul muhayminu aul'azeezu aul jabbaaru aul mutakabbiru subhaana aal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon
Hooa aal laahu aul khaal iqu aul baariu aul musawwiru lahu aul asmaa'u aul husnaa yusabbihu lahu maa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tattakhizu 'adoowi wa'adoowakum 'awleeaa'a tul qoona 'il ayhim bial mawaddati waqad kafaru bimaa jaa'akum mmina aal haqqi yukhrijoona aar-rasoola waiyyaakum 'an tu'minu bial laahi rabbikum 'in kuntum kharajtum jihaada fi sabeeli waabtighaa'a mardaati tusirroona 'il ayhim bial mawaddati waanaa 'a'lamu bimaa 'akhfaytum wamaa 'a'lantum wamany yyaf'al hu minkum faqad dal la sawaa'a aas-sabeel
'iny yyathqafookum yakoonu lakum 'a'daa' wayabsutu 'il aykum 'aydeeahum waal sinatahum bias-sooaa'i wawaddu law takfuroon
Lan tanfa'akum 'arhaamukum wal aa 'awlaadukum yawma aal qeeaamati yufsal u baynakum waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer

Qad kaanat lakum 'iswatun hasanat fi 'ibraaheema waal zeena ma'ahu 'iz qaal u liqawmihim 'innaa bura'aa'ua minkum wamimmaa ta'budoona min dooni ail laahi kafarnaa bikum wabadaa baynanaa wabaynakumu aul'adaawatu waal baghdaa'u aabadaan hattaa tu'minu bial laahi wahdahu 'il laa qawla 'ibraaheema liabeehi laastaghfiranna laka wamaa 'amliku laka mina aal laahi min sha' rrabbanaa 'al ayka tawakkal naa wail ayka 'anabnaa wail ayka aal maseer
Rabbanaa laa taj'al naa fitnat llil zeena kafaru waaghfir lanaa rabbanaa 'innaka 'anta aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Laqad kaana lakum feehim 'iswatun hasanat lliman kaana yarju aul laaha waal yawma aal aakhira wamany yyatawal la fainna aal laaha hooa aal ghaneeyu aul hameed
'asaa aal laahu 'any yyaj'al a baynakum wabayna aal zeena 'aadaytum mminhum mmawaddat waal laahu qadeer waal laahu ghafoor rraheem
Llaa yanhayaakumu aul laahu 'ani ail zeena lam yuqaatil ookum fi aid-deeni wal am yukhrijookum mmin deeaarikum 'an tabarroohum watuqsitu 'il ayhim 'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul muqsiteen

'innamaa yanhayaakumu aul laahu 'ani ail zeena qaatal ookum fi aid-deeni waakhrajookum mmin deeaarikum wazaaharu 'al aa 'ikhraajikum 'an tawal lawhum wamany yyatawal laahum faul aa'ika humu auz-zaal imoon

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa jaa'akumu aul mu'minaatu muhaajiraat faamtahinoohunna aal laahu 'a'lamu bieemaanihinna fain 'al imtumoohunna mu'minaat fal aa tarji'oohunna 'il aa aal kuffaari laa hunna hil l llaahum wal aa hum yahil loona lahunna wa'aatoohum mmaa 'anfaqu wal aa junaaha 'al aykum 'an tankihoohunna 'izaa 'aataytumoohunna 'ujoorahunna wal aa tumsiku bi'isami ail kawaafiri wasal u maa 'anfaqtum wal yasal u maa 'anfaqu zaal ikum hukmu aul laahi yahkumu baynakum waal laahu 'al eemun hakeem
Wain faatakum sha' mmin 'azwaajikum 'il aa aal kuffaari fa'aaqabtum faatu aul zeena zahabat 'azwaajuhum mmithla maa 'anfaqu waattaqu aul laaha aal zi 'antum bihi mu'minoon

Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u aizaa jaa'aka aal mu'minaatu yubayi'naka 'al aa 'al llaa yushrikna bial laahi shaya wal aa yasriqna wal aa yazneena wal aa yaqtul na 'awlaadahunna wal aa yateena bibuhtaany yaftareenahu bayna 'aydeehinna waarjul ihinna wal aa ya'seenaka fi ma'roof fabayi'hunna waastaghfir lahunna aal laaha 'inna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tatawal lawa qawmaan ghadiba aal laahu 'al ayhim qad ya'isu mina aal aakhirati kamaa ya'isa aal kuffaaru min 'ashaabi ail quboor
Sabbaha lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu lima taqooloona maa laa taf'al oon
Kabura maqtaan 'inda aal laahi 'an taqoolu maa laa taf'al oon
'inna aal laaha yuhibbu aul zeena yuqaatil oona fi sabeelihi saffa kaannahum bunyaam mmarsoos
Waiz qaal a moosaa liqawmihi yaaqawmi lima tu'zoonani waqad tta'lamoona 'anni rasoolu aul laahi 'il aykum fal ammaa zaaghu 'azaagha aal laahu qul oobahum waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aal faasiqeen

Waiz qaal a 'eesaa aabnu maryama yaabani 'israa'eela 'inni rasoolu aul laahi 'il aykum mmusaddiqa llimaa bayna yadayya mina aat-tawrayaati wamubashshiraa birasool yati mim ba'deea aasmuhu 'ahmadu fal ammaa jaa'ahum bial bayyinaati qaal u haazaa sihr mmubeen
Waman 'azlamu mimmani aiftaraa 'al aa aal laahi ail kaziba wahwa yud'aa 'il aa aal islaami waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Yureedoona leeutfiu noora aal laahi biafwaahihim waal laahu mutimm nnoorahu wal aw kariha aal kaafiroon
Hooa aal zi 'arsal a rasoolahu bial hudaa wadeeni ail haqqi leeuzhirahu 'al aa aad-deeni kul lihi wal aw kariha aal mushrikoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu hal 'adul lukum 'al aa tijaarat tunjeekum mmin 'azaabin 'al eem
Tu'minoona bial laahi warasoolihi watujaahidoona fi sabeeli ail laahi biamwaal ikum waanfusikum zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Yaghfir lakum zunoobakum wayudkhil kum jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru wamasaakina tayyibat fi jannaati 'adn zaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem
Waukhraa tuhibboonahaa nasr mmina aal laahi wafath qareeb wabashshiri ail mu'mineen

Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu koonu 'ansaara llil hi kamaa qaal a 'eesaa aabnu maryama lil hawaareeyina man 'ansaareea 'il aa aal laahi qaal a aal hawaareeyoona nahnu 'ansaaru aul laahi faamanat ttaa'ifat mmim bani 'israa'eela wakafarat ttaa'ifat fayyadnaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'al aa 'adoowihim faasbahu zaahireen
Yusabbihu lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi ail mal iki ail quddoosi ail'azeezi ail hakeem
Hooa aal zi ba'atha fi ail ummeeyina rasoola mminhum yatlu 'al ayhim 'ayaatihi wayuzakkeehim wayu'al limuhumu aul kitaaba waal hikmata wain kaanu min qablu lafi dal aal mmubeen
Wa'aakhareena minhum lammaa yal haqu bihim wahwa aal'azeezu aul hakeem
Zaal ika fadlu aul laahi yu'teehi many yyashaa'u waal laahu zoo aul fadli ail'azeem

Mathal u aul zeena hummil u aut-tawrayaata thumma lam yahmil oohaa kamathal i ail himaari yahmil u 'asfaaraa beesa mathal u aul qawmi ail zeena kazzabu biayaati ail laahi waal laahu laa yahdi ail qawma aaz-zaal imeen
Qul yayyuhaa aal zeena haadu 'in za'amtum 'annakum 'awleeaa'u lil hi min dooni ain-naasi fatamannawua aul mawta 'in kuntum saadiqeen
Wal aa yatamannawnahu 'abadaa bimaa qaddamat 'aydeehim waal laahu 'al eemu biaz-zaal imeen
Qul 'inna aal mawta aal zi tafirroona minhu fainnahu mul aaqeekum thumma turaddoona 'il aa 'aal imi ail ghaybi waash-shahaadati fayunabbeeukum bimaa kuntum ta'mal oon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'izaa noodeea lis-sal awaati miny yyawmi ail jumu'ati faas'awa 'il aa zikri ail laahi wazaru aul bay'a zaal ikum khayr llakum 'in kuntum ta'lamoon
Faizaa qudeeati ais-sal awaatu faantashiru fi ail ardi waabtaghu min fadli ail laahi waazkuru aul laaha katheera lla'al lakum tuflihoon
Waizaa raawa tijaaratan 'aw lahwaan ainfaddu 'il ayhaa watarakooka qaa'ima qul maa 'inda aal laahi  khayr mmina aal laahwi wamina aat-tijaarati waal laahu khayru aur-raaziqeen
'izaa jaa'aka aal munaafiqoona qaal u nashhadu 'innaka larasoolu aul laahi waal laahu ya'lamu 'innaka larasooluhu waal laahu yashhadu 'inna aal munaafiqeena lakaaziboon
Aattakhazu 'aymaanahum junnat fasaddu 'an sabeeli ail laahi 'innahum saa'a maa kaanu ya'mal oon
Zaal ika biannahum 'aamanu thumma kafaru fatubi'a 'al aa qul oobihim fahum laa yafqahoon

Waizaa raytahum tu'jibuka 'ajsaamuhum wainy yyaqoolu tasma' liqawlihim kaannahum khushub mmusannadat yahsiboona kul la sayhatin 'al ayhim humu aul'adoowu faahzarhum qaatal ahumu aul laahu 'annaa yu'fakoon
Waizaa qeela lahum ta'aal awa yastaghfir lakum rasoolu aul laahi lawawa ru'oosahum waraytahum yasuddoona wahum mmustakbiroon
Sawaa'un 'al ayhim 'astaghfarta lahum 'am lam tastaghfir lahum lany yyaghfira aal laahu lahum 'inna aal laaha laa yahdi ail qawma aal faasiqeen
Humu aul zeena yaqooloona laa tunfiqu 'al aa man 'inda rasooli ail laahi hattaa yanfaddu wal il hi khazaa'inu aus-samaawaati waal ardi wal aakinna aal munaafiqeena laa yafqahoon
Yaqooloona la'ir rraja'naa 'il aa aal madeenati layukhrijanna aal a'azzu minhaa aal azal la wal il hi ail'izzatu wal irasoolihi wal il mu'mineena wal aakinna aal munaafiqeena laa ya'lamoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu laa tul hikum 'amwaal ukum wal aa 'awlaadukum 'an zikri ail laahi wamany yyaf'al zaal ika faul aa'ika humu aul khaasiroon
Waanfiqu mim mmaa razaqnaakum mmin qabli 'any yyateea 'ahadakumu aul mawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawlaa 'akhkhartani 'il aa 'ajal qareeb faassaddaqa waakum mmina aas-saal iheen
Wal any yyu'akhkhira aal laahu nafsaan 'izaa jaa 'ajal uhaa waal laahu khabeeru bimaa ta'mal oon
Yusabbihu lil hi maa fi ais-samaawaati wamaa fi ail ardi lahu aul mul ku wal ahu aul hamdu wahwa 'al aa kul li sha' qadeer
Hooa aal zi khal aqakum faminkum kaafir waminkum mmu'minw waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona baseer
Khal aqa aas-samaawaati waal arda bial haqqi wasawwarakum faahsana sooarakum wail ayhi ail maseer
Ya'lamu maa fi ais-samaawaati waal ardi waya'lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu'linoona waal laahu 'al eemu bizaati ais-sudoor
'al am yatikum naba'ua aul zeena kafaru min qablu fazaaqu wabaal a 'amrihim wal ahum 'azaabun 'al eem
Zaal ika biannahu kaanat ttateehim rusul uhum bial bayyinaati faqaal u 'abashar yahdoonanaa fakafaru watawal la wwaastaghnaa aal laahu waal laahu ghaneeyun hameed
Za'ama aal zeena kafaru 'al llany yyub'athu qul bal aa warabbi latub'athunna thumma latunabba'unna bimaa 'amil tum wazaal ika 'al aa aal laahi yaseer
Faaminu bial laahi warasoolihi waan-noori ail zi 'anzal naa waal laahu bimaa ta'mal oona khabeer

Yawma yajma'ukum leeawmi ail jam'i zaal ika yawmu aut-taghaabuni wamany yyu'mim bial laahi waya'mal saal iha nnukaffir 'anhu sayyiaatihi wanudkhil hu jannaat tajri min tahtihaa aal anhaaru khaal ideena feehaa 'abada zaal ika aal fawzu aul'azeem
Waal zeena kafaru wakazzabu biayaatinaa 'ul aa'ika 'ashaabu aun-naari khaal ideena feehaa wabeesa aal maseer
Maa 'asaaba mim mmuseebatin 'il laa biizni ail laahi wamany yyu'mim bial laahi yahdi qal bahu waal laahu bikul li sha'in 'al eem
Waatee'u aul laaha waatee'u aur-rasoola fain tawal laytum fainnamaa 'al aa rasoolinaa aal bal aaghu aul mubeen
Aul laahu laa 'il aaha 'il laa hooa wa'al aa aal laahi fal yatawakkal i ail mu'minoon
Yayyuhaa aal zeena 'aamanu 'inna min 'azwaajikum waawlaadikum 'adoowa llakum faahzaroohum wain ta'fu watasfahu wataghfiru fainna aal laaha ghafoor rraheem
'innamaa 'amwaal ukum waawlaadukum fitnat waal laahu 'indahu 'ajrun 'azeem
Faattaqu aul laaha maa aastata'tum waasma'u waatee'u waanfiqu khayra llianfusikum wamany yyooqa shuhha nafsihi faul aa'ika humu aul muflihoon
'in tuqridu aul laaha qardaan hasana yudaa'ifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum waal laahu shakoorun hal eem
'aal imu aul ghaybi waash-shahaadati ail'azeezu aul hakeem

Yayyuhaa aan-nabiaa'u aizaa tal laqtumu aun-nisaa'a fatal liqoohunna li'iddatihinna waahsu aul'iddata waattaqu aul laaha rabbakum laa tukhrijoohunna mim beeootihinna wal aa yakhrujna 'il laa 'any yyateena bifaahishat mmubayyinat watil ka hudoodu aul laahi wamany yyata'adda hudooda aal laahi faqad zal ama nafsahu laa tadri la'al la aal laaha yuhdithu ba'da zaal ika 'amr
